jobs.title: Senior Airport Design Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Design Engineer, you can experience the following:

• National and International Aviation Exposure: Work on cutting-edge projects across national and global airports.
• Career Development Opportunities: Engage in continuous learning within a thriving aviation environment.
• Leadership Opportunities: Contribute to and lead initiatives in airport design practice.

The Impact You'll Make:

• Design of airport engineering projects including runways, taxiways, aprons, airfield lighting, navigational aids, etc.
• Preparation of engineering design reports, construction plans, and contract documents / technical specifications.
• Experience in design of general civil engineering projects including site design, sanitary wastewater, water and hydraulic evaluation a plus.

The Expertise You'll Bring:

• B.S. Degree in Civil Engineering
• Professional Engineer (PE designation) preferred.
• 8+ years of experience in the civil engineering field; aviation related experience and knowledgeable of FAA criteria a plus
• Ability to coordinate multiple project tasks
• Self-motivated and able to handle a fast-paced position
• Goal and deadline orientated
• Excellent interpersonal skills, verbal and written communication skills
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Microsoft Office

Why You'll Thrive at Egis

At Egis, you'll do more than build your career—you'll help shape the future of infrastructure. As we continue to expand across the United States, we're looking for curious, collaborative professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and delivering projects that improve communities and create lasting impact.

Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading experts, collaborate across disciplines and borders, and contribute to projects that transform the way people live, move, and connect. Here, you'll be empowered to take on meaningful work, develop new skills, and grow your career with the support of a global engineering leader.

What Sets Egis Apart

• Meaningful Projects – Contribute to complex infrastructure projects that strengthen communities and improve quality of life.
• Global Expertise, Local Impact – Collaborate with technical specialists across North America and around the world while delivering solutions that make a difference locally.
• Career Growth – Expand your skills through mentorship, professional development, technical training, and leadership opportunities.
• A Culture of Collaboration – Thrive in an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and teamwork drives success.
• Opportunity to Grow with Us – Join a rapidly expanding organization where your ideas, contributions, and career can grow alongside the business.

Total Rewards That Support You

We believe great work starts with supporting our people. That's why Egis offers a comprehensive Total Rewards program designed to promote your health, well-being, financial security, and professional growth, including:

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage
• 401(k) retirement plan with company match
• Paid time off and flexible holiday program
• Flexible work arrangements, including hybrid and remote opportunities where business needs allow
• Life insurance and disability coverage, including maternity leave
• Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions
• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for healthcare and dependent care expenses
• Paid family leave
• Wellness programs supporting physical and mental well-being
• Education assistance, professional development, and continuing learning opportunities
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
• Employee discount programs

At Egis, we're committed to creating an environment where talented people can do their best work, continue to grow professionally, and build rewarding, long-term careers.

Equal Employer

Egis is proudly committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse and inclusive workforce. Egis provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

All positions at Egis require an applicant who has accepted an employment offer to undergo pre-employment screening. jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Purpose of the Position

The Finance Manager oversees accounting, financial reporting, tax compliance, treasury, budgeting, and forecasting across multiple U.S. legal entities. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, effective cash flow management, project profitability, and compliance with Group policies and U.S. regulations.

The position works closely with U.S. leadership and European headquarters to support financial planning, business performance, and strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee full-cycle accounting, monthly financial close, account reconciliations, and financial reporting for both stow’s sales & manufacturing entities, in close collaboration with local sales & plant management;
• Manage project-based accounting, including Percentage of Completion (POC), revenue recognition, project costs, and profitability.
• Oversee accounting and reporting across multiple legal entities, including intercompany transactions and reconciliations.
• Ensure compliance with applicable U.S. tax requirements, including sales and use tax.
• Manage treasury activities, cash flow forecasting, liquidity, payments, and working capital.
• Lead annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, variance analysis, and financial planning.
• Prepare financial reports and KPIs and provide insights to support management decisions.
• Maintain internal controls and ensure compliance with Group policies and local regulations.
• Collaborate with U.S. leadership and European headquarters on financial performance and reporting.
• Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, systems, and operational efficiency.

Required Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• Experience in financial management, accounting, and financial reporting.
• Experience with Percentage of Completion (POC) / Project-Based Accounting.
• Experience managing multiple legal entities and intercompany transactions.
• Strong knowledge of financial close, multi state tax compliance, treasury management, and cash flow forecasting.
• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
• ERP experience; SAP R/3 preferred.
• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Experience in a (start-up) manufacturing environment is required

Key Stakeholders

The Finance Manager will report to the Group Finance Director in Global Headquarters, and will have a dotted line to the Managing Director, while managing direct and indirect reports/shared services.

What do we offer you?

• PTO, sick leave, & paid holidays
• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
• Company paid Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
• Company Paid Life Insurance
• Company Paid Accidental Death & Dismemberment
• 401K with employer match, currently 4%
• Partial Tuition Reimbursement after 12 months
• Gross Salary

Quality, Safety, Health, Environment, Compliance

Every employee at stow contributes to a safe and compliant work environment. We set the example and motivate each other to work safely, efficiently, and in a qualitative way. stow’s standards, policies, instructions, and local legislations are there to guide our decisions.

EEO

stow provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. stow prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, age, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer - Medical Communications
jobs.description:
Klick is hiring a Senior Medical Writer to develop scientifically accurate, strategically aligned medical communications for life sciences clients. This role partners closely with Medical Strategy, Science & Regulatory, Client Services, Project Management, and Creative teams to deliver clear scientific storytelling across traditional and digital channels. The Senior Medical Writer will support client-facing work, contribute to strategic recommendations, and help maintain high-quality content standards across multiple therapeutic areas.

What You’ll Do

• Develop scientific platforms, lexicons, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, peer-to-peer slide decks, advisory board reports, training content, and digital medical communications.
• Interpret clinical data, literature, product strategy, and therapeutic area context into clear scientific narratives for healthcare audiences.
• Review medical communications deliverables for scientific accuracy, client brief alignment, quality control standards, and appropriate incorporation of feedback.
• Collaborate with Medical Strategy, Science & Regulatory, Client Services, Project Management, Design, and client stakeholders to meet timelines, budgets, and project objectives.
• Contribute to proposal development, client discussions, new project ideas, and mentorship of junior medical writers on defined deliverables.

Required:

• 5+ years of medical communications writing experience, preferably in an agency environment, across multiple client-facing deliverables.
• Degree in life sciences, with PhD, MD, PharmD, or other advanced scientific degree preferred.
• Experience developing manuscripts, abstracts, posters, scientific slide decks, advisory board reports, or medical education materials for healthcare audiences.
• Demonstrated ability to conduct literature reviews, synthesize clinical data, and translate complex science into clear, accurate medical narratives.
• Experience presenting or discussing scientific content with pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences clients and cross-functional teams.
• Working knowledge of scientific databases, referencing tools, approval platforms, or related resources used in medical communications.

Desired:

• Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
• Experience developing digital healthcare communications, omnichannel medical content, or interactive training programs.
• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas, with evidence of quickly learning and applying new clinical context.
• Experience contributing to pitch work, proposal development, or strategic medical communications planning.
• Experience mentoring associate or junior medical writers on scientific content quality and project execution.

#LI-MK1

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at careers@klick.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.

jobs.title: FP & A
jobs.description:
Life is too short to work with jerks.

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction. Our ecosystem is rooted in our five core values: Relentless Positivity, Growth Obsessed, Get it Done, Helpful Spirit, and Solution Driven.

We are not just coworkers, but a community, working tirelessly towards 'Spreading the Smile' to our members, agents, and each other. NCD is at the forefront of dental and vision insurance, in partnership with our carrier partners MetLife, VSP, and Zurich. Our continuous growth is a testament to our commitment to delivering outstanding agent and customer satisfaction.

If you are ready to win each day, are eager to grow, and aspire to contribute to an organization that is setting the pace in the industry, then we are looking for you. Together, let’s drive change and take NCD to new heights. Join us and become a vital part of our success story as we continue to transform lives and 'Spread the Smile.

Location: Remote (U.S.). Preference for candidates in Greater Detroit, Dallas-Fort Worth, Memphis, or Kansas City who can work hybrid.

The Role

NCD is looking for a Director, FP&A to build and lead the planning function. You will own the budget, forecast, long-range plan, and decision support across the company, and you will be the CFO's partner on capital planning, lender reporting, and new business. Expect to be a player-coach: you will build models yourself while you hire and develop the team. Finance at NCD already uses AI tools in its daily work, and you will decide where they can improve the planning process.

Summary

NCD earns its revenue as broker of record, program administrator, and administrator for its carrier partners, paid through commissions and administrative fees on premium. Results depend on member enrollment, persistency, distributor mix, and carrier terms. The business is growing and adding products, and the planning process has to grow with it. The Director, FP&A designs the planning process for a larger and more complex NCD and makes sure leadership has numbers it can act on.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead the planning calendar: annual operating plan, rolling forecast, and three-year plan.

• Design FP&A processes that scale: a fixed planning calendar, department ownership of inputs, version control, model documentation, and review controls.

• Own the driver-based company model and the P&Ls by carrier program, product line, and distribution channel. Set the standard for analysis across Finance.

• Run the monthly business review with the executive team: results, variances, and the actions that follow.

• Own cash, liquidity, and debt capacity forecasting. Prepare lender and owner reporting and support financing discussions.

• Evaluate new products, carrier programs, distributor agreements, and acquisitions. Build the case and present a recommendation.

• Partner with the Data team on the metrics layer and dashboards Finance relies on. Set Finance's data priorities and decide what belongs in a model versus a BI tool.

• Set how FP&A uses AI. Identify the recurring work that AI tools can take over or speed up, such as data pulls, reconciliations, lender and audit request packages, and first-draft commentary. Put those workflows in place and set the review standard for their output.

• Select and implement a planning tool when the business needs one.

• Hire, develop, and manage FP&A analysts.

• Support the annual audit, valuations, and owner reporting.

• Other duties as assigned.

Must-Have Skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a quantitative field.

• 8+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, corporate development, or Big 4, including at least 3 years leading FP&A or planning at an operating company.

• Has built or scaled FP&A processes at a growing company: put the planning calendar, forecast cadence, and reporting in place where they did not exist or no longer fit.

• Expert financial modeling, including three-statement models, capital structure, and debt.

• Experience presenting results and recommendations to executives, lenders, or investors.

• Experience managing and developing analysts.

• Data fluency: has worked closely with data or BI teams, can read SQL, and knows what reliable metric definitions look like.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• 1-2 years in investment banking or at a Big 4 firm.

• Experience in insurance distribution, an MGA or program administrator, healthcare, or another commission-based business.

• Experience with credit facilities and lender reporting, acquisitions and integration, or preparing a company for its first audit.

• Has selected and implemented a planning tool.

• Hands-on SQL, and experience with BigQuery, dbt, Omni, or a similar analytics stack.

• Has used AI tools to redesign a finance process, not only to speed up individual tasks.

• MBA, CPA, or CFA.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 to 180 Days

• By 90 days: you have assessed the current models, planning calendar, and reporting, delivered a written plan for the FP&A function, and are running the monthly business review.

• By 180 days: the annual plan runs on a set calendar with named department owners, a rolling forecast is in place, lender and owner reporting packages are standardized, and hiring for the team is underway.

NCD Benefits

• Company-paid health, dental, life, and disability insurance

• 401(k) with employer match

• Opportunity for professional development

• Work from home allowance and support

• Positive work environment

• Remote, office-based flexibility within the United States of America

Equal Opportunity

NCD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe our differences make us stronger and help us better serve our members, agents, partners, and each other.

SPREADING THE SMILE

jobs.title: Graduate Development Program (GDP) | International Engineering Traineeship
jobs.description:
Het Graduate Development Program

Ben jij recent afgestudeerd met een master in een technische richting en klaar om jouw kennis in de praktijk te brengen? Met het Graduate Development Program start je jouw carrière in een internationale productieomgeving.

Dit 12-maandenprogramma biedt je de kans om onze technologieën, productieprocessen en organisatie van dichtbij te leren kennen. Je werkt samen met ervaren engineers, technische specialisten en operationele leiders en ontwikkelt je zowel professioneel als persoonlijk.

Internationale ervaring en ontwikkeling in Nederland

Tijdens het programma doe je ervaring op binnen verschillende disciplines, waaronder productie, maintenance, quality en continuous improvement. Daarnaast neem je deel aan drie internationale rotaties binnen O-I-locaties in Europa. Je ontdekt verschillende productietechnologieën, werkt samen met internationale collega's en bouwt een waardevol netwerk op.

Na afloop bekijken we samen welke functie binnen onze Nederlandse organisatie het beste aansluit bij jouw talenten en ambities. Zo leg je een stevige basis voor een langdurige carrière bij O-I.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch sterk en ambitieus. Je neemt initiatief, werkt graag samen en voelt je thuis in een internationale, technische omgeving.

Daarnaast:

• Heb je een afgeronde masteropleiding in bijvoorbeeld Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Chemische Technologie, Industrial Engineering & Management of een vergelijkbare technische richting.
• Beheers je de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.
• Ben je bereid internationaal te reizen.
• Heb je interesse in productieprocessen, technologie en continue verbetering.

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een internationaal ontwikkelprogramma van 12 maanden met intensieve begeleiding.
• Praktijkervaring binnen verschillende technische disciplines en Europese productielocaties.
• Samenwerking met ervaren professionals en technische experts.
• Een marktconform traineesalaris en doorgroeimogelijkheden.
• 24 vakantiedagen en 26 ADV-dagen.
• Een 13e maand in december en een resultaatafhankelijke bonus.
• Een goede cao, pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We're hiring a Growth Marketing Lead to build and scale the growth engine for Rippling IT. This is not a traditional marketing role. You'll combine buyer obsession, technical depth, analytical rigor, and GTM creativity to turn our IT buyer context into repeatable growth strategies across paid channels, cross-sell, SDR outreach, lifecycle marketing, and product launch motions.

The world of IT has changed. The average employee now operates alongside dozens of AI tools and unreviewed OAuth grants. Shadow AI has become the new Shadow IT, with a far larger blast radius. The legacy IT stack — identity, MDM, ticketing, compliance as separate point tools — can't keep up.

Rippling IT is the IT infrastructure for the AI era: one platform that unifies identity, devices, and compliance on a single data graph, so policy is set once and enforced everywhere, for every employee and every agent. It is one of Rippling's most strategic and fastest-growing business lines, with an ambitious set of launches planned for the coming months.

This person will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, BizOps, Product, and the IT GM. The job is to diagnose where growth is bottlenecked, build the system or play to unlock it, and then scale that motion through the teams already on the field. The bar is someone who can get deep into the weeds without getting stuck there: prioritize sharply, influence across functions, and turn analysis into shipped GTM motion.

What you will do

• Develop a deep, ongoing understanding of the IT buyer through customer conversations, sales calls, win/loss analysis, product usage, competitive research and funnel data, using those insights to continuously reshape the GTM strategy
• Own high-leverage growth programs for Rippling IT from problem diagnosis and buyer insight through testing, measurement, and scaled rollout
• Turn validated IT buyer and product insights into coordinated growth plays across acquisition, cross-sell, SDR, lifecycle, field, partner, and product launch channels
• Build AI-native, technically sophisticated GTM workflows across prospecting, audience building, enrichment, personalization, experimentation, routing, and campaign automation
• Identify funnel and pipeline bottlenecks, then partner with RevOps, BizOps, GTM engineering, marketing, and sales to remove them
• Partner with cross-sell marketing to develop plays that convert HR and Finance customers into IT customers
• Partner with product marketing and demand generation on launches for an ambitious roadmap of path-breaking IT products
• Move fluidly between strategy and execution: build the model, write the brief, inspect the data, pressure-test the message, and push the work across the finish line
• Make the central IT GTM team more effective by creating repeatable systems, playbooks, and experiments that can scale 10x across many areas

What you will need

• Experience in growth, GTM engineering, growth marketing, BizOps, RevOps, or another technical growth role at a high-growth B2B company; exact title matters less than demonstrated range and impact
• Strong technical fluency and comfort using data, AI, automation, and modern GTM tooling to build scalable systems, not just dashboards or recommendations
• A track record of identifying growth opportunities, prioritizing effectively, shipping experiments or programs, and scaling what works across teams
• Excellent analytical judgment, with the ability to go deep without getting trapped in analysis or local optimization
• Strong cross-functional influence: you can get work done through people you do not directly manage across sales, marketing, ops, product, and leadership
• High clock speed, low ego, and a bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
• A clear, demonstrated point of view on AI in GTM, not as a buzzword, but as something you're using daily to change how growth work gets done

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.  For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

The Phlebotomist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Phlebotomist provides expert phlebotomy services and must demonstrate excellent customer service and communication skills. The phlebotomist must have the ability to function as part of a highly effective team that consistently puts “Patients First”.

The Phlebotomist is responsible for venipuncture collection and specimen processing. Other responsibilities include but are not limited to order entry in multiple systems, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval and lab reception/clerical duties and functions

Responsibilities:

· Performs phlebotomy and other lab specimen collections per age related standards and in accordance with departmental policies, protocols and procedures.

· Demonstrates AIDET model and optimizes patient safety to reduce the likelihood of medical/health care errors.

· Receives and reviews physician orders; ensures that all necessary information is included for appropriate lab services. Enters accurate orders for lab tests in accordance with department policies, protocols and procedures.

· Patient communication model and provides appropriate post-phlebotomy patient care.

· Processes specimens in a timely manner to ensure stability and integrity of samples including labeling, centrifuging, aliquoting, freezing and packaging specimens for transport in accordance with established protocols and policies.

· Reviews/Records refrigerator temperature(s) and QC/QA records. Areas of concern are recorded through the Corrective Action Log and reported to maintenance for repair. Findings are reported to supervisor or manager.

· Understands the operation and maintenance of equipment pertinent to the job. Follows up with all outstanding orders on manifest log, and communicates all timed, completed or uncompleted draws/charges/results as appropriate

· Communicates and notifies Laboratory and/or Physician of problems with specimen procurement for optimal care

· Maintains a safe work environment, holds self-accountable for safe work practices; including adhering to biohazard waste procedures and ensuring proper storage and timely pickup of biohazardous waste.

· Performs lab-related clerical duties include but not limited to order entry, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval as well as utilization of email, medical record systems, handheld and desktop devices, ordering and maintaining supply inventory, filing and sanitizing equipment as necessary

· Uses department’s resources efficiently; participates in efforts to reduce costs and streamline work processes.

· Adheres to continuing education expectations; completes and signs-off on competency assessments

· Demonstrates the value of teamwork on a consistent basis; interacts with and assists others in a professional manner

· Applies critical thinking, sound decision making and judgment to investigate and resolve challenging situations

· Complies with all organizational policies regarding ethical business practices.

· Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• High School diploma or equivalent.

Certification:

• ·Phlebotomy certification through a nationally recognized organization or training from a phlebotomy school or medical institution or one or more years of phlebotomy experience in a healthcare setting or CMA certification.

Preferred:

· Experience performing phlebotomy on a broad range of patient’s types.

· Experience with processing lab specimens, transferring specimens, and handling a centrifuge.

· Familiar with medical EMR systems.

· Knowledge of medical terminology.

jobs.title: Forensic Psychology Dissertation Chair/Committee Member Faculty
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

The Forensic Psychology PhD program. Adjunct faculty members' primary responsibility will be to chair and/or serve as second members on doctoral dissertation committees as methodologists and/or content experts. Infrequently, and based on student enrollment, Adjunct Faculty may be invited to instruct content courses or research methodology courses for which they are credentialed to teach. Participation in Mentor Training will be provided and required.

Adjunct faculty members serve in a part-time capacity to educate Walden University students by effectively and proficiently using online technology and resources so that knowledge, information, feedback, and critique are imparted to and shared with students in thoughtful, carefully formulated, well-written, and timely communications. This is accomplished in an environment that is respectful of the student, the Faculty Member, Walden University, and the discipline in which the Faculty Member is involved. Faculty Members are expected to adhere to all Walden University Faculty expectations, which are clearly set forth to the Faculty Member at the start of their employment with the University.

Responsibilities

• Dissertation Committee Service (Primary Responsibility): Chair and/or serve as a second committee member on doctoral dissertations, providing methodological and/or content expertise to forensic psychology doctoral candidates.
• Training: All new Faculty Members receive specific training from Walden University in teaching techniques, use of the electronic learning platform, policies and procedures of the School or College in which they will teach, socialization into Walden University culture, assessment of academic integrity of student work (including use of www.turnitin.com), and research supervision of theses and dissertations.
• Course Teaching (Secondary Responsibility): When assigned a course, Faculty Members teach using the Canvas platform and are responsible for interacting with students within it. Discussion boards are open 24/7; postings may be made at any time but must be completed in a timely manner per the Faculty Handbook. Responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hours. Faculty Members are required to verify the accuracy of student postings and submissions and to provide feedback and grades through Canvas.
• Availability: Faculty are expected to be reasonably accessible to students, including outside the course discussion board, and to provide substantive feedback on assignments and postings. Faculty publish their availability through course syllabi, instructor information in the classroom, and/or other appropriate documents. Regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or chats, is suggested.
• Residencies: Faculty Members may be required to attend residencies held domestically or internationally to teach intensives and colloquia and facilitate school- and university-wide discussions. (Part-time faculty may, but are not required to, attend.)
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Complies with all Walden University policies and standards

• Ph.D. in Forensic Psychology or a related field from an accredited institution required
• Forensic experience at the doctoral level preferred
• One year of experience serving on doctoral committees preferred (experience chairing a committee preferred)
• Evidence of continuing scholarly or creative work within the past 5 years; proficient in APA 7th edition
• Strong research methodology background in quantitative, qualitative, and/or mixed methods (preference given to quantitative)
• Excellent leadership, communication, teamwork, and human relations skills
• At least 1,000 hours of direct forensic psychology experience over five years, or completion of a 2,000-hour formal postdoctoral fellowship in forensic psychology

Technology Requirements

• Adjunct faculty provide their own laptops and are expected to use the Walden University Learning Management System and Microsoft 365 tools with their assigned Walden email addresses in all Walden activities. Walden University provides a Walden email account and access to the learning platform, password-protected faculty sections of the website, university and college cloud services, and other faculty communication tools.
• Faculty Members must be able to use Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), zip software, and Adobe Acrobat, and must have reliable internet access as well as alternate access in case primary access becomes unavailable.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Additional information

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

• Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
• Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.

Penguin Random House is seeking a dynamic, self-motivated Customer Service Representative to join our growing Distribution Services Support Center in Westminster, Maryland. This position can either be office based or remote.

Regular working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern time.

Our Customer Service organization continues to evolve, representatives will work within a team environment, and within an integrated customer service environment utilizing ticketing and communication platforms alongside SAP and other business applications.  The ideal candidate must be analytical, customer-focused, adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where organization, sound judgment, and accountability are essential, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Candidates must demonstrate a professional and approachable communication style, strong listening skills, and a commitment to exceptional customer service and the highest standards of professional ethics. Maintain accurate interaction records, and provide timely, professional responses.

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor - Tanger Outlets Grand Rapids
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $14.25 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Campus President
jobs.description:
The Campus President is the senior leader responsible for driving overall campus performance, operational excellence, academic quality, and student success. This dual role combines strategic leadership, operational oversight, and academic stewardship to ensure that every student receives a high-quality educational experience, and the campus meets institutional goals for enrollment, retention, compliance, and financial health.

The President leads cross-functional teams in admissions, financial aid, academics, student persistence, and business operations—fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and mission-driven service.

Strategic & Operational Leadership

• Serve as the chief campus executive, accountable for overall performance, compliance, and culture.
• Lead all campus operations including admissions, financial aid, business office, registrar, student success, and academic programs.
• Translate institutional strategy into local execution, driving key outcomes across enrollment, persistence, financial health, and academic outcomes.
• Maintain full campus P&L accountability: manage revenue, expenses, and operating margin; partner with finance to monitor A/R, collections, and bad debt.
• Ensure operational excellence through daily KPI monitoring, weekly leadership cadence, and timely executive reporting.

Academic & Student Experience Oversight

• Oversee all academic programs, ensuring compliance with institutional, accreditor, and board standards.
• Supervise faculty utilization, scheduling, classroom delivery, and evaluation processes.
• Ensure all faculty observations and academic reporting (attendance, grades, SAP) are completed accurately and on time.
• Champion a student-centered environment that promotes engagement, satisfaction, and outcomes.
• Lead retention and persistence strategies with the Student Persistence Specialist, Deans, and Registrar.

Enrollment, Retention & Financial Accountability

• Achieve or exceed enrollment start goals; ensure full compliance with admissions and packaging processes.
• Drive retention and graduation rates aligned with budget and institutional benchmarks.
• Partner with business office on collections and financial counseling strategies to minimize bad debt.
• Maintain compliance with Title IV, FERPA, ADA, and accreditation standards.

Team Leadership & Culture

• Hire, coach, and retain high-performing department leaders.
• Establish a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Conduct regular one-on-ones, team meetings, and campus updates to drive communication and alignment.
• Promote professional development and training completion for all staff and faculty.

Compliance & Accreditation

• Maintain audit readiness; achieve zero critical or repeat findings.
• Ensure timely completion of corrective actions and submission of required reports.
• Uphold accreditor and regulatory standards across all departments.

Community Engagement

• Represent the institution with professionalism and integrity.
• Build and maintain relationships with employers, advisory boards, and community partners to strengthen placement outcomes and campus reputation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Financial Health: Meets/exceeds revenue and margin goals; controls expenses and bad debt within thresholds.
• Enrollment Growth: Achieves start goals, packaging timelines, and conversion benchmarks.
• Student Success: Meets/exceeds persistence, retention, graduation, and placement benchmarks.
• Academic Quality: 100% faculty observations completed; utilization within benchmarks; zero accreditation deficiencies.
• Compliance: Zero critical audit findings; timely Title IV disbursements and reporting.
• Culture & Talent: Staff turnover within thresholds; training completion 100%; positive engagement survey results.
• Student Experience: NPS at/above institutional benchmark; ≥40% survey participation.

Salary range: $150,000-185,000/annually

• Master’s degree in education, Business, or related field (required); Terminal degree preferred.
• 7+ years leadership experience in campus operations or academic administration.
• Proven track record managing multi-functional teams in a higher education setting.
• Demonstrated success achieving operational and academic KPIs.
• Strong understanding of Title IV, accreditation, and regulatory requirements.
• Excellent communication, financial acumen, and people leadership skills.

We Offer:

• Medical, Dental and Vision starting the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment
• 2 Weeks’ starting Vacation per year. Increasing based on years of service with company
• 12 paid Holidays and 2 Floating Holiday
• 401k with company match
• Company Paid Life Insurance at 1x’s your annual salary
• Leadership development and training for career advancement
• Tuition assistance and Forgiveness for you and your family up to 100% depending on the program

jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

Contribute your technical skills to design and develop manufacturing equipment for the Multiport Accessories Process Engineering organization, with a focus on high-volume automation. The candidate will take responsibility for equipment development from initial concept and detailed mechanical design through fabrication, testing, qualification, and release to production.

The candidate will design and develop in-house proprietary manufacturing equipment and will also evaluate external automation suppliers, define detailed equipment specifications, and provide technical oversight to OEMs. The candidate must demonstrate strong mechanical design fundamentals, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to coordinate within cross-functional teams. They must excel in a high-energy environment and be capable of making sound decisions when faced with time constraints and incomplete information.

Essential Job Duties

• Design and develop in-house manufacturing equipment, automation systems, tooling, and fixtures from concept through release to production.
• Translate manufacturing process needs into detailed equipment requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria.
• Develop 3D models, engineering drawings, tolerance analyses, bills of material, and supporting technical documentation.
• Integrate mechanical designs with robotics, sensors, motors, pneumatics, motion control, machine vision, and safety systems.
• Evaluate and select OEMs and system integrators based on technical capabilities and project requirements.
• Develop detailed specifications for externally sourced automation equipment and provide technical oversight through design, build, testing, installation, and qualification.
• Lead equipment design reviews, risk assessments, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving activities.
• Guide equipment projects through applicable design control, engineering change, qualification, and release processes.
• Develop equipment testing strategies, acceptance criteria, qualification protocols, maintenance requirements, and calibration procedures.
• Apply Cpk, Gauge R&R, tolerance analysis, and other statistical and quality tools to improve equipment capability and reliability.
• Provide equipment-related technical support for production operations, continuous improvement, capacity expansion, and equipment lifecycle management.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, technicians, and cross-functional project team members.

Required Skills and Experience

• Experience with high volume automation lines.
• Fundamental understanding of process engineering, equipment, test and the manufacturing environment “Self-starter” attitude and comfort in a hands-on environment, where he/she can demonstrate an ability to work with other engineers to influence product design to improve reliability
• Demonstrated experience designing and releasing manufacturing equipment or complex automated systems into production.
• Proficiency in 3D CAD and engineering drawing development. SolidWorks experience is preferred.
• Strong understanding of mechanical design, mechanism development, GD&T, tolerance analysis, material selection, and manufacturing processes.
• Ability to integrate mechatronic components such as robotics, sensors, motors, pneumatics, motion control, and machine vision systems.
• Experience developing equipment requirements and detailed technical specifications for automation OEMs or system integrators.
• Experience reviewing supplier concepts, designs, drawings, component selections, and equipment acceptance plans.
• Experience with equipment qualification, process validation, and regulated quality systems.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, project execution, and technical documentation skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Self-motivated, able to take initiative, and effective in a multidisciplinary team environment.

Required Education and Training

• BS/MS degree in Mechanical engineering or a related engineering discipline.
• Minimum of eight years of relevant experience developing manufacturing equipment or automation systems.
• Direct experience in medical device manufacturing is required.
• Staff-level consideration will require additional technical depth and demonstrated leadership of complex equipment or automation projects.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience in an ISO 13485 regulated medical device manufacturing environment.
• Experience designing equipment for high-volume assembly of medical devices or precision products.
• Experience managing internally designed equipment and externally sourced turnkey automation systems.
• Experience with OEM selection, technical bid evaluation, design reviews, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, and production qualification.
• Familiarity with design controls, risk management, engineering change control, and equipment validation.
• Experience with Windchill and Agile product lifecycle management systems is a strong plus.
• Experience mentoring engineers or establishing equipment design standards and engineering best practices.

jobs.description:
The CT Technologist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Maintains accountability for patient safety throughout the imaging process, including screening, preparation, monitoring, and post-procedure care.
• Produces diagnostic-quality images using approved protocols and professional standards.
• Apply professional judgment within approved protocols to optimize image quality and address imaging challenges.
• Reviews images prior to exam completion and initiates corrective action when diagnostic adequacy is not met.
• Administers contrast in accordance with policy, including screening for contraindications and patient monitoring (as applicable).
• Operates imaging equipment and maintains imaging room readiness.
• Identifies equipment performance issues and initiates follow-up through established service processes.
• Coordinates exam flow and prioritizes time-sensitive studies.
• Maintains accurate and timely documentation in medical record and image archive system, including exam set-up, image routing, result availability and charging accuracy.
• Adheres to organizational values, ethical standards, and compliance requirements.
• Consistently upholds all applicable quality and safety standards within diagnostic imaging, such as radiation safety, MRI safety, Infection prevention measures safe practices (as applicable to the role) to protect self, patients, visitors and team members
• Ensures a positive patient experience throughout care delivery
• Supports department initiatives to improve relationships, reliability, efficiency, growth
• Supports additional responsibilities aligned with patient care and department needs
• Verifies orders and confirms protocol.
• Positions and immobilizes patient on examining table.
• Positions patients and selects anatomic and technical parameters accurately and uses ALARA principles during examinations.
• Assures patient, staff and personal safety by adhering to established standards including positively confirming Right Patient and Right Exam.
• Establishes IV access for contrast administration and related lab draws.
• Administers contrast media oral and/or IV contrast in accordance with department policies and procedures, patient history indicators, exam protocols and physician orders and follows through with post exam instructions.
• Prepares for and assists the physician in computed tomography procedures, including interventional procedures.
• Enters data such as type of scan, slice thickness, scan time and other technical data into computer.
• Communicates with patient before and during procedure; monitors safety, comfort.
• Validates that all required series, images, protocols and reconstructions are complete and meet established image quality standards.
• Assures complete study transfer to PACS for radiologist interpretation.
• Performs CT equipment QA and maintains required logs.
• Performs clerical tasks such as receiving orders, scheduling patients, and recordkeeping.
• Maintains and cleans work area and equipment; replenishes supplies as needed

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• Graduate of an accredited Radiology Technologist Program

Licensure:

• Illinois Emergency Management Agency (IEMA) Accreditation

Certification:

• Basic Life Support (BLS)

Preferred:

• 1 year experience
• American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) Computed Tomography (CT) certification within 12 months of hire or 10+ years directly relevant experience in lieu of certification.

You’ll combine product expertise, strategic thinking, and people leadership to improve the technology that helps golf course operators manage their businesses and drive growth. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and business leadership, you’ll translate business objectives into coordinated product priorities and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, adoption, and commercial performance.

You’ll bring an AI-native approach to Product Management, using AI and modern tools to improve effectiveness while developing these capabilities across your team.

Why This Role Matters:

You’ll play a key role in advancing GolfNow’s B2B products while building a strong Product Management team. Your success will be measured by the customer and business outcomes achieved and your ability to develop Product Managers who demonstrate sound judgment, ownership, and accountability.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead Product Ownership: Build deep expertise across GolfNow’s B2B portfolio and develop Product Managers who take accountability for customer experience, product performance, and business outcomes.
• Translate Strategy Into Product Direction: Partner with senior leadership to translate business objectives into coordinated product priorities and roadmaps. Evaluate opportunities and tradeoffs across products while contributing to broader portfolio strategy.
• Drive Customer Experience and Innovation: Identify opportunities to improve customer workflows, expand product capabilities, and introduce innovative solutions that create measurable customer and business value.
• Build and Develop a High-Performing Product Team: Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers. Establish clear expectations, strengthen product judgment, and create an environment that encourages accountability and professional growth.
• Strengthen Cross-Functional Leadership: Build effective partnerships across Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Sales, and business leadership. Align teams around priorities, resolve dependencies, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly.
• Accelerate Execution and Business Results: Establish meaningful success measures, guide complex product initiatives, and use customer insights and performance data to

What You Bring:

• Significant Product Management experience, preferably 10+ years, with demonstrated success leading complex products, portfolios, or cross-functional initiatives.
• Experience managing, coaching, and developing Product Managers, including strengthening team capabilities and accountability.
• Experience with B2B software or technology products and demonstrated success improving customer experience, adoption, retention, or commercial performance.
• Strong strategic thinking and product judgment, with the ability to translate business objectives into coordinated priorities, navigate ambiguity, and make informed tradeoffs.
• Strong analytical capabilities and experience using customer research, product metrics, and market insights to guide decisions.
• Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, architecture, scalability, and engineering tradeoffs, combined with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and technology leaders.
• An AI-native approach to Product Management, with the ability to leverage AI and automation effectively while developing these capabilities across a team.

• Trust: Build credibility through integrity, sound judgment, accountability, and consistent follow-through while creating an environment where team members can take ownership.
• Teamwork: Foster collaboration across Product, Engineering, Design, and business functions while supporting the development and success of others.
• Transparency: Communicate priorities, decisions, risks, and results openly, and create clarity for team members and stakeholders.
• Agility: Help teams adapt to changing business priorities, customer needs, and emerging information without losing focus on outcomes.
• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Encourage innovation, thoughtful experimentation, proactive problem-solving, and the pursuit of new opportunities that create customer and business value.

We value demonstrated product leadership, people development, sound judgment, and measurable business impact alongside relevant professional experience.

• Experience leading Product Management teams responsible for multiple B2B SaaS products or integrated technology platforms.
• Experience developing products for golf course operators, hospitality businesses, or operationally complex B2B environments.
• Knowledge of the golf industry, golf course operations, or related technology ecosystems.

At GolfNow, you’ll have the opportunity to influence the direction of our B2B technology portfolio while developing Product Management talent. You’ll work closely with business and technology leaders, help solve meaningful customer challenges, and build a team that delivers lasting customer and business value.

jobs.description:

• Travel between customer retail facilities, through assigned territory.

jobs.title: Water Principal Engineer / Construction Manager
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

This position is responsible for managing activities related to the successful delivery of large and strategic capital infrastructure projects from inception to completion, the size and sensitivity of which have a significant impact to Operational, Financial, Regulatory and/or other Company objectives. The candidate works closely with Operations personnel, managing and coordinating project activities utilizing a cross functional team approach. The candidate must have the ability to develop unique solutions for complex technical problems that may include the design of new systems or processes to address emerging water and wastewater resource management challenges. This person also will provide value engineering assistance on select design and construction projects and assist in construction oversight as needed.

Specifically, the candidate will be the Construction Manager (CM) for the PFAS treatment project at the Company’s 188 MGD Haworth Water Treatment Plant (WTP), which will use a progressive design-build (PDB) project delivery approach. The CM will be responsible to oversee the progress of the Works in a timely and cost-effective manner. Will act as Veolia’s representative in the daily management of the Designer/Build partner for its construction scope. Manages and is responsible to supervise the construction activities. Requires ability to work under pressure, but also with an open mind and a collaborative mind set.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Phase 0 (Sep 2026 - Aug 2027): Active participation in Design-Build partner review and selection. Challenge construction alternatives in preliminary design development by the Owner Advisor. Haworth time commitment approximately 25%, balance of time will be spent on other VWNJ capital projects.
• Phase 1 (Sept 2027 - March 2029): Responsible for various Work Groups for the scope directly related to construction, challenge construction issued from the Design-Build partner. Anticipated start of full-time commitment to the Haworth project.
• Phase 2 (April 2029 - Mid-2032): Responsible for implementing all QA/QC requirements as well as ensuring that the Design-Build partner delivers according to the time and cost agreed and expected by Veolia (including Commissioning). Ensuring implementation of Veolia safety rules on site. Manage the interface with the Design-Build partner during construction and commissioning phase.

Work Environment:

• This is a full-time, onsite position (5 days per week) located at the Haworth WTP.

Education/Experience/Background:

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Environmental Engineering or related field, Master’s degree preferred.
• Minimum 15 years experience managing water/wastewater design and construction projects and upgrade projects.
• In-depth experience in project scheduling, cost analysis, contract terms development, technical scope development, contracting, cash flow analysis and other construction project related functions.
• Experience with major upgrade projects for currently operating treatment plants and pumping stations.
• Experience with major transmission/force main and distribution/collection projects.
• Experience with environmental regulatory framework and permitting, including drinking water quality standards and compliance.
• Experience utilizing alternate project delivery methods (design-build, integrated project delivery) and contracting methods (guaranteed maximum price, reimbursable).
• Experience with obtaining local permits, such as planning board approvals and building permits.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Thorough working knowledge of water and wastewater Process applications.
• Superior personal effectiveness skills.
• Strong Influencing and Team building skills.
• Collaborative mind set and ready to have a driving role following an alternate project delivery method (i.e. PDB).
• Strong communication, listening, presentation and reporting skills.
• Familiar with Project Control tools (document control, planning, etc.)
• Computer skills (MS Project, AoDOCs or Procore, etc.)
• Strong project.
• Financial analysis skills, including budget management, ongoing assessment of project risks/opportunities and basic project accounting knowledge.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
• PMP and/or Construction Management certifications are a plus.

Pay Range: $180000 to $195000 per year.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

Sick leave – 56 hours; Observed Holidays – 11 days; Vacation – Flexible Time Off

Eligible for up to 20% Annual Performance Bonus

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Who You Are

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $12.00 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

• Responsibilities are to ensure assigned jobsite operations are in compliance with design/specifications and to quality standards.
• Interfaces with other administrative field staff, field management staff and particularly the Senior Superintendent and Project Manager in a coordinated effort.

About Construction Management – AECOM Hunt

Founded in 1944 in Indianapolis, Indiana, AECOM Hunt has been building for over 80 years. AECOM Hunt’s storied history has encompassed many notable projects in over a dozen industries; iconic sports stadiums; an impressive portfolio in aviation; and many repeat clients in the hospitality and convention center industry. From iconic stadiums and arenas, next-gen transportation hubs and sustainable healthcare and academic buildings, AECOM Hunt’s expertise, leadership and dedication are unparalleled.

Minimum Requirements:

• BS Engineering/Construction Management and 4 years of relevant construction experience or AA/AS and 6 years of relevant experience or HSD/GED and 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Valid US Drivers License.

Preferred Qualifications

• Airport construction experience.
• Strong understanding of systems, and phased construction in an operational airport environment.
• Prior experience in construction compliance, scheduling, sequencing, etc.
• Proficiency in construction documentation, change order management, RFI, RFP, etc.
• OSHA safety certification (OSHA 10, 30).

Physical Demands:

• The following physical demands represent those typically required of individuals working in construction field roles, with or without accommodation. Construction field positions require physical stamina and mobility, including the ability to climb ladders and stairs, use personnel hoists, and move through various terrain and active construction zones. Vision requirements include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Team members must be capable of using their hands to handle tools and materials, and perform activities such as sitting, standing, walking, speaking, hearing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling. Lifting and carrying materials weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted may be necessary on an occasional basis.

Work Environment:

• Individuals in construction field roles work primarily on active job sites where exposure to environmental and job-related hazards is common, with or without accommodation. These environments may include proximity to heavy machinery, elevated work areas, airborne particles, varying weather conditions, and potential electrical risks. Noise levels may vary from moderate to high depending on the phase of construction. Employees may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and must remain alert to ensure safety. Additional duties may be assigned as needed based on the scope and progress of the project.

• Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
