jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The shift supervisor, under the general direction of the operations manager, is responsible for the overall operation and conduct of plant operational tasks and functions during assigned shift. This position will supervise the shift operators and serves as the plant contact for all interdepartmental and contractor activities that can affect the safe and reliable operation of Veolia’s site.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Responsible for managing all daily shift operational activities, as well as gives direction to assigned personnel as needed. Manages and implements the departmental and organizational objectives for each shift.

Also responsible to ensure plant is operated in compliance with all environmental permits and regulations. Provides a leadership role in implementation of company policies and procedures developed for improving the safety, reliability and efficiency of the plant. Responsible to ensure the shift operates in a manner that is compliant with all NERC standards and rules.

• Ensures that consistent process control and LOTO procedures are followed in all assigned areas and shifts. Ensures that uniform monitoring and recordkeeping are performed facility-wide.
• Communicates effectively with operations, engineering, maintenance, customer service, etc. to ensure customer satisfaction and successful facility operation.
• Responsible for ensuring the training program to qualify operators for promotion and to re-qualify all operators is occurring on an ongoing basis. Coaches and counsels team to improve technical skills and interpersonal and problem resolution skills. Works to identify and provide opportunities for team to learn new skills and techniques.
• Instructs staff in the operation of auxiliary and BOP equipment, as well as proper procedures for preventive maintenance and repairs on equipment. Oversees operators in housekeeping duties and other assignments as required.
• Logs data in log books, logs customer complaints and ensures complaint resolution. Performs other departmental responsibilities as assigned by Manager Operations.

Work Environment:

• General Industrial environment.
• Works around equipment such as turbines, generators, boilers, pumps, valves, etc.
• Possible Work Hazards: Thermal, chemical, mechanical, and electrical energy exposure.
• Hot ambient temperatures
• Traffic hazards

Education/Experience/Background:

• High school diploma.
• Technical or trade school graduate preferred.
• Seven years of related experience in utility or industrial setting.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Working knowledge of high pressure boiler operation; combustion turbine; steam turbine, water treatment, chilled water, and auxiliary equipment associated with power plant and chilled water plant operations.
• Working skill in the use of electro pneumatic/hydraulic controls, DCS controls, and Computers.
• Demonstrated ability to read, analyze and record gauges and instruments, analyze the effects on operations, and to maintain accurate records.
• Has the ability to perform minor troubleshooting, prepare permits and work orders and supervise shift employees.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Valid Driver’s License.

Physical Requirements:

• Able to handle up to fifty (50) pounds, unassisted.
• Able to climb and tolerate heights and confined space.
• Able to tolerate temperature extremes.
• Able to wear PPE, accurately read and interpret gauges, and capable to hear and understand audible alarms.
• Able to work rotating shifts, odd hours, and overtime.
• Able to lead and interface effectively with others.

Pay Range: $43.00 to $45.00 Per Hour.

The Project Procurement Manager leads end-to-end procurement for assigned projects, from early planning through closeout, while providing leadership across complex procurement workstreams. The position also supports process improvement, mentors team members as needed, and maintains procurement history and market intelligence to support estimating and future project planning.

Responsibilities

• Experience managing sourcing projects end to end, including resource planning, schedule and cost tracking and reporting, supplier management, stakeholder management (internal and external), and procurement team management. Strong proficiency with procurement and document management tools (e.g., ERP/PM systems); Microsoft D365 experience a plus
• Experience mentoring and developing team members

• Demonstrated experience with managing procurement teams to deliver end to end procurement project success for large, complex capital construction projects within life sciences or other highly regulated industries
• Excellent written and verbal communication and listening skills
• Proficiency in procurement processes and principles
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite software, excel and data entry.

The Crawfordsville, IN Center located in Montgomery County, Indiana (30 minutes from the greater Indianapolis area) has an incredible opportunity for a driven, self-motivated individual to join our Operations Services team. This unique position involves collaborating with people at all levels within the organization in support of our goal of strengthening the world's largest general trade book publisher by building the best supply chain in the publishing industry. The Operations Services department is responsible for project management as well as data analysis. Recent projects include adding two distribution centers to our network, implementing a goods-to-person system, and developing distribution network models for a $200M fulfillment operation. This position offers tremendous opportunities for growth while learning the ins and outs of the publishing industry's leading supply chain.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to major operational initiatives across our distribution network. A large-scale automation and material handling implementation is now underway at our Crawfordsville Operations Center, and this position will have the opportunity to support that work through cross-site collaboration, analysis, and project involvement. As our operations continue to evolve, the role will also contribute to future automation, material handling, and operational improvement initiatives at the Westminster facility and across the network.

Success in this role requires adaptability, curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. If you enjoy variety, solving new problems, and working with others across functions, this could be an excellent opportunity. Rarely are two days the same, and the role requires close collaboration with team members both in person and virtually.

This role combines analysis, project management, and process improvement in support of distribution operations. You will evaluate existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and help develop new approaches that support operational growth and efficiency. The role also requires a candidate to be comfortable working with data, building analyses in Excel, and communicating findings clearly to a range of audiences.

You will contribute to analyses and projects focused on distribution operations, with opportunities to take on increasing ownership over time. Some projects will require work in the warehouse, including time studies, flow chart development, testing system enhancements, and training others. Other projects may include developing activity-based costing and labor models, supporting warehouse management system implementations, designing new facilities, and implementing new automation and material handling solutions.

• Some college, preferably in industrial engineering or related STEM field; open to candidates with projected graduation date of May 2027 or earlier
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Advanced Excel skills, including experience working with complex formulas
• Excellent PC skills to include Microsoft Office Suite
• Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple projects, and adapt to changing conditions
• Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across functions and levels of the organization
• Interest in implementing and supporting warehouse management systems, automation systems, and material handling equipment

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading or supporting cross-functional projects
• Experience working with external vendors
• Experience training others
• Experience extracting, analyzing, and summarizing large data sets to communicate findings clearly

jobs.title: Product and Process Industrialization Junior Engineer - Hydraulic Hose
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Product and Process Industrialization Engineer – Hydraulic Hose supports product and process industrialization across the IAM organization. The role contributes to the launch of new products, technologies, and engineering changes into stable serial production through defined engineering activities across multiple hydraulic hose manufacturing sites.

As a developing technical specialist, the position applies practical knowledge of hydraulic hose manufacturing processes and product–process interactions to support launch readiness, process capability, and stable production performance. Working with senior industrialization experts and plant teams, the role contributes to troubleshooting, standardization, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement in alignment with global industrialization standards.

The position supports industrialization and improvement projects across IAM hydraulic hose plants, contributing to the successful execution and performance of a product portfolio representing approximately €300 M in annual revenue.

Location: ContiTech Fairlawn OH, Open to locations in Norfolk, NE or Mount Pleasant IA.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

• Support Business Area technical experts in applying hydraulic hose manufacturing process standards across IAM plants.
• Execute assigned industrialization activities for new products, from design reviews and process definition through launch and production stabilization.
• Provide technical input on processes, materials, and assembly methods; escalate complex issues.
• Support optimization of production processes, equipment, tooling, and layouts to meet operational targets.
• Contribute to DFM/DFA reviews with Product Development, Quality, and Operations teams.
• Support engineering changes and verify implementation with minimal production disruption.
• Coordinate defined improvement actions focused on safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
• Use structured problem-solving tools (A3, 8D, DMAIC, SPC, MSA) with guidance.
• Analyze cycle time, yield, scrap, and cost to identify process improvements.
• Apply manufacturing standards and document improvement opportunities.
• Support post-launch reviews and follow-up actions to stabilize serial production.
• Monitor KPIs for quality, efficiency, capability, and cost; propose countermeasures.
• Identify launch risks and support plant teams with mitigation actions.
• Investigate recurring process deviations and contribute to root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Prepare project status, performance, risk, and improvement updates for PPI Leadership and other stakeholders.
• Support implementation and adherence to global product and process standards across assigned locations.
• Maintain process documentation, technical guidelines, and lessons learned with senior experts and plant teams.
• Share technical knowledge with plant engineers and operators and provide hands-on support during trials and ramp-ups.
• Participate in validation of new technologies, materials, and processes, including documentation and follow-up.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Chemical, or a related engineering or science field.
• 3–5 years of process or manufacturing engineering experience, preferably in hydraulic hose production.
• Working knowledge of rubber and plastic manufacturing processes and experience supporting production ramp-ups.
• Familiarity with product and process industrialization technologies and standards.
• Working knowledge of industrial engineering fundamentals and methods.
• Understanding of manufacturing test processes and basic process validation methods.
• Experience applying problem-solving tools (A3, 8D, DMAIC, SPC, MSA, etc.).
• Ability to plan, coordinate, and track assigned project activities.
• Basic understanding of product lifecycle and engineering change processes.
• Exposure to Quality Core Tools (PFMEA, APQP, MSA, R&R, flowcharting, process control plans).
• Familiarity with Lean production / CBS principles, methods, and tools.
• Proficiency in English is mandatory
• Travel approximately 40 - 50% domestically and within the Americas region.

Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job posting.

ADDITIONAL WAYS TO STAND OUT

• Experience coordinating small technical work packages or defined improvement activities.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Experience working with cross-site or international manufacturing teams.
• Hands-on exposure to hose processes (mandrel preparation, extrusion, braiding, cover, curing, blow-out, pressure testing, and crimping).
• Experience with trials, validation, troubleshooting, or ramp-up activities.

Reposition company commercial tractors and trailers on designated non-highway areas [the yard] to include backing trailers to dock doors. May be required to shuttle tractor/trailer to and from logistic/lease companies.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Moving and Operation of Tractor/Trailer

• Assist with the unloading of trailers when necessary

• Required to always wear and follow Domino’s uniform standards
• Attend scheduled safety, team meetings, and training sessions
• Follow all local, state, federal, and Domino's safety rules, policies, and procedures
• Attend classroom instruction facilitated by the Delivery and Service Team Leader, which covers Domino’s Chock, Safety Cone and Dock Signal Light Policy, Accident Procedure Policy, and any other pertinent policy and/or instruction information.

Complete Necessary Paperwork

• Comply with DOT log regulations
• Accountable for the vehicle and product

• Must maintain a DOT Med Cert

ABOUT THE LUCAS MUSEUM OF NARRATIVE ART
The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is dedicated to illustrated storytelling.  Founded by George Lucas and Mellody Hobson, the museum’s collection features works by artists including Norman Rockwell, Kadir Nelson, Jessie Willcox Smith, N. C. Wyeth, Beatrix Potter, Judith F. Baca, Frida Kahlo, and Maxfield Parrish; as well as comic art legends such as Winsor McCay, Jack Kirby, Frank Frazetta, Alison Bechdel, Chris Ware, and R. Crumb; and photographers Gordon Parks, Henri Cartier-Bresson, and Dorothea Lange. The Museum also houses the Lucas Archives, containing models, props, concept art, and costumes from Lucas’s filmmaking career. 
 
Designed by Ma Yansong of MAD with a landscape by Mia Lehrer of Studio-MLA, the Museum is in Exposition Park, Los Angeles, on an 11-acre campus that includes new green space and a 300,000-square-foot building with galleries, two theaters, a library, restaurant, café, retail store, and community spaces.

jobs.title: Managing Director, PR & Integrated Media
jobs.description:
Job Overview:

The Managing Director, PR & Integrated Media is a senior agency leader responsible for the vision, growth, evolution, and performance of CG Life’s integrated capabilities across earned media, owned media, paid media, and corporate communications. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and serving as a member of the Leadership Team, this individual leads a team of approximately 30 professionals and senior functional leaders while helping shape how CG Life creates measurable impact for pharmaceutical and life sciences clients.

The Managing Director brings deep expertise in the above outlined areas, with significant experience growing and shaping communications efforts that support pharmaceutical products, particularly within rare disease, hard-to-treat conditions, and other complex areas of medicine. They serve as a senior counselor to clients and prospects, bringing the credibility, relationships, strategic perspective, and commercial mindset needed to engage C-suite leaders. They also play a key role in fostering new relationships, expanding existing partnerships, and translating complex scientific and business challenges into meaningful communications opportunities.

Success in this role requires both a strong foundation in communications and a forward-looking perspective on how the discipline is evolving. The Managing Director will bring together earned, paid, owned, and corporate communications capabilities; advance the use of AI, data, technology, and new approaches to measurement; develop differentiated services and products; and ensure the Media Impact Group is an increasingly integrated and valuable part of CG Life’s broader agency offering.

Key Responsibilities, including but not limited to:

Media Impact Group Leadership & Vision

• Set the vision and strategic direction for CG Life’s Media Impact group, bringing together earned media, owned media, paid media, and corporate communications into a differentiated and impactfully integrated client offering across new and existing client accounts.

• Lead and empower senior MI leaders, establishing clear accountability while enabling subject matter experts to independently lead their respective disciplines and teams.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen, evolve, and differentiate CG Life’s MI capabilities based on changing client needs, audience behaviors, industry dynamics, and emerging technologies.

• Build greater connectivity across earned, owned, and paid channels to create integrated programs that reach the right audiences, shape perceptions, and deliver measurable client impact.

• Partner with Strategy, Creative, Client Services, Business Development, and other agency leaders to ensure MI’s capabilities are effectively integrated into and supportive of broader CG Life solutions.

• Represent the Media Impact group as a member of the CG Life Leadership Team, contributing to overall agency strategy, growth priorities, capability development, and organizational decision-making.

Growth & Business Development

• Own the revenue growth strategy for the Media Impact Group, driving growth through new client acquisition, organic expansion of existing client relationships, and development of new services and offerings to existing life science and pharma clients.

• Build relationships with senior client prospects and decision-makers, leveraging deep industry expertise and executive presence to open doors and establish CG Life as a trusted communications and

• Partner with CG Life’s business development team to identify, shape and participate in new business pitches, capability presentations, strategic workshops, and senior-level prospect conversations.

• Engage clients to identify evolving needs and opportunities to expand CG Life’s strategic support and services.

• Partner across Client Services and agency leadership to drive organic growth by identifying opportunities to bring Media Impact Group capabilities to existing CG Life clients.

• Maintain and foster a strong professional network across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare communications, media, and related industries.

Client Leadership & Strategic Counsel

• Serve as a senior strategic counselor to C-suite and executive-level pharmaceutical and life sciences clients on product communications, corporate communications, reputation, media strategy, and integrated communications challenges.

• Apply deep experience in pharmaceutical commercialization communications to help clients navigate complex scientific, regulatory, competitive, and stakeholder environments.

• Bring expertise and perspective to clients’ communications challenges involving rare diseases, hard-to-treat conditions, specialty products, emerging therapies, and complex scientific stories across patient, HCP, and caregiver communities.

• Help clients connect corporate reputation, product narratives, earned media, owned media, and paid media, into cohesive communications strategies.

• Establish trusted senior-level relationships that strengthen client confidence, create long-term partnerships, and generate opportunities for continued growth across capabilities at CG Life.

• Maintain an informed perspective on the pharma and life sciences communications environments, including stakeholder expectations, technology, regulation, and the ways audiences discover and engage with health information.

Innovation, AI & Capability Development

• Reinforce and participate in the continued evolution of CG Life’s approach to AI, technology, data, and emerging technology to improve the quality, speed, intelligence, measurement, and impact of communications and media programs.

• Collaborate with other senior MIG leaders to i

• Work with MI leaders to develop new methodologies, services, tools, and commercial offerings that create differentiated value for clients and new growth opportunities for CG Life.

• Encourage thoughtful experimentation and innovation while ensuring new approaches meet appropriate standards for quality, accuracy, privacy, regulatory compliance, and client trust.

• Build a culture in which teams continually challenge existing approaches, test new ideas, learn from results, and translate innovation into better client outcomes.

Measurement & Media Impact

• Advance CG Life’s approach to measuring the effectiveness and business impact of communications and media programs across earned, owned, and paid channels.

• Partner with MI leaders and cross-functional leaders to connect channel performance, audience behavior, communications outcomes, and client business objectives more meaningfully.

• Establish expectations for data-informed decision-making and ensure insights are used to optimize programs, inform strategy, and demonstrate value to clients.

• Help evolve client conversations beyond activity and channel-level metrics toward a clearer understanding of communications and media impact.

Business & Operational Performance

• Maintain accountability for the overall business performance of the Media Impact Group within CG Life’s integrated agency P&L.

• Drive profitable growth by balancing revenue opportunities, client needs, staffing, investments, and operational efficiency with the Media Impact group.

• Partner with Finance, Operations, and functional leaders to manage revenue forecasts, gross-margin performance, billable utilization, staffing needs, and other key operating metrics.

• Evaluate investments in people, technology, tools, partnerships, and new capabilities based on their potential to improve client impact and create sustainable business value.

People & Organizational Leadership

• Lead and set clear expectations for leadership, collaboration, client service, innovation, business performance, and accountability across the Media Impact Group.

• Coach and advise senior leaders, helping them strengthen their teams, grow their capabilities, address performance challenges, and prepare future leaders.

• Partner with agency leadership and People Operations to anticipate talent and capability needs and make thoughtful decisions about organizational structure, hiring, development, succession, and retention.

• Foster a collaborative culture that encourages expertise within individual disciplines while removing barriers between functions.

• Create opportunities for Media Impact team members to contribute their expertise across integrated CG Life client engagements and agency initiatives.

• Model CG Life’s leadership expectations and contribute to a culture of curiosity, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Champion and reinforce a culture of collaboration, transparency, and trust that supports team well-being, engagement, and exceptional client work.

Qualifications:

• 15+ years of relevant communications experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare communications, or a closely related environment, including significant experience in an agency setting.

• 10+ years leading teams and growing clients within a pharma agency environment.

• Deep expertise in earned media and corporate communications, with demonstrated leadership of communications programs supporting pharmaceutical products, specifically during launch or critical moments of inflection in the products’ lifecycles.

• Significant experience developing communications strategies for complex scientific and medical products, with experience in rare disease, hard-to-treat conditions, oncology, specialty medicine, or similarly complex therapeutic categories strongly preferred.

• Proven ability to generate revenue through new client acquisition and new business pitching, expansion of existing relationships, and development of new services or offerings within PR, corp comms, and/or integrated communications.

• Demonstrated ability to establish relationships with C-suite and senior-level pharmaceutical and life sciences executives, penetrate new client organizations, and convert relationships into meaningful business opportunities.

• Strong understanding of the role of paid media and owned media within integrated communications programs, with the ability to partner with and lead subject matter experts across these disciplines.

• Demonstrated curiosity of and experience in AI and relevant tools, emerging technology, data, and evolving approaches to communications and media, with a track record of applying innovation to improve client or business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of communications and media measurement, with the ability to connect program performance to meaningful client and business outcomes.

• Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing revenue growth, profitability, staffing, utilization, forecasting, and investment decisions within an agency or professional-services environment.

• Exceptional executive communication, presentation, relationship-building, and consultative skills.

• Ability to translate complex scientific, clinical, and business information into clear, compelling communications strategies and narratives.

• Collaborative leadership style with demonstrated ability to work across disciplines, build alignment among senior stakeholders, and lead change within a complex organization.

Benefits:

We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to all of our employees:

• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance. We cover a generous portion of employee contributions

• 401K plan. We invest in present and future you, which is why we offer a generous match and immediate vesting on our plan

• Parental Leave. Generous paid time off for parents to bond with their newest addition

• Professional Development. Each employee has an annual budget to allocate to professional development opportunities. Employees are encouraged to take a workshop, attend a webinar, join associations, and do anything else that will help them grow in their careers.

• And more! We offer flexible time off, life insurance, LTD, a robust employee assistance program, and more!

At CG Life, we recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, we aim for flexibility in structuring competitive compensation offers to ensure we are able to attract the best candidates. As required by law in this state, the estimated salary range for this position is $275,000 - $300,000 and represents our good faith estimate as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect. We tailor our offers within the range based on organizational needs, internal equity, market data, geographic zone, and the selected candidate’s experience, education, industry knowledge, location, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the selection process. At CG Life, it is not common for individuals to be hired at the higher end of the range, and compensation decisions depend on a variety of factors. This position is eligible to participate in a discretionary bonus program, subject to the rules governing the plan. CG Life offers a variety of benefits, including health benefits, 401K retirement with a generous company match and immediate vesting, and flexible time off.

A Note to Candidates:

It has come to our attention that some candidates are being contacted by individuals falsely claiming to represent CG Life. Please note that all official communications from CG Life will come from an email address ending in @cglife.com. If you are contacted by anyone using a different domain, please consider it fraudulent. CG Life will never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial information at any stage of the hiring process

The IT Service Desk Professional provides first-level technical support to Client's colleagues, business partners, and authorized users through voice calls.

jobs.title: HCB Communications & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The HCB Communications & Operations Specialist supports Madison Reed Hair Color Bar (HCB) teams by ensuring field communications are clear, timely, and actionable and that key learning and operational support activities run smoothly.

This role owns the day-to-day execution of HCB field communications while also providing day-to-day administration of the HCB learning platform, and recurring operational programs including the HCB PEX card program and supply ordering.

The Specialist works across HCB Operations Services & Training to coordinate communication needs, turn complex information into simple field actions, and ensure recurring operational workflows are completed accurately and on time.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring exceptional communication, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail. The role reports to the Senior Manager, HCB Training Design & Enablement. Role will require < 10% travel.

The base salary range for this position is between $68,000 and $72,000. At Madison Reed, we aim to pay competitively. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Responsibilities

Field Communications

• Manage the day-to-day execution of HCB field communications, including drafting, editing, scheduling, and publishing clear, concise, and actionable messages.

• Manage the HCB communications calendar and end-to-end production process, including content collection, review, approvals, and coordination across launches, training, programs, and operational priorities.

• Develop recurring field updates, FAQs, leader talking points, launch resources, and other communication materials while maintaining Madison Reed brand and voice standards.

• Lead the execution and production of HCB Town Halls, including project timelines, presentation development, speaker coordination, meeting logistics, and follow-up communications.

• Use AI and communications tools to improve the quality, speed, and efficiency of field communications.

Learning Operations & LMS Administration

• Provide day-to-day HCB LMS administration, including learner records and rosters, course and learning-path assignments, completion tracking, reporting, and first-line troubleshooting.

• Publish and maintain HCB learning content in the LMS, checking that it loads, tracks, and displays correctly before it reaches the field, and keeping learner records accurate as people join, move, and leave.

• Coordinate training communications, schedules, participant information, materials, and follow-up.

• Coordinate logistics for virtual and in-person training as needed.

Operational & Administrative Support

• Administer the HCB PEX card program, including loading and tracking against established processes. Reconciliation is reviewed and approved by a second reviewer outside this role.

• Coordinate recurring supply ordering and distribution for HCB locations.

• Respond to and appropriately route routine field support requests and provide coordination support for selected HCB initiatives.

• Coordinate planning and event logistics for the annual HCB GM Summit, including timelines, vendors, attendee logistics, materials, communications, and onsite support.

• Use AI and available technology to improve efficiency and automate recurring workflows where possible.

Qualifications:

• 2–4 years of experience in field or internal communications, retail operations, training coordination, LMS administration, project coordination, or a related field.

• Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable communications for frontline audiences.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

• Ability to manage recurring work while balancing changing priorities and deadlines.

• Strong technology aptitude and ability to learn new systems quickly.

• Hands-on experience administering an LMS (Wisetail, Docebo, Opus, or similar) — assigning and tracking training, publishing content, pulling completion reports.

• Experience with communications, project-management, or collaboration platforms preferred.

• Proficiency using AI and productivity tools to improve quality and efficiency, with the judgment to check AI output before it reaches the field.

• Experience in multi-unit retail, hospitality, beauty, or another distributed field organization preferred.

• Strong service orientation and ability to work effectively with field and corporate partners.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred (Communications, Broadcast, Marketing or Business Administration ideal) or equivalent relevant experience.

• Proficient in Zoom, Slack, and Google Suite.

Key Competencies

• Exceptional communicator — writes clearly and concisely and can turn complex information into simple, actionable messages for field teams.

• Strong executor — manages details, deadlines, and recurring workflows reliably from start to finish.

• Highly organized — effectively manages multiple priorities, calendars, communications, and administrative processes without losing track of details.

• Service-minded — approaches field and cross-functional partners with responsiveness, professionalism, and a desire to make their work easier.

• Resourceful problem solver — takes initiative to resolve day-to-day issues and knows when to escalate.

• Technology and AI-forward — uses available tools to work more efficiently, automate recurring tasks, and improve quality.

• Collaborative partner — works effectively with business owners to gather information, coordinate work, and keep deliverables moving.

• Adaptable and dependable — remains flexible as priorities change while consistently following through on commitments.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Mobile, iOS
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

We are looking for an iOS engineer to help Compass build a mobile platform that makes the home buying or selling experience delightful. You will work with other engineers and your Product and Design counterparts to contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions for well-defined features. You will independently build components and deliver features with some guidance, ensuring our implementation meets software engineering best practices.

Outside of product-driven projects, you will work with other engineers to determine how to push our platform forward, devising engineering-led initiatives that ensure we can work quickly and efficiently while maintaining a high standard of operational excellence.

What you will do:

• Work in a startup-like environment building agile products and services

• Collaborate closely with engineers on your team, engineers on other teams, as well as your product and design counterparts to successfully launch projects which solve real-world customer problems

• Work independently and deliver features with some guidance while understanding technical trade offs, weighing different approaches, and arriving to a recommended solution

• Perform code reviews, participate in team design reviews, and write high quality tests

• Apply testable, maintainable, and stable approaches to your work

• Hold yourself to a high standard of code quality and operational rigor

• Develop expertise in one or more components within your team's domain

• Create clear and concise documentation (diagrams, service descriptions, decisions, runbooks)

What we look for:

• BS in CS or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of professional iOS development experience using Swift and shipping apps to the App Store, including familiarity with modern Swift development practices, such as SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency. Exposure to reactive programming frameworks is a plus.

• Ability to collaborate with Product, Design and Engineering stakeholders to implement solutions which surprise and delight our customers

• Knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals and iOS design patterns and best practices

• A keen eye for design and attention to detail. The products you build should not merely be functional but should also be well-crafted and user-friendly

• Experience integrating with RESTful backend services

• Experience with Scrum/Agile development methodologies

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Compensation:

The base pay range for this position is $126,000 - $141,000; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

Perks that You Need to Know About:

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive.  Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Console Experience
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here.  We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

DigitalOcean's console is where every customer, from a solo developer to an enterprise platform team, comes to provision, manage, and scale their infrastructure. We're looking for a designer to own that experience end to end: the navigation, the cross-product patterns, the moments where a dozen product teams' features have to feel like one coherent product.

You'll sit on a product team, and use that vantage point to build the reusable frameworks, patterns, and guidance that every team working in the console relies on, while holding the broader view of how the console works as a system. This is a role for someone who can zoom from a single dialog to the entire information architecture and back, often in the same week.

What you'll do

• Own the end-to-end design of the console experience, from first login through daily workflows for their users entire experience.

• Treat the design system itself as the product: own the component library, patterns, and visual/interaction standards every team builds on, and plan its roadmap jointly with the engineering team.

• Set the craft and quality bar for the whole product suite, plus a review process that holds it in place, so consistent, polished UI is the normal outcome rather than something each team has to fight for on its own.

• Build reusable, high-leverage patterns instead of custom screens per team, so product teams can ship well-designed UI without needing a dedicated designer of their own.

• Own the highest-visibility shared surfaces (navigation, onboarding, app shell, landing pages) as the reference examples other teams design against.

• Work closely with engineering to make sure designs land in the product as intended, and grow the design skills of the UI engineers embedded on product teams through a design guild, reviews, and pairing.

• Make simplicity and strong UX a real point of differentiation again, and back up requests for more design investment with evidence of where it will pay off.

• Own the creative vision for the console: bring a clear, opinionated point of view on what the experience should look and feel like, not just the systems that keep it consistent.

What we're looking for

• Staff-level product design experience with a proven track record of building and scaling a design system across many products or teams.

• A systems thinker who designs for reuse and consistency at scale rather than one-off screens, and understands the leverage that good patterns create.

• Strong, well-rounded craft across interaction, visual, and information design, backed by a portfolio that shows both taste and measurable UX impact.

• A history of driving quality and adoption through influence rather than authority, working across dozens of teams via standards, partnership, and persuasion.

• Comfort being the most senior (and possibly only) designer in the room, setting direction under ambiguity.

• A strong, opinionated point of view on design, and the conviction to own the creative direction of the product rather than just its consistency.

• Solid collaboration with engineers, with hands-on knowledge of front-end constraints and how design systems actually live in code as a strong plus.

Nice to have

• Experience running or scaling a design system guild or community of practice across a large engineering org.

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes) or a track record of ramping up quickly on technical domains.

• Experience designing for both novice and expert users within the same product.

Compensation Range:

• $192,800 - $241,000

*This is a remote role

You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.

jobs.title: Principal, Product Management
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

GolfNow is seeking a Principal Product Manager to help shape the future of our B2B golf technology portfolio. You’ll work across multiple products that help golf course operators manage their businesses, improve customer experiences, and drive growth.

In this role, you’ll combine deep customer understanding, strategic thinking, technical fluency, and strong execution to translate business priorities into meaningful product improvements and innovations. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, and business leaders to navigate complex decisions and drive initiatives from discovery through measurable results.

You’ll bring an AI-native approach to Product Management, using AI and modern tools to accelerate learning, strengthen decision-making, and improve execution.

Why This Role Matters:

Your work will influence how GolfNow’s B2B products evolve, helping golf course operators succeed while driving adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Success means developing deep product expertise, making informed recommendations, and taking ownership of customer and business outcomes—not simply delivering features.

What You’ll Do:

• Own Product Outcomes: Develop deep expertise across GolfNow’s B2B products, customers, and business. Take end-to-end accountability for initiatives and measurable customer and business results.
• Drive Product Strategy and Prioritization: Translate business objectives and customer insights into product priorities and roadmaps. Partner with Product leadership to shape direction, evaluate opportunities, and make informed tradeoffs.
• Improve Customer Experience and Business Performance: Lead initiatives that simplify customer workflows, expand product capabilities, and drive adoption, retention, and revenue growth.
• Accelerate Innovation: Identify emerging customer needs, evaluate new technologies and approaches, and lead the development of innovative product capabilities.
• Lead Through Influence: Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Sales, and business teams. Communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly while creating alignment across functions.
• Deliver and Measure Results: Drive complex initiatives from discovery through launch and beyond. Define success measures, evaluate performance using qualitative and quantitative insights, and continuously improve products based on results.

What You Bring:

• Significant Product Management experience, preferably 8+ years, with demonstrated success delivering measurable customer and business outcomes across complex products or initiatives.
• Experience with B2B software or technology products, including customer workflows, commercial considerations, and product adoption.
• Strong product judgment and strategic thinking, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and translate business objectives into actionable product priorities.
• Strong analytical skills and experience using customer research, product metrics, and experimentation to inform decisions.
• Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, system architecture, data flows, and engineering tradeoffs.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead cross-functional initiatives, and communicate complex concepts clearly.
• An AI-native approach to Product Management, using AI, automation, and modern tools to improve problem-solving, decision-making, productivity, and outcomes.

How We Do It:

At Versant, how we work is as important as what we deliver. Successful candidates demonstrate:

• Trust: Build credibility through integrity, preparation, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.
• Teamwork: Collaborate across functions, value diverse perspectives, and create shared ownership of outcomes.
• Transparency: Communicate openly about priorities, decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and results.
• Agility: Adapt to changing customer needs, business conditions, and new evidence while maintaining focus on outcomes.
• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Proactively identify opportunities, challenge conventional thinking, and turn ideas into meaningful customer and business value.

We value demonstrated product leadership, accountability, and measurable impact alongside relevant professional experience.

Bonus Points:

• Experience developing products for golf course operators, hospitality businesses, or other operationally complex B2B environments.
• Familiarity with SaaS business models, subscription products, or integrated technology platforms.
• Knowledge of the golf industry, golf course operations, or related technology ecosystems.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

At GolfNow, you’ll help shape technology that supports the golf industry while working across a diverse portfolio of B2B products. You’ll collaborate with experienced business and technology leaders, tackle meaningful customer challenges, and have the opportunity to influence product direction and see the impact of your work.

Work Environment

This position is remote, with the expectation of occasional in-person collaboration for team meetings, strategic planning sessions, and other business needs.

While there is no formal on-call rotation, this role requires flexibility to participate in the response to critical production issues outside regular business hours when necessary.

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Relief) - Horizon West, FL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($ - $) and 401k match

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Fleet Platform
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Bedrock scales deployments nationwide, every machine we bring autonomy to has to be vetted, provisioned, calibrated, deployed, monitored, updated and serviced. Fleet Engineering builds the platform behind that lifecycle: the system of record, services and applications that teams across Bedrock use to run a fleet growing to thousands of machines. Many of these systems will be used by external partners as well.



The work crosses disciplines. One week you're architecting how we track sensor calibrations across every machine. The next, you're making a fault on an operator's tablet readable at a glance. You'll own problems end to end, working closely with technicians and operators in the field as well as multidisciplinary engineers across hardware, ML and robotics.



Also, you get to drive 100,000 lb excavators.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the fleet system of record: the data model and services for machines, their hardware, worksites and deployments, and how each moves through its lifecycle

 - Build the applications that technicians, dispatchers and operations teams use every day to vet machines, schedule installs, track inventory and keep the fleet healthy

 - Build the services every robot phones home to: delivering identity, credentials, calibrations and configuration to machines in the field, and always knowing what's running where

 - Move petabytes of sensor data off remote job sites across the country, bringing home the real-world data that powers our ML and learning flywheel

 - Spend real time with the people who use what you build, in the office and in the field, and turn messy real-world workflows into simple, durable software

 - Design foundational APIs that other engineering teams and external partners build on, and evolve them safely as the business changes

 - Lean into AI and agents, from automating development workflows to fleet triage and operations
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years building and shipping production software, owning systems from design through operation

 - Strong backend and data-modeling skills: you've designed schemas and services that many other systems depend on

 - Ability to build full-stack applications, including interfaces people actually want to use

 - Product sense: you start from the user's problem and would rather ship the useful version than the elegant one

 - Comfort with ambiguity: you can take a vague cross-functional problem, define it, and drive it to done

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Payroll
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

OpenGov powers more effective and accountable government, and our Accounting team builds the operations that let us grow with that mission. The Senior Manager, Payroll owns US payroll end-to-end and is accountable for its accuracy, completeness, and compliance across every jurisdiction where we employ people. This leader sets the long-term direction for payroll operations: documenting processes, strengthening controls, and improving systems and automation so payroll scales with the business before we add headcount. The role supervises our lead payroll specialist, works across Finance, Accounting, HR, Enterprise Applications & Engineering and Legal, and may expand over time to include equity administration. This is an in-office role in San Francisco, Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta, or Boston.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own end-to-end payroll processing for the United States, ensuring every payroll is accurate, complete, timely, and compliant with federal, state, and local requirements

 - Manage payroll tax compliance across all jurisdictions, including resolving compliance issues, processing adjustments and driving audits to completion in a timely manner with federal, state, and local authorities

 - Partner with HR on 401(k), HSA, and FSA administration by ensuring employee and employer contributions are calculated correctly and remitted on time, and process all deductions accurately and in compliance with legal requirements

 - Provide tax information and withholding calculations for RSU settlements, and over time take on administration of RSU settlement process in partnership with Accounting and Legal

 - Manage quarterly and year-end employment tax reporting, including W-2, 1099, Form 940/941 filings, state and local returns

 - Own payroll general ledger reconciliations and support month-end close in partnership with Accounting, and oversee payroll-related audits such as 401(k) and workers' compensation

 - Design, document, and maintain payroll controls, including review and approval steps, reconciliations, checks for completeness and accuracy across spreadsheets and systems and keep the function ready for internal and external audits

 - Improve processes and systems, using automation where it strengthens accuracy and efficiency, so the function scales before headcount is added

 - Supervise and develop the lead payroll specialist
   
   


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Requirements

 - Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

 - 8+ years of US payroll experience, including 3+ years managing payroll staff, with in-depth knowledge of federal, state, and local employment requirements and multi-state payroll tax

 - Hands-on experience with Workday Payroll and ADP SmartCompliance

 - Exceptional attention to detail and a record of delivering accurate, complete payroll on tight deadlines, with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, including complex formulas and analysis of large datasets

 - Sound judgment and a bias for action: spots issues early, escalates them promptly with a proposed resolution, and drives them to closure

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, a record of working cross-functionally, and discretion with confidential employee information

 - Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency.

 - Ability to work in office in San Francisco, Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta, or Boston




PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC)

 - Experience designing payroll controls and supporting internal or external audits

 - Experience improving payroll processes through automation while maintaining accuracy and control

 - Experience with equity compensation (RSU) payroll tax and reporting

 - Experience in a SaaS or technology company, including integrating payroll for acquired companies




COMPENSATION

San Francisco, CA: $172,800 - $221,000


On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager- Advancement- Weekly Bonus (01387)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

jobs.title: Manager, IT End User Services
jobs.description:
About Ascend

Ascend empowers entrepreneurial CPAs to reach their goals with an innovative growth model that brings their firms into the new age. Backed by PeopleFirst private equity firm Alpine Investors (~$20B AUM), Ascend is the leading aggregator of regional accounting firms in the U.S., with ~3,200 employees globally and approaching $1B in revenue. Ascend has built a modern platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent in their brand, approach to client service, and cultural autonomy, while benefiting from the strategic support and resources of a large CPA firm. Ascend provides access to growth capital, a robust talent acquisition engine, a best-in-breed technology platform, an AI development team, a catalytic leadership system, shared back-office services, and modernized growth incentives, so firms can surmount the typical challenges of the standalone partnership model and reach their full potential. Founded in January 2023, Ascend has grown rapidly both organically and through M&A, placing it among the Top 25 largest accounting firms in the U.S.

For more information, visit ascendtogether.com.

About Alpine Investors

Alpine Investors is a PeopleFirst private equity firm that is committed to building great companies by working with, learning from, and developing exceptional people. Alpine prides itself on fostering cultures where people value empowerment, diversity, fairness, integrity, and intellectual honesty. Founded in 2001, Alpine specializes in investments in companies in the software and services industries. Alpine has ~$20 billion in AUM and has offices in San Francisco, New York, Salt Lake City, and Austin, TX.

For more information on the firm, visit www.alpineinvestors.com.

Position Summary

Ascend is seeking a Manager of IT End User Services to build and run an Ascend-owned, AI-first service desk that Partner Firms trust. This leader will oversee Ascend’s regional service desk organization, comprising four Regional IT Support Leads and their teams of L2 IT Support Technicians, and will deliver consistent, high-quality support in every region while continuously shifting work left to self-service and AI resolution.

This is a driver role. The Manager of IT End User Services will set a high bar, form a point of view on which data matters and act on it, listen for what firms are saying beyond the numbers, and hold the team accountable to consistent processes, all while building a team with deep accounting industry knowledge. The Manager will own service desk performance, resolve all but the most serious escalations independently, and coordinate closely with Ascend’s Applications, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Integration, and AI and automation teams.

The Manager of IT End User Services will report to Ascend’s IT Operations leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, hire, and develop four Regional IT Support Leads and, through them, the regional L2 IT Support Technicians, including regular scorecard reviews and performance evaluations.

• Build a team with deep accounting industry and application knowledge, ensuring every region is fully staffed and trained with backup coverage in place.

• Plan staffing and coverage across an extended East and West shift model, an on-call rotation with P1 and VIP paging, and weekend coverage during busy season.

• Manage the team within approved headcount and budget.

Service Desk Performance & Insight

• Own service desk performance against a live scorecard spanning AI resolution, first-touch resolution, SLA attainment, ticket aging, requester satisfaction and NPS, process adherence, and on-site presence; report weekly to IT leadership and support monthly readouts to the Executive Leadership Team (“ELT”) and Regional Presidents.

• Deliver SLA attainment of 95%+ for response and resolution, sustained through busy season, and first-touch resolution of 80%+ across all regions.

• Bring a point of view, not just a report: identify which metrics and trends matter most, recommend where the team should act, and challenge the scorecard itself when it is not telling the full story.

• Partner with change and problem management owners on L3 and L4 teams to turn recurring issues into problem records and permanent fixes.

Escalation Management & Partner Firm Relationships

• Own escalations end to end, resolving complex, high-visibility, VIP, and multi-firm issues across L3 and L4 teams and firm leadership; bring only the most serious matters to IT Operations leadership, with context, options, and a recommendation attached.

• Capture qualitative feedback from firm leadership, Regional Presidents, and monthly operations reviews, and bring it to the weekly review alongside the metrics so that firm sentiment is addressed before it becomes an escalation.

• Ensure every Partner Firm receives a monthly operations review and a quarterly site visit, with consistent reporting across regions.

Process Excellence

• Maintain consistent processes across all regions, including queue management, ticket hygiene, escalation paths, the standard change catalog, and Freshservice as the single system of record.

• Keep aging tickets and open queues under control at every Partner Firm through weekly review and documented resolution plans, and ensure requests flow through established channels rather than around them.

Shift Left & AI-First Support

• Own the team’s Shift Left program, partnering with Ascend’s AI and automation team to prioritize the request types best suited for self-service and AI resolution.

• Hold the team to a high standard for Knowledge Base and how-to article quality, enabling the AI-first support layer to resolve a meaningfully larger share of incidents each year.

Partner Firm Integration

• Coordinate with the Integration team on Technology Stack Transition (“TST”) for newly joining Partner Firms, including regional alignment, hypercare, and evaluation of inherited firm IT staff against role criteria.

Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in IT service delivery, including 3+ years leading support teams; experience leading leaders and managing performance through others strongly preferred.

• Public accounting or professional services industry experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with accounting industry applications.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; ITIL Foundation certification preferred.

• Strong command of ITIL service management practices across incident, request, problem, and change.

• Data-driven approach to service management, with hands-on experience using ITSM reporting to manage SLA, satisfaction, and NPS; Freshservice experience a plus.

• Driver mentality with a bias for action, high standards, and an ownership mindset; reliable, process-driven, and comfortable holding teams accountable.

• Superior EQ and influencing skills paired with clear, confident executive communication with Partner Firm and Ascend leadership.

• Proven ability to coordinate cross-functionally with Applications, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and Integration teams.

• A continuous improvement and Shift Left mindset, with genuine enthusiasm for AI-first service delivery.

What You Can Count on at Ascend

We live by our values:

• Own it. We seize growth opportunities with the passion, speed, and accountability of an entrepreneur.

• Serve wholeheartedly. We love our people and serve them with positivity and kindness.

• Be excellent. We set a high bar because our mission matters.

• Win together. We stay in sync, achieve as a team, and celebrate each other.

• Bring the sunshine. We have fun and bring enthusiasm to make the journey joyful.

At Ascend, we provide a fair and equal employment opportunity for all candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, marital status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Ascend hires and promotes individuals solely based on qualifications for the position to be filled and business needs.
