jobs.title: Director, Program Management
jobs.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

We are hiring a Director of Program Management to lead Bevi's central PMO. The PMO runs our new product introduction (NPI) programs from concept to launch. The team includes five program managers and sits in Operations, reporting to the COO.

This is a leadership role and a hands-on one. You will lead and develop the team, set the standard for how Bevi runs hardware programs, and run one of our most important NPI programs yourself. Our goal is to reduce our NPI cycle time with a higher predictability and quality. This role is central to getting there.

Your Day to Day

Lead the PMO

• Lead, coach and grow a team of program managers running complex, cross-functional hardware programs.

• Set the standard for how Bevi runs NPI programs and hold the team to it.

• Own Bevi's phase gate process. Each gate ends in a clear go, no-go or recycle decision, and open items carry forward with owners.

Run programs well

• Lead by example, taking on NPI programs directly as needed while building the team.

• Make sure every program has an aggressive, credible schedule that the team believes in and that is updated every week.

• Name risks early, assign owners and track the inputs that drive them: drawings, test results, open decisions and supplier dates.

• Base status on evidence (test data, released drawings, placed POs), not verbal updates. Raise issues before dates are missed, with options.

• Get the right people in the room to make decisions, and log them.

• Report program status to the leadership team and the Board.

Work across the company

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Service and Sales so programs launch at target quality, cost and supply readiness.

• Work with the leadership team and Product on portfolio priorities. Make resource and schedule tradeoffs visible so they can decide.

• Manage programs that involve contract manufacturers and design partners, including partners in Asia.

Make the PMO more efficient

• Keep core teams small and meetings focused on decisions and issues.

• Move program information to one system of record, so status is updated once and every report pulls from it.

• Use automation and AI to cut the time PMs spend compiling updates.

• Run post-program reviews and use what we learn to improve the playbook.

Requirements

• 10+ years in program management, including at least 5 years leading a team of program managers.

• A track record of taking connected hardware products through EVT, DVT, PVT and production launch. Experience across electro-mechanical, firmware and app components.

• Experience in consumer, commercial or appliance-type hardware products.

• Experience working with contract manufacturers on new product launches.

• Comfort setting aggressive schedules and running them with discipline: risk tracking, evidence-based status and early escalation.

• Clear, direct communication with executives and cross-functional teams.

Preferred

• Experience with contract manufacturers or ODM partners in Asia.

• Startup or high-growth company experience.

• Experience building or rebuilding a PMO, including phase gate processes and portfolio reporting.

• Familiarity with Agile methods for firmware and software work.

• Engineering or technical degree.

#LI-CD1

#LI-HYBRID

Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer

• 401(k) with company match

• Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc

• Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non-birth parents

• Fully employer paid disability and life insurances

• Wellness and fitness reimbursements

• Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs

• Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra-cycling, too

• Happy hours, team-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards - and more.

A note on AI in our hiring process: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in.

Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community-driven progress and the future of technology.

We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. jobs.title: Client Partner, Growth and AI Augmented
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

As a Client Partner, Growth & AI Augmented , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 5 or more years of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

We are seeking a growth-minded, AI-native Client Partner to expand Valtech’s enterprise relationships across a portfolio of multiple clients in our Industrials, Manufacturing, Distribution and Agriculture (IMDA) client group. In this role, AI is not an add-on. You use it in everything you do, from how you research and hunt for growth inside an account to how you prepare for every client conversation. The result is even more value for our clients.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

• An AI native who tests new tools often and shares what works with the team

• A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo

• A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing

• Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data

• Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

AI-native commercial excellence

• Use GenAI, Storyblocks and copilot tools to accelerate: RFP comprehension POV development Meeting prep and debriefs Competitive analysis Stakeholder mapping Narrative and deck structuring

Growth and revenue expansion

Team leadership and AI adoption influence

• Contribute to shared Storyblocks, templates, workflows and best practices.

• Champion a culture of AI-enabled ways of working across growth and delivery teams.

Craft, judgment and narrative excellence

AI-native sales craft

Growth mindset and sales leadership

• Proven track record of expanding accounts by identifying and engaging new stakeholders.

• Ability to uncover and shape new revenue streams within complex enterprise environments.

• Experience growing AI, data or digital transformation work inside enterprise accounts.

• Demonstrated expertise in managing multimillion-dollar portfolios.

Strategic account management

• Expertise in account planning, commercial governance, quarterly and annual business planning.

• Ability to orchestrate global delivery, managed services and cross-practice workstreams.

Executive communication

• Exceptional storytelling, persuasion and facilitation skills.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology topics into business value narratives.

Leadership and collaboration

• Demonstrated history of influencing teams without direct authority.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

The benefits

Please note that salary ranges may vary by country or region, in accordance with local market standards and compensation practices.

Why K Group Companies? 
At K Group Companies, culture is built on long-standing relationships, both with our customers and with each other.
Our team is made up of people who take pride in solving problems, supporting one another, and delivering work that reflects the standards we’ve built our reputation on. Whether it’s designing secure environments for customers, supporting critical IT infrastructure, or collaborating across teams, we operate as one organization working toward shared success.
We also believe work should be fulfilling and enjoyable. From friendly gaming competitions in our Team Zone arcade to grabbing lunch together in the community, we value connection and teamwork just as much as technical excellence.
What you can expect here:
A family-owned company with deep roots in West Michigan
A trusted advisor culture built over 40+ years of relationships
The opportunity to work across diverse, real-world technology environments
A team-oriented culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and pride in workmanship
A workplace where people genuinely know and support each other
We believe we are better together, and that belief shows up in everything we do.
Work Authorization Requirement: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. This role is 100% onsite in Grand Rapids, Michigan. No third-party recruiters, agencies, or C2C arrangements.
 Role Overview

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Consumer
jobs.description:
This is a fully remote role in the United States.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, Consumer, you will play a pivotal role as part of the team that is building consumer-facing healthcare experiences that help people understand what they’ll actually pay before receiving care. Whether embedded in conversational AI, care navigation platforms, patient portals, scheduling workflows, or health plan and benefits platforms, our estimates give consumers real, personalized prices instead of generic ranges. Turquoise is looking for a talented individual with strong cross-functional skills, data expertise, product intuition, a deep understanding of the revenue cycle and billing and coding, and a passion for giving people certainty about the cost of healthcare.

In this role, you will be a trusted partner to our product team as we research, build, and validate thoughtful and precise pricing, billing, and bundling logic behind our shoppable service packages, providing accurate and clear estimates to consumers through our Consumer Pricing API. You’ll also partner with sales and customer success to scope opportunities well, get customers live, and help them succeed with our products.

Your expertise in our pricing data warehouse will drive more certainty and choice for consumers as they seek to understand the cost of care. You'll have the opportunity to create data-driven solutions, expand product adoption, and actively contribute to our product roadmap.

We encourage you to bring your innovative, analytical, and resourceful mindset to this role. You'll have the chance to solve unique problems, manage multiple projects efficiently, and build strong relationships inside and outside Turquoise. We measure success in two ways: thoughtful and efficient collaboration with product and engineering, and how well customers use our products, starting with careful scoping during the sale and continuing with a great long-term customer experience.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Partner with product to define, build, validate and expand our shoppable service estimates, including the pricing, billing, and bundling logic behind them

 - Work closely with data and engineering to make sure our upstream data infrastructure enables accurate estimates and supports our consumer product needs

 - Serve as the go-to technical and product expert and partner for Sales and Customer Success, leading technical discovery, scoping, and demos

 - Guide customers through API integration, implementation, and launch, making sure our products meet their needs, are fully understood, and see strong adoption

 - Gather and prioritize technical feedback from customers, and make sure it drives our product development


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, medical billing and coding, claims, care navigation, or digital health

 - Specific expertise working with institutional and professional claims

 - A deep understanding of commercial reimbursement and benefit design and how both translate to what a consumer actually pays for care

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex healthcare datasets

 - Familiarity with APIs (REST, JSON) and how customers integrate them into their products

 - Experience working in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineering, implementation, or management consulting

 - Product intuition and the ability to tackle complex research projects to produce clear answers and recommendations

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and mathematical skills, paired with creative thinking

 - Excellent written communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and seniority levels and build strong customer relationships

 - A drive to deliver consistent, accurate, high-quality work at a fast pace


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building or supporting consumer-facing care navigation or digital health products


BENEFITS

 - Competitive pay with equity options

 - Stellar health care plan options (Medical, Dental & Vision), with FSA, DCFSA, & HSA options

 - Company-sponsored disability & life insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401(k) + 4% Matching

 - Fully remote work + flexible working hours

 - $750 work-from-home setup budget

 - Paid biannual in-person company summits

 - Quarterly $150 co-hanging stipend to meet up with coworkers

 - Monthly $100 health and wellness benefit

 - Generous paid family leave

 - Annual $1,200 learning & development stipend




ABOUT TURQUOISE HEALTH

Turquoise Health is a Series C price transparency platform for finance leaders across healthcare. Backed by a16z, Oak HC/FT, Adams Street, Yosemite, Bessemer Venture Partners, and others, we power price transparency for 300+ enterprise organizations and are building the infrastructure for a more open, efficient healthcare marketplace. We're a remote-first, US-based team that values transparency, empathy, inclusivity, creativity, and ownership.

jobs.title: Safety Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Title: Safety Administrative Coordinator

Department: Safety and Security

Supervisor: Director of Environmental, Health, Safety and Security

Nashville Zoo Mission:

Nashville Zoo is dedicated to inspiring a culture of understanding and discovery of our natural world through conservation, innovation, and leadership. With a diverse collection of animals and a commitment to wildlife preservation, we provide engaging experiences for visitors of all ages.

Why Work with Us:

At Nashville Zoo, we believe in taking care of our team just as well as we care for our animals. Full-time employees enjoy a robust benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and future:

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage – including medical, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy.

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – confidential support services for mental, emotional, and financial well-being.

• 401(k) retirement plan with company matching – helping you build a secure future while you make a meaningful impact today.

• Generous paid time off and sick leave – because rest and recovery are vital.

• Exclusive zoo perks – enjoy discounts on park experiences, retail, and food services, plus complimentary membership benefits.

• A collaborative and inclusive culture – be part of a diverse team where your voice matters, your growth is nurtured, and collaboration thrives across all departments.

• AZA-accredited facility – Nashville Zoo is committed to top-tier animal care, ethics and global conservation efforts.

Job Description:

The Safety Administrative Coordinator provides essential administrative, organizational, and operational support to the Nashville Zoo’s Safety and Security Department. This position is responsible for maintaining departmental records, coordinating administrative functions, assisting with safety meetings and audits, managing office supplies and inventory, and maintaining employee training records, manuals, and related documentation.

The successful candidate will be personable, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. This position requires a proactive individual who can communicate effectively with employees and leadership, maintain accurate records, exercise discretion when handling sensitive information, and provide flexible support to departmental operations throughout the property as needed.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, or requirements. Responsibilities may be modified as operational needs change.

Duties and Responsibilities:

1. General Administrative Support

• Perform daily administrative and clerical duties to support the effective operation of the Safety and Security Department.

• Maintain Regular Attendance

• Maintain professional conduct at all times and consistently model the organizations values in all interactions with colleagues, guests, and stakeholders.

• Prepare, organize, proofread, and maintain departmental correspondence, reports, forms, spreadsheets, and other documentation.

• Assist with scheduling meetings, coordinating calendars, preparing agendas, recording meeting notes, and distributing follow-up items.

• Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems, ensuring documents are accessible, accurate, and properly retained.

• Answer departmental inquiries, communicate professionally with employees and other departments, and direct requests to the appropriate personnel.

• Handle confidential departmental records and information responsibly.

2. Safety Meetings and Audit Support

• Assist with the preparation, coordination, and documentation of departmental safety meetings and employee safety initiatives.

• Prepare meeting materials, attendance sheets, presentations, and action-item tracking documents.

• Support internal safety audits and inspections by organizing records, preparing checklists, documenting findings, and tracking corrective actions.

• Maintain audit documentation and assist with monitoring outstanding compliance items and established deadlines.

• Help coordinate safety-related communications, reminders, and follow-up activities.

• Assist with maintaining departmental procedures and documentation in accordance with established organizational requirements.

3. Employee Training and Documentation

• Maintain employee training records, certifications, attendance logs, and completion documentation.

• Assist with scheduling and coordinating required training sessions, refresher courses, and departmental development activities.

• Monitor training records for upcoming expiration dates, outstanding requirements, and documentation gaps.

• Maintain current departmental training manuals, standard operating procedures, policies, and reference materials.

• Assist with distributing updated policies and training materials and documenting employee acknowledgments when required.

• Support the preparation of training reports and compliance summaries for departmental leadership.

4. Office Supplies and Inventory Management

• Monitor office supply levels and coordinate ordering, receiving, organization, and distribution.

• Maintain accurate inventory records for office supplies, administrative materials, and other assigned departmental resources.

• Identify supply needs, anticipate shortages, and communicate purchasing requirements to department leadership.

• Assist with maintaining organized office spaces, storage areas, and departmental equipment records.

• Support inventory tracking and documentation for other assigned resources as directed.

5. Operational and Property Support

• Provide administrative and logistical assistance for special events, safety initiatives, training activities, and other departmental projects.

• Assist with preparing materials, organizing resources, and coordinating communications across departments.

• Provide temporary coverage or assistance for designated roles throughout the property when operational needs require it and the employee is appropriately trained and authorized.

• Support other departments during special events, staffing shortages, or changing operational demands as assigned.

• Adapt to shifting priorities while maintaining professionalism, attention to detail, and a service-oriented approach.

• Perform other duties as assigned to support the overall mission and operational needs of the Nashville Zoo.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Organization and attention to detail: Maintains accurate records, manages documentation, and follows through on assigned responsibilities.

• Communication and interpersonal skills: Builds positive working relationships and communicates effectively with employees across all levels of the organization.

• Multitasking and prioritization: Balances routine administrative responsibilities with time-sensitive requests and changing operational needs.

• Computer proficiency: Uses Microsoft Word to prepare documents, Excel to maintain records and track information, and Outlook to manage email and scheduling.

• Initiative and problem-solving: Recognizes emerging needs, anticipates supply and documentation requirements, and seeks solutions before issues escalate.

• Confidentiality and professionalism: Exercises sound judgment when handling employee information, departmental records, and sensitive operational materials.

• Adaptability: Demonstrates a willingness to learn new responsibilities and assist with duties outside the primary office function when needed.

• Teamwork and service: Contributes to a collaborative workplace culture and supports the department’s commitment to employee safety, guest service, and operational excellence.

• Ability to self-direct work tasks while ensuring safety and productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Some college coursework or an associate degree in business administration, office administration, occupational safety, or a related field.

• Previous experience in an administrative, clerical, office coordination, safety support, or operations support role.

• Experience maintaining training records, employee files, audit documentation, or compliance-related records.

• Familiarity with spreadsheets, document management, scheduling, and inventory tracking.

• Experience working in a large, multi-department organization, public attraction, hospitality environment, educational institution, or similar operational setting.

Physical Requirements:

Staff must frequently stand and walk for most of an 8–10‑hour shift and regularly bend, kneel, reach, climb, and perform repetitive motions while cleaning, maintaining grounds, or performing facilities repairs. These roles require frequently lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling up to 50 lbs and occasionally heavier items with assistance, as well as safely navigating ladders, stairs, uneven surfaces, and wet or slippery areas. Adequate vision, hearing, hand dexterity, and clear communication are necessary to operate tools, equipment, vehicles, and radios safely. Work occurs both indoors and outdoors year‑round in all weather conditions, with routine exposure to dust, dirt, chemicals, cleaning agents, noise, and equipment vibration. Positions may involve using power tools, machinery, or motorized vehicles and require adherence to established safety procedures. PPE such as gloves, protective footwear, eye and hearing protection, or respirators may be required depending on the task. Schedules may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional overtime based on operational needs. The role must learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete task independently, and make timely decisions in the context of a workflow.

This position operates within the administrative and operational environment of the Nashville Zoo. The employee may be required to work in an office setting, attend meetings throughout the property, and provide administrative or logistical support in indoor and outdoor environments.

The position may require prolonged computer use, sitting, standing, walking throughout the property, and occasional lifting or moving of office supplies and materials consistent with the essential duties of the role. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law.

Schedule requirements may vary based on departmental operations, special events, training activities, and organizational needs.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Departmental Expectations

The Safety Administrative Coordinator is expected to demonstrate professionalism, reliability, accountability, and a commitment to the Nashville Zoo’s mission and workplace culture. The position plays an important supporting role in maintaining departmental readiness, accurate documentation, effective communication, and consistent safety practices.

The employee is expected to follow all applicable Nashville Zoo policies and procedures, protect confidential information, complete assigned training, and work collaboratively with the Safety and Security Department and other operational teams.

Pre-employment requirements:

Nashville Zoo is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and maintains a drug-free work environment. All employment is at-will.

• All candidates are required to successfully complete a criminal background check and drug screening prior to hire.

• Pre-employment and annual tuberculosis (TB) screenings are a condition of continued employment.

Pay Range

$18.76—$18.76 USD

jobs.title: GRC Officer
jobs.description:
About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details:

Salary: £40,000 - £55,000 DOE

Location: Fully remote

About the role

As our Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) professional, you’ll take ownership of core GRC activities and play a leading role in shaping and improving our approach to governance, risk and compliance across the business.

You’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to help them understand, meet and demonstrate compliance requirements in a practical and proportionate way. Our compliance landscape is varied, covering UK legislation and regulation, UK government commercial and contractual requirements, MOD security standards, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 20000-1 and ISO 14001.

Working alongside an experienced Information Security Manager, who will provide specialist cyber security expertise, and other business leads, you’ll bring the GRC knowledge and perspective needed to ensure we meet our obligations, manage risk effectively and maintain clear evidence of compliance for internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance and continuous improvement of the organisation’s governance and compliance activities, including ISO-certified management systems.

• Plan and conduct internal audits and other assurance activities.

• Lead the coordination of external certification audits and compliance assessments, including those relating to ISO-certified management systems.

• Ensure the appropriate records and evidence are in place to demonstrate compliance, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions where needed.

• Produce clear, meaningful compliance reports for senior leadership.

• Coordinate and collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure risks are managed effectively, share requirements, gather information, coordinate governance and compliance activities, and drive agreed actions through to completion.

• With support from subject matter experts, maintain an overview of existing and emerging regulatory, contractual and industry requirements, helping to coordinate the organisation’s response where changes are needed.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for GRC across the business, providing practical advice and guidance and helping teams understand what requirements mean for them.

• Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen or simplify the organisation’s GRC approach, bringing forward ideas and taking ownership of improvements through to implementation.

Key Skills

• Demonstrable experience in governance, compliance, risk, assurance, auditing or closely related roles.

• Practical experience supporting or maintaining one or more ISO-certified management systems.

• A good understanding of governance, risk and compliance principles, including practical risk management.

• Ability to apply a pragmatic and proportionate approach to governance and compliance, balancing requirements and best practice with the practical realities, resources and risk profile of a growing organisation.

• Experience maintaining policies, processes, registers or other controlled documentation.

• Experience conducting or supporting internal audits, compliance reviews or other assurance activities.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor communications to different audiences.

• Highly organised and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines, engage effectively with stakeholders, and ensure others follow through on agreed actions.

• Experience interpreting compliance requirements and translating them into practical actions for the business.

• Confidence using a range of digital tools and systems, with the ability to quickly get to grips with new technology and find effective ways to use it in your work. We currently use Jira and Confluence for work planning, knowledge sharing and collaboration.

• Ability to work effectively remotely and in a flexible, agile environment. Please note that remote working is only permitted from within the UK.

Desirable Skills

• Practical experience supporting or maintaining ISO 9001.

• Experience coordinating surveillance, recertification or certification audits for ISO-certified management systems.

• Experience supporting compliance with UK government commercial or contractual requirements.

• Internal auditor training.

• Delivery or project management experience and training.

• Experience developing compliance reports, metrics or dashboards.

• Proficiency with the Atlassian suite, particularly Jira.

There are many great reasons to join our team!

Pension Plan

Secure your future with our competitive pension plan that offers an 8% employer contribution.

Private Medical Healthcare

Your health and well-being are our top priorities. Enjoy comprehensive private medical healthcare, which includes dental and optical care for you and your family.

Learning and Development

Your career is in your hands. We empower you to take charge of your own development, giving you the autonomy to shape your growth.

Flexible Working

We understand the importance of balancing work and life. Flexibility is not just a policy for us; it is part of our culture. We are passionate about helping you seamlessly integrate work with your home life.

Electric Vehicle Scheme

Drive sustainability forward with our electric vehicle leasing scheme. You can take advantage of this initiative through a convenient salary sacrifice program.

Holidays

Enjoy annual leave of 28 days, plus bank holidays, allowing you to recharge and spend time on what matters most.

Team Events

We love celebrating our achievements! In addition to our quarterly meetings, you can look forward to our Christmas and summer parties—opportunities to relax, reflect, and have fun as a team.

Additional Benefits

We provide life assurance for your peace of mind and a cycle-to-work scheme to support your health and sustainability goals.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you

Further Information:

Due to the nature of the work and the sectors we support, any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of the relevant security screening and clearance process.

This role requires eligibility for [BPSS / SC / DV] clearance. As part of the vetting process, candidates must meet the UK Government's residency and right-to-work requirements associated with the required level of clearance.

jobs.title: Junior Performance Marketer (Full Remote - Bulgaria)
jobs.description:
OUR VISION & PRODUCTS

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next



At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!




OUR TEAM

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.



Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23



Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)



Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)




YOUR ROLE

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


CAMPAIGN EXECUTION AND SCALING SUPPORT:

 - Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

 - Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

 - Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests


PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS AND REPORTING:

 - Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

 - Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

 - Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards


CREATIVE & FUNNEL CONTRIBUTION:

 - Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

 - Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

 - Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue


PARTNERSHIP MANAGEMENT & LEARNING:

 - Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

 - Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

 - Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts




CHALLENGES YOU’LL TACKLE

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

 - Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

 - Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

 - Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

 - Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

 - Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly




YOUR QUALIFICATIONS




HARD SKILLS

 - Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

 - Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

 - Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

 - Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

 - Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

 - Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)




SOFT SKILLS

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition




WHY EVERAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale




WHAT WE OFFER

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows




🎯 TOP TIER TALENT IS OUR MULTIPLIER

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

About the Role

The Senior Supply Planner is a key owner of material availability, driving end-to-end supply strategy across raw materials, sub-assemblies, and finished goods. Positioned at the intersection of supply chain operations and modern data automation, this role bridges internal manufacturing schedules and external supplier operations.

• 5–7+ years of supply planning or material planning experience in complex manufacturing, hardware, robotics, or high-tech industries.

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations, or related field. APICS/ASCM certification preferred.

• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, data modeling, and reporting.

• Proven capability in using AI for complex data transformation and building AI agents or automated scripts to detect supply chain outliers, anomalies, and risks.

Leadership & Process Improvement

• Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and functional leadership to AP team members and outsourced resources.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager - PCBA
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About the Role

As a Global Supply Manager – PCBA, you will lead the global sourcing and commodity strategy for printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) and closely related electronic assemblies powering Agility Robotics' humanoid platforms. You will own supplier selection, cost management, and supplier performance for this commodity, ensuring supply assurance, cost competitiveness, and scalability across development and production phases.

This is a senior, individually-owned commodity role requiring deep knowledge of electronics manufacturing, cost structures, and supplier ecosystems. You will partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Product teams to influence design decisions, drive cost efficiencies, and secure a resilient, high-performance PCBA supply chain.

About the Work

• Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for PCBAs and related electronic assemblies (sensors, power electronics, control systems).

• Collaborate early with Engineering to influence component selection, ensure DFM/DFT compliance, and align cost, performance, and manufacturability.

• Lead supplier identification, selection, and qualification across global regions, evaluating technical capability, quality systems, and scalability.

• Build and maintain strong supplier relationships, driving continuous improvement in cost, quality, and delivery.

• Champion cost modeling and clean-sheet analysis to establish cost transparency and drive competitive pricing.

• Negotiate supplier agreements covering pricing, terms, quality standards, and delivery performance.

• Drive cost-reduction and value-engineering initiatives through design optimization and sourcing leverage.

• Support New Product Introduction (NPI) by ensuring PCBAs are sourced and ready in line with program schedules and targets.

• Develop and maintain supply risk assessments and business continuity strategies for critical PCBA suppliers.

• Collaborate with CMs, JDMs, and ODMs to ensure components are sourced on time, on cost, and on spec per the Supplier Plan of Record (SPOR).

About You

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electronics Engineering — required, not substitutable with a general business or supply chain degree.

• 8+ years of procurement or supply-chain experience, with at least 5+ years focused specifically on PCBA or electronics commodity management.

• Strong working knowledge of electronics manufacturing processes (SMT, wave solder, potting, coating, testing) and the ability to read schematics, BOMs, and DFM/DFT requirements independently.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree (MBA or MS) preferred.

• Proven experience managing global electronics suppliers and contract manufacturers (CMs/ODMs) — this is a senior commodity ownership role, not an entry-level position.

• Deep experience in should-cost analysis, cost modeling, and supplier cost breakdowns.

• Familiarity with NPI processes, change management, and engineering collaboration in a product development environment.

• Skilled in negotiation, supplier performance management, and long-term strategic sourcing.

• Experience using MRP/ERP systems and supplier management tools.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally (up to 35%).

Location

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Consultant – Building Envelope / Facade Performance
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated Consultant to join our team, supporting a Senior Managing Director in resolving complex client issues related to facades, watertightness, moisture intrusion, and mold in real estate assets. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional with a background in architecture or engineering to deepen their technical expertise in building envelope performance and forensic consulting while working closely with senior leadership on high-impact client engagements.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in the investigation, diagnosis, and resolution of facade, building envelope, watertightness, moisture, and mold-related issues for real estate clients.
• Support site visits, field investigations, and visual/physical assessments of building envelope conditions (facades, cladding, windows, roofing interfaces, etc.).
• Review architectural, structural, and MEP/HVAC drawings and specifications to identify design or construction deficiencies contributing to moisture or envelope failures.
• Analyze building science data (e.g., moisture readings, thermal imaging, water testing results) and contribute to root-cause analysis.
• Prepare technical reports, findings summaries, and repair/remediation recommendations under the guidance of the Senior Managing Director.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including architects, structural engineers, HVAC engineers, and facade specialists.
• Communicate directly with clients to gather information, clarify issues, and present findings as needed.
• Stay current on building codes, industry standards, and best practices related to building envelope design and moisture management.
• Manage multiple projects/tasks simultaneously, working independently with limited day-to-day supervision while keeping leadership informed of progress and issues.

• 2–4 years of relevant professional experience with a facade consultant/manufacturer, architectural firm, building envelope firm, or engineering firm (structural, HVAC, or facade engineering), or a similar organization.
• Degree in Architecture, Structural Engineering, Mechanical/HVAC Engineering, or a related field.
• Engineer-in-Training (EIT) status preferred.
• Genuine interest in building envelope performance, watertightness, moisture control, and mold-related issues in real estate.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, client-ready technical reports.
• Ability to work independently and manage priorities with limited supervision, while knowing when to escalate issues.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Willingness to travel for site visits/field investigations as required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background as an architect, or as a facade/structural/HVAC engineer.
• Prior exposure to forensic/consulting engagements involving building envelope failures, water intrusion, or mold remediation.
• Familiarity with relevant building codes and standards (e.g., ASTM, local building codes) related to facades and moisture control.

What We Offer

• Mentorship and direct collaboration with senior leadership on high-visibility client engagements.
• Exposure to a broad range of real estate asset types and building envelope challenges.
• Opportunities for professional growth and development toward licensure/certification.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Material Planner, you will serve as the operational backbone of Base’s manufacturing supply chain. This is a high-ownership role responsible for ensuring material availability across our vertically integrated factories while balancing inventory health, cost, and production velocity.

You will not simply release POs or manage shortages reactively. You will own the end-to-end material planning strategy for critical components and assemblies - translating production plans and engineering changes into executable supply signals, driving supplier accountability, and building the planning systems and processes required to scale manufacturing at Base Pace.

This role sits at the intersection of Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Quality, and Finance, and is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks in systems, and is energized by building durable infrastructure from first principles.



What You’ll Do

 - Own material planning and execution for assigned commodities, components, or assemblies to support production, engineering builds, and ramp events.

 - Translate production demand into executable supply plans through ERP while balancing service levels, inventory targets, and cost objectives.

 - Design, manage, and continuously refine planning system parameters and master data to accurately reflect supply chain capabilities and constraints.

 - Lead material readiness for engineering changes, new part introductions, and product transitions while minimizing obsolescence and line risk.

 - Deliver clear-to-build status, material coverage views, run-out risk assessments, and scenario analyses to inform production and leadership decisions.

 - Apply analytical rigor to inventory strategy, safety stock sizing, and EOQ optimization across suppliers and production phases.

 - Serve as the primary operational interface for assigned suppliers - driving delivery performance, resolving shortages, and escalating cross-functionally when required.

 - Partner closely with Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Accounts Payable to resolve constraints and enforce execution discipline.

 - Support supplier ramp-up for new programs and production phases, ensuring operational readiness and adherence to Base standards.

 - Identify and implement improvements to planning processes, tooling, and reporting as Base scales its factories and product lines.



What You'll Bring

 - Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations, Finance, or a related quantitative field.

 - 2+ years of experience in material planning, supply chain operations, manufacturing, or a closely related role within a hardware or industrial environment.

 - Strong working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems in discrete manufacturing environments, including BOMs, part lifecycles, and procure-to-pay workflows.

 - Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets, identify risk, and drive clear operational decisions under tight timelines.

 - Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration and supplier execution in fast-paced, evolving environments.

 - High proficiency in Excel; experience with planning, analytics, or visualization tools is a plus.

 - Clear, structured communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

 - Strong alignment with Base’s operating principles - ownership, bias to action, and willingness to challenge legacy supply chain assumptions.



Preferred Skills

 - Experience with Odoo ERP.

 - SQL and related basic data manipulation skills.

 - Experience with electro-mechanical assemblies with a mixture of off the shelf and custom manufactured components, inclusive of those built by large contract manufacturers.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
The Human Resources Manager serves as the senior on-site HR partner for an approximately 200-person warehouse operation. This role is accountable for translating business priorities into practical people strategies that strengthen leadership capability, workforce stability, associate engagement, organizational effectiveness, and operational performance.

The role combines strategic partnership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced distribution environment. The incumbent advises the site leadership team, independently manages complex employee relations matters, leads workforce and talent planning, ensures consistent application of policy and employment requirements, and drives the disciplined execution of core HR processes. Success requires sound judgment, visible floor presence- working onsite each day, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence leaders at all levels.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the primary HR advisor to the site leadership team, providing independent counsel on organizational, workforce, leadership, and employee matters that affect safety, service, cost, quality, productivity, and retention.
• Develop and execute an annual site people plan aligned with operational priorities, including workforce capacity, critical-skill needs, leadership capability, succession, engagement, retention, attendance, and culture.
• Assess organizational effectiveness and recommend changes to structure, roles, spans of support, work practices, and leadership routines to improve accountability and execution.
• Lead workforce planning for an approximately 200-person operation, using staffing, overtime, turnover, absenteeism, vacancy, labor-market, and productivity trends to identify risks and recommend actions.
• Partner with operations and talent acquisition to establish recruiting priorities, selection standards, onboarding practices, and staffing strategies for hourly, technical, professional, and leadership roles, including the effective use of temporary labor.
• Own complex and sensitive employee relations matters from intake through resolution, including investigations, corrective action, performance concerns, workplace complaints, conflict resolution, and termination decisions; ensure conclusions are timely, well documented, consistent, and defensible.
• Coach leaders to improve decision quality, communication, performance management, associate engagement, and consistent application of company policy. Challenge ineffective or inconsistent leadership practices and follow through on corrective actions.
• Lead talent management processes for the site, including goal and performance discussions, talent review, succession planning, development planning, salary review, and leadership development. Ensure actions are integrated and completed with quality.
• Identify capability gaps and implement targeted development solutions for supervisors, managers, and high-potential associates, with particular focus on frontline leadership, accountability, change leadership, and associate relations.
• Lead the people and change-management workstream for significant operational changes, including shift changes, staffing model changes, process redesign, technology implementation, and organizational transitions.
• Monitor associate experience and organizational health through floor presence, leader feedback, listening channels, engagement results, exit feedback, and workforce data; translate findings into measurable improvement plans.
• Ensure site HR practices comply with applicable employment laws, company policies, collective requirements where applicable, recordkeeping standards, and internal controls. Escalate material risk and coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Health Services, Security, and HR Centers of Expertise as appropriate.
• Provide oversight and governance for leave, accommodation, attendance, wage and hour, compensation, benefits, performance, and personnel-action processes, coordinating with specialized teams while maintaining site-level accountability.
• Establish and maintain clear HR metrics, dashboards, and operating reviews. Present trends, root causes, risks, and recommended actions to site and divisional leadership; verify that agreed actions produce sustained improvement.
• Lead or coordinate HR projects and continuous-improvement initiatives across the site. Standardize processes, clarify ownership, remove administrative waste, and improve the timeliness and quality of HR service delivery.
• Provide functional direction, prioritization, and quality oversight to HR support resources and cross-functional partners supporting the site. Build effective relationships with divisional HR and North American Centers of Expertise.
• Maintain appropriate confidentiality, professional judgment, and composure when handling sensitive business and associate information.
• Perform other duties and lead special assignments consistent with the scope and level of the role.

Decision Scope and Expected Impact

• Operates with substantial independence within established policy and governance frameworks and is expected to resolve most site HR matters without routine escalation.
• Makes recommendations and influences decisions that affect site staffing, leadership capability, labor cost, associate relations, retention, organizational risk, and continuity of operations.
• Balances immediate operational needs with long-term workforce health and organizational capability, clearly identifying trade-offs and risks.
• Escalates high-risk legal, ethics, compliance, safety, or reputational matters promptly while retaining ownership for local coordination and follow-through.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant responsibility as an HR business partner or HR manager supporting operational leaders.
• Experience supporting a warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or similarly complex hourly workforce environment.
• Demonstrated experience independently handling complex employee relations investigations, performance matters, corrective action, and sensitive workplace issues.
• Demonstrated experience leading workforce planning, talent management, organizational change, and leadership development activities.
• Must be able to successfully complete applicable pre-employment screening requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting a multi-shift operation and a workforce of comparable size and complexity.
• Professional HR certification such as SHRM-SCP, SHRM-CP, SPHR, or PHR.
• Experience with SAP or a comparable enterprise HR information system and reporting tools.

Key Competencies and Capabilities

• Strategic HR partnership: Connects business priorities to workforce, organization, talent, and culture actions.
• Business and operational acumen: Understands how staffing, labor practices, leadership behavior, and workforce capability affect warehouse performance.
• Judgment and risk management: Reaches balanced, fact-based conclusions and recognizes when legal, compliance, or reputational risk requires escalation.
• Influence and courage: Builds credibility with leaders while constructively challenging decisions or behavior that create people or business risk.
• Employee relations expertise: Applies policy and employment requirements consistently while addressing issues with fairness, urgency, and sound documentation.
• Data-driven problem solving: Uses workforce measures and root-cause analysis to move beyond symptoms and recommend practical, measurable solutions.
• Change leadership: Anticipates people impacts, develops stakeholder and communication plans, and reinforces adoption through leader accountability.
• Execution discipline: Establishes priorities, assigns ownership, tracks commitments, and ensures completion of critical HR processes and improvement actions.
• Communication: Communicates clearly and credibly with hourly associates, supervisors, managers, senior leaders, and specialist partners.
• Presence and resilience: Maintains visibility, accessibility, composure, and effectiveness in a dynamic, deadline-driven operating environment.

jobs.title: Patient Support Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Montu, our Patient Support team plays an important role in ensuring patients feel informed, supported and cared for throughout their treatment journey.

We are looking for a Patient Support Coordinator to join our Pharmacy Support team at Winnersh Triangle. This is a busy, fast-paced and predominantly telephone-based role, supporting patients with prescription queries, medication availability, deliveries and any issues that may arise along the way.

Many of our patients are managing complex health conditions, so we need someone who understands that behind every call is a person relying on us to get things right. Whether you are resolving a delayed prescription, providing reassurance or working with our Pharmacy team to find a solution, the way you communicate and support our patients really matters.

This is not your typical customer service role. It requires patience, empathy, resilience and exceptional attention to detail. You will need to be comfortable managing challenging conversations, working under pressure and taking ownership of queries in a highly regulated healthcare environment.

Previous healthcare experience would be an advantage, but what matters most is your ability to communicate with compassion, remain calm under pressure and genuinely care about the difference you can make.




WHAT IS THE JOB?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, you will be the first point of contact for patients with pharmacy and medication-related queries, ensuring they receive clear, accurate and timely information.

You will work closely with our Pharmacy, Clinical and wider Patient Support teams to resolve issues, provide updates and help ensure patients receive their medication safely and efficiently.

This is a telephone-heavy role where you will manage a high volume of patient enquiries, often involving sensitive or complex situations. You will need to balance empathy with efficiency, ensuring every patient feels listened to while maintaining the accuracy and standards expected within a regulated healthcare environment.

Location and working pattern

 - Hybrid working from our Winnersh Triangle office, with three days on site and two days working from home following completion of training.

 - Full-time position, working five days per week.

 - Weekend working is required as part of the five-day working week.

 - Shifts are 7:30am to 4:30pm or 9:30am to 6:30pm, including a one-hour lunch break.


WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

 - Acting as the first point of contact for patients, primarily over the telephone, providing professional, compassionate and accurate support.

 - Managing patient enquiries relating to prescriptions, medication availability, deliveries and potential delays.

 - Taking ownership of patient queries, working proactively to resolve issues and keeping patients informed throughout.

 - Working closely with our Pharmacy team to investigate and resolve medication-related concerns.

 - Liaising with Pharmacy Dispensers regarding stock availability, prescription processing and dispensing queries.

 - Supporting communication between patients, Pharmacy, Clinical teams and healthcare professionals to ensure information is shared accurately and efficiently.

 - Providing appropriate guidance on prescription processes and medication-related queries, escalating clinical questions to qualified healthcare professionals.

 - Recognising when patients require additional support and escalating complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate teams, including Clinical Governance.

 - Maintaining accurate and detailed records of patient interactions, ensuring all information is documented in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

 - Collaborating with remote colleagues to support tasks that require action on site.

 - Working collaboratively across teams to improve the patient experience and support the safe and timely delivery of medication.


WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys supporting people, takes pride in delivering excellent service and understands the importance of getting the details right.

Essential skills and experience

 - A minimum of two years' experience in a customer service or patient-facing environment.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Level 2 Software Engineer in Support to help us make specialty medications more accessible and affordable for patients. Keep reading to learn more about the role, our team and why House Rx is the right next step in your career.

About The Role

In the role of Software Engineer in Support, you will be responsible for triaging and resolving engineering escalations, reviewing and shipping fixes across our stack, and owning projects that reduce support load over time.

What You’ll Do

• Prioritize and resolve software bugs impacting end-users (TypeScript, Node, React) and execute database changes (Postgres) to unblock workflows.

• Partner with product and engineering teams to address root causes and resolve larger product gaps surfaced through support.

• Document troubleshooting steps, solutions, and internal processes to expand the support knowledge base.

• Monitor system performance, proactively identify potential issues (Grafana, Sentry), and participate in the escalation and on-call rotation to lead incident resolutions.

• Review pull requests from teammates, providing constructive feedback on correctness, risk, and maintainability.

• Own engineering projects from scoping through delivery, focusing on tooling and fixes that eliminate recurring escalations.

About You

• Problem-Solving & Drive: Comfortable digging into unfamiliar code and production data to find root causes, and producing well-vetted fixes. You anticipate problems rather than waiting for them.

• Collaboration & Communication: Clear, proactive communicator in writing and conversation, able to explain technical issues to engineers and non-technical partners alike, and to give and receive candid feedback.

• Problem-Solving & Drive: Able to anticipate problems, dig into issues, and produce well vetted solutions.

• AI Fluency: Able to leverage AI tooling and agents while maintaining a high quality of code and focused outcomes produced from them.

• Technical Foundation:

• Have 3 years experience building and maintaining production software, have a degree in computer science or a related field.

• Judgment & Ownership: You weigh risk carefully when touching production, and know when to fix something yourself, when to escalate, and when to bring in another team.

• Craft & Growth: You view software development as a craft, stay curious, and keep raising your own bar.

• Able to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving development environment.

• An awareness that we fail and succeed together.

Why You’ll Grow With Us

You'll find a culture that supports open communication, embracing failure as a learning opportunity, and always being open to new ideas, no matter how radical. We are a remote-first company. We’re committed to creating a positive and collaborative culture to achieve our mission, all while supporting our team members in all aspects of their lives, at home, at work and everywhere in between.

jobs.title: Global Process Owner (gn) - Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Start: immediately | Level: Professional / Senior | Location: Elmshorn (on-site) | Working hours: Full-time (40h/week)

Shape the future of our manufacturing and quality operations.

As Global Process Owner – Manufacturing (gn) within our enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud transformation, you will own the global end-to-end process responsibility for our manufacturing execution, line scheduling, and quality management.

You combine strategic process design with technical implementation and bridge the gap between shop-floor operations, Quality Assurance, IT, Supply Chain, and Finance. Through your efforts, you will build a standardized, scalable, and technology-enabled manufacturing model that ensures operational excellence, compliance, and high product quality.

If you bring deep expertise in production operations and quality control within a regulated FMCG, food, supplements, or pharma environment and are passionate about driving shop-floor standardization during a major business transformation, we look forward to getting to know you.

Your Mission with Us

• Define and own the global standard process design for the end-to-end Make process — spanning detailed line scheduling, shop-floor execution, batch management, quality control, and release logic.

• Own the business requirements and target concepts across MES (SmartR), LIMS, and SAP S/4HANA (PP/QM), aligning continuously with your technology counterparts.

• Establish standardized production execution and quality release processes, including Quality Inspection (QI) hold logic, non-conformance/deviation handling, and batch release protocols.

• Govern shop-floor and quality KPIs (e.g., OEE, Right-First-Time, deviation cycle times, release lead times) while ensuring high data quality per process step.

• Drive change management, process adoption, and continuous improvement directly on the shop floor, resolving operational roadblocks with Planning, Warehousing, and Quality.

• Manage interfaces with upstream planning (line feasibility) and downstream logistics (finished-goods hand-off to LEA Reply), ensuring seamless system and operational integration.

• Align closely with adjacent Global Process Owners (Planning, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics) and the Transformation Office on cross-functional standards and interfaces.

Your Experience & Skills

• Deep expertise and extensive operational experience in production/manufacturing operations and quality management within a regulated FMCG, food, dietary supplements, or pharmaceutical environment.

• Hands-on experience with MES (SmartR or comparable) and LIMS, alongside a solid working understanding of SAP PP / QM integration.

• Strong command of QA/QC, batch management, GMP/HACCP, food safety regulations, and non-conformance/deviation management.

• End-to-end process mindset that connects capacity planning, shop-floor execution, quality release gates, and logistics hand-offs.

• Shop-floor credibility and seniority paired with a hands-on attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to drive change in an operational environment.

• Experience with SAP S/4HANA (Public Cloud) PP/QM transformations, multi-site standardization, or formal QM certifications/auditing background is a major plus.

• Fluent in English and German.

Why choose us?

Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,200 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.

You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:

• Flexible working hours and remote work options

• Attractive employee discounts

• Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass

• Corporate benefits

• 28 days vacation/year

• and much more

About Us

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021.

ESN has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, More Nutrition focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.

TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.

This is us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!
We look forward to your application! Regardless of gender, age, background, or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring to the table. Join our team and grow with us!

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. jobs.title: Sr. Clinical Informaticist
jobs.description:
Opportunity Overview:

We’re seeking a Senior Clinical Informatician to serve as a key bridge between clinical expertise and data science. In this advanced role, you’ll apply deep clinical reasoning and informatics expertise to design, evaluate, and optimize data-driven healthcare solutions. You’ll also lead ontology mapping, structured data validation, and annotation quality initiatives supporting our next-generation AI and LLM-enabled healthcare tools.

This is a remote-first role that may require travel to Boston, MA for new hire onboarding and occasional in-person team meetings and company events.

What you’ll do:

• Collaborate with clinicians, data scientists, and engineers to design and validate digital health and analytics solutions.

• Translate clinical workflows into structured data and logic for algorithms and quality measurement.

• Lead efforts in ontology mapping, terminology management (SNOMED, ICD, LOINC, RxNorm), and interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7).

• Oversee labeling and abstraction to ensure model safety, accuracy, and clinical integrity.

• Mentor junior informaticians and specialists in annotation, data validation, and workflow improvement.

What you’ll need:

• BSN or related clinical degree with active RN license required.

• 4–6+ years of experience in clinical informatics, analytics, or digital health.

• Advanced understanding of clinical data, EHR systems, and data standards.

• Experience with data modeling or AI-driven healthcare products preferred.

• Master’s degree or informatics certification (RN-BC, CPHIMS, ACHIP, etc.) a plus.

Pay & Perks:

💻 Fully remote opportunity with about 5% travel

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program

📈 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account

🏝️ Up to 184 hours (23 days) of PTO per year + company holidays
