• Client Intake: Handle inquiries, conduct screenings, gather facts, and assess case viability.

• Client Conversion & Responsiveness: Respond to prospective clients with urgency, build trust, and use a consultative soft-sales approach to guide qualified prospects toward becoming signed clients.

• Agreement Facilitation: Send and explain engagement/retainer agreements, including contingency terms.

• Education Background: Associate’s degree or comparable required; Bachelor’s preferred.

• Intake Experience: Prior law firm intake experience is strongly preferred, though relevant intake experience from other professional service environments may also be considered.

• Sales Aptitude: Soft sales skills to convert prospects without hard-selling tactics.

• Research Skills: Proficiency in using online tools for conducting thorough research.

• Team Environment: Comfort working in a fast-paced, small-team setting; willingness to take on diverse tasks.

• Quick Thinking & Urgency: Able to think on your feet, respond quickly to new leads, exercise sound judgment in real time, and remain composed in a fast-moving environment.

• Organization & Accuracy: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accurate records and strong written communication.

Why you should work here:

• Impactful Role: Directly influence case intake and the firm's focus areas, impacting profitability and success.

• Leadership Exposure: Work closely with leadership and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic legal environment.

• Growth Potential: Opportunity to grow within the firm over time, with potential pathways into areas such as paralegal or operations work.

• Independent Work: Enjoy autonomy with meaningful responsibilities and the chance to shape processes and KPIs.

Additional perks:

• Competitive Compensation: Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

• Performance Incentive Potential: The firm is developing a performance-based incentive program tied to measurable intake and conversion outcomes.

• Benefits: Health insurance, paid time off, and a retirement plan.

Your role in converting potential clients and supporting our legal team will make a lasting impact on the firm's success. If you're ready to take on this challenge and make a real difference in the legal field, we invite you to apply and join our dedicated team.

jobs.description:
The Appeal Specialist is responsible for reviewing, investigating, and resolving appeals submitted by parents, guardians, or applicants regarding Child Care Services (CCS) eligibility determinations, benefit reductions, suspensions, terminations, co-payment assessments, and other program-related decisions. This position ensures appeals are processed fairly, consistently, and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, contractual requirements, and established program procedures.

The Appeal Specialist serves as a neutral and objective reviewer, conducting fact-finding activities, evaluating eligibility documentation, interpreting Child Care Services policies, facilitating appeal hearings when required, and preparing written determinations. The role is critical to ensuring due process and maintaining the integrity of the Child Care Services program.

• Receive, review, and process Child Care Services appeal requests within established timeframes.
• Conduct comprehensive reviews of eligibility determinations, supporting documentation, and case records.
• Investigate disputed decisions involving income eligibility, family composition, employment status, residency requirements, participation requirements, and other program eligibility factors.
• Analyze applicable Child Care Services policies, Texas Workforce Commission regulations, and local board procedures to ensure accurate appeal decisions.
• Communicate with applicants, parents, guardians, eligibility specialists, providers, workforce staff, and other stakeholders to obtain information necessary for case resolution.
• Schedule, coordinate, and facilitate informal reviews, appeal hearings, or administrative review conferences as required.
• Prepare detailed case summaries, findings of fact, recommendations, and written appeal determinations.
• Maintain complete and accurate appeal records in case management systems and ensure documentation meets audit standards.
• Initiate, establish payment plans and document recoupments
• Monitor appeal deadlines and ensure all required actions are completed within regulatory timeframes.
• Draft and issue appeal outcome letters and related correspondence.
• Identify trends related to eligibility determinations and recommend process improvements.
• Assist with quality assurance reviews, audits, monitoring activities, and corrective action initiatives.
• Provide technical guidance regarding appeal procedures and Child Care Services eligibility policies.
• Ensure compliance with all federal, state, local, and contractual requirements governing Child Care Services programs.
• Maintain confidentiality of participant information and records.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Associate's degree required; Bachelor's degree preferred in Public Administration, Social Services, Business Administration, Human Services, Education, Legal Studies, or a related field.
• Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
• Two (2) years of experience in eligibility determination, case management, appeals processing, social services, workforce development, public assistance programs, or a related field.
• Experience interpreting policies, regulations, or program requirements.
• Experience handling confidential or sensitive information.
• Experience working with child care assistance programs, public benefits, or government-funded programs preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Knowledge of Child Care Services eligibility requirements and applicable program regulations.
• Ability to interpret policies, procedures, laws, and eligibility guidelines.
• Strong analytical, investigative, and critical thinking skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to conduct objective reviews and make impartial decisions.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Ability to manage multiple cases and meet established deadlines.
• Experience preparing professional reports, determinations, and correspondence.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and case management systems.
• Strong customer service and conflict-resolution skills.
• Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism when dealing with sensitive matters.

We are looking for a US Renewal Lead who will be responsible for developing the commercial strategy, commercial construct, and negotiating contract renewals for our organization.

As a US Renewal Lead, you will support a critical part of our business by aiding in the retention and growth of our largest clients. You will be part of a team of unique experts focused against understanding how and why our clients license solutions from NIQ to translate into value and commitment via a contract. Leveraging your expertise, you will develop recommendations and strategies for a deal including solutions, pricing, and terms to address current and future needs. You will collaborate with various internal partners to align and negotiate the appropriate approach supporting the revenue function of our organization.  In this role you will be critical to ensure our offers are accurate, timely and best represent the strategy developed.

Responsibilities

• Plan renewal opportunities in advance year to year to set goal and objectives.

jobs.title: Senior Onboard Vehicle Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Mission Summary:

Motional's Platform Infrastructure organization builds and operates the foundational onboard software systems that power our autonomous vehicles. Our responsibilities include system communications and IPC, networking, Linux operating system development and maintenance, high-speed data logging and offload, and onboard system performance optimization.

We are seeking an Onboard Vehicle Network Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and maintenance of our onboard vehicle network architecture. In this hands-on engineering role, you will be responsible for defining the network topology, hardware interfaces, communication protocols, and network diagnostics for both our current generation of operational autonomous vehicles and our next-generation vehicle platform. You will blend software engineering expertise with system-level network design to ensure high-throughput, low-latency, deterministic, and resilient communication across all onboard compute nodes, sensors, and controllers.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Design and evolve the onboard vehicle network topology, including physical and logical architectures for both current operational platforms and next-generation autonomous vehicles.

• Define and implement network protocol stacks, communication standards, and messaging layers across compute nodes, sensors, microcontrollers, and actuators.

• Write and maintain high-quality software and tooling for network routing, monitoring, fault detection, diagnostics, and failover handling.

• Partner with hardware, platform, and autonomy software teams to evaluate and select network hardware components.

• Establish network performance budgets, Quality of Service (QoS) policies, network isolation/segmentation strategies, and latency/bandwidth constraints.

• Build telemetry and monitoring tools to observe network health, bandwidth utilization, packet drops, and real-time communication performance.

• Diagnose and resolve complex, system-level networking issues, including loss of communication, packet drops, latency jitter, and hardware controller errors.

• Define maintenance, provisioning, and OTA firmware update strategies for onboard network switches and interface hardware.

• Contribute to technical roadmaps for next-generation onboard networking and communications infrastructure.

What We’re Looking For:

• Strong background as a Software Engineer with demonstrated ability to write, debug, and maintain production code.

• Deep understanding of embedded network architectures, network topology design, and system-level communication flows.

• Hands-on experience with networking protocols and standards (e.g., Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, CAN/CAN-FD, etc).

• Proficiency in a modern programming language (C++ is preferred, but experience in any modern language is acceptable).

• Experience designing network security policies, traffic shaping/prioritization, QoS, and logical network isolation.

• Ability to design and build software tools for network telemetry, packet inspection, and automated system diagnostics.

• Experience collaborating closely across organizational boundaries with hardware, embedded Linux, system integration, and application engineering teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex network architecture decisions to diverse engineering audiences.

Bonus Points:

• Strong, practical coding experience in modern C++ within embedded Linux or automotive software environments.

• Experience with automotive network software architectures and protocols (e.g., AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive, DDS, ROS/ROS2).

• Familiarity with automotive switch hardware, PHYs, and compute platforms (e.g., Broadcom, Marvell, NVIDIA DRIVE AGX platform).

• Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, network simulation, or bus heavy-load stress testing.

• Knowledge of Linux networking internals, socket programming, network device drivers, or eBPF-based network monitoring.

• Experience with automotive cybersecurity concepts (e.g., ISO/SAE 21434, SecOC, MACsec, onboard firewalls).

• Familiarity with Bazel build systems and large-scale software codebases.

Work Arrangement:

This role is hybrid from our Pittsburgh/Boston/LV office and requires in-office days each week to support hands-on system work and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Trader Trainee - Commodities
jobs.description:
At Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), we're seeking ambitious, analytical, and curious graduates to join our Trader Trainee Program, a structured two-year development journey designed to prepare the next generation of commodity traders and commercial leaders. Program Start Date: July 2027.

This is more than an entry-level role. It's an opportunity to learn how global agricultural commodities move from farm to customer, gain hands-on exposure to international markets, and develop the commercial skills needed to succeed in a fast-paced trading environment.

What Makes Commodity Trading Different?

When people hear the word "trader," they often think of hedge funds, investment banks, or trading financial instruments from behind a screen.

That's not what this role is.

We are looking for individuals who are passionate about the business of moving and merchandising physical commodities. Success in this program comes from curiosity about supply chains, market fundamentals, customer relationships, and global trade. While futures and risk management are important components of the role, this is first and foremost a career path in physical commodity trading and merchandising, not a traditional financial markets trading role.

At LDC, you'll learn how commodities are sourced, transported, stored, marketed, and sold around the world. You'll gain exposure to supply and demand dynamics, logistics, risk management, customer relationships, and commercial strategy while helping move essential products through the global food and agriculture supply chain.

Whether it's understanding crop conditions, analyzing market trends, evaluating trade flows, or supporting commercial decisions, you'll develop the skills and business acumen needed to build a long-term career in commodity trading.

What You'll Experience

As a Trader Trainee, you'll participate in LDC's Global Commercial Graduate Program and gain exposure to multiple areas of the business through structured rotations, formal training, mentorship, and real-world commercial experience. The program is designed to develop market awareness, analytical rigor, commercial acumen, adaptability, and relationship-building skills required for success in commodity trading.

Throughout the program, you'll:

• Learn how physical agricultural commodities are traded in domestic and international markets.
• Develop an understanding of market fundamentals, pricing, risk management, and trade execution.
• Analyze supply and demand trends, market research, and commercial opportunities.
• Gain exposure to logistics, execution, research, operations, and commercial teams.
• Participate in formal development courses covering trading fundamentals, market analysis, risk management, execution, and business communications.
• Receive mentorship and coaching from experienced traders and commercial leaders.
• Build a global network through LDC's international commercial organization.
• Work on meaningful projects that contribute directly to commercial decision-making.

What You'll Learn

By the end of the program, you'll develop experience in:

• Understanding the physical flow of commodities through domestic and export markets.
• Identifying market trends and commercial opportunities.
• Negotiating and managing risk.
• Using market intelligence to support trading and merchandising decisions.
• Leveraging data and analytics to drive commercial insights.
• Understanding logistics, quality, customer needs, and supply chain economics.
• Building strong relationships across customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

Why Join LDC?

For more than 170 years, LDC has connected farmers, markets, and consumers around the world. As part of our Trader Trainee Program, you'll gain exposure to global commodity markets, work alongside experienced commercial professionals, and participate in a structured development journey designed to accelerate your growth.

Through rotations, formal learning, mentorship, and hands-on commercial experience, you'll build the foundation for a successful career in commodity trading, merchandising, marketing, research, or other commercial leadership roles. Graduates who successfully complete the program may have the opportunity to transition into permanent commercial positions within the organization.

If you're ready to launch a career at the intersection of global markets, agriculture, analytics, and commercial strategy, we encourage you to apply and join the next generation of trading talent at LDC.

Who We're Looking For

We're hiring for potential, not prior trading experience.

You may be a great fit if you are:

• Graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree by Summer 2027, preferably in economics, finance or mathematics.
• Passionate about global trade, agriculture, economics, supply chains, or commodity markets.
• Excited by the idea of building a career in physical commodity trading and merchandising.
• Analytical and comfortable working with large amounts of data and information.
• A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating and building relationships.
• Curious, resilient, and motivated to continuously learn.
• Able to think critically, solve problems, and make informed decisions in dynamic environments.
• Must be open to relocate to either Memphis, TN or Wilton, CT.

Preferred Areas of Study

• Agricultural Economics
• Economics
• Finance
• Mathematics

jobs.title: Senior MLOps Engineer
jobs.description:

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’ page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

CivCheck is transforming how cities manage plan review and building code compliance. As part of Clariti, CivCheck brings together deep domain expertise and cutting-edge AI to streamline and modernize the permitting process. Our Guided AI Plan Review™ (GPR) platform is the first of its kind and it is helping cities and applicants alike navigate complex building codes with clarity, consistency, and speed. By combining intelligent automation with human expertise, CivCheck empowers communities to build faster, safer, and smarter.

How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻

The Senior MLOps Engineer will design, build, and scale the systems that power CivCheck and Clariti’s AI capabilities. As the first MLOps Engineer, you will lead the development of robust ML infrastructure, ensuring that models move efficiently from research to production with reliability, observability, and performance at scale.This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of machine learning, software engineering, and cloud infrastructure, and who’s motivated to enable teams to deliver high-impact ML systems efficiently and safely.

As a Senior MLOps Engineer at Clariti, you’ll get to:

• Design and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment of models and agentic AI workflows

• Build and optimize infrastructure for training and model serving across cloud providers and compute instances

• Develop tools for data pipelines, data labeling, experiment & performance tracking, and automated retraining

• Collaborate with AI researchers and ML engineers to productionize POCs and ensure model reproducibility and scalability

• Implement CI/CD best practices for ML systems, including continuous integration, automated testing, and deployment workflows

• Monitor and manage model health, performance, drift, and data quality in production

• Partner with Engineering teams to streamline infrastructure provisioning and data access

• Drive cost optimization and performance tuning for large-scale model training

• Contribute to internal documentation and best practices

What do you bring to the team? 🧠

• 6–10+ years of experience in software or ML engineering, with at least 3+ in MLOps or ML infrastructure

• Solid experience working with Python, C, C++, Bash, etc

• Proven experience deploying and managing ML models in production

• Proficiency with Docker, and Kubernetes for scalable ML system design

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and GPU orchestration

• Hands-on knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar) Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow, and other similar tools for experiment tracking and pipeline automation

• Solid understanding of data versioning, model reproducibility, and monitoring strategies

• Excellent problem-solving skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset

Bonus Points 🎉

• Experience training models from scratch, including defining architectures, curating & cleaning datasets, tuning training parameters, and bringing models from research to monitored production

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation)

• Background in distributed systems or high-performance computing

jobs.title: Principal Specialist, HR Change Management
jobs.description:
The Principal Specialist, HR Change Management is Renesas’ principal advisor for enterprise HR transformation and adoption. The role translates complex people, organization, process, policy, and technology priorities into coordinated change programs spanning governance, stakeholder alignment, communications, readiness, enablement, and adoption. Working globally across functions and regions, the role resolves ambiguous change challenges and influences senior stakeholders through expertise rather than direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Enterprise change strategy: Define and lead integrated strategies for Renesas-wide HR and organization priorities, covering the case for change, sponsorship, stakeholder analysis, readiness, communications, learning, resistance, reinforcement, and benefits realization.
• Immediate transformation portfolio: Lead change across evolving priorities such as organization simplification, job re-leveling and title cleanup, technical ladder program, rewards and benefits harmonization, HR process standardization, and digital, automation, or AI-enabled ways of working.
• Portfolio governance and delivery: Establish integrated roadmaps, milestones, interdependencies, decision forums, ownership, resource needs, risk escalation, and accountability from design through stabilization.
• Communications and enablement: Translate complex priorities into executive briefings, leader narratives, manager toolkits, presentations, FAQs, digital content, cascade plans, training, and practical support for employee conversations.
• Stakeholder and sponsor alignment: Build coalitions across HR, Legal, Communications, Finance, business functions, and regions; align outcomes, sequencing, and employee impacts while surfacing competing needs early.
• Employee experience and digital engagement: Create accessible channels and self-service resources that provide employees and managers with reliable information, tools, updates, and support throughout the change journey.
• Insights and adoption: Use readiness, adoption, sentiment, service, process, and channel data to remove barriers, refine interventions, demonstrate value, and sustain new behaviors.
• Capability and innovation: Build change capability through coaching, reusable methods, communities of practice, and mentoring, while applying external practices in workforce transformation, digital enablement, and responsible AI.

Scope and Accountability:

• Serves as Renesas’ principal advisor and thought leader for complex, enterprise-scale HR change.
• Partners with senior business and HR leaders to establish strategy, principles, and priorities across functions and geographies.
• Resolves significant and unique issues requiring conceptual thinking, independent judgment, and a long-term view.
• Develops enterprise methods and standards where established approaches are insufficient.
• Owns outcomes affecting the HR function and multiple business areas through expertise, influence, and cross-functional leadership.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent advanced knowledge in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business, Communications, Technology, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
• Typically 12+ years of progressive experience in change management, HR transformation, organization effectiveness, HR technology, or a related discipline, including complex global initiatives.
• Expertise in change strategy, organization transformation, sponsor and stakeholder management, executive communications, enablement, and adoption measurement.
• Experience across people and organization change, including organization redesign, job architecture, career frameworks, rewards or benefits harmonization, HR process transformation, and digital or AI-enabled adoption.
• Proven ability to advise executives and influence outcomes in a global, matrixed, multicultural environment.
• Strong analytical judgment and working knowledge of responsible AI, data privacy, employee relations, and regional consultation requirements.
• Change management certification such as Prosci, CCMP, or equivalent preferred.

Core Capabilities

Enterprise Change Strategy | Portfolio Delivery | Organization and Workforce Transformation | Job Architecture and Career Programs | Rewards and Benefits Change | HR Process and Digital Transformation |  Communications and Manager Enablement | Governance and Risk | Adoption Analytics | Global Collaboration

jobs.title: Manager or Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
About the role:

Patiently™ is a multi-condition telehealth business helping consumers use tax-advantaged healthcare dollars for treatment and care. As we scale our condition roadmap, we need a strong operator and strategic thinker to build and run the operational foundation of the business.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between resolving an immediate patient or partner issue and building the processes, metrics, and cadence to scale. The right person thrives in an evolving environment — comfortable building 0-to-1 workstreams, creating structure where none exists, and driving results across internal and external partners.

You will own day-to-day coordination and performance across clinical and provider workflows, pharmacy and fulfillment partners, customer support, and platform partners — working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Analytics, CS, Finance, and Operations to remove constraints and build a repeatable operating system as Patiently scales.

Key responsibilities:

Care delivery operations

• Manage the day-to-day operating relationship with Patiently's clinical, provider, and telehealth-platform partners.

• Ensure patients move smoothly from intake through provider review, treatment, and ongoing care.

• Identify workflow breakdowns and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve root causes.

• Have ownership mindset to drive solutions and think of second order effects when resolving operational challenges.

Pharmacy and supply-chain operations

• Manage operating relationships with pharmacy, fulfillment performance, turnaround times, and SLAs.

• Build contingency plans for capacity constraints, shortages and partner disruptions.

Platform and partner coordination

• Ensure responsibilities and handoffs are clear across Patiently, providers, pharmacies, customer support and technology partners.

• Lead readiness planning for major launches - workflows, escalation paths, reporting and contingency plans.

Customer-support partnership

• Partner with CS to unblock operational constraints and improve patient experience.

• Coordinate resolution of complex cases across clinical, pharmacy, payment, or partners.

Operating cadence and performance

• Utilize data for key operational metrics to drive business performance.

• Develop SOPs, playbooks, and controls that allow Patiently to scale efficiently.

What you'll need:

• Minimum of 5+ years of experience in healthcare operations, telehealth, or a similarly complex regulated environment.

• Experience managing external partners against defined service levels and business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of operational workflows with the ability to diagnose problems across multiple organizations and systems.

• Demonstrated success building processes, reporting and operating cadences in a growing and evolving business.

• Strong analytical judgment: use data to identify risks, priorities, and performance.

• Ownership mindset with hands-on operating style: investigate individual issues while building scalable solutions.

• Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress before every process or ownership boundary is fully defined.

Preferred experience

• Experience in a multi-condition telehealth or digital-health business.

• Direct experience with provider networks, pharmacy partners or prescription fulfillment.

• Experience supporting employer, benefits or B2B healthcare programs.

• Experience transitioning from outsourced operations to internally managed capabilities.

• Familiarity with healthcare compliance, patient privacy and regulatory environments.

Level Guidance:

Both levels perform the same core responsibilities above. The distinction comes down to depth of experience, scope of prior ownership, and readiness to operate with full autonomy in an ambiguous, early-stage environment.

Manager, Strategy & Operations

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare operations, telehealth, provider operations, pharmacy operations.

• Experience managing external partners against defined service levels and outcomes.

• Strong understanding of operational workflows and cross-functional problem solving.

Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations

• 5–8+ years of experience in digital health operations, including end-to-end management of multi-stakeholders, platforms and complex regulated environment.

• Has built or involved in establishing operational processes from scratch (0-1 experience) with minimal guidance.

• Track record reporting to cross-functional stakeholders/leadership on operational performance.

Note for Current Employees:

Please use the internal job board in Greenhouse to apply. Applications submitted through this external link will not be tagged as internal.

Compensation, Benefits, & Additional Details:

Health-E Commerce's compensation philosophy is grounded in market data and internal equity to ensure fairness and consistency across the team. Individuals new to the company should generally expect offers to fall between the entry point and midpoint of the salary range.  Our goal is to provide an offer that supports growth potential within the role and allows for future salary progression.

jobs.title: Metrology Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges and ensuring critical laboratory systems perform at the highest level? Eurofins is seeking a Metrology Engineer to provide technical leadership for the lifecycle management of laboratory instrumentation within a regulated environment.

In this role, you will be responsible for the calibration, qualification, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of a diverse range of laboratory equipment. You'll partner closely with laboratory operations, quality, and engineering teams to ensure instrumentation remains reliable, compliant, and ready to support scientific innovation.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced instrumentation professional who enjoys hands-on problem solving, driving process improvements, and serving as a technical subject matter expert in a fast-paced laboratory environment.

What You'll Do

• Lead calibration, maintenance, qualification, and validation activities for laboratory instrumentation to ensure operational reliability and regulatory compliance.
• Troubleshoot equipment issues, perform root cause investigations, and implement effective corrective actions.
• Support the installation, commissioning, qualification, and validation of new laboratory equipment and systems.
• Develop, review, and execute protocols, engineering assessments, investigations, and technical reports.
• Ensure instrumentation remains in a validated state through preventative maintenance programs and lifecycle management strategies.
• Manage calibration schedules, maintenance records, qualification documentation, and equipment histories.
• Analyze equipment trends to identify opportunities for increased reliability, efficiency, and performance.
• Collaborate with laboratory, quality, and technical teams to support business objectives and maintain GxP compliance.
• Serve as a technical resource during audits, inspections, and regulatory activities.
• Provide training and mentorship on instrumentation best practices and troubleshooting techniques.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance laboratory operations and equipment performance.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Instrumentation, Physical Sciences, or a related technical field.
• Minimum of 8 years of experience supporting metrology, calibration, instrumentation engineering, equipment qualification, or related functions within a regulated environment.
• Experience troubleshooting, repairing, qualifying, calibrating, and maintaining laboratory instrumentation.
• Strong technical writing skills with experience authoring procedures, protocols, investigations, and validation documentation.
• Experience working within GxP-regulated environments.
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or contract laboratory environments.
• Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), laboratory software systems, and equipment qualification programs.
• Knowledge of equipment lifecycle management, risk assessment methodologies, and continuous improvement practices.

If you’re interested in joining a high-performing team and pushing the boundaries with a clean-sheet development of a reusable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

SENIOR ELECTRICAL ENGINEER – MARINE OPERATIONS

We are currently seeking an Electrical Engineer based out of Rocket Lab's Space Structures Complex in Middle River, Maryland. You will be responsible for the design, specification, analysis, and execution of power distribution, navigation systems, controls, and communications systems on our recovery vessel.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Serve as the electrical engineering technical expert within the Marine Operations team, enabling recovery and reusability of Neutron

• Design critical electrical infrastructure, including schematics, layout, and routing for power, lighting, navigation, instrumentation, propulsion, and communications systems

• Coordinate with other Rocket Lab engineers to ensure electrical systems are well integrated with the other vessel systems

• Ensure all systems meet regulatory requirements (ABS, USCG, IEC, NFPA, FCC)

• Conduct design reviews to ensure systems meet requirements, identify risks, resource needs, and schedule estimates

• Work onboard the vessel during construction, ensuring build-out meets engineering specifications, and drive future modifications to enable more efficient mission execution

• Collaborate with the marine engineering group for commissioning and sea-trials test planning

• Troubleshoot and validate electrical systems during commissioning

• Oversee the operation, sustainment, troubleshooting, and repair of critical electrical power and control systems

• Build and manage electrical and electronic spares inventory and maintain minimum inventories of those onboard parts and components.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER:

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or marine engineering

• 3+ years of experience as an electrical engineer, preferably in the maritime industry, with exposure to large vessels and autonomous or automated vessel systems

• Technical project management experience and the ability to liaise with external suppliers

• Advanced understanding of systems design principles

• Proficient in using EPLAN or comparable electrical CAD software for developing detailed schematics, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts

• Advanced ability to analyze systems, troubleshoot and solve problems, and select and source equipment

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Project management experience in a fast-paced prototype environment

• Detailed knowledge of Siemens NX or similar CAD and PLM packages.

• Experience with hands-on projects, including the use of hand tools

• Knowledge of modern industrial communication protocols and network layers, including experience with Modbus (RTU/TCP), Profibus, Ethernet, and serial interfaces (RS-232/RS-485) for control systems

• Experience integrating marine components (hoists, thrusters, winches, radar, etc.)

• Valid and current training certifications as an Electrical or Electronic Technician issued by a recognized authority.

• At least two years of experience working on vessels of comparable size and mission duration, or in a similar industrial setting requiring equivalent qualifications and operational expertise.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored medical HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, 3 weeks paid vacation and 5 days sick leave per year, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, and free snacks/drinks onsite.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)

$156,275—$171,675 USD

Base Salary

$108,800—$149,600 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.title: Post Production Supervisor
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is seeking a Post-Production Supervisor to serve as the core driver of post-production operations for the branded content division of Vox and New York Magazine. Reporting to the Director, Creative Production, you will lead end-to-end post operations in managing project schedules, engaging freelance editors and post-production vendors, and guaranteeing that all deliverables, from social content to still photography and long-form video, meet our high-quality standards and deadlines. Collaborating closely with Creative Directors and Producers, you will optimize post workflows and implement efficient operational practices. Serving as the ultimate steward of the production pipeline, you will work hand-in-hand with creative teams through final delivery, taking pride in delivering polished, high-caliber final assets.

Crew and Vendor Support

• Resource and assign editors, colorists, retouchers, and sound mixers per campaign based on availability, budget, edit style, and Creative Director input

• Onboard external support and manage timely payment and budget tracking

• Build and maintain a vetted roster of post-production resources, staying current on new talent and tools in the field

Schedule and Workflow Management

• Manage post-production tracker and calendar, finding automation efficiencies to improve workflow

• Approve and oversee post-production timelines for all active campaigns

• Confirm schedule feasibility with editors, vendors, and internal stakeholders

• Establish and maintain technical workflows for media, dailies, and archival/stock footage

• Track licensed assets across campaign deliverables such as royalty-free stock and music

• Track physical hard drives sent to and from editors or other post support

• Set up and manage campaign-specific post-production Slack channels with all associated resources

• Work alongside management to track and distribute post resources, including Frame.io, stock and library logins, and subscriptions

Delivery and Quality Control

• Archive and back up all raw media files, edit versions and project files from campaigns into Lucid link

• Enforce file-naming conventions and delivery specs across video and photo outputs

• Work in tandem with the Design team to ensure graphics and animations are incorporated efficiently and on time

• Review every cut and photo asset alongside Creative and Production for color, retouching quality, and spec compliance before client review

Leadership and Process

• Guide the overall team in adopting efficient workflows and media-management practices

• Develop and maintain SOPs for post-production to keep output consistent as the team scales

• Own budget tracking and vendor invoicing across active post-production work alongside Production

• Stay current on post-production tools and platforms, leading adoption of new tools that improve speed or quality

WHO YOU ARE

• 4-6 years of experience managing post-production in branded content, media, or an agency environment

• Deep understanding of digital production workflows across both video and photo post

• Experience managing production budgets, timecard approvals, vendor invoicing, and payment tracking

• Fluency with Frame.io and asset/production-tracking platforms (Airtable or similar)

• Experience building and maintaining SOPs or process documentation for a scaling team

• Solid grasp of the legal side of post-production, including copyright, licensing, and clearance procedures for third-party content

• Strong people-management instincts, with the ability to anticipate roadblocks and conflicts before they arise

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical post-production concepts for non-technical stakeholders

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

• This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office three days a week & remote two days a week.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range

$110,000—$130,000 USD

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.

Vox Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer and qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact our recruiting team (recruitment@voxmedia.com).

jobs.description:
You will join our Environment & Health department

As our new Entry Level Air Quality Consultant you will be part of the Air & Climate Service Line within Ramboll’s Environment & Health Division. This group consists of like-minded individuals who are passionate about air and climate issues and assisting Ramboll’s clients with their most challenging problems. The Air & Climate team consults with clients across various industries on a range of topics, including but not limited to emissions estimation, air dispersion modeling, human health risk assessment, climate change, permitting, and compliance.

Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:

Your starting point for constant growth

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:

• B.S. or M.S. in Chemical, Mechanical, Civil, or Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Atmospheric Science, or a science degree with air quality course work with a GPA of 3.5 or higher
• Strong computing skills including high level use of spreadsheets and word processing
• Strong written/verbal communication, problem-solving and organization skills

Welcome to our Environment & Health division

Ramboll develops innovative, scientifically sound solutions that help increase live ability by reducing pollution and restoring natural environments. One of the world’s leading environmental and health consultancies, our bright minds are trusted by clients to manage their most challenging environmental, health and social issues.

Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $58,416 to $73,020 yearly. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Receptionist, internally known as a Member Support Specialist, you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you'll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback-driven multi-disciplinary teams

• A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $21.50 per hour based on a full time schedule.

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place between Monday-Friday 7:00am-7:00pm based in person at our Union Station office in Washington, DC.

Physical Demands:  Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Arabic Speaking Center-Based Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. jobs.title: Senior Airframe Tech Writer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Mission Success team is a cross-functional group that partners with every business line and supports all products that Anduril builds. Our responsibilities include product operations, training and adoption, and user documentation. We are seeking an experienced Technical Writer to create and maintain user documentation across our diverse business lines. We believe that the quality of our documentation should reflect the quality of products, which are world-class.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Airframe Tech Writer, your mission is to partner with our numerous product and operations teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to use Anduril products. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, operations, and various subject matter experts to understand our products, identify user workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the Seniorr Airframe Tech Writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts.

With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, user documentation plays a critical role in ensuring front-line operators know how to leverage the “arsenal of democracy.” Your mission is to make the process of learning how to operate systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally well written and presented artifacts.

You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. You will engage subject matter experts at the right time, and you will guide them towards a finished user-facing document that plainly meets customer needs. Finally, you will work with our account teams to ensure that contract deliverables are accurate, on-time, and in the right format.

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: technical manuals, operational manuals, maintenance manuals, procedures, checklists, templates, user guides, troubleshooting guides, and release notes. You will partner with account, product, and engineering teams across all phases of product development to ensure users have the right documentation available.

Along with our commercial offerings outlined above, Anduril is pursuing Programs with the GOV, which require documentation in standards such as MIL-STD-40051D, and S1000D, delivered via IADs. Familiarity with these standards and delivery methods, is highly desired.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Generate, review, and edit documentation that is user-focused. Work with engineering and operations to deliver task, conditions, standard-centric documentation.

• Evaluate and prioritize tasks required to successfully support product documentation efforts and keep them on track. Help drive the best decision for the company by using a data-driven approach and consider input from stakeholders to ensure well-informed decisions.

• Communicate and help manage expectations. Ensure risks are noted with adequate time, and shared with leadership.

• Help build a culture of technical documentation by contributing to the living documentation process, ensuring that those that come after you learn from your acquired Anduril experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation.

• Experience writing technical user-facing documentation.

• Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation.

• Experience building content in a variety of formats (Word, XML, etc)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local, to be onsite in Ashville, OH

• In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Military exposure and experience, particularly with military technical documentation writing and formatting standards, guidelines, and verbiage (MIL-STD-40051, S1000D, etc)

• Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with emphasis on technical subjects.

• Passion for excellent documentation and user experience.

• Previous experience creating technical documentation in Aerospace and Defense (for DoD).

• Experience delivering content on fast-paced, complex projects with multiple stakeholders.

US Salary Range

$126,000—$167,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Technical Marketing Manager, you will be tasked with owning the technical story that earns SentinelOne attention long before a deal exists, across our market-leading Singularity™ Platform: Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, AI Security, and the Autonomous SOC, and the products behind them, Singularity Endpoint, Singularity Cloud, Singularity Identity, Singularity AI-SIEM, Purple AI, and Prompt Security. Your job is to make the practitioners and technical influencers who shape buying decisions curious enough to come looking. Technical Marketing and Product Marketing are different jobs here: Product Marketing owns the market story, including segmentation, positioning strategy, pricing, launch, and the business case, while you own the technical one.

Some travel may be required.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Lead one or two medium to high impact projects while contributing to several others, creating the demos, content, and technical thought leadership that earn practitioners' attention early.

• Own the technical value proposition for the work you take on, articulating the how and the why behind the product, not only the what; develop, refine, and defend technical positioning covering technical benefits, integration capabilities, security features, and performance metrics, and translate it into customer-centric narratives a practitioner recognizes as true.

• Develop and land high-quality technical content, including white papers, technical blogs, solution briefs, deployment and integration guides, technical articles, FAQs, and reference architectures, making each one an argument a practitioner wants to follow rather than a specification they have to decode; build for reuse so each piece keeps producing long after the launch that prompted it, and hold the technical accuracy line on your own work and on the content you review for others.

• Develop demos, demo scenarios, webinars, and videos end to end, from the environment it runs on through the final edit, with light manager input rather than step-by-step direction, standing up whatever environment you need and pressure-testing what you are about to say before it reaches a slide.

• Design realistic attack and threat simulations that bring customer outcomes to life, and turn public testing such as MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations into content practitioners actually want to read.

• Own the plan and the calendar for the work you take on, sequencing topical content, community activity, and thought leadership against launches, threat events, and what practitioners are already talking about; run it like a program with named deliverables, real dates, and a current view of who owes what, chasing contributors you do not manage and landing the work on the date you committed to across competing timelines.

• Use data and insights, including content performance, demo telemetry, field feedback, and search behavior, to decide what to make next and what to retire.

• Work closely with product management, product engineering, detection engineering, threat research, product marketing, sales engineering, and analyst and media relations to stay ahead of what is shipping, why it was built that way, and where adversary tradecraft is moving; partner with competitive and market intelligence, bringing the hands-on technical read to the market picture they own, build the credibility and relationships that make people who do not report to you want to help, and bring the right people in when a problem is bigger than your project.

• Present the work at webinars, user groups, and partner engagements as opportunities come up, and stay active in the communities where security practitioners discuss this technology.

• Carry real deployment and evaluation feedback into product management and engineering, grounded in what you see in labs, proofs of concept and value, competitive bake-offs, and architecture and design reviews, and bring whatever instincts you built in a customer-facing technical seat to that work.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• Big passion for cyber-security and for the technology itself, with genuine enjoyment in understanding how a product works under the hood.

• Real technical depth and the hands-on habits that keep it current, a requirement we do not flex: you stand up your own lab, build your own demo environment, run your own tests, read the detection logic, and hold a technical conversation with detection engineers and threat researchers without an interpreter.

• Working knowledge of endpoint, cloud, identity, and data security, and familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

• 3 to 5 years of directly related experience, or 4 to 6 years of general professional experience, across technical marketing, sales engineering, solutions architecture, product management, or a hands-on security operations role.

• Strong storytelling in both writing and demos: the ability to carry a technical argument in prose, edit your own work down hard, land the same argument live in a demo, and simplify complex technical concepts without flattening them into marketing language, with presence and credibility in a room of practitioners.

• Strong organizational skills: you track your own deliverables and dates, keep a dozen threads straight at once, and people hear about a slip from you before they notice it themselves.

• A highly collaborative, low-ego approach, comfort in cross-functional teams with competing priorities, the ability to build technical partnerships that outlast any single launch, and a positive, problem-solving attitude.

• The ability to operate independently inside established procedures, taking a demo or piece of content from idea to published with light manager input, holding a consistent delivery cadence rather than working in bursts, and building frameworks others can reuse rather than one-offs only you can run.

• A growth mindset with comfort in experimentation, data-driven about what is working and unsentimental about what is not, with the relentlessness to stay with a hard problem, adjust when the evidence says to, and land the commitment you made.

• Prior technical marketing engineer or sales engineer experience is preferred but not critical if the depth above and proven demo-building, content, and positioning skills can be demonstrated.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

• Flexible time off

• Paid company holidays and paid sick time

• Gender-neutral parental leave

• Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Life and disability insurance

• Health and dependent care FSA

• Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• ARAG pre-paid legal

• Nationwide pet insurance

• Cancer Care program

• Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

• Home office allowance

• Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

• Wellness coach

• Wellness/gym reimbursement

• Fertility coverage

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply.  If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

$108,000—$149,000 USD

.

Teaching & Student Success
