jobs.title: Senior Embedded Applications Engineer, Tiny ML Lab
jobs.description:
Build Physical Rigs. Collect Real-World Sensor Data. Deploy TinyML on Silicon.

About the Role & The Reality AI Lab

The Renesas AIoT Center of Excellence in Columbia, MD (formerly Reality AI) is seeking a hands-on Senior Edge AI Applications Engineer to build and deploy edge AI solutions that integrate machine learning with real-world hardware systems.

In this role, you will work directly in our physical lab facility, executing proof-of-concept (PoC) hardware builds, assembling custom sensor setups, and deploying low-power ML models onto microcontrollers. You will operate at the exact intersection of small-scale physical fabrication, digital signal processing (DSP), C/C++ embedded firmware, and microcontroller-level TinyML deployment.

You will execute non-visual sensing solutions - instrumenting physical hardware setups (industrial motors, automotive systems, consumer devices), collecting high-frequency time-series sensor data, building custom DSP pipelines, and optimizing tiny machine learning models to run on Renesas silicon.

Are you an Embedded Engineer or Applied Physicist who thrives in a physical lab environment building custom sensor rigs, soldering prototype boards, and squeezing machine learning models onto microcontrollers?

ATTENTION APPLICANTS: READ BEFORE APPLYING

• This is a physical lab execution and embedded hardware role.
• DO NOT APPLY if your background is strictly in Cloud AI, Data Science, Generative AI, LLMs, LangChain, or Web Backend APIs.
• DO APPLY if you have 2–3+ years of experience building physical prototype rigs, writing embedded C/C++, running FFTs on raw accelerometer/acoustic data, debugging SPI/I2C signals with an oscilloscope, and running TinyML on bare-metal silicon.

Key Responsibilities

• Physical Prototyping & Fabrication: Hands-on assembly of prototype rigs, sensor arrays, 3D-printed mounts, and microelectronic setups to capture real-world physical data.
• High-Frequency Sensor Data Engineering: Instrument physical systems to capture, clean, and preprocess high-frequency time-series datasets (acoustic, vibration, electrical, motor current).
• DSP & TinyML Deployment: Build DSP feature extraction pipelines (FFTs, spectral analysis, filtering) and deploy optimized, quantized TinyML models onto microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, Renesas RA/RX/RL78) using TFLite Micro, CMSIS-NN, or eIQ.
• Embedded Firmware Development: Write real-time C/C++ firmware, bare-metal or RTOS drivers (FreeRTOS, Zephyr), DMA buffer management, and low-level peripheral communication (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN).
• Customer & Cross-BU Collaboration: Work directly with customers and internal product teams to ingest raw hardware telemetry, debug edge firmware issues, and demonstrate working hardware solutions.
• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead junior engineers on lab tasks, document engineering best practices, and contribute technical leadership across cross-functional teams.

Why Join Renesas?

• No SCIF / No Clearance: Enjoy complex signal processing and hardware challenges without defense contractor bureaucracy or classified workspace restrictions.
• Commercial Product Impact: What you build in our lab gets integrated into Renesas silicon and deployed into millions of industrial, automotive, and consumer devices globally.
• Startup Autonomy + Global Backing: Small-team environment (under 50 people in Columbia) backed by one of the world's premier semiconductor manufacturers.

• Education: B.S. or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline.
• Career Experience: 2–3+ years of hands-on career experience in embedded software, physical hardware prototyping, digital signal processing, and real-time edge computing.
• Hardware & Lab Skills: Practical experience in physical system fabrication, 3D printing, electrical assembly, PCB bring-up, and low-level debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD.
• Embedded Firmware: Strong C/C++ programming for constrained microcontrollers, bare-metal or RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr), DMA buffer management, and low-level drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN).
• Signal Processing & On-Device ML: Solid understanding of digital signal processing (DSP) for time-series/audio data and practical experience deploying quantized ML models directly onto microcontrollers.

The expected annual pay range for this position is $84,000 - $105,000. This position is also eligible for   bonus opportunities and commission pay.  Please note that the final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

In addition to elective benefit options, benefited employees receive company-paid life insurance and AD&D, LTD, short term medical benefits as well as paid sick time, paid holidays, and accrued paid vacation. jobs.title: Fabrication Team Lead - Houston, TX
jobs.description:
Fabrication Floor Lead

Crane Structural Fabrication

Location: Houston, Texas

Company: Konecranes

Position Summary

Konecranes is seeking a hands-on Fabrication Team Lead to lead fabrication personnel responsible for the manufacturing of custom-engineered crane structures, including bridge girders, end trucks, trolley frames, platforms, walkways, machinery structures, and other welded assemblies used in overhead and gantry crane systems.

The Fabrication Foreman is responsible for the safe, efficient, and high-quality execution of all fabrication activities, including material preparation, fit-up, welding, dimensional verification, and structural assembly. This position provides direct leadership to fabrication employees and is accountable for safety, productivity, quality, schedule adherence, and workmanship.

Success in this role requires a visible leader who actively engages on the shop floor, promotes accountability, and ensures all fabricated structures meet engineering requirements, dimensional tolerances, and applicable welding standards, including AWS D14.1. The ideal candidate understands that crane manufacturing demands exceptional precision, weld quality, and structural integrity to ensure safe and reliable operation in the field.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and direct welders, fitters, fabricators, and production personnel.
• Establish clear performance expectations and hold employees accountable for safety, quality, productivity, and attendance.
• Promote a culture of craftsmanship, ownership, discipline, and continuous improvement.
• Provide coaching, training, and development opportunities for fabrication employees.
• Support employee development and succession planning within the department.
• Foster teamwork and collaboration between Fabrication, Engineering, Quality, Planning, and Assembly teams.
• Maintain a visible presence on the shop floor and actively support daily operations.

Fabrication Operations

• Oversee fabrication, fit-up, welding, grinding, structural assembly, and material handling activities.
• Coordinate manpower, equipment, and resources to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
• Monitor workflow and remove obstacles impacting productivity and throughput.
• Ensure fabrication processes are executed in accordance with approved drawings, work instructions, and welding procedures.
• Manage daily production priorities and communicate progress, risks, and resource needs to management.
• Drive labor efficiency while maintaining quality and safety expectations.
• Coordinate with engineering and quality personnel to resolve fabrication issues and drawing discrepancies.

Welding Quality & Structural Integrity

• Ensure all welding activities are performed in accordance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), quality requirements, and AWS D14.1 standards.
• Verify weld quality through proper fit-up, joint preparation, welding practices, and visual inspection standards.
• Ensure welders maintain required qualifications and certifications.
• Drive first-pass weld quality and minimize weld repairs and rework.
• Review weld defects, nonconformances, and repair activities and implement corrective actions.
• Work closely with Quality personnel to ensure compliance with inspection and testing requirements.
• Promote workmanship standards that result in safe, structurally sound crane components.
• Quality & Dimensional Control
• Ensure fabricated structures meet engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
• Maintain strict control of dimensional tolerances, structural alignment, and fabrication accuracy.
• Verify girder geometry, wheel alignment, rail alignment, span dimensions, camber requirements, and structural squareness.
• Ensure fabricated components transition to assembly operations without quality-related delays.
• Drive first-time quality and reduce fabrication-related rework.
• Support root-cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions for recurring quality issues.
• Ensure all required inspection documentation and production records are completed accurately.
• Safety Leadership
• Lead and promote a strong safety-first culture throughout fabrication operations.
• Ensure compliance with all Konecranes safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
• Conduct routine safety observations, audits, and corrective actions.
• Promote safe welding, cutting, rigging, lifting, and material handling practices.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient work environment utilizing 5S principles.
• Actively investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions and implement corrective measures.

*This position will be located on the factory floor

Desired Qualifications

• Experience leading fabrication, welding, structural steel, heavy equipment, or industrial manufacturing operations.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop hourly production personnel.
• Thorough understanding of welding processes, fabrication methods, and structural assembly techniques.
• Working knowledge of AWS D14.1 welding requirements and quality standards.
• Ability to read and interpret fabrication drawings, weld symbols, inspection reports, and engineering documentation.
• Experience with dimensional inspection, alignment verification, and structural tolerance control.
• Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
• Crane manufacturing, structural steel fabrication, bridge construction, heavy equipment, or similar experience preferred.

What Success Looks Like

• Consistent achievement of fabrication schedules and production targets.
• High first-pass weld acceptance rates.
• Reduced weld repairs, rework, and quality escapes.
• Compliance with AWS D14.1 and Konecranes workmanship standards.
• Improved labor productivity and fabrication efficiency.
• Strong employee accountability, engagement, and development.
• Safe, organized, and disciplined fabrication operations.
• Delivery of structurally sound, dimensionally accurate crane components ready for assembly.

What we offer:

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

Konecranes moves what matters. Konecranes is a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Trella Health, our mission is simple: empowering meaningful change in healthcare.

We are building AI-enabled intelligence and workflows that help healthcare organizations make smarter decisions, strengthen operations, and support healthier outcomes for patients. Our platform connects health systems and post-acute providers through actionable intelligence and connected workflows that improve how care is coordinated across the healthcare continuum.

That work starts with our people. Trellavators are collaborative, curious, and committed to doing meaningful work that makes a measurable impact. We move quickly, support each other, keep our commitments, and continuously look for better ways to serve our customers and one another.

If you are excited by the opportunity to grow your career while helping shape the future of healthcare intelligence, workflows, and outcomes, we would love to meet you.

Position Overview:

The Clinical Solutions Development team is a fast-moving, high-quality group focused on solving one of healthcare’s most complex challenges: patient discharge. We are expanding the scope of our work and the team to solve it. To help us do that, we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design, build, and scale the data-driven healthcare solutions. You'll own significant pieces of our architecture, set technical direction, and raise the bar for engineering quality across the team. This is a hands-on role for someone who writes excellent code and elevates the people and systems around them.

We operate like a startup within a larger organization–highly collaborative, often challenging status quo, and always looking to get better. If you’re excited about building something meaningful (and having fun while you do it), we’d love to meet you.

Location: This is a hybrid position requiring 1 day a week in our Philadelphia office.

Reports to: Manager, Software Engineering

As a Senior Software Engineer at Trella, you will:

• Design complex, scalable systems; review code; maintain technical documentation and diagrams ensuring best practices.

• Resolve challenging issues; optimize performance and reliability; lead root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

• Build cloud-native solutions; support CI/CD, automation, containerization; collaborate on infrastructure provisioning and monitoring.

• Apply security best practices; mitigate risks; ensure compliance with standards and regulations.

• Drive engineering excellence by defining best practices in testing, documentation, and observability.

• Mentor engineers; share expertise; foster collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning culture.

• Architect and implement efficient API integration patterns to build backend services, collaborate with front-end engineers to define API contracts, and ensure seamless data flow between systems.

• Partner closely with cross-functional teams in design, product, and other business units.

• Take ownership in product features that drive Trella’s mission.

• Improve the team through the process and/or technical contributions.

• Be results-driven: We prosper by delivering value to our customers. We need each team member to be customer-centric and focusing on actions that provide value to the customer

This job might be a fit for you if you have:

• 7+ years of software development, including experience with distributed systems and cloud platforms.

• Expert proficiency in programming languages and API development (Java, Python, JavaScript, REST) with a strong understanding of architectural patterns and system design.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.

• Experience working with RESTful APIs and system integrations.

• Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards.

• Good understanding of JSON, SQL, and GIT actions.

• Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and logging.

• A constant desire to grow, learn and explore new things.

• Experience developing applications for healthcare is a plus.

About Trella Health

Trella Health is the AI-powered intelligence and workflow platform helping health systems and post-acute providers turn fragmented healthcare data into decisive action. We bring together market intelligence, referral workflows, patient discharge automation, and care coordination tools so healthcare organizations can make smarter decisions, strengthen business and clinical operations, and deliver high-quality, cost-efficient care.

Powered by billions of data points across claims, referrals, patient discharge, and clinical data, Trella Health gives customers the intelligence and workflows they need to understand their markets, build stronger referral relationships, coordinate patient care transitions, and grow with confidence.

Since launching our first product in 2016, Trella Health has continued to grow our team, our platform, and our impact across healthcare. Today, we support more than 17,000 customers, including leading post-acute providers and health systems, and more than 63,000 users across the care continuum.

Trella Health is headquartered in Atlanta, with a growing presence in Philadelphia and team members located across the country.

Join Us

At Trella Health, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work with people who are focused on outcomes, committed to continuous improvement, and supportive of one another. We believe great work happens when team members feel trusted, connected, and empowered to grow.

Our culture is built on transparency, accountability, partnership, and the belief that better healthcare starts with better decisions. Trellavators work hard, move fast, celebrate wins, and have fun along the way.

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members inside and outside of work, including:

• Health, dental, vision, and voluntary benefits

• Competitive salary, incentive compensation, and equity shares

• 401(k) retirement savings

• Flexible PTO and 10 paid holidays

• Flexible work hours

• Paid leave programs

• Marketplace for discounted retail and entertainment

At Trella Health, you can grow your career while helping build technology that strengthens healthcare operations, improves care coordination, and supports healthier outcomes for patients.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Trella Health is an equal opportunity employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, handicap, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status as recognized by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Master HVAC Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

FACILITIES

Rocket Lab’s Facilities team is responsible for the maintenance, operation, and continuous improvement of our sites, ensuring our teams have the safe, reliable, and high-performance environments they need to deliver on our mission. At our Middle River, Maryland Space Structures Complex, our work environment presents unique challenges, including demanding weather conditions and specialized production requirements; making robust, adaptive facility management essential.

MASTER FACILITIES TECHNICIAN

As the onsite Master Facilities Technician at Rocket Lab’s Space Structures Complex in Middle River, MD, you will play a pivotal role in both maintaining and building out our facility. This is not just a maintenance role: you’ll be hands-on in the construction, renovation, and expansion of our site, ensuring our infrastructure keeps pace with our rapid growth and evolving needs. With a strong emphasis on HVAC systems—critical to our production processes and sensitive to Maryland’s climate—you’ll directly impact our ability to build and launch the Neutron vehicle on schedule.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Lead facility build-out and improvement projects: Oversee and execute facility expansion, renovation, and construction projects, including planning, procurement, installation, and commissioning/decommissioning of equipment and systems.

• Critical HVAC operations: Maintain, repair, troubleshoot, and upgrade all HVAC systems (package units, split units, exhaust fans, etc.), ensuring optimal performance in challenging weather conditions and supporting sensitive manufacturing environments.

• Preventative and corrective maintenance: Develop and execute preventative maintenance schedules for all building systems, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, safety, and waste management to maximize uptime and reliability.

• General facility operations: Manage day-to-day facility operations, including general building and equipment maintenance, repairs, and upgrades, with responsibility for major facility renovations and construction as needed.

• Plumbing and utility support: Assist with plumbing maintenance, new installations, and repairs to support facility and production needs.

• Safety and compliance: Ensure all maintenance and construction work adheres to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications. Manage hazardous waste streams in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.

• Project and ticket management: Oversee the facilities ticketing system (JIRA), prioritize and resolve breakdowns, and track work orders to completion within budget.

• BMS/BAS implementation: Support the rollout and ongoing management of new Building Management Systems (BMS) and Building Automation Systems (BAS).

• Site oversight: Maintain and enforce site safety, security, and cleanliness standards across the Space Structures Complex and manufacturing infrastructure.

• Emergency response: Respond to facility emergencies, including after-hours or weekend calls, to minimize downtime and protect critical operations.

• Other duties as assigned, including occasional travel.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• 10+ years of HVAC maintenance experience and a High School Diploma or GED.

• Journeyman or Master HVACR license.

• Facility maintenance experience in aerospace, automotive, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• EPA 608 Universal License

• Electrical journeyman license.

• PID setting experience.

• HVAC system design and/or CAD experience.

• Experience with facility BAS/BMS systems and improvement projects.

• Experience in contamination control or cleanroom environments.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Work in environments with electrical hazards, chemical exposure, temperature variations, and noise

• Wear required PPE as assigned, which may include safety glasses, gloves, respirators, and/or other protective clothing for extended periods

• Move between buildings, labs, and work areas, as needed

• Lift, carry, push and pull materials and equipment up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, and varied shifts as operational needs require

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
RESEARCH ASSISTANT 

 


ABOUT LATENT LABS




At Latent Labs, we are building frontier models that learn the fundamentals of biology. We pursue ambitious goals with curiosity and are committed to scientific excellence. Before building Latent Labs, our team co-developed DeepMind’s Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold, invented latent diffusion, and built pioneering lab data management systems as well as high throughput protein screening platforms. At Latent Labs you will be working with some of the brightest minds in generative AI and biology.



Our team is committed to interdisciplinary exchange, continuous learning and collaboration. Team offsites help us foster a culture of trust across our London and San Francisco sites.



We’re looking for innovators passionate about tackling complex challenges and maximizing positive global impact. Join us on our moonshot mission.




THE OPPORTUNITY 


We are seeking a curious and engaged Research Associate to join our team working at the interface of generative AI and biology. Working closely with a team of lead scientists, you will help execute and optimize assays to functionally test and characterize novel proteins designed using our proprietary models. This hands-on laboratory role emphasizes mammalian cell culture, cell-based assays, and high-throughput screening (HTS).

This is an opportunity to contribute to an organization applying artificial intelligence to longstanding scientific challenges while developing your experimental skills. You will receive scientific guidance and mentorship, take ownership of routine laboratory workflows, and collaborate with teammates to generate reliable, reproducible data.

We are seeking a curious and engaged Research Associate to join our team working at the interface of generative AI and biology. Working closely with a team of lead scientists, you will help execute and optimize assays to functionally test and characterize novel proteins designed using our proprietary models. This hands-on laboratory role emphasizes mammalian cell culture, cell-based assays, and high-throughput screening (HTS).

This is an opportunity to contribute to an organization applying artificial intelligence to longstanding scientific challenges while developing your experimental skills. You will receive scientific guidance and mentorship, take ownership of routine laboratory workflows, and collaborate with teammates to generate reliable, reproducible data.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Maintain mammalian cell cultures. Perform routine cell culture, including thawing, passaging, expansion, cryopreservation, and monitoring cell health. Prepare cells for screening experiments using consistent aseptic technique.

 - Execute high-throughput screening workflows. Run plate-based assays to evaluate protein activity, using established protocols, appropriate controls, and careful sample tracking. Support workflows in 96- and/or 384-well formats.

 - Support assay development and optimization. Work with lead scientists to test assay conditions, assess reproducibility, and troubleshoot experimental issues. Contribute observations and ideas that improve assay performance.

 - Use laboratory automation. Operate liquid handlers, plate readers, and other screening equipment following training and established procedures.

 - Document and summarize results. Maintain accurate experimental records in Benchling or a similar electronic lab notebook, track samples, and share results with the team.

 - Support daily laboratory operations. Prepare reagents, maintain supplies, store deliveries, and help keep shared equipment and workspaces organized and ready for use.


YOU BRING:

 - Relevant education and laboratory experience. A bachelor’s degree in molecular biology, cell biology, biochemistry, or a related field with approximately 1–3 years of relevant laboratory experience, or a master’s degree with 0–2 years of relevant experience. Academic research and substantive internship experience are both welcome.

 - Hands-on mammalian cell culture skills. Experience maintaining mammalian cell lines, using aseptic technique, and assessing cell viability and culture quality. Experience with transfection is a plus.

 - Experience with HTS or high-throughput assay workflows. Familiarity with multiwell plate assays, multichannel pipetting, plate layouts, controls, and consistent sample handling. Experience with automated liquid handling.

 - A foundation in experimental biology. Experience with cell-based assays and one or more complementary techniques, such as flow cytometry, ELISA, fluorescence or luminescence assays, or molecular cloning. Expertise in every technique is not expected.

 - Careful data handling and documentation. Comfort organizing and reviewing experimental data using Excel, GraphPad Prism, or similar tools. Familiarity with Benchling or other sample-tracking systems is a requirement. Familiarity with Python, or a willingness to learn, is a requirement.

 - A collaborative, curious approach. You communicate clearly, ask questions, flag unexpected results, and welcome feedback. You can execute established protocols independently after training and work with lead scientists on unfamiliar methods or troubleshooting.

 - Strong organization and attention to detail. You enjoy hands-on laboratory work, manage routine tasks reliably, and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining experimental quality.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer strongly competitive compensation and benefits packages, including:

 - Private health insurance

 - Pension/401(K) contributions

 - Generous leave policies (including gender neutral parental leave)

 - Hybrid working

 - Travel opportunities and more

 

We also offer a stimulating work environment, and the opportunity to shape the future of synthetic biology through the application of breakthrough generative models.

 

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and we are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

jobs.title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT DSC:

In 2011, Dollar Shave Club didn’t just shake up the shaving aisle—we reinvented it. A viral video put us on the map, and our direct-to-consumer model challenged an entire industry by making great razors accessible, affordable, and actually fun to buy.

Since then, we’ve grown far beyond blades. From grooming to personal care, we’ve built a lineup of quality essentials designed to make life easier (and smoother), whether you find us online or in stores near you.

Today, DSC is expanding into new categories and new markets, but our DNA hasn’t changed. We’re still here to cut the BS, deliver real value, and bring a little humor to the everyday routine.

So what are you waiting for? Join the Club.

ROLE SUMMARY:

We’re excited to bring on a TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager to join the TikTok Shop Channel team, supporting both Dollar Shave Club and Truly Beauty! In this role, you’ll own the day-to-day engine of our TikTok Shop affiliate program: recruiting and vetting new creators, managing sampling, onboarding and supporting affiliates, and turning creator content into GMV. You’ll be the go-to contact for our creator community, from first outreach and sample request through posting, performance, and reactivation, including our Spanish-speaking creators and Star/VIP partners.

You’ll collaborate closely with our brand, marketing, and e-commerce teams to coordinate monthly product pushes, distribute creator briefs, set up Target Collabs, and make sure creators have the right products ahead of every launch. You’ll also keep a close eye on the numbers, pulling weekly performance, tracking what content angles actually convert, and recommending which creators and
products to scale, maintain, or deprioritize.

The ideal candidate is fluent in English and conversational in Spanish, lives and breathes TikTok Shop, and combines strong relationship-building instincts with a data-driven approach to creator performance. If you love working with creators, know a great hook when you see one, and get excited about watching GMV grow, we want to hear from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Source, vet, and recruit new creators (with a focus on L3+ and high-converting affiliates) by building targeted creator lists by brand, product, and category and running personalized outreach

• Manage the full creator funnel, tracking outreach → acceptance → sample → posting → GMV to keep the affiliate pipeline healthy

• Review and approve incoming sample requests for DSC and Truly, recommending when to increase or decrease sampling so priority products get enough creator coverage

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for creators, handling DMs and questions in English and Spanish, onboarding new affiliates, and reactivating dormant creators

• Build relationships with Star/VIP and high-potential creators, identifying who deserves more attention and investment to grow their impact

• Review creator content and give quick, actionable feedback on hooks, angles, product education, and claims, while sharing winning content examples and inspiration

• Execute monthly and campaign plans by distributing creator briefs, setting up and managing Target Collabs, coordinating product pushes, and ensuring creators have the right products before launches

• Pull weekly TikTok Shop creator performance and maintain trackers for GMV, active creators, videos, samples, and conversion, recommending which creators and products to scale, maintain, re-engage, or deprioritize

• Help manage our creator community on Discord and in our Spanish-language chat, answering recurring questions, sharing product education, and celebrating creator wins to keep the community engaged

REQUIREMENTS:

• 2+ years of experience in affiliate, influencer, or creator marketing, with at least 1 year managing creators on TikTok Shop

• Fluency in English and conversational fluency in Spanish, with the ability to communicate with creators in both languages

• Hands-on experience with TikTok Shop Seller Center and the affiliate tools, including sample management, open and targeted collaborations, and creator performance data

• Demonstrated ability to find, vet, and recruit high-converting creators and grow a creator program’s GMV

• Strong understanding of what makes TikTok content convert, including hooks, angles, product education, and claims guidelines

• Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel for building trackers and analyzing weekly performance (GMV, conversion, samples, active creators)

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a knack for building relationships with creators at every tier

• Highly organized and able to manage a high volume of DMs, sample requests, and launches across two brands at once

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote, cross-functional environment

• Experience in beauty, personal care, or grooming CPG preferred

• Experience managing creator communities on Discord or similar platforms preferred

• Experience with Target Collabs or retail-linked creator programs preferred

POSITION TYPE:
This is a full-time exempt position.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:
This position is fully remote within the United States.

SALARY:
$92,000 - $115,000 + Bonus

BENEFITS:

• Comprehensive benefit plans with low premium options, including medical, dental and vision coverage, along with supplemental coverage options

• Free life insurance, short term disability and long term disability

• 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of the first 2%, and 50% of up to an additional 4% with no vesting period

• Unlimited vacation and generous sick time

• Half day Fridays year-round (subject to business needs)

• 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave

• 4 weeks of fully paid disability leave

• Free Dollar Shave Club Products

• Monthly cell phone stipend

APPLICATION PROCESS:
All applications must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System, Greenhouse, in order to be considered. Once you submit your application, the recruiting team will review your submission and will reach out if your skill sets and/or qualifications match our needs. If selected, you’ll be invited to an initial phone screening interview with a recruiter before meeting with various members of the team. Candidates will be notified if they are not selected for the position. The position will remain open and we'll be accepting applications until the role is filled.

Dollar Shave Club is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
Sobre a Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país,  em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 valores:

💚 O cliente é a razão
O cliente é o motivo pelo qual existimos e só temos sucesso se ele tiver sucesso.

⚡ Cabeça de dono
Fazemos o que é certo, do jeito certo, com responsabilidade e tecnologia para decidir melhor.

🎯 Direto ao ponto
Profundidade para entender e simplicidade para resolver.

🤝 Excelência é um jogo de equipe
Construímos um negócio de longo prazo, em time e com colaboração.

✨ Paixão em cada detalhe
Fazemos com paixão, atenção aos detalhes e vontade de surpreender para ajudar o cliente a vencer.

Como é ser um (a) Analista de Ouvidoria:

A Ouvidoria atua como a última instância de atendimento e como uma instância estratégica de mediação entre clientes, unidades de negócio e órgãos reguladores. O time é guiado pelos princípios da transparência, imparcialidade e análise crítica, e tem a missão de entregar resolutividade na ponta para o lojista e prevenir acionamentos em instâncias externas. A área exige alto rigor técnico para garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das diretrizes do Banco Central e proteger a reputação e a governança da Companhia, trabalhando sempre para honrar a confiança de quem escolhe a Stone para empreender.   Além da mediação de conflitos, a área atua de forma consultiva e funciona como um radar do negócio. O time transforma o feedback e os atritos dos clientes em inteligência de dados para identificar as causas-raiz dos problemas, gerando um impacto estratégico que chega à alta liderança e pauta as decisões da Companhia.

As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

• Apurar e responder manifestações de segunda instância e demandas do Banco Central (RDR), assegurando rigor técnico e cumprimento estrito dos prazos regulatórios;

• Atender chamadas telefônicas direcionadas pela triagem, exercendo escuta ativa e acolhendo lojistas com demandas de alta complexidade;

• Investigar o histórico de atendimentos e cruzar informações com áreas parceiras para apurar a causa-raiz de cada demanda;

• Elaborar defesas técnicas e pareceres conclusivos fundamentados, utilizando sistemas internos e ferramentas de automação para sustentar as decisões;

• Realizar devolutivas diretas por telefone ou e-mail com clareza, objetividade e empatia, mediando situações de conflito;

• Classificar e tabular as manifestações por motivo e produto, gerando base de dados para subsidiar análises analíticas de recorrência;

• Atuar junto aos times internos para propor melhorias estruturais em fluxos operacionais e evitar a reincidência de problemas.

O que esperamos de você:

• Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Direito, Comunicação, Letras ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência prévia em atendimento de 2ª instância, ouvidoria, SAC, retenção ou mediação de conflitos;

• Habilidade de negociação e resolução de conflitos;

• Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com domínio gramatical para redigir pareceres técnicos, claros e objetivos;

• Perfil analítico e investigativo apurado para cruzar diferentes versões dos fatos, analisar históricos e identificar as causas-raiz dos problemas.

Diferenciais:

• Vivência prévia no mercado financeiro, fintechs ou empresas de meios de pagamento (adquirência);

• Conhecimento prático sobre tratativas de demandas do Banco Central (RDR) e noções do Código de Defesa do Consumidor (CDC);

• Experiência com o uso da plataforma de CRM para gestão, classificação e tratativa de chamados;

• Certificação em Ouvidoria (como Febraban, ABO ou certificações similares).

jobs.title: Institutional Sales Lead (Europe)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

RootstockLabs is seeking a hunter to help raise capital for an institutional grade, BTC denominated fund that is being built from the ground up. The fund gives institutional and private Bitcoin holders a regulated vehicle to put their Bitcoin to work, unlocking yield and managing credit risk across a mixed portfolio of strategies, and bridging traditional institutional demand with Bitcoin native yield generation.

You will own capital raising end to end: self sourcing institutional allocators, carrying each opportunity from first contact through to a signed subscription or facility, and closing it yourself. There is no existing book to inherit.

You will work closely with the VP of Sales, the fund management team, and risk, legal and compliance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Capital raising

• Build and own a qualified pipeline of allocators across L1 foundations and treasuries, ecosystem funds, family offices, miners and high net worth Bitcoin holders, sourced through your own network and disciplined outbound rather than inbound.

• Run the full raise cycle: prospecting, first meetings, needs discovery, mandate and suitability, terms, and close through to signed subscription.

• Work with the Fund Management team on share class terms and side letters suited to each allocator, so proposals are credible and deliverable.

Market and operations

• Represent the fund at industry events and across institutional networks, and feed allocator demand back into fund strategy and product.

• Keep the CRM and pipeline tracker current, contribute to weekly pipeline reviews, and operate strictly within marketing, solicitation and AML/KYC rules.

WHAT YOU BRING

• At least 2 years in digital asset or regulated investment sales, ideally raising for funds or selling yield and lending strategies. Less is considered from a directly comparable seat, such as a digital asset lending or yield platform.

• A demonstrable client book: you’ve owned the sales cycle and know the clients, ideally raising $15 million or more.

• A strong, active network of Bitcoin holders and allocators (miners, DATCOs, L1 foundations, family offices, high net worth individuals); a broader digital asset network is also valuable.

• Working fluency in Bitcoin, DeFi, BTC collateralised lending, collateral management and fund structures, with the comfort to hold both commercial and technical conversations.

• A clear understanding of fund marketing, solicitation and investor eligibility rules, and AML/KYC.

• A self starting, resilient and collaborative temperament, and the discipline to keep CRM and process tight in an early stage business.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in capital raising from traditional finance

• Experience raising for a regulated fund, ideally a Cayman SPC or similar structure.

• A record selling yield or lending products into other digital assets (for example Ethereum or XRP), with a transferable client base.

• Exposure to hashrate or miner finance, structured or private credit, tokenisation or real world assets.

• Experience as the first or an early commercial hire in a scaling business.

• Familiarity with Rootstock, Bitcoin L2s or merged mining.

ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

• Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.

• 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces.

• Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days

• Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.

• Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team. REVIEW

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital.

• What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies

• Empathy, patience, kindness, and respect.

• A passion for caregiving, providing private home care, and a desire to help others.

• A commitment to being present and providing quality care.

• Flexible schedules for work/life balance: full-time, part-time, per-diem, and on-call.

jobs.title: Sr. Service Techncian, Witten (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Your Role:

You’re a seasoned technician who knows your craft – and at Lucid Motors, you’ll get the chance to take it to the next level. As a Senior Service Technician, you’ll work on one of the most advanced electric vehicles in the world. You’ll lead by example, share your expertise, and help shape a high-performance service culture.

• Perform advanced diagnostics, maintenance, and repairs on Lucid vehicles

• Support and mentor junior technicians – your experience makes the difference

• Use modern software to document your work with precision

• Carry out certified high-voltage repairs, safely and professionally

• Communicate with customers and deliver a true premium experience

• Take ownership of quality, efficiency, and cleanliness in the workshop

• Step in wherever your knowledge and advice are needed

What You Bring:

• Completed vocational training as Automobil-Diagnostiker EFZ or equivalent Swiss-recognized advanced certification

• 5–7 years of practical experience in professional automotive repair, including work with high-voltage vehicles, preferably premium vehicles

• Deep diagnostic experience in mechanical and electrical systems, including CAN architecture and electronic fault tracing

• High Voltage Level 3 Certification (FHV Stufe 3) – including live work authorization (Arbeiten unter Spannung)

• Proven experience using diagnostic software and workshop systems (e.g., OEM-specific, Bosch, Snap-On)

• Familiarity with inspection, maintenance, and wear part replacement in line with OEM standards

• Valid Class B driver’s license

• Fluent in German (spoken and written), working knowledge of English

• Confident with Microsoft Office applications and willing to learn internal platforms (e.g., DMS)

Why Lucid?

• Work on a vehicle that’s setting new standards in design and technology

• Join a dynamic, international team with real start-up energy

• Get access to top-tier training in high-voltage systems, diagnostics, and more

• Be part of something bigger – not just fixing cars, but shaping the future

• Competitive pay, modern tools, and real opportunities to grow

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. jobs.title: Продавач - консултант - Mall Rousse
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

Като продавач - консултант ти ще заемаш ключова роля в създаването на изключително клиентско преживяване. Посрещайки нашите клиенти, ще им помагаш в техния избор, като същевременно ще ги запознаваш с нашите нови продукти и колекции. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Споделяш модните си познания, така че клиентите ни да изберат най-доброто за себе си.
• Работиш заедно с екипа, за да осигурите перфектно обслужване на клиента, включително активно промотиране на лоялната ни програма
• Подсигуряваш етажа и складовите помещения заредени и подредени.
• Помагаш с процедурите по отварянето и затварянето на магазина.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.

​

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

​

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в обслужването на клиенти в сферата на търговията ще е предимство.
• Удоволствие от общуването с клиенти и интерес към модата – ние ще те научим на всичко останало!

И човек, който е…​

• Успяващ в динамична среда, със силни комуникативни умения.
• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.
• Адаптивен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки част от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Научи повече за програмата ни тук;
• Ваучери за храна на стойност 78 €;
• Осигуровки върху реално брутно възнаграждение;
• Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
• Възможност за издаване на Multisport карта на преференциална цена;
• Обучения и възможност за световно кариерно развитие в компанията;
• Програма “Препоръчай приятел” с включен бонус;
• Платен отпуск при сключване на брак;
• H&M карта-подарък при раждане на бебе;
• Ваучер при навършване на 10 години в компанията;
• Възнаграждение при пенсиониране;

ПРИСЪЕДИНИ СЕ КЪМ НАС

Нашите ценности, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

Това е постоянна позиция на непълен работен ден, намираща се в град Русе.

Очакваме твоята кандидатура като ни изпратиш актуално CV на български език. Поради политиката за личните данни, приемаме кандидатури единствено през кариерната ни страница.

Направи следващата крачка в кариерното си развитие с нас. Пътешествието започва тук.

*Оценка за ролите в магазина:

За да успеем да обработим голямото количество кандидатури за позицията продавач-консултант, използваме онлайн метод за оценка на уменията за подбор в някои от нашите магазини. Трябва да го попълниш като част от процеса на кандидатстване и селекция. Твоите отговори ще бъдат оценени с помощта на инструмент за оценка, който прилага предварително зададени критерии от H&M Group.

След като завършиш оценката, ще имаш възможност да споделиш мнение и да зададеш въпроси. Ако срещнеш трудности или предпочиташ алтернативен метод за оценка, моля, свържи се с recruitment_support@hm.com. Изборът на алтернативен метод няма да има влияние върху твоята кандидатура.

За повече информация относно това как обработваме твоите лични данни, моля, виж нашето уведомление за конфиденциалност.

**Стремим се да имаме справедлив и прозрачен процес и затова любезно молим да не прилагаш мотивационно писмо към кандидатурата си, тъй като то често съдържа информация, която лесно би могла да бъде разбрана пристрастно.

jobs.title: Bilingual Strategic Cuisines Account Executive, East Houston, TX - Spanish
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

This is a bilingual Spanish field sales opportunity based out of a personal home office. You must live local to your territory in the East Houston, TX area or be willing to relocate.

As a Strategic Cuisines Account Executive, you will help grow Toast’s presence within the Spanish Cuisine restaurants. Using a consultative sales approach, you will convert inbound demand, generate new opportunities through referrals, and build trusted relationships with restaurateurs. By delivering a high quality, language inclusive experience, you will identify each restaurant’s needs and recommend how Toast’s end-to-end platform helps their business run better. Your role will focus on driving new customer growth through calls, demos, and closing contracts in the customer’s preferred language.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Following up on marketing qualified leads in the market you support

• Conducting discovery calls & product demonstrations in your customer’s preferred language

• Creating and reviewing quotes and contracts in your customer’s preferred language

• Ensure our onboarding team and customer are set up for success post sale

• Understand the competitive landscape in your market (strengths, weaknesses, benefits) to best position Toast.

• Your Spanish skills will be used on the job to communicate with Spanish-speaking customers and prospective customers, while your English language skills will be used primarily for communicating with other employees at Toast.

• As with most internal business at Toast, the job application and interview process for this role will be conducted primarily in English.

• Toast will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this role.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Fluency in both oral and written English and Spanish is required for this role.

• Prior Sales experience preferred.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• An entrepreneurial and feedback driven mindset.

What will help you stand out (Nice to Haves/Nonessential Skills)

• Restaurant Operations Experience

• Experience using Salesforce to keep track of Sales activities

• Sandler Sales Training

AI at Toast

jobs.title: IT Operations Specialist I
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London, UK

Role summary

As an IT Operations Specialist I, you will provide essential onsite IT support and help maintain daily workplace technology at our corporate office. Working in a heavy macOS and Google Workspace environment with additional support for Windows and Linux endpoints, you will deliver hands-on technical assistance, maintain office AV systems, and manage end-to-end hire-to-retire lifecycle processes. In this role, you will also leverage our internal AI technology tools to optimize support workflows and documentation. You will collaborate closely with broader IT teams, the IT Service Desk, HR, Places & Office, and Security teams to ensure a seamless technical experience for all employees.

Role responsibilities

• Act as the primary onsite technical support resource, managing employee walk-ups, support tickets, and hardware troubleshooting across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.

• Work closely with broader IT engineering and operations teams to execute infrastructure updates, enforce system policies, and resolve escalated technical issues.

• Manage complete hire-to-retire IT operations, including hardware provisioning, account setup, leading IT orientation for new hires, offboarding asset recovery, and access revoking.

• Administer day-to-day user accounts, permissions, and group access within Google Workspace and connected corporate SaaS tools.

• Manage physical IT asset lifecycle operations, including inventory tracking, hardware check-in/check-out, stock audits, and secure device disposal.

• Utilize internal AI technology tools to summarize support incidents, speed up ticket resolution, and draft self-service Knowledge Base (KB) documentation for end users.

• Support office conference room technology (Google Meet Hardware and Zoom Rooms) and provide live technical setup for corporate town halls and department events.

• Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation (evenings and weekends) to address critical after-hours P1/P2 incidents, system outages, and urgent executive support needs.

This is an in-office/onsite position. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• 1–2 years of hands-on IT support or help-desk experience in a corporate environment.

• Strong expertise troubleshooting macOS hardware, software, and enterprise OS configurations.

• Working knowledge of Windows OS and basic Linux desktop administration or CLI troubleshooting.

• Practical administrative experience with Google Workspace (User management, Shared Drives, Groups, Admin Console).

• Willingness and availability to work fully onsite 5 days a week and participate in a scheduled on-call rotation for after-hours support.

• Readiness to utilize internal AI tools and assistants to streamline ticketing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first approach to technical support and leading new-hire orientations.

• Application requires a current resume/CV detailing relevant IT workplace support experience.

Bonus points

• Experience with macOS endpoint management using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms like Jamf Pro or Kandji.

• Experience using corporate ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Zendesk.

• Relevant technical certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP), Google Workspace Administrator, CompTIA A+, or ITIL 4 Foundation.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: VP of Sales
jobs.description:
A FOUNDATIONAL COMPANY

Rilla builds the leading conversation intelligence software for offline commerce. Salespeople talk, our mobile app records the conversation, and our AI transcribes and analyzes it to make them better at their jobs. We’re bringing the technology of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the more than 10 million salespeople who work face to face.

We’ve grown from zero to $55M+ in ARR in four years, and we’re profitable. We sell to enterprises like The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup. We’re backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We’re in-office because the best work happens when ambitious people are in the same room.




THE ROLE

You will own all of revenue at Rilla: Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB, and Customer Success. Every new logo, every renewal, and every expansion runs through your org. 

This role is for someone who has done both. Closed at the top of the board and taken a team to numbers it had never touched. You know the difference between carrying a quota and building the engine that blows past one. Now you want to build and lead the whole engine here.

You want to pass on everything you've learned, build something real at a startup, and grow an org in your image. You're on the way up, with everything to prove, and you'll outwork anyone in the room.

You get your hands dirty.

You lead by example.

At Rilla, leaders are second-class citizens. You work for your team, not the other way around. Your job is to clear their obstacles, make everyone around you better, and put them first.

You hire great leaders and great reps, coach them hard, and build an org that wins.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the number. Net new ARR, net revenue retention, and gross retention across Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB, and Customer Success are yours.

 - Lead, grow, and develop the leaders of each segment and the reps. Set a high bar for pipeline, deal quality, quota attainment, and retention, and coach the org hard to clear it.

 - Design how each segment runs. Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB need different sales processes, playbooks, and deal motions. Build each one, and know when a motion belongs in one segment and not another.

 - Run Customer Success as a revenue team. Own onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion, and make sure every customer sees the behavior change they bought.

 - Stay in the biggest deals yourself. Run the toughest enterprise closes and the hardest renewals alongside your leaders and show them how it's done.

 - Own the forecast. Define the metrics that matter (pipeline coverage, win rate, cycle time, ACV, net new ARR, NRR, GRR) and build the pipeline reviews, QBRs, and accountability to move them.

 - Set comp plans and capacity plans for every segment, and hire ahead of the number.

 - Be the clearest voice for what customers need from the product. Turn what you hear across every segment into sharp, prioritized feedback that shapes the Rilla roadmap.

 - Partner with Growth, Sales, and Product to give buyers one seamless experience from first touch through close, renewal, and expansion, and clear the internal friction that slows deals down.




WHO YOU ARE

 - A customer obsessive. You deeply care about delighting customers and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

 - An infinite learner. You’re always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

 - A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback, and learning and growing as a team.

 - Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. You’re excited by the unconventional.

 - Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always prioritizing your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

 - Our operating principle is that we try to run Rilla like a high speed reinforcement learner: a machine learning algorithm that plays a game a million times over and becomes invincible in a short amount of time.




SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

 - You put your team first, always. Their growth is the scoreboard you actually care about, and you'd trade your own spotlight for their wins every time.

 - You've led a multi-segment sales org before, with second-line leaders reporting to you, and taken it well past the number it was handed.

 - You're a proven top enterprise closer. You carried a big number and beat it, again and again, winning complex, multi-stakeholder deals that other reps couldn't.

 - You've owned retention and expansion, not just new logo. You know how to multiply teams as a revenue function.

 - You know what great selling looks like at every deal size and can develop it in others: velocity motions in SMB, structured discovery in Mid-Market, long cycles, procurement, and security reviews in Enterprise.

 - You've built the machinery: forecasting, comp plans, territory and capacity planning, pipeline reviews, and the hiring engine behind them.

 - You build trust with executives and the C-suite, and you can coach your leaders to earn that same trust.

 - You develop people intentionally: you invest in each leader's and rep's growth, give direct feedback, and create the conditions for your org to do the best work of their careers.

 - You're in NYC, or ready to relocate. This role is in-office.




NICE TO HAVES

 - You were an early hire at a fast-growing startup.

 - You’ve sold a behavior-change, coaching, or enablement product, where the win is getting a whole team to work differently, not just signing a contract.

 - You’ve already mentored or coached reps on the side, and you want to do it for real.




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility benefits

 - Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks 6 days a week in our NYC office

 - Wellness / Gym Benefits

 - Commuter benefits

 - Relocation assistance to NYC

 - Unlimited PTO (not accrual-based — take what you need)

 - $1,000 annual learning and development stipend

 - Tech equipment + unlimited Claude spend

jobs.title: Junior Security Evaluator
jobs.description:
Position Overview

SGS-Penumbra is seeking a Junior Security Evaluator to support the testing and validation of cryptographic modules under the FIPS 140-3 Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP). This position is ideal for an early-career technical professional interested in cybersecurity, cryptography, and security compliance.

The successful candidate will work alongside experienced evaluators to assess hardware, software, and firmware products against FIPS 140-3 requirements, while developing expertise in NIST standards, cryptographic testing, and security evaluations.

Key Responsibilities

FIPS Evaluation Activities

• Assist with the development and execution of FIPS 140-3 test plans in accordance with CMVP requirements.
• Review cryptographic module documentation, including security policies, design documentation, finite state models, and vendor evidence packages.
• Perform hands-on testing of cryptographic modules, including operational testing, physical security testing, and algorithm validation activities.
• Conduct Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program (CAVP) testing using NIST-approved test methodologies and vectors.
• Document test procedures, test results, observations, and findings in accordance with laboratory quality procedures.
• Support preparation of validation reports and submission packages for CMVP review.

Physical Security Testing

• Perform physical security assessments of cryptographic modules in accordance with applicable FIPS 140-3 security level requirements.
• Evaluate enclosure construction, tamper evidence mechanisms, tamper response features, and other physical security controls.
• Assist in documenting physical security findings and test results.

Customer and Project Support

• Serve as a day-to-day technical point of contact for assigned customer projects.
• Coordinate evidence requests, documentation updates, and technical questions with customers.
• Provide project status updates and communicate risks, issues, and schedule impacts to senior staff.
• Track assigned project milestones and deliverables to support successful project completion.

Professional Development

• Develop working knowledge of FIPS 140-3, the NIST SP 800-140 series, CMVP implementation guidance, and related validation requirements.
• Participate in internal technical training and mentoring activities.
• Continuously build expertise in cryptography, cybersecurity, and security testing methodologies.

Required Qualifications

• College degree in an IT discipline, or a related technical discipline; or equivalent practical experience.
• Foundational understanding of computer systems and information security principles.
• Basic understanding of cryptographic concepts, including symmetric and asymmetric cryptography, hashing, digital signatures, and key management.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent written documentation and technical communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured test procedures.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a professional services environment.
• Ability to communicate effectively with customers and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; or equivalent practical experience.
• Familiarity with FIPS 140-2, FIPS 140-3, Common Criteria, or other security certification programs.
• Experience with Linux operating systems and command-line tools.
• Experience with Python, Bash, or other scripting languages.
• Exposure to embedded systems, firmware, hardware security modules (HSMs), or secure hardware development.
• Familiarity with cryptographic libraries such as OpenSSL, BoringSSL, wolfSSL, or similar implementations.
• Knowledge of software development, secure coding practices, or vulnerability analysis.

Additional Requirements

• Ability to obtain any required background checks or security clearances.
• Occasional travel may be required to customer locations.
• Ability to perform hands-on hardware testing activities in a laboratory environment.

Compensation

The expected salary for this position is $46,000 to $62,000 per year. This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

Our Benefits

We care about your total well-being and will support you with the following, subject to your location and role.

• Health: Medical, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, employee assistance programs.
• Wealth: In addition to base pay, we offer 401(k) with company match (immediate vesting upon enrollment).
• Happiness:Professional Growth: Online training courses, virtual and classroom development experiences, tuition reimbursement programWork-Life Balance: Paid-time off and family leave

In compliance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws, we provide clear and equitable compensation information for all applicants.

Position anticipated to close November 2, 2026.

jobs.title: Boiler Technician
jobs.description:
Boiler & Heating Service Technician
Location: Baltimore, Maryland and surrounding communities
Position: Full-Time | Experienced Heating Professional
About the Position
We specialize in steam and hot water heating systems, providing expert diagnostics, repairs, maintenance, and installations for residential and light commercial customers.
We're looking for an experienced heating professional who understands boilers, enjoys solving challenging mechanical problems, and takes genuine pride in their craftsmanship.
This position is primarily focused on steam and hydronic heating. We're particularly interested in someone with a strong plumbing background who understands piping, mechanical systems, and the fundamentals of heat distribution.
Primary Responsibilities
Boiler Service, Diagnostics & Repair
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair residential and light commercial steam and hot water heating systems.
Service natural gas and oil-fired boilers, depending on experience.
Diagnose and repair burners, ignition systems, gas valves, circulators, zone valves, aquastats, pressure controls, and safety devices.
Troubleshoot steam heating problems, including water hammer, uneven heating, venting deficiencies, and condensate return issues.
Diagnose hydronic heating problems involving circulation, air elimination, expansion tanks, zoning, and system pressure.
Perform seasonal maintenance, safety inspections, combustion analysis, and efficiency evaluations.
Identify opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and longevity.
Heating System Installation & Replacement
Install and replace residential and light commercial steam and hot water boilers.
Perform near-boiler piping, hydronic distribution piping, venting, and control installations.
Evaluate existing heating systems and assist in developing appropriate repair and replacement solutions.
Work with a variety of traditional and modern boiler technologies.
Ensure installations meet manufacturer specifications, applicable codes, and established quality standards.
Additional Mechanical Work
While steam and hot water heating will be the primary focus, there may be opportunities to assist with related plumbing and mechanical work, depending on experience, interests, and seasonal demand.
Experience with forced-air heating systems is also welcome, although it is not a requirement for this position..
