jobs.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll be responsible for managing revenue accounting across Thndr’s entities, making sure all revenue is recorded correctly, invoices are issued, collections are followed up on, and settlements are reconciled on time.

You’ll work closely with the Finance, Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to understand where our revenue comes from and make sure everything is reflected correctly in our books. This includes working with data from our platform, banks, clearing houses, and other partners, as well as handling month-end reporting and investigating any discrepancies.

As Thndr continues to grow and expand into new markets, there will also be opportunities to improve how we work. Some processes are already in place, while others will need to be developed or improved. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership, getting into the details, and finding practical ways to get things done.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Revenue accounting & recognition
• Record revenue transactions across Thndr’s entities, products, and markets, including journal entries, accruals, deferrals, and intercompany allocations
• Make sure revenue is recognized correctly under IFRS 15 and relevant local accounting standards
• Review new products, pricing changes, and commercial arrangements to understand their accounting treatment
• Account for refunds, fee reversals, credit notes, promotional offers, and referral incentives

Billing, collections & receivables
• Prepare and issue invoices to asset managers and other partners based on agreed fees and commercial terms
• Keep track of outstanding receivables, follow up on overdue payments, and maintain accurate ageing reports
• Review partner agreements to make sure fees are recorded and billed correctly
• Investigate differences in billed or collected amounts and follow up with the relevant teams until resolved

Settlement & reconciliations
• Reconcile revenue data from our platform with settlement reports from clearing houses, asset managers, banks, and other partners
• Match user transactions and bank statements against the general ledger
• Investigate differences, understand what caused them, and work with the relevant teams to resolve them
• Keep reconciliations accurate, up to date, and properly documented across our entities and currencies

Month-end close & reporting
• Prepare revenue journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules as part of the month-end close
• Prepare revenue reports for management, highlighting changes across products, markets, and entities
• Compare financial results with operational metrics such as trading volumes, assets under management (AUM), and subscriber numbers
• Make sure revenue balances are accurate and supported by the necessary documentation

Tax, audit & regulatory support
• Support VAT and withholding tax requirements related to revenue, working with the Finance team and external advisors where needed
• Prepare revenue schedules and supporting documents for audits and regulatory reporting
• Respond to audit queries and help resolve any issues related to revenue accounting
• Keep financial records and supporting documents organized and ready for review

Process improvement
• Review existing revenue accounting processes and identify where things can be done more efficiently
• Improve manual reconciliations and reporting, including automating tasks where possible
• Document processes and put clearer controls in place as the business grows
• Work with Operations, Product, and Engineering to resolve issues affecting revenue data and reporting



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• 4–5 years of experience in revenue accounting, ideally in fintech, financial services, brokerage, banking, payments, or asset management
• A good understanding of accounting principles, particularly IFRS 15 and revenue recognition
• Experience handling the revenue cycle, including bookkeeping, billing, collections, and reconciliations
• Experience working with high transaction volumes, multiple products, counterparties, or currencies
• Strong Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems and large datasets
• Good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and understand what went wrong
• A hands-on approach and willingness to get into the details rather than just oversee the process
• Someone who takes ownership, follows up on outstanding items, and makes sure things get done
• Comfortable working in a changing environment where not every process is already defined
• Well organized and able to manage deadlines and competing priorities
• Fluent written and spoken English
• A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, with a strong academic background

Key outcomes:
• Revenue is recorded and recognized accurately across all entities, products, and markets
• Invoices, collections, and receivables are properly tracked, with overdue balances followed up on
• Revenue and settlement reconciliations are completed on time, and discrepancies are resolved
• Month-end revenue entries, reconciliations, and reports are delivered accurately and on schedule
• Revenue reports clearly explain movements across products and markets and are linked to operational data
• Revenue accounting processes are documented, and manual work is reduced wherever possible




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience working across multiple legal entities, markets, and currencies

 - Experience in a regulated financial services business, particularly brokerage, banking, payments, or asset management

 - ACCA, ACA, CPA, ESAA, or an equivalent qualification, completed or in progress

 - Exposure to VAT, corporate income tax (CIT), or withholding tax (WHT)

 - Experience with ERP implementations or finance process automation

 - Experience working with Product, Operations, or Engineering teams




WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

 - High barriers to entry - In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.

 - Irrelevant experience - Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

 - Fragmented offering - Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

 - 5.5 million app downloads

 - EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025

 - #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year

 - 76% of users are first-time investors

 - 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - US
jobs.description:
Sweep is hiring a Senior Account Executive, tasked with building Sweep's presence in North America from the ground up by establishing relationships with prospective clients and turning them into successful customers.

Our ideal candidate is an experienced salesperson, with the ability to engage in both business and technical conversations, across multiple levels in complex organisations. You have a strong understanding of the buyer journey and can lead multi-thread complex selling in a consultative manner. You show great skills at creating value in an emerging market and enjoy selling a tool that requires a deep understanding of the product, and technical knowledge.

You like the challenge of prospecting, building compelling proposals and leading a sales cycle from initial contact to closing.

Finally, you are keen to contribute to the development of the sales process, the craft of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.

Ok, sounds promising. What will I be doing?

As part of the Sales Team, you are the pioneering force of Sweep's US expansion, working on the front line of the sales process for the sales team. You'll be responsible for closing opportunities and ensuring the success team can deliver real impact for our customers while helping establish Sweep as a leader in the North American sustainability software market.

To be more specific, this includes:

• Help build Sweep's presence in the US market by identifying and engaging target accounts.
• Own an account list and develop strategic account plans to win and expand business with mid-market and Enterprise accounts across North America.
• Take full accountability for building and closing your own sales pipeline with a consultative and solutions-focused approach.
• Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities in a greenfield market.
• Collaborate closely with our Marketing and SDR teams to qualify and nurture leads.
• Work with company leaders from different functions (Sustainability, ESG, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, etc.) to lead product workshops and presentations.
• Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes (operational leaders, C-suite, legal, procurement, etc.).
• Partner with the sales engineering team and customer success team to ensure we deliver exceptional value.
• Maintain accurate pipeline and account data in Salesforce.
• Coordinate prospecting campaigns with the marketing team.
• Provide critical market feedback to help shape our US go-to-market strategy.
• Help develop and refine our sales process for the US market

That sounds just right for me. What do I need to bring?

Glad you asked. This is who we’re looking for:

Qualifications 🏆

• You bring a minimum of 5+ years of sales experience
• Experience in software-as-a-service environments, ideally in the B2B Enterprise space
• Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations
• Ability to lead intricate negotiations
• Experience working closely with multi-disciplinary teams
• Ability to evolve in a fast-paced environment
• Knowledge of CSR and climate change is a clear plus
• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English

Qualities 🧠

• You’re an empathetic team player that is great at building lasting relationships, both internally and externally
• A strategic thinker, who sees both the big picture and the smaller underlying mechanics
• An expert communicator, with a knack for turning complex things into simple, engaging and fun interactions
• A hands-on problem solver, self-motivated with a glass half-full attitude
• An entrepreneurial mind, ready to launch and fail and iterate
• Attuned to remote collaboration, using digital tools and meticulously documenting work
• A desire and ambition to grow, mentor and support other members on the team

At Sweep, artificial intelligence is part of how we work, learn, and build. Every team member uses AI tools daily to speed up operations, improve decision making, and unlock creativity. We don’t expect you to be an expert on day one, but we do expect curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and the desire to use AI as a true partner in your work.

Whether it's analyzing information, drafting content, improving workflows, designing better employee experiences, or supporting distributed teams, you’ll use AI to work faster and smarter. We provide guidance, tools, and best practices so you can get the most out of it.

We’re looking for candidates who already have hands-on experience with AI tools in a professional setting. You should be comfortable using AI to support your daily work, enhance productivity, and create new solutions. If you naturally reach for AI to amplify what you do, you’ll feel right at home here.

Copy that. And what’s in it for me?

You will be joining an exciting young business that has the humble ambition to change the world. With a proven track record in starting companies, we’re planning to hit the ground running and have an impact fast. Joining this journey right at the beginning allows you to really help shape our path.

Our hybrid work model, with hiring focussed around our head offices in Paris, London and Montpellier, allows us to balance our personal and professional lives while staying connected and engaged with colleagues and clients.

We’re big believers in creating successful businesses that are good for everyone, including society and the planet. That’s why we have a B Corporation status.

We think this will be the ride of our lives. And maybe yours, too.

jobs.title: Principal AI-Native Software Engineer
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to open and manage doors & gates from a smartphone. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.




OUR SOLUTION

Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.




OUR CULTURE & VALUES

Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for an exceptional Principal or Staff-level engineer who has fundamentally changed how they build software because of AI. This is not a traditional software engineering role with an AI assistant bolted on. We want someone who uses AI agents, especially Claude Code, to independently take well-defined product initiatives from business requirements to secure, tested, production-ready software.



The ideal candidate is an excellent backend engineer first, grounded in our stack: TypeScript services, MongoDB and relational data, and cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP. AI dramatically increases your output, but your engineering judgment is what makes that output valuable.



In this role, you will work closely with our Product and Design teams. You will operate with unusually broad engineering ownership. You may clarify requirements with Product, develop the technical specification, work through implementation details with Design, coordinate multiple coding agents, review their work, deploy the application, manage its infrastructure, and continue improving the product after launch.



The ideal candidate is already working this way. You routinely operate several Claude Code sessions or agents in parallel. You know how to divide work across agents, provide them with the right context, establish effective feedback loops, and keep multiple workstreams moving without losing control of quality or architecture.



You believe manually writing code should become a relatively rare part of software development. But you are not impressed by code merely because an AI generated it. You recognize over-engineered "AI slop," unnecessary abstractions, sprawling diffs, weak tests, insecure implementations, and solutions that are technically functional but fundamentally poor.




RESPONSIBILITIES


PARTNER WITH PRODUCT AND DESIGN

 - Work closely with Product to understand business requirements, intended user outcomes, priorities, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

 - Translate Product's business requirements into clear technical requirements, implementation plans, system behaviors, and engineering tasks.

 - Identify technical ambiguities, dependencies, risks, edge cases, and tradeoffs that must be resolved before or during implementation.

 - Ask the questions necessary to ensure the engineering solution addresses the actual product need.

 - Partner with Design to understand intended user workflows and translate designs into complete, functional product experiences.

 - Provide Product and Design with clear feedback when requirements or designs introduce unnecessary complexity, technical risk, security concerns, or operational challenges.

 - Preserve the intent of the product requirements while making sound technical and implementation decisions.

 - Communicate progress, tradeoffs, risks, and changes in scope clearly throughout development.


BUILD AND OWN PRODUCTS END TO END

 - Take approved product initiatives from business requirements through technical design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation.

 - Manage several products or major engineering initiatives with limited day-to-day oversight.

 - Develop complete technical requirements from the business and product requirements supplied by Product.

 - Make thoughtful architectural, implementation, security, infrastructure, and operational tradeoffs within an established platform direction.

 - Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, reliable, and testable code; identify bottlenecks and bugs, devise solutions, and propose optimizations.

 - Deliver working software quickly while maintaining high standards for reliability, maintainability, security, and user experience.

 - Own the technical execution of a product rather than waiting for every implementation detail to be specified.

 - Continue improving products after launch based on feedback, usage, defects, and changing requirements.


OPERATE AN AI-NATIVE DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT

 - Use Claude Code as a primary development environment and orchestration layer.

 - Run multiple agents, sub-agents, worktrees, branches, or development sessions in parallel.

 - Decompose technical requirements into work that can be executed safely and effectively by different agents.

 - Design reusable Claude Code skills, commands, hooks, context files, agent instructions, and development workflows.

 - Provide agents with the technical requirements, architectural context, constraints, designs, examples, and verification methods necessary to produce high-quality work.

 - Build feedback loops in which agents review, test, critique, and improve one another's output.

 - Use agents to investigate unfamiliar systems, understand legacy code, create implementation plans, write code, generate tests, review changes, prepare pull requests, and assist with releases.

 - Continuously improve the systems, instructions, and tooling that make your own AI-assisted development more reliable and scalable.


AUTOMATE THE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT LIFECYCLE

 - Help automate the engineering portions of the product development lifecycle, including:

 - Translating business requirements into technical requirements

 - Technical discovery and architecture

 - Implementation planning

 - Design and UX implementation

 - Software development

 - Automated testing

 - Security analysis

 - Code review

 - Pull-request creation and iteration

 - Infrastructure provisioning

 - Deployment

 - Monitoring and operational support

 - Documentation and maintenance

 - Create workflows in which agents can execute substantial portions of the development lifecycle while preserving appropriate human judgment and control.

 - Establish clear quality gates so that agent-generated work is verified rather than accepted on faith.

 - Develop methods for measuring the effectiveness, quality, cost, and speed of AI-native engineering workflows.

 - Reduce the manual coordination and repetitive work required to move from an approved product requirement to deployed software.


MAINTAIN EXCEPTIONAL ENGINEERING QUALITY

 - Review agent-generated code with the judgment expected of a Principal or Staff engineer.

 - Reject unnecessary complexity, excessive abstraction, inappropriate frameworks, duplicated logic, and changes that are much larger than the problem requires.

 - Prefer focused, understandable solutions: for example, an eight-file targeted change rather than an eighty-file rewrite when both accomplish the same result.

 - Ensure software is appropriately tested, observable, secure, maintainable, and production-ready.

 - Understand how systems work beneath the abstraction layer rather than treating AI output as a black box.

 - Debug complex issues across application code, infrastructure, data systems, third-party services, and development tooling.

 - Know when the AI is wrong, when its proposed approach is risky, and when direct engineering intervention is necessary.

 - Ensure implementations satisfy the agreed product requirements and acceptance criteria without adding unnecessary scope.


WORK ACROSS OUR STACK AND BEYOND

 - Bring deep, hands-on expertise in our core stack — Ruby on Rails, production TypeScript/Node.js, MongoDB and relational data, and cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP.

 - Use Claude Code to move confidently into adjacent or unfamiliar codebases — Android, iOS, Go, and others — developing enough understanding to make sound architectural and implementation decisions without waiting for a specialist.

 - Work across frontend, backend, mobile, infrastructure, integrations, and internal tooling as needed.

 - Manage infrastructure and deployment workflows across AWS and GCP.

 - Improve legacy systems rather than avoiding them or insisting that everything be rewritten.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Significant experience operating at the Staff, Principal, or equivalent engineering level, with 8+ years of professional software development experience.

 - A track record of independently delivering complex, production software in partnership with Product and Design teams.

 - Expert-level experience with Claude Code. This is a mandatory requirement. You must be able to demonstrate substantial product development with Claude Code — not merely autocomplete, isolated code generation, or simple prompting.

 - Experience coordinating multiple AI agents or development sessions in parallel, with a deep understanding of agent context, skills, sub-agents, tool use, planning, verification, and orchestration.

 - Production experience with both a dynamic language ecosystem and a strongly-typed one. Production TypeScript/Node.js experience is required.

 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and document/NoSQL databases. MongoDB experience is required.

 - Hands-on experience deploying and operating production software in a distributed, cloud-based environment (e.g., AWS EC2/ECS, Lambda, Cloud Run) within a service-oriented or micro-service architecture, across AWS, GCP, or both.

 - Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in production. For example integrating LLMs or other models into products or workflows, building retrieval or agentic systems, prompt/eval design, or on-device/edge inference.

 - Extensive experience developing and maintaining APIs and integrating with third-party APIs.

 - Strong experience with automated CI/CD pipelines and a deep understanding of testing what, when, and how to test.

 - Strong ability to translate business and product requirements into technical requirements and implementation plans.

 - Strong product judgment, including the ability to understand user intent, identify edge cases, and recognize when an implementation does not satisfy the underlying requirement.

 - Strong understanding of software design, architecture, security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

 - Ability to review AI-generated code critically and distinguish high-quality engineering from superficially functional output.

 - Comfort working across unfamiliar programming languages, frameworks, and legacy systems, using AI to accelerate that work.

 - Strong ownership, initiative, and bias toward building.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, particularly when expressing technical requirements, constraints, implementation plans, and engineering decisions to both business and technical audiences.




COMPENSATION

The expected base salary range for this position is $215,000 –$250,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.




BENEFITS

 - Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans (ButterflyMX covers 80% of the cost) starting day 1

 - 401(k) plan with a match

 - 10 paid holidays, 20 vacation days, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays

 - Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)

 - Short and Long Term Disability (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)

 - Paid Family Leave

 - Employee Assistance Program

 - Quarterly self-care stipends

 - Access to optional benefits including pre-tax flexible healthcare spending accounts (FSA and HSA), Dependent Care FSA, and Commuter Benefits, as well as optional Supplemental Life, AD&D, Hospital Indemnity, Legal, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet, and Personal Liability Insurance

 - And more!



ButterflyMX is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. You must have the authorization to work in the US to become an employee. We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates and employees. If you need reasonable accommodations during the application or the recruiting process, please let our recruiting team know.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. 

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup https://sifted.eu/leaderboards/sifted-future-50-2025 in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben https://www.linkedin.com/in/ben-freeman-a8542166/, Abs https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhirukt/, Sabrina https://www.linkedin.com/in/scastiglione/, and Rebe https://www.linkedin.com/in/rebecatristan/.



FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THE TEAM AND LIFE AT OMNEA HERE https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb. 


THE ROLE

AI is changing what it means to run enterprise pre-sales. Building a custom demo, standing up a proof-of-concept environment, or drafting responses to a security questionnaire used to mean days of manual configuration and copy-paste from old RFP answers. Increasingly, that first-draft work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI can generate demo environments, draft PoC configurations, and produce a first pass on technical RFP responses.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every demo and proof point from scratch, you specify exactly what a prospect needs to see, direct AI to build the first draft, and apply the judgment AI can't: does this PoC actually prove the thing this customer's IT security team will ask about, does this demo reflect how their approval hierarchy actually works, is this RFP answer technically accurate or just plausible-sounding.

As Omnea's AI Sales Engineer, you're the technical authority in our enterprise sales process, working alongside Sales to win some of the world's largest companies. You run discovery, build and direct demos and PoCs, and become the trusted technical advisor a prospect leans on to decide whether Omnea is real. You're deep in the modern finance and procurement stack - ERPs, CLMs, GRC, AP automation - and you use that expertise to judge what AI produces, not just to present it.

This is a foundational hire on our Sales Engineering team, working closely with Sales, Product, and the Customer team who take a deal from signed to live.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own technical discovery and demos: Run technical discovery sessions with prospects, direct AI to build a first-draft demo environment tailored to what you've learned, then adapt it based on what only a human would catch - a workflow quirk, a compliance requirement, a stakeholder's pet objection.

 - Drive PoCs end to end: Scope and own proof-of-concepts in collaboration with Product and the Customer team, directing AI to configure the environment fast and applying your own judgment on whether the PoC actually proves what the prospect needs to see to move forward.

 - Answer the hard technical and security questions: Direct AI to draft first-pass responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, then validate every answer against the prospect's actual requirements - a wrong answer here can lose the deal or create a problem after signature.

 - Be the bridge between Sales, Product, and Customer: Translate what you're hearing in the field into product feedback, and hand off cleanly to the Customer team so nothing gets lost between a signed contract and a live deployment.

 - Build the pre-sales toolkit: Keep demo environments, technical documentation, and RFP libraries sharp, using AI to draft and refresh materials as the product evolves, and refining what works based on what's actually landing with prospects.


ABOUT YOU

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're technical enough to be a genuine authority in the room, customer-facing enough to be trusted by a CFO or a CISO, and comfortable directing AI to do the heavy lifting so you can focus on the judgment calls only you can make.

 - 3-7 years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

 - Ideally you have experience in the modern finance or procurement stack - you understand procurement and AP automation, and have demoed, implemented, or administered tools like ERPs, CLMs, or GRC platforms

 - Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft demos, configurations, and RFP responses, with the judgment to catch what's wrong before a prospect sees it

 - A strong technical foundation: you can learn a complex software platform fast and go deep enough to answer hard security and architecture questions

 - An excellent communicator who can simplify technical concepts for multiple stakeholders from CFO, CPO to CISO. 

 - A proactive problem-solver with real troubleshooting instincts and a customer-first mindset

 - Comfortable owning RFPs, RFIs, and IT security questionnaires end to end, including the technical requirements that come with them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Front-End Engineer – Digital Agency | DR
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRUELOGIC

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.




OUR CLIENT

A premier independent digital creative agency headquartered in New York, operating at the intersection of design, technology and strategy. They build world-class digital experiences for top global brands, and this role supports one of the most recognized Fortune 500 brands in the world. They are known for meticulous attention to design detail, high standards for code quality and a very collaborative work environment.



JOB SUMMARY

As a Senior Creative Front-End Engineer, you will build premium, highly animated, design-driven web experiences where craft matters as much as code. You’ll turn high-end designs into pixel-perfect interfaces with smooth, performant animations and rich interactions. The ideal candidate is an autonomous, detail-oriented engineer with a strong eye for design and motion who stays on top of emerging UI trends. This is a long-term, 100% remote role from Latin America, working US Pacific Time hours.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build visually stunning, highly interactive web experiences for a world-class consumer brand.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering. It's complex, demanding, and deeply collaborative. We turn deep research into reliable, full-stack systems that drive discoveries in fields like medicine, energy, and technology, reshaping how the world computes.

Join the team that gives quantum a heartbeat.

The work

As a Business Development Manager in Germany, you’ll grow our existing customer relationships and win new ones across HPC centers, universities, research centers, government and enterprise. You’ll lead complex public tenders, shape offers that fit what customers really need, and help make IQM a recognized part of the national quantum strategy. You’ll work closely with our other Business Development Managers and with our product, marketing and technical teams, with high ownership of your accounts. In your first months, you’ll get to know your customers and partners, build a clear plan for your accounts, and have your first tenders and new opportunities moving.

What you’ll actually do

• Build and manage a strong pipeline for your accounts in Germany, finding and qualifying new opportunities in research, academia, government and industries such as finance, defense, aerospace, pharma, chemistry and energy
• Develop relationships with existing customers and find growth opportunities together with them
• Lead public tenders from first review to submission, shaping the offer together with internal teams
• Help customers navigate public funding programs to make quantum projects happen
• Meet and engage with customers regularly
• Represent IQM at conferences, industry events and exhibitions
• Bring customer feedback and market insights back to our product and marketing teams to shape what we build next

What we’re looking for

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Physics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a similar field, or equivalent experience
• Extensive experience in sales and account management across hardware, software, telecommunications, storage or application fields
• Background in high-performance computing (HPC) or data center industries
• Proven track record of growing business in a defined sales territory and closing complex deals in the tech industry
• Hands-on experience with public tenders and public funding, and with running deals that involve many stakeholders
• Confidence to build trust with both senior decision makers and technical experts
• Fluent German and English
• Willingness to travel around 40% of the time, mainly in Germany, with possible overseas trips from time to time

Seen as an advantage

• Knowledge of or experience in the quantum computing ecosystem
• Data center related certification, such as CDCS or ITIL

Why IQM?

• Full-stack quantum computing: From quantum hardware to software layers and beyond, we build across the full-stack.
• High-performance playground: We aim high, and we know sustainable performance only works when life outside work does too—hybrid setups, flexible hours.
• Never the smartest: You won’t always be the smartest person in the room. Neither will we. Expect to learn constantly - from each other and beyond with IQM’s Learning Hub, LinkedIn Learning, and a team-based L&D budget.
• Approachable leadership: Flat hierarchy, direct access. Feel free to approach any leaders. They're friendlier than they look!
• The sweet spot: Big enough to matter. Small enough to move fast. Growing between a startup and a corporation. We’re in the phase where top performers get noticed.
• Bigger than IQM: Our people build know-how for the entire quantum ecosystem. We publish papers, run hackathons, and help shape a market that's still being defined.

The future of computing won’t build itself. You might be one of the few who do.

• Meet our people and learn more about IQM on our stories page.
• Explore our scientific publications.

We'll start interviews and move forward with hiring as soon as we meet strong candidates. Please submit your application soon.

600M€+ Total Funding | 400+ Team Members | 30+ Quantum Computers Built | 300+ Patents Filed | 10 Location Globally

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Looma Background

Looma is an in-store digital media platform focused on storytelling, education, and recommendations. Their network of in-store screens helps retailers better modernize and monetize their stores, while enabling brands to tell their story directly at the point of decision. All content that airs on Looma’s network is produced or edited by Relay™, their global network of independent filmmakers, editors, and other creators who specialize in point-of-decision content.

Position Summary

Looma is growing fast. We’re adding new national retailers and expanding with existing partners, and every new program means hundreds or thousands of stores, multiple hardware and install vendors, and a retailer team counting on us to launch on time. The Senior Implementation Manager will own these deployments end to end.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll independently run our largest and most complex rollouts with our most important partners. You won’t just track the plan; you’ll write the playbooks, solve the problems blocking the work, and be the person retailers and vendors trust to get it done. You’ll also own project management as a discipline at Looma, building the program, documentation, and training that let the rest of the team deliver at the same level.

The responsibilities for this role can be split into three primary categories:

• Deployment leadership | 50%

• Hands-on problem solving & partner management | 25%

• Building Looma’s project management practice | 25%

Deployment leadership (50%)

• Own large, multi-site retail deployments end to end, from planning and procurement through install, launch, and handoff to steady-state operations

• Build and maintain integrated project plans spanning hardware procurement, certification, site surveys, installation, device registration, content readiness, and go-live

• Coordinate cross-functional work across Retail Ops, Product & Tech, Sales, and Content, as well as with partners and vendors, so every launch is ready on every front

• Track progress against milestones, surface risks early, and drive decisions to keep deployments on schedule

• Maintain a single source of truth and report clear, concise status to Looma leadership and retail partners

Hands-on problem solving & partner management (25%)

• Roll up your sleeves to clear blockers directly, whether that means troubleshooting an install issue, reworking a timeline, or chasing down a missing approval

• Produce the artifacts a deployment needs: Install guides, store communications, rollout schedules, trackers, and launch readiness checklists

• Serve as a primary point of contact for retailer stakeholders, from store operations and IT to merchandising and corporate leadership

• Manage install, hardware, and logistics vendors, holding them accountable to quality, cost, and timeline

• Travel to stores, retailer offices, and vendor sites (~25%) to oversee pilots, resolve issues in the field, and build relationships

• Capture lessons from every deployment and turn them into improvements for the next one

Building Looma’s project management practice (25%)

• Own project management as a discipline at Looma, defining the standards, tools, and rituals our deployments run on

• Create repeatable playbooks and templates for new-retailer launches, expansions, and hardware refreshes

• Own project management documentation and training, and keep both current as we scale

• Mentor and coach more junior project and implementation team members

• Partner with Retail Ops leadership to improve planning, resourcing, and forecasting across the deployment portfolio

Experience

• 7+ years of project, program, or implementation management experience, including ownership of large, complex deployments

• Track record of leading multi-site physical rollouts (e.g. hardware, fixtures, or technology installed across hundreds of locations), including managing field and install vendors

• Experience working directly with large retail chains or in retail technology / in-store media strongly preferred

• Experience creating project management processes, documentation, or training for a team

• Comfort with project management tools (e.g. Asana) and spreadsheets for planning and tracking

Attributes

• Owner’s mindset | You take full responsibility for outcomes and don’t wait for permission to solve problems

• Calm under pressure | You stay organized and decisive when timelines slip or plans change

• Clear communicator | You write and present crisply to audiences from store associates to retailer executives

• Builder | You enjoy creating structure where little exists and leaving processes better than you found them

• Generous teacher | You make the people around you better and take pride in their growth

• Detail-oriented | Nothing slips through the cracks

• Willing to travel approximately 25% of the time

Structure & Compensation

Looma will provide a competitive compensation package consisting of base salary and stock options. All Looma compensation packages include some cash / equity flexibility (i.e. you can opt for more equity and less cash or vice-versa).

Benefits

• Employee coverage for health, dental, and vision (gold plan)

• Unlimited PTO (3-week minimum)

• Flexible office setting (office, flex, or WFH, with associated stipends)

• Craftsmanship stipend

• Paid parental leave

• 401(k) plan

Our Values

At Looma, we strive to be and/or create work that is:

• For You | Generous, generative, humble, in your corner

• Incisive | Pragmatic, wise, perceptive, insightful

• Beautiful & Clear | Polished, elegant, detailed, conveys a sense of craftsmanship

• Undaunted | Tenacious, courageous, indomitable, “impenetrable ray of sun”

• Dependable | Trustworthy, reliable, nothing slips through the cracks

Diversity & Nondiscrimination

Looma is committed to promoting diversity both in our workplace and through the stories we tell. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, protected veteran status, class or caste status, or any other protected class. Our global nondiscrimination policy covers these protected classes in every market in which we do business.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.title: Creative Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Perry Ellis International, Inc. represents a diverse portfolio of lifestyle apparel brands. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiaries owns and licenses nationally and with a brand portfolio of over 40 Brands domestically and internationally recognized brands including: Perry Ellis®, Original Penguin® by Munsingwear®, Laundry by Shelli Segal®, Rafaella®, Cubavera®, Ben Hogan®, Savane®, Grand Slam®, John Henry®, Manhattan®, Axist® and Farah®. The Company enhances its roster of brands by licensing trademarks from third parties, including: Nike®  for swimwear, and Callaway®, PGA TOUR®, and Jack Nicklaus® for golf apparel.

About Perry Ellis International

Perry Ellis International, Inc. represents a diverse portfolio of lifestyle apparel brands. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiaries owns and licenses nationally and with a brand portfolio of over 42 Brands domestically and internationally recognized brands including: Perry Ellis®, Original Penguin® by Munsingwear®, Laundry by Shelli Segal®, Rafaella®, Cubavera®, Ben Hogan®, Savane®, Grand Slam®, John Henry®, Manhattan®, Axist® and Farah®. The Company enhances its roster of brands by licensing trademarks from third parties, including: Nike®  for swimwear, and Callaway®, PGA TOUR®, and Jack Nicklaus® for golf apparel.

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Creative Director of Marketing to lead the creative strategy and execution for our sports properties. Based in our Miami headquarters, you will be the driving force behind our visual identity and brand storytelling, ensuring our marketing initiatives resonate deeply with fans, partners, and the broader sports community.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Marketing, Sports, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of designers, copywriters, video producers, and content creators. You will conceptualize and execute high-impact, multi-channel campaigns that elevate brand awareness, drive fan engagement, and support revenue-generating initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in a high-energy, fast-paced environment and possesses a deep passion for sports, culture, and lifestyle marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Vision & Brand Leadership

• Define, evolve, and champion the visual identity and creative voice of our sports brands across all consumer touchpoints.

• Develop compelling, culture-defining creative concepts that align with the overarching marketing strategy set by the SVP of Marketing.

• Ensure brand consistency across all mediums, including broadcast, digital, social media, out-of-home (OOH), print, in-venue, and experiential activations.

Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Lead the end-to-end creative process for major campaigns, from ideation and pitching to production and post-launch analysis.

• Direct high-profile photo and video shoots, working closely with internal production teams and external agencies to ensure output meets elite industry standards.

• Design compelling collateral for revenue-driving initiatives, including ticketing campaigns, corporate partnership pitches, and premium hospitality offerings.

Team Management & Mentorship

• Manage, inspire, and develop a diverse in-house creative team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Optimize creative workflows and resource allocation to ensure high-quality deliverables are produced on time and within budget.

• Provide actionable, constructive feedback to elevate the work of junior creatives and mid-level managers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with the broader marketing, digital, communications, and live-event production teams to ensure cohesive storytelling across all platforms.

• Act as the primary creative liaison for external stakeholders, including corporate sponsors, broadcast partners, and external creative or media agencies.

• Present creative concepts and strategic rationale clearly and persuasively to executive leadership.

Qualifications & Requirements

• Experience: 10+ years of progressive creative experience in an agency or in-house environment, with at least 4 years in a senior creative leadership role managing cross-functional teams.

• Industry Expertise: Background in sports, entertainment, or lifestyle brand marketing is strongly preferred. A deep understanding of sports culture, fandom, and the vibrant Miami market is a significant plus.

• Portfolio: A world-class portfolio demonstrating a proven track record of conceptualizing and executing major, multi-platform brand campaigns.

• Technical Skills: Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere, After Effects). Deep understanding of modern digital design, video production, motion graphics, and typography.

• Work Style: Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Ability to pivot quickly, manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously, and thrive under the pressures of a live-event calendar.

• Work Arrangement: This is a fully on-site role requiring physical presence in our Miami office 5 days a week, with the expectation to attend evening and weekend games, events, and shoots as the sports schedule dictates.

What We Offer

• Competitive executive base salary and performance-based bonus structure.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

• 401(k) with company match.

• Exclusive access to sporting events, company-sponsored outings, and cultural experiences in Miami.

• The opportunity to shape the creative legacy of a premier sports brand.

What’s In It For You?

• Comprehensive Health: Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision plans designed to keep you and your family healthy and thriving.

• Financial Security: Secure your future with our 401(k) retirement plan (including a discretionary company match) plus company-provided Basic Life and AD&D Insurance.

• Work-Life Balance: Take the time you need to recharge with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and a full schedule of paid Holidays.

• Growth & Support: We invest in your potential through our Tuition Reimbursement program for continuous learning and provide 24/7 personal support via our Member Assistance Program (MAP).

• Team Culture: Join a community that celebrates your hard work with regular Associate Engagement Events, ranging from seasonal celebrations to on-site wellness activities.

• Exclusive Style Perks: Look your best for less with generous Associate Clothing Discounts across all our company stores and e-commerce sites.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their individual background and characteristics. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, transfer, compensation, and termination. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the company's commitment to equal employment opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Finance Operations
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Manager, Finance Operations to lead accounts payable and billing and collections as one function. You'll own procure-to-pay and order-to-cash from end to end, with teams across the US, the Philippines and Colombia.

This is an accounting-led role. AP and AR sit at the start of our financial data. When an invoice gets paid without a PO, or a bill goes out at the wrong price, the problem lands in the general ledger weeks later. We want a leader who understands the accounting impact of every transaction and builds controls to get the data right at the source.

Dandy runs high-volume physical operations: two US manufacturing labs, dental practice and DSO customers in several countries, a large vendor base and multiple legal entities. You'll bring accounting rigor and scale to the teams behind every dollar in and out.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


ACCOUNTS PAYABLE

 - Own the full procure-to-pay cycle: vendor setup, invoice processing, PO matching, approvals and payment runs.

 - Enforce PO compliance and three-way match with Procurement and Operations.

 - Manage domestic and international vendor payments across entities and currencies, in partnership with Treasury.

 - Own vendor master data quality and 1099 reporting.


BILLING AND COLLECTIONS

 - Own billing accuracy, credit controls and pricing controls across practice and DSO accounts.

 - Run cash application and collections, including a clear process for large DSO accounts agreed with Account Management.

 - Support the bad debt reserve with aging analysis and collection forecasts.


CONTROLS AND CLOSE

 - Design and document controls over procure-to-pay and order-to-cash, including segregation of duties, built to public company audit standards.

 - Deliver AP and AR subledger reconciliations, accruals and cut-off on the close calendar.

 - Serve as the main contact for auditors on AP and AR testing.


TEAM AND SYSTEMS

 - Lead the AP and billing and collections teams, including managers and team leads, with clear SOPs, training and quality checks.

 - Automate invoice capture, approvals and collections workflows in NetSuite and related tools.

 - Set and report on core metrics: DSO, aged receivables, PO match rate, payment accuracy and cost per transaction.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

 - Every invoice paid against an approved PO or a documented exception.

 - A working collections process for aged receivables and a lower DSO.

 - AP and AR reconciliations complete early in the close, with no audit adjustments.

 - Documented SOPs and controls for every core AP and AR process.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

 - 8+ years of experience, including general ledger or public accounting, and 3+ years leading AP, AR or finance shared services.

 - Hands-on knowledge of how AP and AR transactions hit the general ledger, accruals and revenue.

 - Experience in an operational business with high transaction volume: manufacturing, distribution, healthcare services or logistics.

 - Experience leading offshore or BPO teams across time zones.

 - A track record of building controls and passing audits, ideally under SOX or PCAOB standards.

 - Multi-entity and multi-currency experience.

 - Advanced Excel and strong NetSuite or comparable ERP skills.

 - A builder mindset: you fix the process, document the fix and train the team.


BONUS POINTS

 - CPA preferred. 

 - AP automation or billing system implementation experience.

 - Healthcare, dental or medical device industry experience.

 - High-volume B2B or usage-based billing experience.

jobs.title: Head of Collections
jobs.description:
In Person in New York City, NY

About Us

Obligo is a fast-growing FinTech / Real Estate Tech startup on a mission to build trust between renters and landlords worldwide. By leveraging open banking, data, and AI, Obligo eliminates traditional security deposits and replaces them with a fair, flexible, and transparent renter experience while streamlining operations and reducing risk for property managers.

At Obligo, we believe that clear communication, thoughtful user experience, and trust-building design are just as important as strong risk models and technical execution. We build financial products that people can understand, trust, and feel confident using.

The Role

As Head of Collections, you'll lead Obligo's collections function, combining hands-on collections expertise, people leadership, data, and technology to improve recovery performance while delivering a thoughtful renter experience.

About the Position

We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and hands-on collections leader to own and continuously improve Obligo's collections operation. You will manage a team of four collectors as well as external first- and third-party collection resources and AI agents, while serving as Obligo's internal collections subject matter expert.

This role combines day-to-day leadership with strategy and execution. You'll coach the team, handle complex escalations, track and improve performance, develop new collection strategies, and lead projects that make the organization more effective and scalable.

Working in a hybrid model from our NYC office in Union Square two days per week, you'll collaborate closely with Risk, Customer Support, Legal, Product, Data, and other teams across Obligo.

Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop Obligo's internal collections team, setting clear goals and driving individual and team performance.

• Own Obligo's collections strategy, including account segmentation, prioritization, outreach, negotiation, escalation, and resolution strategies. Lead projects and experiments to improve recovery rates, operational efficiency, renter experience, and team productivity.

• Help design and implement the use of AI agents, automation, and other technologies across the collections lifecycle. Develop and maintain collections playbooks, workflows, scripts, training, QA standards, and operating procedures.

• Use data to understand renter behavior, evaluate collection strategies and team performance, and identify opportunities for improvement. Identify recurring issues and emerging trends from collections activity and translate them into broader product, policy, or operational improvements.

• Serve as Obligo's collections subject matter expert and personally handle Tier-3, sensitive, unusual, and high-value collection cases when needed.

• Manage the performance of external first-party and third-party collection partners and determine how work should be allocated across internal, external, and automated resources.

• Partner closely with Support, Risk, Legal, Product, Data, Finance, and Operations on complex cases, new initiatives, product improvements, and collections policies.

Requirements

• 5+ years of relevant experience in collections, customer operations, or a similar operational environment, including 3+ years managing a team.

• Strong track record of data-led performance management—setting targets, identifying performance gaps and root causes, and turning insights into coaching and action.

• Strong analytical skills and comfort working hands-on with dashboards, spreadsheets, BI tools, and operational data to make decisions and measure results.

• Demonstrated ability to improve processes and team productivity, from identifying opportunities through implementation and measurement.

• Experienced people manager who can set clear expectations, coach and develop employees, and address underperformance.

• Meaningful collections expertise, including collection strategy, negotiation, escalations, and customer communication.

• Self-motivated and adaptable, with strong judgment and the ability to lead and execute in a fast-moving startup environment.

Nice to Have: Experience in fintech or consumer finance; managing outsourced collection partners; implementing AI or automation in operations; SQL or hands-on BI experience.

• Generous PTO and holiday schedule

• Commuter benefits

• Life insurance

• Amazing offices in NYC and Tel Aviv

• A chance to work with incredibly bright, creative, talented, and passionate teammates

Salary Range: 140 - 160

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A  the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Your Role

Focused Energy is developing its flagship fusion facility at Biblis, Germany and this role sits at the heart of making it happen. As Facility Development Lead, you’ll own the integrated development plan for Focused Energy’s Biblis facility. You’ll translate technical requirements into coordinated facility, utility, planning, and permitting workstreams, aligning engineering teams with RWE/Biblis stakeholders and external design partners. You’ll drive priorities, dependencies, and decisions so the site can progress through development with a clear, realistic plan.



What You'll Do

 - Drive German design and permitting strategy by identifying required approvals, regulatory constraints, fire protection requirements, and risk assessment.

 - Coordinate external architects, planners, consultants and utilities partners, ensuring their output is aligned with FE’s technical roadmap and decision needs.

 - Enable senior decision-making by maintaining a clear, current picture of facility options, risks, assumptions, dependencies, and cost/schedule implications, so engineering leadership can act with confidence and without delay.



Who You Are

Must-haves

 - Experience leading or shaping complex facility, industrial building, infrastructure, or technical site development in Germany.

 - Ability to translate technical engineering needs into facility, layout, infrastructure, and utility requirements.

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect
jobs.description:
The job in short

As a Principal Solutions Architect at Backbase, you help banks integrate BankingOS with their existing technology and build solutions for Digital Banking and Agentic Banking.

You combine architecture expertise with hands-on development. You work with AI models, agent frameworks, APIs and integrations to build prototypes, test ideas and understand what works in practice.

You work alongside Solutions Engineers to design the overall architecture, connecting BankingOS with the bank’s systems, data and security requirements. You explain technical decisions to executives, architects and engineers, and adjust your approach based on testing and evidence.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on technical design, practical experimentation and mentoring colleagues. You also contribute to product improvements and develop reusable architecture patterns.

Meet the job

• Work with bank technology teams: Understand their technical requirements and help them make architecture decisions.

• Design BankingOS integrations: Define how banking journeys, AI agents, data and existing systems connect through APIs, events and other integration patterns.

• Design Agentic Banking solutions: Define how AI agents use data and tools, including permissions, human approvals, testing and traceability.

• Address AI limitations: Assess reliability, hallucinations, privacy and agent autonomy. Test solutions and define where additional controls are needed.

• Build and test prototypes: Work directly with AI agents, knowledge retrieval, tools and integrations. Investigate failures and use the results to improve the architecture.

• Plan for production: Consider performance, security, reliability, cost and implementation effort. Document the architecture in the Digital Solution Document (DSD) and align customer teams, Services and partners on delivery requirements.

• Lead technical evaluations: Run architecture workshops, technical assessments and RFP responses. Explain how the proposed solution meets requirements and where compromises may be needed.

• Share technical knowledge: Build demos, reusable components and architecture patterns. Mentor colleagues and help them apply new technologies in customer projects.

• Contribute to product development: Share customer feedback and testing lessons with the product team to help improve BankingOS.

How about you?

• Experience designing complex enterprise solutions in customer-facing architecture or technical consulting.

• Practical experience building AI applications and agent workflows, including an understanding of their limitations and trade-offs.

• Strong knowledge of enterprise integration, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native deployment.

• Engineering experience with Java, Spring, identity and access management, DevOps and modern cloud platforms.

• Understanding of security, data privacy, access permissions and operational resilience in banking or other regulated industries.

• Ability to explain technical decisions to executives, architects and engineers and connect them to business requirements.

• A hands-on approach to testing new technologies, building prototypes and sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• Ability to work independently, solve technical problems and make decisions when requirements are unclear.

• Experience mentoring colleagues and willingness to travel for customer engagements approximately 25% of the time.

What do we offer?

• A bonus on top of your base salary.

• Referral bonus.

• Time for self-development, a training budget and a clear promotion path.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Project Manager - Oncology
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced full service Project Manager in the field of clinical trials who’s engaged in addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology. Are you passionate about impacting the health and lives of patients around the world? Do you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in trial operational delivery?

Precision for Medicine are looking to hire a Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager with experience in Oncology who have managed full service clinical trials within a CRO setting to join our global team.

In this pivotal role you will have full service oversight for clinical projects across global/regional (ph I-IV) trials, within Oncology.  Accountable for clinical project delivery, oversight of all functional departments, and ensuring agreed timelines, scope, cost and quality.

Involved in all study stages, including proposal strategy, development, costing, and bid defence, and seeing studies through the full cycle to completion, managing the client relationship, project team and budget and timelines throughout.

You will work in a cross-functional team with both internal and external stakeholders, driving quality and coordinating the study team.

We offer an amazing high-energy, dedicated, collaborative team members who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments. If you are no stranger to taking charge and seek positive teamwork to deliver extraordinary work, we have an opportunity for you.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

• You will independently lead clinical projects in accordance with the study budget and scope of work. You will use your strong interpersonal and organizational skills to set and achieve objectives in the execution of the projects; both contracted objectives and financial objectives. You may be called upon to run international trials as well.

• Serve as the primary point-of-contact liaison with the client to provide excellent customer service, including participation in proposal activities and client presentations

• Liaise with Project Team and senior management of both Precision and sponsors, including C level

• Handle and lead all aspects of a clinical research trial or trials

• Total project management for all functional areas including data management, safety, clinical, medical monitoring and biostatistics, etc.

• Prepare project status updates for clients and management; identifying key deliverables and performance metrics of success and escalation.

• Serve as an active member of the Project Team with the goal to contribute towards efficient management and execution of trials

• Prepare and reviews protocols and other study documentation such as project plans, inform consents, site contracts and budgets

Requirements:

• Degree or similar related life science qualification, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Previous experience in a full service/global Project Management role working in the CRO industry is essential.

• Extensive experience working within Clinical Operations position within a CRO, and at least 4 years full service Project Management experience in a clinical trial setting working for a Clinical Research Organisation.

• Experience managing studies within Oncology

• Working understanding of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process

• Ability to drive and availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays

• Be able to communicate effectively in the English language both written and spoken

• Strong presentation skills

• Proven computer skills (MS Office, MS Project, PowerPoint) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS)

• Proven ability to develop positive working relationships with individual and teams internally and externally

• Demonstrated core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities as it relates to the execution of a clinical development plan

Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development.

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. jobs.title: Transport Manager
jobs.description:
Pozícia Transport Manager je kľúčovou súčasťou Supply Chain tímu. Zodpovedá za plánovanie, koordináciu a neustále zlepšovanie logistických a skladových procesov s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý tok materiálu a hotových výrobkov naprieč výrobou a skladovým hospodárstvom.

Náplňou práce bude najmä:

• plánovanie a koordinácia logistických operácií v úzkej spolupráci s výrobným oddelením a oddelením kvality,
• riadenie skladového hospodárstva vrátane externých skladov,
• zabezpečenie dodržiavania princípov FIFO, 5S a vizuálneho manažmentu,
• monitorovanie stavu zásob a skladovaných výrobkov vrátane riešenia nezhodných alebo zastaraných položiek,
• analýza skladových kapacít a návrh opatrení na optimalizáciu využitia skladového priestoru,
• vedenie, plánovanie práce, rozvoj a hodnotenie tímu na sklade a v kancelárii príjmu dreva,
• pravidelné reportovanie ukazovateľov zásob, obrátkovosti a skladových výkonov,
• tvorba, implementácia a zlepšovanie procesov, pracovných postupov a štandardov v oblasti skladového hospodárstva,
• aktívna účasť na projektoch zameraných na optimalizáciu logistických a skladových procesov,
• zabezpečenie dostupnosti a efektívneho využívania manipulačnej techniky.

• ukončené stredoškolské alebo vysokoškolské vzdelanie,
• minimálne 3 roky skúseností v oblasti logistiky a riadenia skladových procesov,
