• pokročilú znalosť anglického jazyka,
• pokročilú používateľskú znalosť MS Office,
• výhodou je znalosť systému MOVEX.

Osobnostne a profesijne oceníme:

• schopnosť viesť a rozvíjať tím,
• výborné organizačné a plánovacie schopnosti,
• analytické myslenie a schopnosť riešiť problémy,
• rozhodnosť a schopnosť prevziať zodpovednosť,
• komunikačné a prezentačné zručnosti,
• orientáciu na výsledky, náklady a efektivitu,
• flexibilitu, samostatnosť a proaktívny prístup,
• schopnosť spolupracovať s rôznymi tímami naprieč organizáciou.

jobs.title: Account Development Representative (French Speaker) - Chicago Based
jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team

Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization, built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other businesses.

We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by prividing a reliable, scalable, and high-quality service.

From intimate Candlelight Private Concerts or a large-scale multi-city activation, we turn live entertainment into a repeatable business solution that drives employee engagement and brand differentiation. Our team owns the full journey, from initial sales and strategy to global execution, working closely with Fever Originals and Operations to scale B2B experiences smoothly and at a global level.

Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service.

The Role

As our Account Development Representative, you’ll be the pipeline engine for privatized events. You’ll qualify and nurture inbound interest, craft targeted outbound plays, and close group ticket deals while sharpening the sales methodologies that will fuel your growth (and ours).

What success looks like in your first year:

• 3 months: Ramp up our offering, tools, and messaging. Start hitting your pipeline targets.

• 6 months: Consistently generate and progress qualified opportunities for private events. Demonstrate improved conversion rates through disciplined follow-up and data-driven iteration.

• 12 months: Become a go-to revenue contributor for Fever for Business, with a repeatable playbook and strong internal partnerships that scale results, and become promotion-ready

What You'll Do

• Drive inbound and outbound pipeline generation for Fever for Business’ privatized events offering.

• Build and optimize outreach sequences, messaging, and cadences to increase response and conversion rates.

• Maintain spotless CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting to keep the team aligned on targets.

• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Fever Originals, and the broader Sales organization to align campaigns, share insights, and maximize impact.

• Track and report on key KPIs (SQLs generated, pipeline value, conversion rates, closed-won revenue) and iterate based on data.

• Act as an ambassador of Fever’s mission to democratize culture and entertainment for corporate audiences.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree or higher education from a top university or business school

• Proven experience in a sales development or similar role, preferably within a B2B SaaS, media, or events company, is strongly preferred

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills

• Proven track record of achieving sales targets

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• An entrepreneurial can-do attitude

• A self-starter and comfortable in ambiguity - working through things for the first time

• Ability to think creatively and make data-driven decisions

• Skilled in crafting slide decks and written pitch materials

• Fluency in English + French. Additional languages are a plus.

Why You'll Love It Here

• Attractive compensation package consisting of an starting OTE of $80,000.

• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.

• Tax advantage programs: employee-funded accounts like HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and Commuter Benefits let you pay for eligible expenses tax-free.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Employee-funded, giving you the flexibility to contribute what you choose and enjoy tax advantages while saving for your future.

• Private health, dental and vision insurance with Cigna.

• Flexible Parental Leave: We’ve got you covered! After just 3 months, all parents get 8 weeks at 100% pay, plus your choice of an extra 4 weeks at full pay or 8 weeks at 50% pay to bond with your newest family member.

• Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Bronze plan.

• Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.

• Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

#LI-hybrid #LI-fulltime

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Online Data Analyst - Spanish (US)
jobs.description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of USA's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

• Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools
• Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources
• Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning
• Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
• Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
• Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Why join the project:

• Fully remote flexibility: Complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments
• Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment
• Direct feedback and growth: Receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision
• Intellectually rigorous work: Each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis.
• Responsive support team: Contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions

Qualification path

Requirements:

• Professional fluency in English and Spanish (native or near-native proficiency required)
• Residency in USA for the last 5 consecutive years
• Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
• Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability
• Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of USA
• Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in analytical, technical, or research disciplines (strongly preferred)
• Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

• Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview
• Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
• Review the open-book study guide and evaluation framework (provided in your welcome materials)
• Complete an open-book qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
• Receive your project assignment and access credentials

Service Rates

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

To apply, please reach us at tiai_diverse_crowd@telusdigital.com by sending a copy of your CV along with the following details:

• Year of Birth
• Country Origin
• Current Country of Residence
• Native language and any additional languages spoken
• Subject Title: "Jobs for Humanity- Put the Job Role"

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.

*Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*

Your daily adventure:

• Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.

• Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.

• Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.

• Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.

• Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.

• Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.

• Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.

• Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.

• Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.

• Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.

• Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.

YOUR SKILLS

• Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.

• 5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.

• Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.

• Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.

• Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).

• Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.

• Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.

• Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.

• Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.

• Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.

Nice to Have:

• Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.

• Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).

• Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).

• Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.

• Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.

• Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)

• Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
• Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
• Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
• Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
• Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
• 5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
• Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
• Life Insurance with AXA.
• Office Gym open from 7 AM to 8 PM
• Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Supabase manages millions of Postgres instances and is growing. We have strong teams across observability, release engineering, and incident management — and we're concentrating our reliability efforts into a dedicated SRE practice that ties the discipline together across the platform.

You'll be embedded within Service Operations, and your primary job is to make every engineering team more reliable — not by owning their infrastructure, but by establishing the practices, frameworks, and feedback loops that let them own reliability themselves. You'll work across the org: sometimes setting the standard, sometimes pair-programming a fix, sometimes helping a team define their error budget, sometimes telling them it's exhausted.

This role is ideal for someone who has a strong vision for how SRE should work and thrives in async, fast-paced environments where influence matters more than authority.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Partner with service teams to define meaningful SLIs and SLOs grounded in customer experience, and build the error budget policies that turn them into engineering decisions

 - Own and evolve the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process — conducting reviews for new services and major changes across observability, alerting, runbooks, capacity, and graceful degradation

 - Strengthen the incident-to-improvement pipeline: connecting postmortem findings to operational readiness gaps, identifying repeat failure patterns, and driving systemic fixes

 - Act as the reliability expert teams pull in for architecture reviews, failure mode analysis, dependency mapping, and resilience design

 - Identify and quantify operational toil across the org, and build or advocate for automation that eliminates it

 - Help teams design sustainable on-call practices: alert quality, escalation paths, runbook coverage, and noise reduction

 - Track and report on org-wide operational maturity, surfacing systemic gaps and driving remediation


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 7+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or reliability-focused roles, including experience shaping SRE practices and driving adoption across engineering teams

 - Have a software engineering mindset — you write code and build tools, not just configure them

 - Have hands-on experience defining and operationalizing SLOs/SLIs at scale, including error budget policies that actually influenced engineering decisions

 - Have deep experience with incident response, postmortem facilitation, and turning incident learnings into systemic improvements

 - Have worked with large-scale multi-tenant systems (bonus: managed database platforms or Postgres)

 - Are proficient with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi preferred, Terraform/CDK also acceptable)

 - Communicate clearly and persuasively — this role requires influencing without authority across a distributed org

 - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

 - Are energized by making other teams more effective rather than being the one who fixes everything


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Kubernetes-based platform operations

 - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, or similar observability tooling

 - Experience building developer-facing reliability tooling (SLO dashboards, ORR frameworks, toil tracking, DORA metrics)





WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Senior AI R&D Engineer - Performance - Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model https://huggingface.co/Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

 

We are hiring a Senior Performance Engineer to grow our pre-training efficiency team. If you are excited about making models fast and scaling them to thousands of GPUs, this is the role for you!


Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will engineer the systems required to train foundation models at scale. Your objective is to maximize hardware utilization and training throughput on our large-scale GPU clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs). You will work at the intersection of deep learning frameworks, distributed systems, and GPU microarchitecture, eliminating bottlenecks from the Python layer down to the GPU kernel.

This role is for Aleph Alpha Research GmbH.

Your responsibilities:

 - End-to-End Optimization: Profile training loops using PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute to identify system- and kernel-level bottlenecks in order to maximize model throughput.

 - Distributed Strategy and Topology: Configure and tune composite parallelism strategies (e.g. TP, DP, HSDP/FSDP, EP), optimizing load balance, minimizing critical-path bottlenecks, and managing communication-to-computation trade-offs for large-scale LLM training.

 - Hardware-Aware Modeling: Partner with AI Researchers to define model architectures for hardware efficiency without compromising convergence.
   


YOUR PROFILE

Basic Qualifications

 - Are proficient in Python and the PyTorch library.

 - Have a strong engineering background in parallel and/or distributed systems with proven track record of excellence.

 - Have hands-on experience with modern machine learning techniques (especially large language models and their life cycle).

 - Deeply understand the CUDA programming model.

 - Have experience in distributed programming with APIs like NCCL or MPI.

 - Have experience analysing profiling traces with tools such as PyTorch Profiler and Nvidia Nsight.

 - Please note this role requires regular on-site collaboration in Heidelberg as a member of the Training Efficiency Team.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Contributions to modern distributed training frameworks (e.g., TorchTitan, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed).

 - Familiarity with low-precision training formats (MXFP4, MXFP8) and their impact on numerical stability and throughput.

 - A deep understanding of NCCL communication primitives, NVSHMEM or CUDA IPC and their performance.

 - A proven track record of implementing and optimising modern transformer-based model training.

 - A proven track record working on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture.
   


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Become part of an AI revolution!

 - 30 days of paid vacation

 - Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub https://wellhub.com/de-de/

 - Mental health support through nilo.health http://nilo.health

 - Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

 - Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

 - Budget for additional technical equipment

 - Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

 - JobRad® https://www.jobrad.org/ Bike Lease

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/aa99046a-07f4-421d-8d6a-afe18d87eb09/a6a3f816-65cc-4590-aa69-685dcbbeac0b/image.png]

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Accounts and Delivery
jobs.description:
About Us

Beamup builds AI agents for supply chain and operations at scale. Our agents find and fix failures inside large supply chain and operations businesses: retailers, marketplaces, fulfillment operators and manufacturers. They cut through the noise in the fifteen to twenty systems our customers already run, find the failures that matter, prove what they cost, and fix the cause autonomously so it stops repeating, before the end customer ever finds out.

We are deployed in more than twenty countries, hold eleven granted AI patents, and count Fortune-100 customers.

Our Mission

To close the gap between what every customer-facing team hears and what every operations team sees. So delivery promises hold, customer loyalty compounds, and nobody starts from zero the next time the same failure comes back.

The Role

This is a senior customer-facing role. Your job is to make every deployment deliver, prove the value in numbers the customer’s finance team accepts, and grow the account from there. You are the executive sponsor’s named contact, the person the operators trust, and the one who runs the plan and flags problems early.

The position reports to the VP of Sales and is fully remote, based in USA. Your working day is balanced across US and Europe time zones and you should expect around 30+ days of travel a year across the US and Europe, including transatlantic trips.

What You Own

• Retention. Every account converts from pilot into production and renews.

• Growth. Each agent we commission opens the door to the next one. You find the second and third missions inside the account and you close them.

• The relationship. You are the named point of contact for the executive sponsor at every account, and the person who keeps the operators on side.

• ROI. You build the value case before signature, then prove it afterwards using the customer's own numbers, in a form their finance team will accept.

• The read on the account. You understand their supply chain and their business well enough to find the openings they have not told us about yet.

• Your Team: You will be part of a customer facing team including sales, PM, and forward deployed engineers. Your job within this team will be to translate customer needs into digestible, actionable direction for the tech and product teams.

What We Are Looking For

• 10+ years in enterprise software or consulting, with at least three of them owning named accounts and the outcomes attached to them.

• A consulting background on the vendor side is the strongest fit: professional services, solutions consulting, delivery or presales at an enterprise software company. Supply chain practices at the large consultancies and the specialist boutiques are also a fit.

• Domain depth in one of three areas: supply chain operations, supply chain data, or data and cloud infrastructure.

• You have worked with $1B+ enterprises, and you are credible in a room with Supply Chain executives in the morning and a data engineering team in the afternoon.

• A project management instinct. You run a plan, you chase the dependency nobody else noticed, and you tell the customer bad news early.

• A record of retention and expansion you can describe with numbers, including one account that nearly went wrong and what you did about it.

• Comfortable holding a technical conversation about data without needing to write code yourself.

Helpful, Not Required

• SQL, data modelling, or working familiarity with Snowflake or Databricks.

• Experience in a fast-paced startup environment. You are comfortable building the process while running it.

• Experience across both US and European enterprise accounts.

Beamup is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

You can read more about us at:

https://www.beamup.ai/

And we were also chosen to be one of the 50 most promising Israeli startups of 2023:
https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/hjtwkugx2

jobs.title: Global Clinic Operations Lead
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.



Role Purpose

Neko is scaling fast. Our clinical teams already outnumber HQ across the US and Europe, and that ratio will keep growing. They deliver Neko’s promise to every member, every day – and right now, the information supporting their work is fragmented, inconsistent, and ungoverned. At our current pace, that's not just operational noise. It's a quality and safety risk. This role exists to fix that.

The role sits at the centre of two funnels. Inbound: you'll work closely with every team at Neko to shape what reaches clinical staff, when, and how. That means building trusted relationships across the organisation, helping teams understand what clinical staff need, and together making deliberate decisions about what gets communicated, what waits, and what can be consolidated. Outbound: once aligned and prioritised, you translate that into structured, cadenced formats that a dispersed clinical workforce can act on – right channel, right format, right frequency.

This is change management as much as communications. You're not just sending updates. You're redesigning how the whole organisation relates to its clinical teams.



What you'll deliver in the first 6-12 months 

Build and enforce the intake model

 - Design the process that governs how every team at Neko communicates with clinical staff – how requests are submitted, evaluated, sequenced, and approved

 - Build the centralised view that ensures nothing reaches clinical staff in an uncoordinated or duplicative way

 - Document decision criteria clearly enough that stakeholders understand and trust how calls are made

 - Define escalation paths for urgent communications that need to move faster than the standard cadence



Drive organisation-wide change management

 - Partner with senior leadership to establish the intake model as an endorsed, org-wide norm – not an optional service, but the way Neko works

 - Run a structured roll-out across every team with touch points to clinical staff

 - Build the relationships that make the process feel collaborative rather than bureaucratic

 - Report regularly on intake volume, team compliance, and where we need to evolve.



Operationalise clinical communications

 - Start with a clear-eyed audit of how information reaches clinical teams today – the gaps, the overlaps, the friction

 - Build a global clinical programme with a single source of truth that clinical staff can rely on

 - Design the right mix of channels and formats for a dispersed, non-desk workforce – including AI-enabled formats like short-form video, audio briefings, and visual summaries

 - Create repeatable templates that make consistency straightforward for programme managers and local teams

 - Equip clinic leads with the tools and confidence to communicate well within their teams without losing global coherence

 - Define the metrics that prove it's working – comprehension, consistency, engagement, reduction in operational noise – and report on them regularly

 - Build a global communications cadence that helps leadership teams understand what’s changing, what’s ahead and how to prepare.



Minimum Qualifications

 - Proven experience in change management, or programme management, with direct ownership of communication or enablement strategy at scale

 - Proven experience designing and enforcing intake or governance processes across multiple cross-functional teams – you've built the model, sold it in, and made it stick

 - A track record running structured communications programmes for large, dispersed frontline workforces

 - Strong programme management instincts: you bring structure to ambiguity and build systems that hold

 - A creative communicator who knows when a policy document is right and when a 60-second video does the job better

 - Genuine fluency with AI tools and an appetite to use them to improve quality, efficiency, and reach

 - Sharp stakeholder skills: you can align leadership and cross-functional teams, hold the line when needed, and build trust in the process

 - Experience in high-growth, multi-site consumer services or healthcare strongly preferred

 - Comfortable working across multiple geographies and time zones

 - Strong written and verbal English; additional European languages a plus

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist (Poland)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end accounts payable process, ensuring timely and accurate payments, maintaining vendor records, and supporting month-end close activities. You will serve as a key liaison between our vendors and internal teams to uphold strong financial operations and vendor relationships.

This role requires someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Ensure proper coding, approval, and documentation of invoices in accordance with company policy.

 - Schedule and prepare payments in line with vendor terms and internal timelines.

 - Maintain and reconcile the AP aging report and monitor outstanding payables.

 - Assist in fulfilling audit requests and compiling internal control documentation.

 - Support month-end close activities by reconciling AP and corporate credit card accounts.

 - Act as a primary point of contact for accounts payable inquiries from employees, contractors, and vendors.

 - Collaborate with auditors and external partners when required.

 - Foster and maintain positive relationships with vendors through timely and professional communication.

Requirements

 - Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in an Accounts Payable role.

 - Required proficiency with financial systems including NetSuite and Ramp.

 - Strong command of Google Workspace tools, including Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Meet.

 - Excellent analytical, organizational, and multi-tasking abilities.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

 - Ability to operate both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.

Location

This role is remote but needs to be located within Poland. Option to come either hybrid or full time into our office in Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Product Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:

The role combines business consulting, light technical aptitude, and a good understanding of AI-driven tools to help clients get maximum value from the platform.

jobs.title: HR Associate
jobs.description:
We're hiring an HR Associate to help run the systems and operational side of People Operations at CEA. You'll own the processes that move people into, through, and out of the organisation: onboarding, contracts, expenses, payroll inputs, state and city tax filings, and the HR systems that connect them. You'll have real ownership of how these processes work, and the role includes projects to improve them with automation and AI. This position reports to Keighly Baron, HR Manager.




ABOUT CEA

The Centre for Effective Altruism (CEA) stewards the movement of people putting effective altruism principles into practice to solve the world's most pressing problems. We're working to build a flourishing future by applying evidence, reason, and compassion to challenges like global poverty, animal suffering, and existential risks.

Our work centers on growing and supporting a global community of people who rigorously analyze where they can do the most good and take action on those insights. Current strategic priorities include increasing understanding of effective altruism and its principles, growing the number of people who are motivated by EA principles to take significant action to address pressing problems, and diversifying funding sources for high-impact work.

We had significant success in 2025, building momentum within CEA. Our headcount grew from 42 to 66 core staff. Program participation (e.g., events, courses, groups) grew by 20-25% year over year. We merged with EA Funds and are rapidly scaling up our capacity for grantmaking and associated fundraising.

In 2026, we've maintained ambitious momentum while building the foundations for a step-change in the wider EA ecosystem's growth trajectory from 2027 onwards.




ABOUT THE PEOPLE OPERATIONS TEAM

People Operations at CEA is a small team that handles the full employee lifecycle for a distributed, international staff. The team covers compensation and benchmarking, international employment compliance, payroll and benefits administration, onboarding, employee relations, and policy. You'll work most closely with the HR Manager and the People Operations Specialist, and with colleagues in Business Operations, Finance, and Legal.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll take over a set of operational responsibilities that are currently spread across the team. You'll also own projects: rebuilding the onboarding and offboarding workflow, building an HR metrics dashboard and a compliance calendar, and using AI to speed up drafting and routine requests.

We expect the role to be roughly half operations, a quarter systems and process projects, and a quarter onboarding, handbook, and employee experience. Early on you'll work with review before anything goes out (contracts, tax filings, payroll inputs). As you continue to onboard, that review loosens, and after probation you will move to fully owning payroll.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


OPERATIONS

 - Prepare and track state and city tax registrations and filings, including annual benefit reporting. Work with Business Operations to escalate filing notices to Gusto.

 - Process expense reimbursements in Expensify for the US and UK, including routing reports to the correct approver when needed, and handle Deel expense approvals. Process UK taxable expenses through payroll.

 - Administer contracts for staff, contractors, and EOR team members. This covers generating agreements from approved templates, routing them through DocuSign, and filing them. Run the contractor onboarding process, including UK right-to-work checks where needed, invoicing instructions, and point-of-contact guidance.

 - Coordinate pre-clearance checks: run the process, collect documents, and track status against criteria set by the HR Manager.

 - Collect and validate payroll inputs for the US, UK, and Deel before the People Operations Specialist runs and approves payroll. After probation, take on full ownership of the process.

 - Provide first-line benefits administration, including enrolments, changes, and employee questions.

 - Run offboarding logistics, including removing access from systems and coordinating equipment returns with Business Operations.

 - Keep HRIS data accurate in Humaans, run reports on request, and reconcile accruals between Gusto, Deel, and Humaans.

 - Produce monthly HR and Finance reporting.

 - Send NDAs for work trials and set up email and Slack access for work-trial candidates and contractors.


ONBOARDING AND EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE

 - Run onboarding end to end: offer letter, I-9 (US) and right-to-work and DBS (UK) checks, welcome emails, first-day calls, manager communication, and the HR and manager checklists in Asana and Humaans.

 - Set up new joiners in our systems: Gusto, Ethena, 1Password, email and Google Groups, Slack, and Polly. Match new joiners with buddies.

 - Collect onboarding feedback and use it to improve the process.


HANDBOOK AND KNOWLEDGE BASE

 - Maintain the staff handbook in Notion: formatting, version control, routing pages to reviewers, tracking sign-off, and keeping benefits and policy details accurate.

 - Write and maintain onboarding and manager documentation, and keep Notion tidy by clearing defunct pages and assigning page owners.

 - Update the website team page when people join, leave, or change roles.


SYSTEMS AND PROCESS PROJECTS

 - Build AI workflows for contract drafting, an internal HR FAQ, and role updates.

 - Build an HR metrics dashboard covering headcount, turnover, and internal mobility.

 - Build a compliance calendar of recurring deadlines across jurisdictions. State and city filing dates will be the first entries.

 - Be the day-to-day contact for Humaans, including onboarding workflows, work anniversary and birthday automations, annual public holiday updates, and the quarterly call with our customer success manager.

 - Maintain Polly (adding and removing team members and updating reporting lines).


WHAT THE FIRST 90 DAYS LOOK LIKE

 - 30 days: Complete onboarding and shadow each core process. Take over expense processing and system setup for new joiners.

 - 60 days: Own onboarding and offboarding logistics, contract administration (with review), and payroll input collection. Complete your first full state and city tax filing cycle alongside the People Operations Specialist. Start the compliance calendar.

 - 90 days: Run the monthly HR and Finance reporting. Take on the first process improvement project and present a plan for it.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

At a minimum, we want a candidate who has:

 - Operations experience. 2+ years of experience in operations, HR operations, people operations, or a similar role. You can run a process reliably, meet deadlines, and spot when something looks wrong.

 - Attention to detail. You'll handle payroll inputs, tax filings, and employee records, where errors cost money or create compliance risk.

 - Comfort with systems. You learn new tools quickly and have worked with HRIS, payroll, or similar platforms. Experience with tools like Humaans, Gusto, Deel, Expensify, Asana, Notion, Airtable, or DocuSign is helpful but not required.

 - Interest in HR. You have a basic understanding of HR and want to learn employment compliance, benefits, and payroll, and are excited to continue developing.

 - Skill with AI tools. You use AI in your own work and are interested in building workflows that save the team time.

 - Willingness to do administrative work. A large part of the job is clerical, and you're excited to do it well and look for ways to automate it.

 - Clear written communication. You'll write documentation, emails to new hires, and handbook content.

 - Commitment to CEA's mission. You're interested in effective altruism and the work CEA does.

It will be valuable if you also have:

 - Experience with US or UK employment processes such as I-9 verification, right-to-work checks, or payroll

 - Experience building automations or workflows (for example in Airtable, Zapier, or Notion)

 - Experience working in a remote or international team

 - Experience in a nonprofit or startup

We recognise we may not find someone who fits all of these criteria, and we encourage you to apply even if you aren't sure you're fully qualified.




OTHER INFORMATION

This is a full-time, remote position. We prefer applicants who are able to work in time zones between US Pacific Time and GMT. We have an office in Oxford, UK, that you would have access to.

Start date:  December 2026, with some flexibility for the right candidate

Reports to: Keighly Baron, HR Manager

Compensation:

 - US: For this role we offer a base salary of $79,200 - $90,000 and a 10% unconditional 401k contribution.

 - Other locations: For candidates outside the US, base salary is converted to local currency using a fixed exchange rate, and total compensation is adjusted based on the cost of employment and fixed local benefit costs to create an equivalent package.

 - Benefits globally include private health insurance, flexible work hours, a $6,000 annual professional development allowance, a $6,000 mental health support allowance, extended parental leave, ergonomic equipment, 25 days of paid vacation, and more.

This role may involve travel. There are likely 2-3 trips a year to attend team retreats and other events.

We want a team with a range of backgrounds and experiences and encourage people from all of them to apply. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.description:
About PackageX
PackageX builds the Physical Logistics Execution Platform for enterprise teams working across manufacturing sites, distribution centers, warehouses, retail locations, and other logistics-heavy environments.
Our platform combines Vision AI, workflow automation, mobile execution, and integrations to help companies digitize, execute, and verify physical operations at the point of work, creating trusted evidence of what actually happened.
Our operating model is simple: Execution. Verification. Evidence.
Why This Role Exists
Every scan, photo, and workflow event on a customer's floor lands in our backend. The volume is real: thousands of devices sending scans and images all day, often from spots with bad connectivity, dropping offline and syncing back later. Enterprise customers notice every slow query and every lost event.
We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer (Full Stack) to build and scale the services, APIs, and integrations that carry that load, along with the web screens customers and internal teams use to configure and run the platform. You'll work with product, mobile, AI, and implementation teams to turn messy physical operations into software that holds up in production.
The role is backend-first. You'll design data models, build services and APIs, run integrations with customer ERPs, WMSs, and TMSs, and keep the platform fast and dependable as customers scale. You'll also ship across the stack: the dashboards, configuration tools, and admin screens that sit on top of your own APIs. You'll take a feature from schema to screen without waiting on a separate frontend team, make architecture calls, own your services in production, and get pulled into customer integrations when they get hard.
How This Role Works
This is one role with two modes, and you'll move between them often, sometimes in the same week.
Backend mode. You're in the services: designing data models and APIs, building workflow and event-processing logic, integrating with customer systems and our Vision AI pipeline, and owning what you ship in production.
Full stack mode. You're in the web app: building the dashboards, workflow configuration tools, and reporting views that customers and our implementation teams use every day, on top of the APIs you designed.
Both halves matter. If you're a backend engineer who won't touch a UI, or a frontend engineer who has never owned a production service and a database, this probably isn't your role. If you genuinely enjoy both, keep reading.
What You'll Do
Design and build the backend services and APIs that power the PackageX platform, mobile app, and web console.
Model data for complex, configurable workflows (events, evidence, and customer configuration) and keep it consistent as volume grows.
Build and maintain integrations with customer ERPs, WMSs, TMSs, third-party APIs, webhooks, and data exports.
Write event-driven and async processing with queues, workers, and scheduled jobs.
Build the backend behind Vision AI features, image ingestion, processing pipelines, and result storage, and work with the AI team to move results from model to platform to customer report.
Handle offline sync and conflict resolution for data coming in from mobile devices on the floor.
Build web features end to end, from API to UI: dashboards, configuration tools, admin, and reporting. Our web stack uses both React and Svelte.
Find and fix slow queries, bottlenecks, and reliability issues before customers feel them.
Own your services in production: deploys, monitoring, logging, alerting, on-call, and post-incident fixes.
Keep the platform secure: access control and multi-tenant data isolation.
Write tests, review code, and keep design docs and API documentation in a state other engineers can build on.
Join implementation and customer conversations when an integration or data issue needs an engineer in the room, and push for reusable platform patterns over one-off customer builds.
You Might Be a Fit If
Backend engineering
You've spent 5+ years building and running production backend services.
You're strong in Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go.
You know relational databases well: schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migrations. We run both MySQL and PostgreSQL.
You've designed APIs and built integrations with third-party or enterprise systems.
You've worked with queues and async processing (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar).
You've deployed and run services on AWS or GCP, with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Full stack
You have hands-on React experience and can ship a production-ready web feature on your own. This is required.
You've worked with Svelte, or you're confident picking it up quickly. Parts of our web stack use it, so prior experience is a real plus.
You're comfortable owning a feature from database schema to UI.
How you work
You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teammates.
You're comfortable owning ambiguous problems and making sound calls without a perfect spec.
You stay close enough to customer workflows to understand why what you're building matters.
 
Nice to have
None of these are required, but any of them will make us sit up:
You've integrated with ERP, WMS, TMS, or other logistics and enterprise systems.
You've worked on image pipelines, ML-backed products, or mobile backends with offline sync.
You've built or run multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
You've worked in logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, warehousing, or another operations-heavy space.

jobs.title: Director of Demand Generation
jobs.description:
About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.

Our Benefits

📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success

For more information on our benefits, visit this page.

Come as you are. Build with us.

Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.

We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
About PackageX
PackageX builds the Physical Logistics Execution Platform for enterprise teams working across manufacturing sites, distribution centers, warehouses, retail locations, and other logistics-heavy environments.
Our platform combines Vision AI, workflow automation, mobile execution, and integrations to help companies digitize, execute, and verify physical operations at the point of work, creating trusted evidence of what actually happened.
Our operating model is simple: Execution. Verification. Evidence.
Why This Role Exists
Our software runs on warehouse floors, in mailrooms, and at receiving docks. When it breaks, it doesn't fail quietly in a dashboard somewhere. A worker is standing there with a scanner that won't scan, a label that won't read, and a line of packages piling up behind them.
We're hiring a Senior QA Automation Engineer to make sure that moment never arrives. You'll own quality across our mobile apps, web platform, SDKs, and Vision AI workflows, and you'll build automation as core infrastructure so coverage grows at the pace our releases demand.
You'll write and own JavaScript/TypeScript automation across mobile, web, API, and SDK layers, wire it all into CI/CD, and test by hand where automation falls short: new features, scanner quirks, camera capture in bad lighting, and networks that drop mid-shift. You'll join our engineering team, work alongside our existing QA function, and set the direction for how we test.
How This Role Works
This is one role with a few hats, and you'll switch between them often, sometimes in the same day.
Web and API automation. You're in the code: building Playwright-based web automation, and driving it through MCP servers to speed up how tests get written and maintained. You write API and integration tests in Vitest, grow regression coverage, triage failures, and keep suites reliable instead of flaky.
Mobile and SDK automation. You own our WebdriverIO and Appium mobile suite (Mocha, Allure reporting, Testmo integration) for the PackageX React Native app, and you build test coverage for our SDKs: integration harnesses, sample apps, contract tests, and version regression matrices.
Hands-on validation. Where automation can't see well, you pick up the device: exploratory testing of new features, scanning and camera capture, offline sync, rugged handhelds, and customer-specific workflows before pilots and go-lives.
If you only want to write scripts and never touch a device, or you've only ever executed manual test cases, this probably isn't your role. If you genuinely enjoy both, keep reading.
What You'll Do
Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks for our React Native app (WebdriverIO and Appium with Mocha), web platform (Playwright), and APIs and SDKs (Vitest).
Build and maintain Playwright web automation, including driving it through MCP servers, with guardrails that keep generated tests trustworthy.
Own failure triage, flaky-test detection, and coverage analysis. When a suite gets noisy, you fix it rather than mute it.
Build and maintain SDK test coverage: integration harnesses, sample apps, contract tests, and cross-version regression suites.
Wire everything into CI/CD so regressions get caught on every pull request and build, with clear reporting and traceability in Allure, JUnit, and Testmo.
Run exploratory and manual testing on real Android and iOS devices, including the rugged handhelds and scanners our customers actually use.
Test Vision AI features the way the real world treats them: poor lighting, damaged labels, angled shots, and low-end devices.
Validate offline behavior, data sync, and recovery when connectivity drops mid-workflow.
Reproduce and isolate issues reported from customer sites, and hand engineers a clean repro with steps, logs, and screenshots. No “cannot reproduce” dead ends.
Get into requirements and designs early, flag gaps and untestable logic, and push for testability in the codebase: test IDs, mocks, seeded data, and environment parity.
Give evidence-based go or no-go input on every release, and own the numbers: defect leakage, coverage, flaky-test rate, and escaped bugs.
Look after test data, test environments, and the device lab, and keep suites healthy and run times reasonable.
You Might Be a Fit If
Automation
You've spent 5+ years in QA engineering, with test automation as the core of your job, not a side task.
You've built or seriously extended an automation framework yourself, not just added cases to someone else's.
You know Playwright deeply, including driving it through MCP servers.
You've done mobile automation with WebdriverIO and Appium for React Native or native apps. That's our stack.
You write JavaScript/TypeScript that other engineers trust.
You've written API, integration, or component tests with Vitest or Jest. We use Vitest.
You've wired test suites into CI/CD before (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitrise, or similar).
Manual and exploratory testing
You test with discipline: test plans, edge cases, boundary conditions, and structured exploratory sessions.
You've tested on physical Android and iOS devices across OS versions and hardware tiers.
You're comfortable with API tools, logs, and basic SQL when a bug hides below the UI.
How you work
You communicate clearly with engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams.
You'll say a release isn't ready when it isn't, and you'll have the evidence to back it up.
You create structure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments instead of waiting for someone to hand it to you.
Nice to Have
None of these are required, but any of them will make us sit up:
You've tested SDKs or other developer-facing products.
You've worked with Allure reporting and test management tools (Testmo, TestRail, or similar).
You've tested camera-driven features, barcode scanning, OCR, or ML/Vision AI outputs.
You've done performance and load testing (k6, JMeter, Gatling, or similar).
You've worked in logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, warehousing, or another operations-heavy space.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenLabs operates a complex and fast-evolving revenue model – enterprise contracts, self-serve API subscriptions, usage-based billing, and expanding international markets. As a Revenue Accountant, you will play a key role in ElevenLabs’ revenue accounting function. 

You will own significant portions of the monthly revenue close, support the application of ASC 606 to customer arrangements, and help build scalable processes and controls as ElevenLabs grows toward IPO readiness.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Billing Operations, Engineering, and FP&A to support contract review, usage and billing completeness, new product launches, and accurate and timely revenue recognition. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a lean Finance team – the right person will independently run recurring workstreams, identify issues early, and help scale the revenue accounting operating model as the business grows.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Execute significant portions of the monthly revenue close, including journal entries, deferred and unbilled revenue schedules, reconciliations, and flux analysis

 - Perform recurring usage / consumption completeness and billing-to-GL reconciliations; investigate exceptions and drive resolution with cross-functional partners

 - Review customer contracts and apply established ASC 606 guidance to standard arrangements; escalate novel, high-judgment, or precedent-setting matters

 - Support accounting for credits, refunds, contract modifications, cutoff, and variable consideration, with clear and audit-ready documentation

 - Prepare revenue workpapers, audit support, and control evidence; support external audit, walkthroughs, and SOX readiness activities

 - Support accounting readiness and UAT for new products, pricing structures, billing models, and partner / channel launches

 - Improve and automate recurring revenue processes, reconciliations, documentation, and exception reporting as the business scales




REQUIREMENTS

 - Deep expertise in ASC 606, including multi-element arrangements, SSP evaluation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and principal vs. agent analysis

 - Experience leading the revenue close: deferred revenue management, unbilled receivables, journal entry review, and month-end flux analysis

 - Track record of partnering with Sales and Legal on contract review and revenue impact assessments

 - Experience operating in a pre-IPO or public company environment, with direct exposure to external audit, controls build-out, and revenue accounting documentation

 - CPA, ACA, or ACCA qualification (active); Big 4 or public accounting background a strong plus

 - Strong systems proficiency; Stripe, Metronome, HubiFi or a comparable revenue recognition tool preferred




BONUS:

 - Experience with consumption/usage-based and subscription billing models

 - Familiarity with ASC 326 (CECL) and AR accounting in a high-volume SaaS context

 - Multi-entity or international revenue accounting background




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Central Europe or Eastern US timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York and Warsaw.

jobs.title: Senior Billing Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

As Juniper Square continues to expand, our billing complexity has intensified, driven by a tripling of transaction and invoice volumes over the last 18 months. We are seeking a Senior Billing Specialist to join our team and help navigate this increased scale. In this hands-on role reporting directly to the Billing & Collections Manager, you will collaborate closely with team members to ensure invoice accuracy, manage daily cash application, and provide guidance on invoice processing within Zone.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Review customer contracts and correspondence, interpreting ambiguous contract language to determine correct billing treatment

 - Process invoices and credit memos for complex or non-standard billing scenarios

 - Guide and support teammates on invoice processing workflows within Zone

 - Review invoices processed by the team for accuracy before sending out to customers

 - Respond to customer billing inquiries via email, researching and providing accurate answers in a timely manner

 - Perform daily cash application: match incoming customer payments to invoices and post accordingly

 - Own follow-up on past-due accounts, coordinating escalations with Fund Admin/CX as needed

 - Monitor AR aging and flag at-risk balances to the Billing & Collections Manager

 - Play a key role in ongoing process improvements and workflow refinement within Zone (project-based work)

 - Manage increased workload during peak Fund Admin billing cycles (December, March, June, September)

 - Partner cross-functionally with Deal Desk on contract structuring, and with Fund Admin/CX on billing and collections

 - Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity and efficiency across billing, cash application, and reporting workflows

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - At least 4 years of professional billing experience, particularly with intricate billing scenarios

 - Proven capability to analyze vague contract terms and determine precise billing consequences

 - Practical familiarity with Zone or equivalent NetSuite-native billing software, including the ability to train and guide team members

 - Proficiency in cash and payment applications, including matching and posting customer payments against invoices

 - Familiarity with Salesforce for navigating and extracting contract, account, and opportunity details

 - Adept at utilizing AI productivity tools (such as ChatGPT and Claude) to enhance daily workflows

 - Background in collections is advantageous, though the primary emphasis remains on billing mastery

 - Collaborative mindset with a strong emphasis on teamwork; comfortable guiding colleagues on workflows without needing a formal title

 - Strong interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional internal stakeholders and a proactive approach to asking clarifying questions

 - Prior background in the Services and SaaS sectors is preferred.

 - Highly resourceful with the capability to independently investigate and resolve questions when details are scarce.

 - Thrives and operates effectively within a high-speed, dynamic workplace.

 - Advanced proficiency in Excel, particularly utilizing calculations from the Fund Admin team, is a distinct plus.

 


COMPENSATION

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $60,000 - $75,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

 

Benefits include:

 - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

 - Life insurance

 - Mental wellness coverage

 - Fertility and growing family support

 - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

 - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

 - Retirement saving plans

 - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

 - Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

jobs.title: Grants Associate
jobs.description:
About CEA

The Centre for Effective Altruism (CEA) stewards the movement of people putting effective altruism principles into practice to solve the world's most pressing problems. We’re working to build a flourishing future by applying evidence, reason, and compassion to challenges like global poverty, animal suffering, and risks from transformative AI.

Our work centers on growing and supporting a global community of people who rigorously analyze where they can do the most good – and take action on those insights. Current strategic priorities include increasing understanding of effective altruism and its principles, growing the number of people who are motivated by EA principles to take significant action to address pressing problems, and diversifying funding sources for high-impact work.

We had significant success in 2025, building momentum within CEA. Our headcount grew from 42 to 66 core staff. Program participation (e.g., events, courses, groups) grew https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/NKrpEdg7wAgcoHNRG/cea-is-growing-again-25-more-people-engaged-with-our-1 by 20-25% year over year. We merged https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BLvTcMMEQGFYsh6Jw/ea-funds-and-cea-are-merging with EA Funds https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/ and are rapidly scaling up our capacity for grantmaking and associated fundraising.

In 2026, we’ve maintained ambitious momentum https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/Dy4iGHbAkKAQ4t2Dw/building-sustainable-momentum-progress-report-on-cea-s-2025 while building the foundations for a step-change in the wider EA ecosystem’s growth trajectory from 2027 onwards. We’re in the midst of the best fundraising year in CEA’s history and are looking for the right talent to help us take advantage of the many opportunities in front of us.




ABOUT THE GRANTS TEAM

CEA makes grants to high-impact projects, individuals, and organizations through programs such as EA Funds https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/, EAGx event https://www.effectivealtruism.org/ea-global/events grants, CEA community building grants https://www.centreforeffectivealtruism.org/community-building-grants, and groups support funding https://www.centreforeffectivealtruism.org/group-support-funding. Our grantmaking team manages the systems that move money from donors to projects, focusing on efficient processing, compliance with grantmaking requirements, accurate records, and a positive experience for grantees.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Grants Associate to help expand our capacity and strengthen the systems that move money from donors to high-impact projects. In this role, you’ll be a key point of contact for both grant recipients and internal grant evaluators, administering our grants management system and keeping rounds moving smoothly.

Day to day, you’ll maintain efficient grant processing, support a clear end-to-end experience for grantees, and manage grant records to keep our data reliable and up to date. You’ll also help improve how our grantmaking operates over time, refining and scaling the processes the team relies on.

You’ll work closely with our Grants Lead, Becky Lang, and play a central role in making sure our processes are responsive, robust, and easy to use. We’re looking for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and has a strong customer service mindset. Prior operations experience is helpful (and grant administration experience is a plus), but we’re also open to entry-level candidates who can get up to speed quickly and work carefully through routine tasks. If you’re successful in the role, you’ll help move millions of dollars to high-impact work.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Process grants through our Salesforce grants management system

 - Communicate with grant recipients to solve issues and give them a smooth experience

 - Conduct due diligence on all grant recipients to ensure grants are compliant with relevant law and our policies

 - Review grantee reports in keeping with relevant law and our policies

 - Maintain accurate record keeping for all grants

 - Run monitoring and reporting, to track impact


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You might be a great fit for this role if you are:

 - Detail-oriented: You will be dealing with a complex system with many moving parts where errors can be costly

 - Highly organised: This role requires keeping track of many grants, and you’ll need to keep the balance between providing a fast turnaround while ensuring all grants adhere to our grantmaking policies

 - A clear and friendly communicator: You’ll be frequently interacting with our grant recipients so you will need to have excellent interpersonal skills and a ‘customer service’ attitude

 - Committed: We’re looking for someone who is excited to learn the ins and outs of our systems and who wants to commit for at least two years

 - Mission-driven: Our ideal candidate is passionate about the mission and values of CEA

 - (bonus) Experienced with grant administration or using Salesforce: while not a requirement, it will help you get up to speed more quickly


OTHER INFORMATION

 - This is a full-time, remote position. We prefer applicants who are able to work in time zones between US Pacific Time and CET.

 - Start date: We'd ideally have you start as soon as possible, but we can be flexible on timeline.

 - Reports to: Becky Lang, Grants Lead

 - Compensation
   
   - US: For this role we offer a base salary of $65,000 - $85,000 and a 10% unconditional 401k contribution.
   
   - Other locations: For candidates outside the US, base salary is converted to local currency using a fixed exchange rate, and total compensation is adjusted based on the cost of employment and fixed local benefit costs to create an equivalent package.
   
   - Benefits globally include private health insurance, flexible work hours, a $6,000 annual professional development allowance, a $6,000 mental health support allowance, extended parental leave, ergonomic equipment, 25 days of paid vacation, and more.

 - This role will involve travel. Depending on the location, there are likely 2–3 trips annually, including international trips to attend team retreats.

For this role, we are unable to consider candidates based in Spain, France, Germany, Israel, or Brazil.

We are committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and encourage individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply. We especially encourage applications from self-identified women and people of colour who are excited about contributing to our mission. The Centre for Effective Altruism is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, or have any other questions about applying, please contact jobs@centreforeffectivealtruism.org.

CEA participates in E-Verify for US employees.

We are committed to protecting your data. See our privacy policy https://www.centreforeffectivealtruism.org/privacy for more information.




INTERVIEW PLAN

We expect the interview process to include the following steps, subject to minor changes:

 - Application

 - Short interview

 - Test task

 - Final interviews (3-4)

 - Reference checks
