Sophisticated Cases. Exceptional Trial Attorneys. Meaningful Work.

Please note: An active California Bar license is required.

Tyson & Mendes is seeking an accomplished Senior Counsel to join a specialized Complex Trial Team defending some of the most sensitive and high-exposure matters in civil litigation, including cases involving allegations of sexual assault, child sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, and institutional liability.

This is not a traditional insurance defense position. These matters require exceptional judgment, discretion, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex factual and legal issues with professionalism and sensitivity.

For an experienced litigator looking to deepen their expertise in this highly specialized practice area, this is an opportunity to work alongside exceptional trial attorneys and mentors while taking on sophisticated, meaningful litigation.

Work Alongside Proven Trial Leaders

The team is led by Equity Partner Susan Oliver, an accomplished California litigator with extensive experience handling catastrophic personal injury, sexual torts, employment practices, and medical malpractice matters.

Susan is known for identifying creative and novel legal strategies in complex cases. Her recent successes include obtaining summary judgment in two significant matters, collectively saving clients more than $100 million. Her experience extends from California state and federal courts to the California Courts of Appeal and the Ninth Circuit, as well as stepping into major cases late in litigation to evaluate, reposition, and prepare them for trial.

She works alongside other highly experienced partners and trial attorneys who are committed to collaboration, mentorship, and developing the next generation of sophisticated litigators.

Build Expertise in a Highly Specialized Practice

You’ll work on complex matters involving allegations of sexual assault, child sexual abuse, misconduct, and institutional liability; cases that can involve significant exposure, complicated legal issues, extensive discovery, expert testimony, and substantial reputational considerations for clients.

Senior Counsel are trusted to bring their own experience and judgment to the table while having access to seasoned trial attorneys for strategy, collaboration, and mentorship.

Why Tyson & Mendes?

Sophisticated, High-Exposure Work – Handle challenging matters that demand thoughtful strategy and strong litigation skills.

Exceptional Mentorship – Work alongside Susan Oliver and other accomplished trial attorneys who understand what it takes to successfully position and try complex cases.

Meaningful Case Ownership – Take an active role in strategy, discovery, depositions, experts, dispositive motions, client counseling, and trial preparation.

National Resources – Benefit from the resources of a national litigation firm, including trial training and experienced litigation support.

Collaborative Culture – Join a team where experienced attorneys share ideas, strategize together, and support one another.

Flexibility – We offer flexibility while maintaining the collaboration and connection necessary for complex litigation.

Who Will Thrive Here

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned civil litigator who is comfortable handling sensitive, emotionally complex, and high-exposure matters and wants to continue developing as a trial attorney.

Experience involving sexual assault, abuse, institutional liability, catastrophic injury, professional liability, medical malpractice, or similarly complex litigation is highly valuable. Just as important are excellent judgment, discretion, strong writing and analytical skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with clients, witnesses, experts, and opposing counsel.

Bring Your Experience. Deepen Your Expertise.

• Proficiency in MS Suite, specifically Word, PowerPoint and Outlook

jobs.title: Territory Manager (Pennsylvania)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

 

This role covers the entire team of Pennsylvania. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.



YOU’LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

 - Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual USD$750 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

 - Health Benefits - We offer best-in-class insurance for our employees, so they can care for themselves and their families.

 - 16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers plus many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

 - Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

 - We're proud to offer 401k and make an employer match. We offer a 100% match on the first 3% you contribute, and a 50% match on the next 2%.

 - Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

 

This role covers the entire state of Indiana. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.



YOU’LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
The Assistant Marketing Manager supports the development and execution of marketing, communications, digital, social media, content, and brand initiatives for Our Habitas Ras Abrouq. The role helps strengthen brand awareness, drive engagement and commercial performance, and ensure that all communications authentically reflect the Our Habitas brand, culture, and guest experience.

The position works closely with property leadership, Sales, Revenue, F&B, Wellness, and regional/global marketing teams to bring the resort's stories, experiences, and commercial priorities to life.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Marketing & Brand

• Support the development and implementation of the property's annual marketing and communications plan.
• Ensure all marketing activities and collateral are aligned with Our Habitas brand standards and positioning.
• Support campaigns promoting accommodation, F&B, wellness, experiences, events, and seasonal offerings.
• Coordinate the production and approval of marketing collateral, promotional materials, presentations, signage, and other brand assets.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen the positioning and visibility of Our Habitas Ras Abrouq within Qatar and key international markets.
• Maintain consistency of brand voice, imagery, messaging, and guest-facing communications.

Digital & Social Media

• Support the planning and execution of digital marketing and social media activities.
• Coordinate content calendars and ensure regular, relevant, and engaging content across appropriate channels.
• Work with internal teams, photographers, videographers, agencies, and content creators to produce high-quality visual and written content.
• Monitor digital and social media performance and recommend opportunities to improve reach, engagement, and conversion.
• Ensure online information about the property, experiences, offers, and facilities remains accurate and up to date.

Content & Storytelling

• Develop engaging content that communicates the unique story, experiences, people, culture, nature, and sense of place of Our Habitas Ras Abrouq.
• Support copywriting and editing for campaigns, newsletters, digital platforms, promotional materials, and internal/external communications.
• Coordinate photography and content shoots, including planning, logistics, shot lists, and departmental requirements.
• Maintain an organized library of approved photography, videos, artwork, and marketing assets.

Campaigns & Commercial Support

• Work closely with Sales and Revenue teams to develop campaigns supporting occupancy, revenue, and business priorities.
• Support the creation and promotion of packages, offers, events, activations, and experiences.
• Coordinate campaign timelines and ensure deliverables are completed according to agreed deadlines.
• Track campaign performance and prepare reports highlighting results and opportunities for improvement.
• Support partnership and cross-promotional opportunities with relevant brands and organizations.

PR, Media & Partnerships

• Support PR activities, media visits, influencer stays, familiarization trips, and content collaborations.
• Coordinate itineraries and property requirements for visiting media, influencers, partners, and content creators.
• Assist in preparing press materials, property information, fact sheets, and media assets.
• Support relationships with relevant local partners, tourism stakeholders, lifestyle brands, and community organizations.
• Ensure collaborations are aligned with the positioning and values of Our Habitas.

Administration & Coordination

• Assist with marketing budget tracking, purchase requests, invoices, contracts, and related administrative requirements.
• Coordinate with external agencies, suppliers, and creative partners.
• Maintain marketing calendars, campaign trackers, reports, and documentation.
• Participate in commercial and operational meetings as required.
• Ensure deadlines and agreed marketing deliverables are consistently followed up and completed.

Leadership & Collaboration

• Build strong working relationships across all departments and encourage collaboration around marketing initiatives.
• Work closely with operational teams to understand upcoming activities and identify opportunities for storytelling and promotion.
• Represent the brand professionally when dealing with guests, partners, agencies, media, and other external stakeholders.
• Support and guide colleagues involved in marketing activities where required.
• Demonstrate flexibility and actively support wider property initiatives and events.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Hospitality, or a related field preferred.
• Previous experience in marketing, preferably within luxury hospitality, lifestyle hotels/resorts, travel, or a premium consumer brand.

Experience

• Experience in digital marketing, social media, content creation, and campaign management.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic or additional languages are an advantage.
• Strong understanding of social media platforms and digital marketing trends.
• Experience coordinating photography, videography, PR, influencers, or creative agencies is advantageous.
• Good commercial awareness and ability to understand marketing performance and business objectives.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage several projects and deadlines simultaneously.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with content management, social media, design, CRM, or digital analytics platforms is an advantage.
• The statements in this job description are intended to outline the essential duties and level of responsibility of the role. They are not intended to include all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications associated with the position.

What's in it for you...

• The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
• A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
• Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

Working at Our Habitas means being part of a purpose-driven movement. You will help shape stories that go beyond rooms and amenities, creating emotional experiences and connecting people through shared rituals, culture, and a sense of belonging.

If you believe in luxury that speaks to the soul, and want to build something meaningful in two of Middle East's most extraordinary destinations, we’d love to meet you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US. 

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. 

In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers. Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups. 

 

This role covers the East region of Minnesota. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattlemans, Stockmans associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities. 

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers. 

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals. 

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights. 

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups. 

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible.  You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter. 

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need. 

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.
   
    


YOU'LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act. 

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities. 

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

 - Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual USD$750 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

 - Health Benefits - We offer best-in-class insurance for our employees, so they can care for themselves and their families.

 - 16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers plus many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

 - Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

 - We're proud to offer 401k and make an employer match. We offer a 100% match on the first 3% you contribute, and a 50% match on the next 2%.

 - Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

jobs.title: Администратор офиса
jobs.description:
• Ведение делопроизводства: обработка входящей-исходящей документации, подготовка и подписание у ответственных лиц.
• Работа с почтовой корреспонденцией: отправка, прием, информирование адресатов.
• Обеспечение жизнедеятельности офиса: заказ канцелярских принадлежностей, продуктов питания, хозтоваров.
• Оказание содействия в части организации мероприятий.
• Бронирование авиа и железнодорожных билетов, бронирование проживания и т.д.
• Оказание поддержки сотрудникам в части оформления различных заявок, запросов на авторизацию и т.д.
• Оформление заказов на закупку, передача в финансовую службу документов для оплаты.
• Согласование договорной документации с ответственными сотрудниками внутри компании.
• Прямые и непрямые закупки.

• Высшее образование;
• Опыт работы на аналогичной должности не менее 1 года;
• Знание бухгалтерии будет преимуществом;
• Знание английского языка на уровне А2 будет преимуществом.

jobs.title: Senior Counsel (Remote or Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Build Your Next Chapter With a Team That Will Make You a Better Trial Lawyer

Please note: An active Florida Bar license is required for this position.

There’s a point in your litigation career when the right opportunity isn’t simply about finding another firm. It’s about finding the right cases, the right mentors, and the right environment to keep growing.

Tyson & Mendes is looking for an experienced Florida defense attorney to join a busy litigation team handling sophisticated, high-exposure matters throughout Central Florida. This is an opportunity for an attorney who already has a strong foundation in litigation but wants to sharpen their skills alongside attorneys who are regularly in the courtroom.

You’ll work closely with two of Tyson & Mendes’ accomplished trial attorneys, Holly Howanitz and Stefani Cogsdale, gaining meaningful exposure to case strategy, motion practice, discovery, depositions, trial preparation, and trials themselves.

If you’re a strong writer, a thoughtful strategist, and the kind of attorney who takes ownership of your work while still wanting to learn from great lawyers, we’d love to meet you.

The Work

This isn’t a volume practice built around handling the same type of case over and over. The team handles sophisticated and often high-exposure litigation, including trucking and motor vehicle matters, premises liability, surgical and medical-related cases, and other complex liability matters.

You’ll have the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of your cases while collaborating closely with attorneys who care deeply about strategy, preparation, and getting the details right.

The Attorney Who Will Thrive Here

We’re looking for someone who takes pride in excellent work product. You’re a strong legal writer, comfortable with substantive motion practice and discovery, and able to independently move assignments and cases forward.

You’re also coachable. You welcome thoughtful feedback because you want to keep getting better, and once expectations are clear, you can run with them.

Ideally, you’ll bring 5–8 years of litigation experience, including insurance defense, along with substantive experience in discovery and motion practice. Trial experience is highly valued, but if you haven’t yet had significant courtroom opportunities, what matters is that you want them.

Law Review or another demonstrated record of exceptional legal research and writing is particularly attractive for this team.

Two Trial Lawyers in Your Corner

One of the biggest reasons to consider this opportunity is the leadership around you.

You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with Holly and Stefani, two highly experienced trial attorneys at Tyson & Mendes, on significant Florida matters. They are hands-on, engaged leaders who care about developing strong lawyers and producing exceptional work.

This is a great fit for someone who wants genuine mentorship—not just a name assigned to them on an organizational chart.

You’ll be trusted to work independently, but you won’t be left to figure everything out alone. As you build trust and demonstrate your capabilities, you’ll have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and continue developing as a litigator.

Based in Central Florida. Built for Growth.

Stefani is based in Orlando and handles significant work throughout Central Florida, making Orlando an especially attractive location for this position. While the team is connected to our Jacksonville office, the role offers the opportunity to build alongside a growing presence in Central Florida without an expectation of constant travel.

And because Tyson & Mendes is a national litigation firm, you’ll have the resources, technology, training, and opportunities of a large organization while working closely with a team where your contribution is visible.

Come Grow With Us

We’re looking for an attorney who is smart, driven, detail-oriented, and excited to keep learning. Someone who wants challenging cases, meaningful responsibility, excellent mentors, and the opportunity to become an even stronger advocate.

If that sounds like the next chapter you’ve been looking for, we’d love to start a conversation.

Apply today and come see what you can build at Tyson & Mendes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop a case theme that is more compelling than any plaintiff ploy for sympathy or anger

• Refuse to accept mediocrity, the average, the standard or the norm in anything

• Independently handle court appearances, depositions, briefs and trials

• Work as part of a team with all levels of experiences

• Routine communications with clients

• Cultivate relationships with the firm’s existing and future clients

• Provide leadership and direction with respect to less experienced attorneys

REQUIREMENTS

• JD from an ABA approved school

• Must be licensed in your state

• 8+ years of solid litigation experience, specifically with litigation support, deposition and trial preparation

• Ability to manage full case handling responsibilities, including all facets of discovery and trial

• Experience handling insurance defense matters preferred

• Experience with time management systems

• Proficiency in MS Suite, specifically Word, PowerPoint and Outlook

• Ability to think and act independently and with minimal supervision

• Outstanding listening, verbal and written communication skills

• Professional appearance and demeanor

Compensation Package

• The base salary for this position ranges from $150,000 - 190,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications

• Attorneys are eligible for an annual billable hours bonus ranging from $10,000 and then aggregating with $7,500 for every additional tier

• Comprehensive benefits coverage offered, including plans available at zero employee cost (average annual employer contribution for health/vision/dental/life coverage is $700-$1,700)

• Employees benefit from a 401(k) program that includes a 100% match on the first 3% contributed and a 50% match on the following 4-5%

• Student loan repayment assistance or 529 college savings plan (full-time attorneys after one year with the firm) $100-$200/month

• Paid parental leave at base pay

• Employees receive a monthly technology reimbursement of $60

Benefits

• Employee Assistance Program through HealthAdvocate

• Comprehensive in-house training and leadership development opportunities

• Firm Provided CLE Programs and Paid Bar License Renewal Fees

• Flexible vacation policy for attorneys

• Defined pathway to partnership

• Internal diversity and inclusion programs, such as the Women’s Initiative and Young Professionals Initiative

• Firm-wide charitable giving program

• Numerous social and off-site events each year to enrich your relationships with your colleagues

• Flexible Work Model: Remote, hybrid, or onsite options available

About Tyson & Mendes

Click here to learn more about the Tyson & Mendes Office!  (944) The Tyson & Mendes Office - YouTube

We’re one of the fastest-growing civil defense firms in the country—known for breaking the mold of the traditional law firm. Our dynamic, diverse team of trial attorneys delivers exceptional results, from landmark cases like Howell v. Hamilton Meats to numerous defense verdicts across the nation.

But we don’t stop at great legal work—we invest in our people. With specialized training in our proven defense methods, clear paths to leadership, and robust professional development, we empower attorneys to grow their careers, build their personal brands, and become leaders in the field.

Follow along with the firm on Twitter and LinkedIn, or visit www.tysonmendes.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer Notice

OK, now for the legal copy (we are a law firm, after all). jobs.title: Autonomous Vehicle Specialist
jobs.description:
A WORLD EMPOWERED BY AUTONOMY. WE BUILD ROBOTIC VEHICLES TO IMPROVE LOGISTICS SAFETY, FORGE A GREENER EARTH, AND ENHANCE HUMAN LIVES.



We are a closely-knit team aspiring to change the world through disruptive technology. We are innovators. We are tinkerers. We are problem-solvers. And we have a fair amount of magic dust up our sleeves. We have a plan for fleet-level deployment of autonomous vehicles, and we are looking for the best-of-the-best to join us in making this a reality.



ABOUT VENTI TECHNOLOGIES


Based in the U.S. and Asia, Venti Technologies is the leader in safe-speed autonomous logistics systems, developing the future of goods transportation. Using rigorous mathematics, deep learning, and theoretically-grounded algorithms, Venti has a proprietary collection of autonomy technologies including a suite of powerful logistics algorithms. Venti’s proven value proposition of saving costs, increasing vehicle utilization, and improving safety is recognized by customers and driving growth. 

Launched in 2018, Venti brings together an unsurpassed team internationally. The company has autonomous systems deployed in Asia for industrial and logistics sites and a growing pipeline. Venti has offices in Cambridge (Massachusetts, USA), Suzhou (China), and Singapore – our Asian headquarters.



ROLE OVERVIEW

 - We are looking for a hands-on Autonomous Vehicle Specialist to support autonomous vehicle deployments and daily operations at customer sites across the United States.

 - This role is primarily focused on on-site vehicle operations, deployment support, customer coordination, and field issue handling. The successful candidate will work directly with customer operations teams and collaborate with venti Engineering teams to ensure vehicles are ready for operation, site activities run smoothly, and operational issues are addressed promptly.

 - The ideal candidate is practical, resourceful, and comfortable working in customer-facing environments. They should be willing to work hands-on with vehicles, respond to operational issues, and travel between deployment sites as business needs require.



Key Responsibilities

1. US Site Operations and Vehicle Support

 - Support day-to-day autonomous vehicle operations at customer sites, ensuring vehicles are ready for scheduled activities.

 - Perform vehicle readiness checks, basic inspections, and operational checks before and after vehicle use.

 - Assist with vehicle positioning, site preparation, operational coordination, and other on-site activities required for smooth daily operations.

 - Respond to vehicle operational issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and coordinate with relevant teams to restore operations.

 - Work closely with customer personnel to understand operational needs and address day-to-day site challenges.

 - Support operational activities outside normal working hours, including occasional evenings and weekends, when required.



2. Vehicle Deployment and Commissioning

 - Support the deployment of autonomous vehicles and associated equipment at new and existing customer sites.

 - Assist with vehicle commissioning, site readiness checks, operational setup, and initial on-site testing.

 - Coordinate with internal teams and customer representatives to ensure deployment activities are completed according to schedule.

 - Help identify and resolve practical deployment issues involving vehicle setup, site conditions, equipment, and operational procedures.

 - Support customer demonstrations, site acceptance activities, and operational ramp-up.

 - Travel to different US sites as needed to support deployments and ongoing operations.



3. Field Issue Handling and Coordination

 - Act as a first point of contact for day-to-day vehicle and operational issues at assigned sites.

 - Gather relevant information when issues occur, including operating conditions, observed vehicle behavior, photos, videos, and system logs where appropriate.

 - Perform basic troubleshooting and determine when issues require escalation to Engineering or other specialist teams.

 - Communicate issues clearly, follow up on their status, and coordinate with the relevant teams to minimize operational disruption.

 - Maintain records of recurring issues, actions taken, and operational workarounds.

 - Help identify recurring site-level problems and recommend practical improvements to operating procedures.



4. Customer and Cross-functional Coordination

 - Maintain effective day-to-day communication with customer operations and maintenance teams.

 - Coordinate schedules, vehicle availability, site activities, and operational support requirements.

 - Provide clear explanations of vehicle operating procedures, system capabilities, and known operational limitations.

 - Relay customer feedback and field observations to the Singapore-based Engineering and Product teams.

 - Coordinate with US and Singapore teams to ensure operational issues are tracked and addressed.

 - Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and site visits as required.



5. Operational Safety and Documentation

 - Follow established vehicle operating procedures, site safety requirements, and company policies.

 - Identify and report unsafe conditions, abnormal vehicle behavior, and potential operational risks.

 - Ensure field activities are conducted within approved safety procedures and operating boundaries.

 - Maintain accurate records of vehicle checks, operational activities, incidents, and field issues.

 - Help improve site operating procedures and deployment checklists based on practical field experience.



Required Qualifications and Experience

 - Diploma or degree in Engineering, Automotive Technology, Mechatronics, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related field; equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.

 - Experience in vehicle operations, field service, equipment deployment, technical support, robotics, automation, or a similar hands-on role.

 - Practical troubleshooting skills and the ability to resolve day-to-day operational issues systematically.

 - Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple on-site activities and follow through on open issues.

 - Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with customers, operations personnel, and distributed Engineering teams.

 - Willingness to work on-site at customer facilities and travel regularly between US deployment locations.

 - Flexibility to support occasional evening, weekend, or extended-hour activities during deployments and critical operations.

 - A valid driving licence appropriate for the assigned location.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with autonomous vehicles, commercial trucks, heavy vehicles, automotive systems, or industrial equipment.

 - Experience working at customer sites, logistics facilities, ports, rail yards, or other industrial environments.

 - Experience supporting vehicle commissioning, field deployment, equipment installation, or operational ramp-up.

 - Familiarity with basic vehicle electronics, sensors, diagnostic tools, and technical troubleshooting.

 - Basic familiarity with Linux, system logs, or software-based vehicle systems.

 - Experience working with teams across different locations and time zones.




SALARY IS COMMENSURATE WITH EXPERIENCE. WE ALSO OFFER WORLD-CLASS BENEFITS, FANTASTIC CULTURE, FLEXIBLE WORKING ARRANGEMENTS, AND A GREAT INTERNATIONAL WORKING ENVIRONMENT. COME AND JOIN US!

jobs.title: Product Manager (ElevenCreative Self-Serve)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative’s user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

You’ll drive growth and adoption across the self-serve product experience, focusing on how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There’s no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you’ll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive growth and adoption of the self-serve product, focusing on onboarding, activation, and upgrade moments, and partnering with growth, lifecycle, and pricing teams where they connect

 - Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

 - Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

 - Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

 - Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

 - Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

 - Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

 - Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

 - A track record of moving growth and adoption metrics through the products you’ve shipped

 - Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision

 - Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

 - Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself

 - Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact

 - A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows

 - Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec

 - Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

Today, the biggest priorities are sales enablement, web design and social graphics, with about 70% of your time spent on 0x and 30% on Matcha.

jobs.description:

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a key member of the integrated solutions software team, you will design, develop, and own the software infrastructure that lets Apex teams move faster, scale, and keep delivering reliable products. You will build the critical systems that automate software builds, container image creation, security scanning, and SBOM generation across embedded software, flight software, and internal tooling — making security and compliance automatic, auditable, and invisible.

Responsibilities:

DevOps & CI/CD

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across a range of languages and functions, primarily in GitHub Actions.

• Develop and optimize containerized build and test workflows; own base images, build caching, and artifact management (JFrog Artifactory).

Secure Containers, SBOM & Scanning

• Own the secure container supply chain: harden base images, manage trusted registries, and integrate image scanning into every build.

• Automate SBOM generation and vulnerability/license scanning (e.g., JFrog Xray) across artifacts and container images, delivering results back to software teams in a clear, actionable, automated format.

• Own static analysis tooling (e.g., Black Duck, Klocwork) and surface findings in a digestible, automated way.

Software Supply-Chain Security

• Code Signing: Own code-signing infrastructure and verification workflows that guarantee the authenticity and integrity of Apex software

• Build lightweight internal solutions — policy-as-code, custom scanners, CI/CD integrations — that make security and compliance automatic and auditable.

Collaboration

• Partner with software engineers to identify, triage, and remediate application security vulnerabilities; champion secure coding, threat modeling, and developer security training.

• Work with embedded, ground, and infrastructure teams to embed security principles directly into CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements:

 - Applicants must hold U.S. Person status and must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) security clearance. This requirement is mandated by federal law and the demands of the work performed.

 - 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, platform / DevSecOps, or cloud infrastructure roles.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

 - Strong proficiency building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.

 - Hands-on experience with Docker and container development — building, hardening, and optimizing images.

 - Experience with secure container, SBOM, and scanning tools (e.g., Chainguard, JFrog Xray, Binarly).

 - Experience with artifact management (JFrog Artifactory).

Nice to Have:

Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes).

 - Working knowledge of Linux and system administration.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), networking, and services.

 - Familiarity with static analysis tooling (Black Duck, Klocwork)


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. Job Description

The Reference Data Operations Expert is responsible for ensuring high-quality, timely and accurate Reference Data delivery across EU markets. The role combines operational execution, quality governance, stakeholder collaboration, process improvement and technical expertise to support end-to-end delivery—from input through to client delivery.

The role brings an AI-first, continuous-improvement mindset, identifying where AI, automation, analytics and intelligent controls can reduce manual effort, strengthen preventive quality checks and improve operational outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute and support high-quality Reference Data operations across EU markets, ensuring delivery meets agreed quality, timeliness and customer expectations.
• Partner with operational teams to resolve process and technical challenges, ensuring new tools, system enhancements and AI-enabled solutions are understood and effectively adopted.
• Identify repetitive, manual or high-risk activities and recommend AI, automation and process-improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency, scalability and quality.
• Support the testing, implementation and continuous refinement of AI-enabled validation, workflow and decision-support solutions in partnership with Technology, Transformation and operational teams.
• Lead error-management and Root Cause Analysis activities, providing clear issue analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and timely stakeholder communication.
• Strengthen preventive quality controls through data analysis, trend identification, AI-supported validations and targeted review mechanisms.
• Maintain effective communication with Client Ops teams and cross-functional stakeholders; provide accurate project updates and manage operational queries efficiently.
• Define, monitor and document process execution, including standard operating procedures, governance controls, exception tracking and process documentation.
• Ensure the accuracy and consistency of Reference Data coding is of high standards; investigate data-related concerns raised by clients and internal teams and support timely resolution.
• Execute Reference Data operations and project activities with a clear understanding of the production lifecycle—from retailer/manufacturer input, coding and validation through to final client delivery.
• Deliver assigned work accurately within agreed timelines, coordinating with local, regional and offshore teams to resolve data inquiries and operational challenges.
• Support standardization and continuous improvement across methods, applications, reporting and operational workflows.
• Provide technical and process expertise across Reference Data, supporting Western European markets in implementing projects, new capabilities and operational changes.
• Prepare, maintain and interpret KPI reporting covering Quality Escapes, data accuracy, delivery performance, productivity and adherence to operational commitments.
• Translate operational data into actionable insights, highlighting risks, trends and opportunities for improvement.
• Support colleagues through knowledge sharing, process guidance and training on quality standards, new tools and responsible use of AI-enabled solutions.
• Collaborate effectively in a virtual, multicultural environment across markets, functions and stakeholder groups.

• 5–8 years of experience in Operations, Quality Management, Data Operations and/or client-facing roles.
• Experience identifying and implementing process improvements, automation opportunities or technology-enabled operational enhancements.
• Strong interest in applying AI, analytics and automation to improve operational performance, quality controls and customer outcomes.
• Ability to critically review AI-generated recommendations, validate outputs against business rules and ensure appropriate human governance.
• Fluent written and spoken English.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and translate insights into practical actions.
• Strong understanding of KPIs, operational monitoring, quality-performance management and root-cause analysis.
• Ability to explain technical concepts, process changes and AI-enabled solutions to stakeholders with varied levels of expertise.
• Process-oriented mindset with experience defining, refining and improving processes to strengthen quality, efficiency and on-time delivery.
• Strong organizational, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
• Knowledge of process-improvement methodologies and project-management practices.

jobs.title: Head of Talent
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex's ability to unlock our strategy only happens if we hire (and retain) exceptional people, faster and better than anyone else in the industry. Apex is now just over 400 full-time employees, having more than doubled over the last year. As we continue to win new business, we're aiming to hire hundreds of additional talented humans to join us in the next year. We’re looking for an exceptional Head of Talent to own recruitment end-to-end: the strategy, the team, the systems, and the long-term pipelines that will feed Apex for the next decade. You'll lead a team of ~10, set the strategy and metrics we run against, personally drive our most critical executive searches, and build the partnerships to fuel Apex's talent engine. This is a leadership role first. Your individual-contributor work stays focused on executive search, where your hands are on the highest-stakes hires.'




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Recruit exception talent, at speed. Build the team, systems, processes, and brand to attract and close top aerospace talent. Move fast and make significant impact every day.

 - Lead a high-performing recruiting team. Manage, coach, and grow a team of 10 into a group known for speed, judgment, and a high hiring bar. Develop your recruiters, set clear expectations, and raise the ceiling on what the team delivers against our annual hiring plan.

 - Set recruiting strategy. Own the 12- to 24-month hiring plan against Apex's growth targets and see around the corner to what we'll need beyond that. Translate business strategy into a capacity-modeled plan: when we source vs. rely on inbound applications, where niche roles need dedicated sourcers, and what tooling and process the funnel requires.

 - Define ways of working and metrics. Establish how the team recruits: structured interviewing, interview training, a high-signal hiring bar, the ATS and tooling, and the weekly funnel metrics we use to run the function. Build the operating rhythm and the data that tells us what's working and what to fix.

 - Drive executive search. Personally lead searches for Apex's most senior and hardest-to-fill roles. Partner directly with executives on leadership hires and act as a trusted advisor on org and workforce planning. (We do work with external search firms on an exception basis)

 - Build long-term talent partnerships. Create and own durable relationships with universities, trade schools, industry conferences, and scholarship programs. Build the early-career, technical, and skilled-trade pipelines that give Apex a lasting recruiting advantage.

 - Partner with and influence internal stakeholders. Work with leaders to identify and win the best talent in the industry. Coach partners on effective recruiting strategies and tactics, ensuring a robust pipeline and fair hiring practices.

What success looks like in your first year

 - Business strategy is translated cleanly into a hiring plan the team executes against, on time, with high quality, and at volume.

 - The recruiting team is measurably stronger: better talent density, clearer expectations, and recruiters who are growing under your leadership.

 - You're a trusted partner from executives to first-time hiring managers, with the presence to tell a cohesive story rather than drowning the room in charts.

 - People analytics drive decisions: funnel health, bottleneck diagnosis, and a weekly dashboard that connects recruiting to business outcomes.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

 - 10+ years in recruiting and talent acquisition, with 5+ years leading and developing teams.

 - A leader, not just a manager. Someone who inspires and mentors, and who turns analysis into action.

 - A track record setting recruiting strategy and building the metrics and processes behind it.

 - Hands-on executive and leadership search experience.

 - Proven ability to run high-volume hiring (hundreds of hires per year) without lowering the bar.

 - Data and people-analytics fluency, plus modern ATS and tooling experience. We use Ashby, Linkedin and Juicebox, and you can design the tech stack.

 - Executive presence. Credible in the room with executives and boards.

 - Thoughtful, specific use of AI across the recruiting funnel.

 - Must meet ITAR and U.S. person requirements.

Nice-to-haves

 - Recruiting in technical, manufacturing, and skilled-trade environments: hardware, deep tech, or aerospace.

 - Building university, trade-school, or industry talent partnerships from the ground up.

jobs.title: Senior Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a member of the Flight Software team, you will design, develop, and own the software driving the autonomous operation of Apex’s satellite buses. You will be responsible for developing mission critical systems that operate reliably 24/7, ensuring that Apex’s spacecraft continue to operate in all scenarios.

In this role, you will work closely with both internal teams and external customers, aligning your solutions with company objectives and user requirements. We are looking for motivated engineers who are eager to solve complex problems with a focus on practicality and scalability, and who thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

 - Design, implement and own mission critical software applications for satellite systems. 

 - Support commissioning of spacecraft during launch and early operations and ensure software systems remain functional during critical operations.

 - Own spacecraft software solutions through the full lifecycle from initial design to deployment.

 - Perform unit testing, integration testing, and system-level testing of software components, identifying and resolving any defects or issues.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to baseline product requirements and technical roadmaps.



Requirements:

 - U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

 - 8+ years of total flight software experience

 - Bachelor’s degree in CS, EE or equivalent.

 - Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, Rust.

 - Experience with real time systems running on distributed hardware.

 - Knowledge of embedded Linux operating systems, system administration and creating Linux distributions (Yocto).

 - Familiarity with satellite systems and protocols, such as CCSDS, and ECSS.

 - Experience with software integration, testing, and validation for real-time and distributed systems.

 - Familiarity with network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), secure communication systems, Protobuf and encryption.
