jobs.title: Senior Manager,  Manufacturing Safety Engineering
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Anduril’s Manufacturing Safety Engineering team partners across Anduril’s manufacturing, engineering, and operations organizations to ensure our production systems are safe to build, test, and sustain at scale. As an engineering discipline, we design safety into the way products are made, covering the equipment, fixtures, test stations, and work instructions on the factory floor, rather than inspecting for it after the fact. Our mandate spans the production lifecycle, from new equipment and line design through ramp and sustained operations. We apply formal risk assessment and the hierarchy of controls to identify hazards early and engineer them out, partnering closely with our Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) experts, controls and manufacturing engineers, and production leadership to keep our people safe while moving at the speed Anduril demands.

ABOUT THE JOB
We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Safety Engineering leader to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA to stand up and scale manufacturing safety as an engineering discipline across Anduril. This is a build role: you will create the manufacturing-safety-engineering team, define the risk-assessment framework and processes that keep our production equipment, fixtures, test stations, and work instructions safe, and drive adoption of those practices across Anduril’s manufacturing sites. As a Manufacturing Safety leader, you will apply deep expertise in machine safety, formal risk assessment, and the hierarchy of controls to engineer hazards out of how our products are built, partnering closely with EHS, manufacturing and controls engineering, and production leadership. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can set strategy and standards while remaining the senior authority on the hardest hazard problems on the floor.
This role is based in Costa Mesa, CA, and supports Anduril’s manufacturing operations, including sites at Quonset Point, RI and Atlanta, GA; travel to production sites is expected.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Build, lead, and develop the Manufacturing Safety Engineering team, including hiring, leveling, mentoring, and performance management, as the discipline scales across Anduril.

• Establish and standardize the manufacturing-safety framework: risk-assessment methodology, templates, risk-acceptance criteria, safety sign-off gates, and the management-of-change process, aligned to the business.

• Grow the manufacturing-safety discipline across Anduril, driving adoption across production lines and sites and defining the standards of record, in partnership with Manufacturing, EHS, and product engineering.

• Define and communicate the discipline’s vision, goals, roadmap, and operating model, and integrate manufacturing-safety practices across all stages of production development.

• Own manufacturing-safety metrics, KPIs, and executive-level reporting; represent the discipline to leadership and to customer and defense-program stakeholders.

• Manage resource allocation and capacity planning across concurrent programs and sites, and manage budget, tooling, and external partnerships (EHS, controls integrators, certification bodies).

• Serve as the senior technical authority and final risk-acceptance escalation point for the highest-consequence manufacturing hazards.

• Lead formal machine and task-based risk assessments on production equipment, fixtures, tooling, and processes, documenting hazards, risk ratings, required controls, and residual risk.

• Review manufacturing work instructions and supporting training material for safety adequacy; author Job Hazard Analyses (JHA) and embed the required controls, PPE, and safe-work steps.

• Engineer and review production equipment such as lift fixtures and material-handling aids in partnership with EHS, and support proof-load testing.

• Assess and design safety into production test equipment.

• Apply the hierarchy of controls and prevention-through-design principles to eliminate or reduce hazards at the equipment and line-design stage.

• Define functional-safety requirements for safety-related control systems and verify their implementation.

• Partner with EHS to ensure engineering controls satisfy applicable OSHA 29 CFR 1910 general-industry requirements (machine guarding, lockout/tagout, electrical, PPE, materials handling).

• Support incident and near-miss investigations and root-cause analysis; drive corrective engineering actions and management of change.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• B.S. Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Industrial, or Safety Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline

• 10+ years of experience in manufacturing/machine safety, equipment/controls engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 3 years in a leadership role

• Proven track record building, scaling, and managing technical teams and establishing engineering processes or disciplines

• Deep expertise in formal machine and task-based risk assessment and machine safeguarding, applied across equipment, fixtures, and processes

• Strong working knowledge of applicable OSHA 29 CFR 1910 general-industry requirements (machine guarding, lockout/tagout, electrical, PPE, materials handling) as engineering controls

• Experience partnering with EHS, manufacturing, and design organizations to embed safety into equipment and production processes

• Strategic thinking with the ability to balance hands-on technical authority with organizational leadership responsibilities

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functionally at all levels

• Eligibility to pursue and maintain a U.S. security clearance, as required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with machine safety standards such as ISO 12100 (risk assessment and risk reduction), ISO 13849 (safety-related parts of control systems), and ANSI B11 (machine safety and safeguarding)

• M.S. Degree in an engineering discipline

• Professional safety or machinery-safety certification (CSP, CMSE)

• 12+ years of experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role, including standing up a safety-engineering function or discipline from an early stage

• Experience managing teams and programs across multiple manufacturing sites, and through periods of rapid growth (2x+ expansion)

• Track record of developing talent and promoting team members into senior and leadership roles

• Experience in high-rate or rapidly scaling aerospace, defense, or automotive manufacturing

• Executive-level communications, reporting, and roadmap presentation experience

• Active U.S. security clearance

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Insurance
jobs.description:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property — all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide — we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.

Why Hover wants you

Nine of the top ten U.S. insurance carriers use Hover to turn a policyholder's smartphone scan into an accurate 3D model, so claims move faster and settle with fewer site visits. We're building our Implementation function now, and we want an Implementation Manager who will deliver our most strategic and complex carrier deployments. You'll work with Hover's largest insurance customers, help define and iterate on the implementation playbook as an early member of the team, and see your work change how adjusters and policyholders handle claims. If you like building the process while you deliver, this is the role.

You will contribute by

You'll own several enterprise implementations at once, from sales handoff through adoption and transition to Customer Success. You'll lead kickoffs, working sessions, and training with carrier claims teams, and you'll run the plan, status reporting, and risk management that keep rollouts on track. You'll get hands-on with configuration, data migration, integration testing, and UAT, partnering with Solutions Architects on how Hover connects to the insurance ecosystem, including Verisk and Cotality. You'll guide customers through change management as their teams move from in-person inspections to remote, scan-based workflows. Alongside a small team, you'll help build the playbook, templates, and processes every future rollout will use.

• Lead customer-facing delivery: kickoffs, working sessions, training, and status calls

• Manage project plans, timelines, risk logs, and executive status reporting

• Incorporate implementation learnings into our playbook to refine our ever-evolving process

• Configure the platform and support data migration, integration testing, and UAT

• Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions, Product, and Engineering on handoffs and escalations

• Contribute to enablement, process improvement, and the implementation playbook

Your background includes

• 4+ years of direct, hands-on implementation experience at a SaaS company, ideally a high-growth or venture-backed one

• Experience delivering enterprise implementations, including managing several at the same time

• A track record of building and refining systems, templates, or processes that others adopted

• Experience with configuration, data migration, integrations, and UAT for a workflow-based product

• Strong cross-functional skills, with experience partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering

• Comfort working autonomously at a small-company pace, where you own a lot and priorities can shift

• Clear, confident communication with customer stakeholders, from end users to executives

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with insurance claims products or the insurance technology ecosystem (for example Guidewire, Duck Creek, Verisk, or Cotality)

• Experience driving change management for large customer teams moving to a new workflow

• Experience implementing workflow-based platforms such as ServiceNow, Procore, ServiceTitan, Airtable, monday.com, Ironclad, UiPath, or Celonis

Benefits

• Compensation - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a fast-growing company

• Healthcare - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents

• Paid Time Off - Unlimited and flexible vacation policy

• Paid Family Leave - We support work/life balance and offer generous paid parental and new child bonding leave

• Mandatory Self-Care Days - A day set aside each month to allow employees to recharge

• Remote Wellbeing Resources - We provide recurring fitness classes, meditation/ mindfulness tools, virtual therapy, and family planning assistance

• Learning - We encourage continued education and will help cover the cost of management training, conferences, workshops, or certifications

Hybrid roles at Hover

Hover has Hubs in San Francisco and New York City, where we expect that all employees living within a 50-mile radius of our offices will come into their local Hover office at least three times a week to build rapport and foster organic connection. At this time, Hover is not considering fully remote roles.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all applicable US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Manager, System Safety Engineering
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's System Safety Engineering organization partners across Anduril's engineering, manufacturing, and operations organizations to ensure our autonomous systems are safe for development, testing, and deployment in complex operational environments. Our mandate spans the complete product lifecycle, from early concept design through production scale-up and fielded operations. We make our products safe by guiding product teams through safety analyses such as: Functional Hazard Analysis, Fault Trees, Hazard Management and Hazard Mitigation activities, identifying hazards early and partnering with design teams to engineer safety into hardware, software, and operations.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking experienced System Safety Engineering leaders to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA and drive system safety excellence across Anduril’s product portfolio. As a System Safety leader at Anduril, you will play a critical role in developing and implementing robust safety frameworks. Your expertise will be instrumental in guiding product teams through the System Safety lifecycle, from initial concept through design, qualification, production, and field deployment. You will drive continuous improvement initiatives, lead the development of risk mitigation strategies, and foster a safety culture across the organization. Leveraging your deep knowledge of system safety tools (FHA, FTA, SCFTA, SSA, FMECA, etc.) and hazard analysis methodologies, you will ensure that our systems operate safely under diverse and demanding operating conditions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead and manage the performance of a team of System Safety Engineers, providing technical guidance and mentorship on system safety principles, best practices, and artifact development.

• Manage resource allocation and capacity planning to support multiple concurrent programs, and drive recruiting efforts to maintain growth trajectory.

• Conduct performance management, career development planning, and succession planning.

• Develop and implement tailored System Safety program plans aligned with MIL-STD-882E and the needs of Anduril and its customers.

• Define and communicate the System Safety organization's vision, goals, and framework to standardize development efforts across the business and integrate safety processes across all stages of product development.

• Oversee and review complex safety analyses, including FHA (Functional Hazard Analysis), Fault Tree, SCFTA (Safety Critical Functional Thread Analysis), and SAR (Safety Assessment Report).

• Develop system safety requirements and collaborate with design teams to implement safety solutions.

• Support Milestone Reviews such as PDR, CDR, and TRR representing System Safety.

• Liaise with customers, regulatory bodies, and internal stakeholders on safety-related matters.

• Drive continuous improvement in System Safety processes and methodologies.

• Ensure compliance with relevant military and industry safety standards.

• Contribute to proposal efforts and support business development activities, as required.

• Provide management-level reporting and communications on team performance, program status, and strategic initiatives.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• B.S. Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline

• 7+ years of experience in System Safety Engineering, with at least 1 years in a leadership role

• Proven track record building, scaling, and managing technical teams of 5+ engineers for complex advanced programs

• Strong background in safety analysis techniques, including FTA, FHA, SCFTA, and FMECA.

• Extensive knowledge of MIL-STD-882E, JSSSEH or other relevant safety standards.

• Experience with safety-critical hardware and software systems in the defense or aerospace industry, with a preference for Weapon Systems

• Experience setting up a System Safety Engineering framework for a product or program, including early stage Design for Safety and Hazard Analysis experience

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to influence cross-functionally at all levels

• Strategic thinking with ability to balance hands-on technical work with management responsibilities

• Eligibility to pursue and maintain a U.S. security clearance, as required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• M.S. Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline

• 10+ years of experience in System Safety Engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

• Experience managing teams through periods of rapid growth (2x+ team expansion)

• Track record of developing talent and promoting team members into leadership roles

• Experience or familiarity with ISO 26262, ARP-4754, ARP-4761, and MIL-STD-516C

• Experience with software safety, software assurance, or Level of Rigor for safety-critical software systems

• Executive-level communications, reporting, and roadmap presentation experience

• Technical writing experience developing standards, specifications, user guides, and policies

• Experience with Relyence, Teamcenter, Confluence, JAMA, Cameo, and JIRA

• Experience drafting requirements for software and hardware systems

• Active U.S. security clearance

$166,000—$220,000 USD

jobs.title: Power Electronics Test & Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first focus goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.

 


JOB OVERVIEW 

The Power Electronics Test & Validation Engineer will own application-specific testing of Heron's solid state transformer (SST) across its core use cases: powering AI data centers, utility-scale BESS, and PV plants. That means bringing up hardware in the lab and at pilot sites, writing scripts to drive test equipment and power converters, and debugging performance against what each application demands, from MPPT performance and PPC/EMS/BMS communication to AI load smoothing and DC protection coordination. You will work hand in hand with the Systems Integration team: they own the SST platform; you own the applications.

 


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Own end-to-end application testing of a novel high C-rate battery pack (SuperBBU) with Heron's SST, validating ripple mitigation, backup capability, slew rates, and power-loss profiles.

 - Support SST and utility-scale BESS integration testing at pilot sites, covering EMS-to-SST communication, black start and grid-forming coordination, charge/discharge cycling, and round-trip efficiency.

 - Support integration testing of the SST with commercial off-the-shelf DAS, SCADA and EMS systems. 

 - Own Heron's first pilot deployments: review field performance, identify feature gaps, and work with SW/FW teams to turn findings into product improvements.

 - Write and maintain Python-based test automation to command power converters, sequence tests, log data, and turn manual procedures into repeatable automated loops.

 - Safely operate power converters, chillers, contactors, and protection hardware, and set up cabling, instrumentation, and data acquisition for high-power test runs.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We have a short list of must-have requirements. We prioritize a strong grip on first principles, hands-on skills, and a sense of initiative. Domain-specific knowledge and experience will help determine the career level for each hire.

 


MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in power electronics, energy storage, EV, grid, or a comparable hardware-intensive environment.

 - Strong grasp on DC circuit fundamentals: resonances, parasitics, slew rates, and inductive spikes. You can correlate test data with simulation results.

 - Strong scripting and test-automation skills to drive instruments and power converters and to log and analyze data.

 - Working knowledge of power conversion and battery systems: inverters and converters, BMS, DC pre-charge, contactors and protection, and thermal and cooling loops.

 - Comfort with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, DAQ systems) and comms protocols such as CAN and Modbus TCP.

 - Scrappy mindset: you get things done with a hundred hurdles in front of you.

 


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with solid state transformers or grid-forming inverters.

 - Familiarity with utility-scale BESS commissioning, grid-support functions, or EMS integration.

 - Prior experience in systems-level testing of power electronics or energy storage products

 - Hands-on experience with circuit and system simulation tools such as LTspice, Simscape, or PLECS. 

If you are passionate about the energy transition and enjoy working at the frontier of power electronics and grid integration, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits.

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Lifecycle Marketing Specialist

San Mateo, CA / Hybrid

The Consumer Engagement team is part of the broader Global Media and Omnichannel Marketing function within PlayStation and is responsible for implementing multi-channel digital programs and campaigns developing a relevant dialogue with tens of millions of customers across the globe.

We are advocates for the player. Crafting unforgettable digital experiences that fulfill player curiosity, boost gameplay, and drive revenue. We use data-driven insights to build one-to-one relationships and personalized journeys with players across the web, email, mobile, and on-console.

The Lifecycle Marketing Specialist role is responsible for delivering lifecycle campaigns head to tail including planning, testing, executing and measurement. This creative and innovative individual will work closely with our Creative Studio, Data Science, Audience & Measurement and Marketing teams across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Together, we are on a mission to redefine owned channel marketing and its relationship to company growth and player engagement.

This role combines campaign strategy with hands-on execution, requiring both creative thinking and strong operational and technical capability within lifecycle marketing platforms.

Responsibilities:

• Own the end-to-end build and deployment of campaigns within lifecycle marketing platforms (e.g. channel build, journey configuration, audience segmentation, QA and troubleshooting).

• Plan campaigns based on existing blueprints and collaborate with team to iterate and improve prior campaign structures.

• Design, build and optimise automated and trigger-based messaging, spotting opportunities to scale our lifecycle programs.

• Collaborate with team to drive ‘Player Centricity’ through models, content and player insights to achieve 1:1 personalisation at scale across the channel mix.

• Analyze campaigns and journeys to understand the performance of these activities and build on the results for the next iteration. Share these results back to the business with clear insights and opportunities.

• Collaborate on test and learn strategy to optimise campaigns; feeding all insights gained back into a continuous process of testing and refinement.

• Keep a pulse of lifecycle marketing landscape and evolutions, seek and understand emerging trends, technologies and innovation to provide ongoing learning for the marketing organization.

Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience building and deploying campaigns within lifecycle marketing platforms, with a strong understanding of how journeys, data and triggers interact.

• Self-starter who takes ownership of campaign delivery end-to-end, from setup through to troubleshooting and optimisation.

• Educated to degree level in a related field such as Business, Marketing or Mathematics and a strong academic record.

• 3+ years (or equivalent) of proven experience in B2C marketing, customer lifecycle management, and engagement marketing.

• Highly organized - able to handle a full workload and progress multiple ambitious projects simultaneously thanks to your skill and work ethic.

• Passionate about the customer– you look at quantitative and qualitative consumer insights to make decisions and recommend improvements.

• Strong communicator who is comfortable briefing Creatives, Analysts, Engineers, Legal and management.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a consistent track record in data-based decision making.

• Innovative and constantly exploring new ways of doing things and challenging the status quo.

• Sophisticated communicator with excellent influencing skills.

• Experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Journey Builder, Interactive Studio or equivalent ESP.

• Excellent interpersonal skills with expertise and integrity that will earn respect and trust with internal team members and external vendors.

• Experienced in establishing relationships and operating compassionately across cultures. This includes collaborating openly and bringing together different perspectives to drive well-informed decisions.

jobs.title: Director, EEDI Business Lead- Commercial
jobs.description:
Purpose

This role leads the design and execution of Equity, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (EEDI) strategies for one of AbbVie's key functions. Reporting to the Director, Programs and Business Partnerships, this individual serves as a strategic driver and takes a hands-on approach — shaping the vision and rolling up their sleeves to make it real. The role partners closely with VP-level leaders, functional EEDI councils, Business HR (BHR), and HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) to deliver measurable business and talent outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings a demonstrated track record of driving organizational impact at scale — someone who combines forward-thinking strategy with a bias for action, and who is equally comfortable setting direction and doing the work. This person operates with both a grounding in proven approaches and a commitment to evolving practices that serve our global, diverse organization.

Responsibilities

• Own EEDI functional strategy: Partner with the business to develop the EEDI strategy for assigned function. Lead strategy execution, including roadmap implementation, stakeholder management, communication plans, and achievement of clear measures of success.
• Lead and align EEDI councils: Direct the work of EEDI councils by establishing clear goals, aligned priorities, and effective operating models that connect directly to business and EEDI strategy. Facilitate council effectiveness with hands-on engagement through active leadership.
• Co-design and manage EEDI programs: Co-design, deliver, and manage EEDI programs that are intentionally inclusive and accessible to all employees. Take ownership of program outcomes, with accountability for adoption and measurable outcomes.
• Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner with EEDI leads, BHR and COEs to integrate EEDI principles into foundational people processes and to collaboratively advance new strategies and initiatives — ensuring consistency and coherence across the enterprise.
• Embed systemic change in talent processes: Apply change management methodologies to deliver year-over-year progress on key EEDI metrics and overall talent metrics. Ensure aligned and systemic changes across functions, sustained efforts over one-time initiatives.
• Serve as a strategic advisor: Advise BHR and COEs on practical, evidence-based ways to embed EEDI into all people and business processes. Provide thought leadership that shapes the HR practices and promotes equitable decision-making — with both global perspective and local sensitivity.
• Research and benchmark: Stay up to date on ongoing research and external benchmarking to inform best practices and to identify new opportunities for building a globally inclusive workforce.
• Translate data into action: Use AI, workforce data and analytics to identify talent opportunities, assess initiative effectiveness, and establish KPIs that demonstrate measurable business impact. Be a practitioner who understands data and interprets what it means.
• Uphold governance standards: Ensure consistent adherence to governance processes and guidelines across all EEDI programming and initiatives.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Advanced degree or EEDI Certification preferred.
• Minimum 8+ years of related EEDI work experience; 5+ years of leadership or high-level consulting roles.
• Experience in translating external and internal trends into innovative practices.
• Proven track record of facilitating company-level initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
• A deep understanding of how to promote EEDI within a large, complex, multi-national organization.
• Experience in senior business partnering and advisory roles; ability to build collaborative, business-focused relationships with senior HR and business leaders.
• Strong consulting skills, project planning, management and review, with an ability to roll up sleeves to demonstrate initiative and results-orientation, with a focus on service.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills, and facilitation skills.
• A proactive, resourceful and self-motivated approach to their work.

jobs.title: HR Generalist (Cairo-based, 12-month contract)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The People Team helps Agoda attract, support, and develop talented individuals from around the world. We work together to create an inclusive, collaborative workplace and deliver a positive employee experience through onboarding, development, benefits, and everyday People support.

Our Regional Business Partners Team works closely with business leaders, People Operations, Employee Relations, and Legal/Compliance to support employees and managers. In Cairo, dependable HR operations, accurate employee records, and effective administrative controls are essential to delivering this support.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an HR Generalist to join our People Team in Cairo on a 12-month contract at Senior Analyst level, reporting to the Cairo Business Partner.

The HR Generalist is an integral part of the Cairo team and will partner with both the Cairo Business Partner as well as the rest of People team subject matter experts cross

functionally to ensure a seamless HR operational delivery of the employee life cycle from onboarding, reporting, and supporting local HR administrative compliance. You will coordinate routine employee lifecycle activities and work with colleagues across the People Team to complete tasks accurately and on time.

This role suits someone who takes ownership of execution, follows through on outstanding items, and uses data to identify gaps and practical improvements. You will manage assigned work independently within established processes, seeking guidance and escalating sensitive, complex, or non-standard matters to the Cairo Business Partner and relevant specialist teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Deliver Reliable HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Administration

• Coordinate assigned administrative activities for onboarding, employee changes, and offboarding, ensuring required documents, approvals, and system updates are completed on time.

• Maintain accurate employee information in HR systems and local personnel files/trackers, checking consistency across records and resolving discrepancies with the appropriate owners.

• Prepare routine employment letters and other HR documentation using approved templates and obtain the required review and approvals.

• Coordinate accurate and timely employee information for Payroll, Benefits, and other People teams, following agreed responsibilities and deadlines.

• Respond to routine employee and manager queries on HR processes and documentation, routing specialist or sensitive questions to the appropriate team.

• Prioritize requests and projects against agreed service expectations, maintain clear delivery plans, and communicate progress, dependencies, and next steps.

Support Local Administrative Compliance and Controls

• Support the Cairo Business Partner in maintaining HR documentation and administrative controls aligned with company policies and applicable local requirements.

• Maintain compliance checklists and calendars, and coordinate documentation for required local administrative processes, submissions, or renewals within assigned scope.

• Prepare records and supporting evidence for internal reviews, audits, and authorized external requests, coordinating review and approval before release.

• Identify missing approvals, incomplete records, overdue actions, and process exceptions; raise concerns promptly and track agreed corrective actions to completion.

• Apply guidance from the Cairo Business Partner, Legal/Compliance, and relevant People specialists when requirements or processes change.

Produce HR Reports and Improve Processes

• Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports on employee data, file completeness, lifecycle activity, outstanding requests, and compliance actions.

• Validate report inputs, investigate discrepancies, and present findings clearly, with support where needed.

• Highlight recurring documentation gaps, service delays, and data quality issues, explaining their impact and recommending practical improvements.

• Improve checklists, trackers, templates, and workflows to reduce errors, rework, and manual effort.

• Take ownership of assigned process improvement activities, coordinating stakeholders and reporting progress and outcomes.

Build Effective Stakeholder Relationships

• Build productive working relationships with employees, managers, the Cairo Business Partner, and colleagues across the People Team.

• Understand the business context relevant to your work and anticipate how operational tasks affect employees and other teams.

• Coordinate across teams to resolve dependencies, clarify ownership, and support timely delivery.

• Escalate employee relations concerns promptly to the Cairo Business Partner and Employee Relations team, and provide administrative support under their direction.

Contribute to the People Team and Agoda Culture

• Participate in team meetings, share operational updates, and contribute thoughtful suggestions and feedback.

• Support local employee engagement activities and People Team events within the scope of the role.

• Share process knowledge and provide occasional guidance to junior colleagues where appropriate.

• Proactively develop your HR knowledge and skills, seek feedback, and take on new challenges.

• Demonstrate Agoda’s values through collaboration, accountability, discretion, and inclusive employee support.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

• A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• At least three years of relevant experience in HR operations, HR administration, or an HR Generalist role, including hands-on responsibility for employee records and lifecycle processes.

• Working knowledge of HR documentation and administrative compliance requirements in Egypt, with sound judgment about when to seek specialist advice.

• Strong organization and prioritization skills, with a track record of delivering accurate work within agreed deadlines.

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify incomplete records, inconsistencies, and missing approvals.

• Proficiency in Excel or comparable spreadsheet tools for maintaining trackers, reconciling data, and preparing reports.

• Experience using HR information systems and maintaining confidential employee data.

• Practical problem-solving skills and the ability to translate operational data into clear findings and improvement suggestions.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate progress, concerns, and follow-up actions clearly.

• High standards of discretion, confidentiality, and ethics.

• Fluency in written and spoken Arabic and English.

• Flexibility and the ability to work effectively in a changing, multicultural environment.

It’s Great if you Have:

• Experience supporting HR operations in a multinational organization.

• Experience reviewing employee files, resolving documentation backlogs, or supporting HR audits.

• Experience improving HR administrative workflows, reporting, or data quality.

• Familiarity with coordinating across Payroll, Benefits, People Operations, and Employee Relations teams.

• Curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative approach to work.

This role is based in Cairo, Egypt, and is offered on a 12-month contract.

jobs.title: Director, Technical Data Modernization
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



The Role:
Much of the technical data behind US defense systems is decades old: scanned paper, hand-marked prints, and drawings that were never turned into 3D models. Hadrian is building a team to turn that data into modern, manufacturing-ready models and drawings. Customers can then keep their systems running, and those parts can be quoted, made at Hadrian, or procured.

The team supports multiple defense programs that need this work now. The first priority is a large, multi-year technical data migration for a defense customer. The team works alongside Hadrian's software to convert each technical data package and confirm it is right before it goes to the customer.

As Director, you build and run that operation, growing it from a small founding team into a large organization. You report to the Senior Director of Central Quality and NPI.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build the operating model for each program, starting with the migration: the standard workflow, the training, and the quality controls that confirm each package matches its source data before it goes to the customer.

 - Work with the software team so the process and the automation tools improve together, and the manual effort per package keeps falling.

 - Plan and run the hiring ramp: sourcing, location, training, and retention.

 - Balance capacity across programs, track throughput and quality against each program's schedule, and fix the bottleneck.

 - Hire and develop the leaders who run the team day to day.

 - Meet each program's data-handling rules while keeping the quality call.
   
   How Success Is Measured
   
   - Throughput. Technical data packages delivered each month against each program's plan.
   
   - Quality. Share of packages the customer accepts on first submission, and errors found after delivery.
   
   - Ramp. Hires on plan, time for a new hire to reach full output, and retention.
     
   
   The Team
   
   You start with a small team of engineers and specialists who define the process. Headcount rises quickly as the migration ramps and more programs come on, and the team is expected to divide into separate groups.
   
   - Conversion Engineers. Define the process, work with the software team on the automation, and check the work.
   
   - Conversion Specialists. Convert technical data packages using Hadrian's software, and check the output.
   
   - CAD Modelers. Build 3D models from 2D drawings when no model exists, for programs across Hadrian.
     
   
   
   WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
   
   - Built and ran a high-volume technical operation, such as production, engineering services, or drawing conversion, and grew it to 50 or more people.
   
   - Hired and trained people quickly, and kept them engaged in repetitive work.
   
   - Runs an operation on throughput and quality data.
   
   - 3+ years leading other leaders.
   
   - Enough engineering-drawing depth to own the quality bar, including GD&T and model-based definition.
   
   - You raise problems early and make decisions without waiting for full consensus.
   
   - Engineering or STEM degree, or equivalent hands-on experience.
     
   
   
   WHAT WILL SET YOU APART
   
   - Built a team from the ground up at a startup or a fast-growing company.
   
   - Ran a large legacy-to-modern technical data or PLM migration, including the team and its throughput.
   
   - Worked alongside a software team to automate a manual engineering process.
   
   - Teamcenter or CATIA experience.
   
   - Naval, submarine, or federal technical data program experience.
     


COMPENSATION

For this role, the target salary range is $200,000 - $240,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Identity & Access Management (IAM)
jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot Platforms is seeking a Senior Engineer, Identity & Access Management (IAM) to design, implement, and operate modern identity security capabilities across our enterprise, cloud, SaaS, and data center environments. This role will be hands-on and highly technical, with responsibility for building secure, scalable, and automated identity solutions that support Riot’s continued growth into AI/HPC and data center operations.

The Senior IAM Engineer will work closely with Cybersecurity, IT, Cloud, Infrastructure, Data Center Operations, People Operations, and GRC.

This is a remote position with travel to Riot sites as needed.

What you'll do

• Design, implement, and support IAM solutions across Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SaaS, cloud, and data center environments.
• Manage and optimize SSO, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, PIM, RBAC, and identity lifecycle controls.
• Implement and maintain Privileged Access Management (PAM) capabilities, including privileged account onboarding, credential rotation, session controls, and removal of standing access.
• Support Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) processes including joiner/mover/leaver workflows, access reviews, entitlement management, and role-based access.
• Automate user and access provisioning using technologies such as SCIM, APIs, scripting, PowerShell, and workflow automation.
• Engineer secure access for vendors, contractors, partners, and other third-party users.
• Develop and maintain controls for service accounts, application identities, API access, secrets, certificates, and other non-human identities.
• Integrate enterprise applications with SSO using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and related standards.
• Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, provisioning, and federation issues.
• Partner with Cybersecurity Operations to investigate identity-related threats, anomalous authentication, credential compromise, and privilege escalation.
• Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, and operating procedures.
• Support IAM-related audit and compliance activities, including SOX, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence and control testing.
• Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, strengthen security, and improve the user experience.

What you'll bring

• 5+ years of IAM, cybersecurity engineering, identity engineering, or related technical experience.
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft identity technologies, especially Entra ID and Active Directory.
• Demonstrated experience integrating enterprise applications with SSO and automated provisioning.
• Experience implementing or supporting PAM, PIM, Conditional Access, MFA, and access governance.
• Strong understanding of least privilege, Zero Trust, RBAC, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management.
• Experience scripting and automating IAM processes using PowerShell, APIs, or similar tools.
• Strong troubleshooting skills across identity, networking, federation, and application integrations.
• Ability to work effectively across Cybersecurity, IT, Infrastructure, and business teams.
• Preferred experience with CyberArk or comparable privilege management technologies.
• Preferred experience with SailPoint or comparable entitlements management technologies.
• Preferred experience supporting cloud, data center, critical infrastructure, or AI/HPC environments.
• Preferred experience with SOX, SOC 2, ISO, NIST CSF, and Zero Trust architectures.
• Certification in Microsoft, CyberArk, SailPoint, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent.

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive Salary: $160,000-$175,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
• Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
• Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Equip is the leading virtual, evidence-based eating disorder treatment program on a mission to ensure that everyone with an eating disorder can access treatment that works. Created by clinical experts in the field and people with lived experience, Equip builds upon evidence-based treatments to empower individuals to reach lasting recovery. All Equip patients receive a dedicated care team, including a therapist, dietitian, physician, and peer and family mentor. The company operates in all 50 states and is partnered with most major health insurance plans. Learn more about our strong outcomes https://equip.health/outcomes and treatment approach at www.equip.health. http://www.equip.health

Founded in 2019, Equip has been a fully virtual company since its inception and is proud of the highly-engaged, passionate, and diverse Equipsters that have created Equip’s culture.  Recognized by Time https://time.com/collection/time100-companies-2023/6285207/equip/ as one of the most influential companies of 2023, along with awards from Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2022-50-us-companies-rise-linkedin-news/ and Lattice https://lattice.com/blog/announcing-the-2023-finalists-for-lattices-people-success-awards, we are grateful to Equipsters for building a sustainable treatment program that has served thousands of patients and families.

About the Role

The Licensed Therapist will be responsible for working closely and effectively with a multidisciplinary care team (including nutrition, medical, psychiatry, and mentorship) and utilize evidence-based based care modalities (such as FBT and CBT-E). The Licensed Therapist will be responsible for evidence based treatment delivery, quality documentation, and ongoing assessment of patients’ and families’ needs.


The Licensed Therapist role involves emotionally rewarding but inherently difficult work. To ensure continuity of care for both patients and providers, we are committed to offering benefits that support long-term well-being and job satisfaction. The Licensed Therapist has Flex PTO (recommended 3-5 weeks), which we encourage all providers to take, as well as company holidays. They also have access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a company-paid resource for mental health, legal services, financial support, and more. We know this work is hard, and strive to take care of our people who work so hard taking care of others.


Working Hours:

Equip’s working hours are Monday - Friday, between 8am-8pm in Therapist’s respective patient care time zone*.

 - Ability to provide 30 hours a week of availability for direct patient care, including new patients and follow-up sessions.

 - Ability to commit to a minimum of 16 hours of direct patient care after 2 pm in Therapist’s respective patient care time zone throughout the week (3pm if you live in the Mountain Standard Time Zone to accommodate Pacific Time Zone patients).

 - Ability to commit to working until 8pm two evenings per week (you choose which evenings and you can start later in the day on these days).

 - Ability to attend mandatory meetings (i.e Group Supervision, Treatment Huddles, Labs/All Hands, Individual Supervision, etc.).



Responsibilities 

 - Provide evidence-based family, individual, and group therapy for eating disorders and comorbid diagnoses in a virtual clinic (i.e. telehealth) setting.

 - Implement family-based treatment (FBT), enhanced cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT-E), cognitive behavioral therapy for ARFID, and other evidence-based treatments for patients across the lifespan with eating disorders and their loved ones.

 - Maintain a caseload of 30-40; with the expectation being 20-26 hours of direct care and remaining time dedicated to administrative tasks. 

 - Participate in initial and ongoing trainings.

 - Assess and diagnose mental health conditions.

 - Collaborate with a multidisciplinary treatment team of physicians, dietitians, patient mentors, and family mentors, along with outside providers.

 - Utilize between-session messaging to support patients and communicate with the treatment team through Equip’s EMR in accordance with Equip’s policies and procedures.

 - Engage and collaborate in Treatment Team meetings, supervision, and department meetings.

 - Maintain licensure in home state and obtain licensure in other states as requested by Equip (licensure costs will be covered by Equip).

 - Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Must Haves

 - Active, unrestricted, and independent license to practice psychotherapy in Nebraska. 

 - Ability to support a caseload of patients of all ages, co-occurring conditions, backgrounds and cultures, and with varying degrees of acuity.

 - Passion for evidence-based care and treatment.

 - Ability to provide care 2 evenings per week (meaning being available until 8pm in your patient caseloads primary time zone).

 - Enthusiastic, strong team player.

 - Ability to safely and effectively deliver care in a virtual setting.

 - Passion for mental health and eating disorder treatment and expanding access to treatment.

Nice to Haves (preferred but not required)

 - Experience in Family-Based Treatment and/or eating disorder treatment.

 - Experience with evidence-based treatment and/or intensive treatment settings.

 - Experience supporting patients with suicidal ideation and trauma.

 - Case management experience and/or experience working closely with a multidisciplinary care team. 

Compensation & Benefits Package

Compensation: 

 - Earning Potential Range: $71,000 to $92,000 Annually+ 15% Performance-Based Bonus Potential

Time Off:

 - Flex PTO policy (3-5 wks/year recommended) + 11 paid company holidays.

 - Generous Parental Leave Benefits.

Core Benefits:

 - Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance.
   
   - Equip pays for a significant percentage of benefits premiums for individuals and families.

 - Spring Health, a 100% employer-paid mental health benefit through Guardian.
   
   - You can receive 5 free therapy sessions and 5 free coaching sessions per year for you and each of your dependents.

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a company paid resource for mental health, legal services, financial support, and more!

 - HealthJoy, a 100% employer-paid platform connecting you to a healthcare concierge who can help you navigate your benefits.

 - 401K Option!

Other Benefits

Student Loan Repayment:

 - $500/quarter for employees under a year of tenure.

 - $1,000/quarter for employees over a year of tenure.

Continuing Education:

 - Robust training in evidence-based treatments for eating disorders, including Family-Based Treatment, Enhanced Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for ARFID. Comparable training workshops and supervision in these modalities are valued over at $3,000 per training.

 - For therapists and medical providers, unlimited online courses through NetCE.

 - Up to $1,000/year stipend for continuing education.

Licensing:

 - Equip reimburses fees associated with initial licensure and license renewals (e.g., exam fees, application to the state board, exam study materials, etc.) for any Equip-required licenses and/or cross-licensure requests.

Work From Home Additional Perks:

 - $50/month stipend added directly to an employee’s paycheck to cover home internet expenses.

 - Initial work-from-home stipend of up to $500.
   
   - Reload of $200 on the home office stipend at the 3-year mark and then every other year after that (year 5, year 7, etc.).

 - Company Laptop.

Physical Demands 

Work is performed 100% from home with no requirement to travel. This is a stationary position that requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards as well as to talk or hear by telephone. Sit or stand as needed.

We also strive toward our providers and corporate team reflecting that same dedication both in bringing in and retaining talented employees from all backgrounds and identities. jobs.title: Structural Analyst
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

To help achieve these efforts, Stratolaunch is seeking a Sr- or Staff-level Structural Analyst to support design, analysis, integration, testing, and maintenance of hypersonic vehicle and launch system structure.  This position will include contributing to conceptual and detailed structural analysis-driven design of primary and secondary structure.  You are responsible for contributing to the vehicle’s structural technical performance, including meeting design and mission requirements, resolving technical challenges, and implementing technology upgrades that improve the competitive basis of the hypersonic vehicle and launch system architecture.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Participate in portions of the structural development of hypersonic vehicles and launch systems

• Generate and maintain finite element method (FEM) models - including meshing, materials & properties assignment, grouping, etc.

• Generate and/or expand upon FEMAP interfacing and data reduction scripts and programs

• Apply vehicle loads and environments to FEM

• Perform modal and linear finite element analysis (FEA), as required, to evaluate vehicle loads and environments

• Perform structural trade studies to develop and/or improve airframe load paths

• Assess and confirm FEA results with hand calculations as appropriate

• Interpret results and make design modifications to meet program requirements

• Select material systems and construction techniques, as needed, that meet project objectives

• Work with structural and mechanical designers to incorporate analysis-driven design modifications

• Create analysis reports to support the documentation of structural margins

• Perform detailed design of structural components and assemblies, as required

• Assist structural designers in disposition of manufacturing nonconformances and resolve technical challenges, as they arise

• Evaluate risks and develop risk mitigation plans for primary structures

• Regular and comprehensive communication to relevant Structures Lead and Section Manager

• Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity, and fulfillment of commitments

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required Qualifications:

• Strong fundamental structures background, including load paths and the ability to hand size structural components

• Perform structural hand calculations

• Experience designing and analyzing either composite or metallic structures

• Experience with FEM generation

• Experience with FEA and FEA post-processing

• Experience generating pre- and post-processing scripts

• Ability to communicate technical challenges and guidance to varied audiences to explain rationale and/or resolve concerns

• Ability to take direction, work relatively independently, and prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals

• Ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities

Required Computer Skills:

• Proficient with FEMAP and NX NASTRAN

• Experience programming - Python, C++, or Matlab

• MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with BMI or epoxy pre-preg composites

• Experience with static structural testing

• Experience with loads development

• Experience with dynamics analyses

Preferred Computer Skills:

• Computer Aided Design tools – NX (preferred), Solidworks, or CATIA

• Familiarity with configuration management systems – Jira (preferred)

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• Sr Level ($102,000-$172,000): Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) from accredited institution and 5-10 years of engineering experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience

• Staff Level ($129,000-$214,000: Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) from accredited institution and 10-20 years of engineering experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

• Position based in Mojave, CA. Consideration for remote or hybrid position for well-qualified candidate.

• Travel estimated to be <10%

• 9/80 Schedule

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

• Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)

• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave

• 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

• Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles.  The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? You’re within a half day’s drive or less of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and San Francisco where you can find a variety of live entertainment, museums, tours, and historical sight-seeing. Theme parks are in abundance, with Six Flags Magic Mountain, Disneyland, and Knotts Berry Farm ready to meet the needs of rollercoaster thrill seekers.

Food and drink fanatics are in a haven of delectable choices. Wine aficionados will also find easy access to some of the state’s best vino in Paso Robles, Santa Ynez, and even more locally in Tehachapi and Agua Dulce. Beer fanatics will find some of the best West Coast IPAs at Bravery and Lucky Luke’s in Lancaster. Any food option you crave is covered, and we always recommend the authentic and fresh Mexican food that you won’t find anywhere else in the United States.

Stratolaunch is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at our company. We encourage people from all walks of life to apply, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Our management team does not tolerate discrimination or harassment at any point during our employees’ and applicants’ time with us, especially with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, and general treatment during employment.  For purposes of transparency, U.S. Citizenship may be required for some positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.
