jobs.description:
About Agero:

Wherever drivers go, we’re leading the way. Agero’s mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients’ relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

Note: For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.

Role Description and Mission:

This is an in-person position located at our Clarksville, TN contact center at 2971 International Blvd, Clarksville, TN 37040. Associates hired for this role are expected to train and commit to working onsite.

Agero is currently hiring for Onsite Total Case Specialists to take inbound calls in our Consumer Affairs department for Kia Care. In this role, you will handle vehicle-related inquiries, provide technical support, and resolve complex customer issues with exceptional care.

As a Total Case Specialist in Kia Consumer Affairs, you’ll handle a wide range of customer cases related to vehicle concerns - from warranty coverage and repair assistance to service campaigns, technical support, and dealership issues. Customers may reach out with general questions or in stressful situations, and your role is to provide calm, empathetic guidance every time.

You’ll act as a trusted liaison between customers, dealerships, and Kia - ensuring customers receive the help they need and hang up feeling heard, valued, and confident in their connected technology and ownership experience.

Key Outcomes:

• Manage a High Volume of Cases: Handle inbound calls and outbound follow-ups to resolve concerns, from troubleshooting Kia Connect and mobile app integration to navigating warranty coverage, repair assistance, and service campaigns.

• Be the Customer’s Voice: Serve as the bridge between customers, dealerships, Kia, and any third party vendors, ensuring smooth communication and empathetic solutions.

• De-escalate and Resolve: Listen actively, acknowledge concerns, and deliver calm, personalized support to frustrated callers while focusing on positive, lasting resolutions.

• Elevate the Customer Experience: Deliver empathetic, personalized support that strengthens customer satisfaction and long-term loyalty.

• Build Brand Trust: Represent Kia with professionalism and care, reinforcing the brand’s reputation for reliability and service excellence.

• Drive Service Excellence: Facilitate smooth communication between customers, dealerships, and Kia to ensure timely, effective resolutions.

• Empower Customers: Help customers understand their vehicle’s features, warranty coverage, and available resources so they feel confident and informed in their ownership experience.

• Collaborate for Success: Partner with dealerships, Kia, and external & internal teams to resolve a range of issues related to in-car technology, subscription services, warranty coverage, and backordered parts.

• Document with Care: Record all case details and customer interactions accurately, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution.

• Provide Technical Guidance: Help customers troubleshoot vehicle features such as the Owner’s Portal, Bluetooth, infotainment, radio, and navigation with clear, step-by-step support.

• Navigate Digital Tools: Use web-based systems and CRM tools to manage workflows, coordinate service requests, and track case progress.

• Excel in our In-Person Contact Center: Thrive in an independent, performance-driven onsite office style environment where reliability, empathy, and consistent quality service are recognized and rewarded. Connect directly with your teammates, peers, and leaders while working face-to-face and online using Zoom and Google Chat. Team work and positive attitude required.

Skills, Education, & Experience:

• Empathy in Action: You listen with care, respond with compassion, and support customers through stressful situations.

• Case Management & Multi-tasking Mastery: Manage multiple calls, dispatch requests, and systems efficiently. Able to speak to customers or providers on the phone, while typing detailed call notes, looking up information, and navigating multiple screens. You take ownership of your work, prioritize effectively, and follow through on every case.

• Strong Communicator: You set clear expectations, keep your word, and build trust through empathetic two-way communication.

• Problem-Solver & De-escalator: You stay calm under pressure, think critically, and offer innovative solutions.

• Customer Advocate: You go the extra mile to ensure concerns are fully understood and resolved.

• Computer Proficiency & Technical Support Skills: Skilled at navigating multiple digital tools and CRM software confidently. Able to type at least 45 wpm accurately on a computer keyboard. You’re comfortable troubleshooting infotainment, navigation, Bluetooth, and other vehicle technologies with clear step-by-step guidance.

Position Requirements:

• Location: Must live in the state of TN (or KY) within 50 miles of our Clarksville contact center at 2971 International Blvd, Clarksville, TN 37040 as this role is onsite in our contact center office.

• Experience: 1+ year of continuous customer service, sales, or technical support, including in-person retail, hospitality food service, or administrative support. Experience in a fast-paced contact center is preferred.

• Customer Focus: Genuine passion for helping others, with proven experience in customer-facing or support roles.

• Technical Skills: Comfortable navigating Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail) and web-based systems to manage customer and vehicle information.

• Professional Readiness: Thrive in a professional in-person contact center environment, collaborating effectively with peers and leaders.

• Flexibility: Availability for evenings, weekends, and peak times as needed.

• Background Check: Must pass a criminal background screening.

• Onsite Role: This is an in-person position located at our Clarksville, TN contact center at 2971 International Blvd, Clarksville, TN 37040. This is not a remote role. Associates hired for this role are expected to work onsite.

Pay, Benefits, & Career Growth:

• Starting Pay: $16.50 per hour

• Bonus and Incentives: Opportunity to earn up to 4% semi-annual performance and attendance bonus + Shift differentials for working after 6pm and on weekends! ($1.75 to $2.50 per hour.)

• Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision; 401(k) with match; Paid Time Off; Tuition Reimbursement; and Complimentary Roadside Assistance.

• Career Growth & Development: Invest in your future with access to online skill-building courses, mentorship, and cross-training programs designed to build the expertise needed for advancement at Agero.

• Compensation Note: Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range presented based on various factors, including, but not limited to, work location, experience, job-related skills, and relevant training and education.

Training and Schedules

• Attendance & Performance: 100% attendance is required during the training period to ensure your success. Your performance will be assessed throughout this time, and you will have ongoing opportunities for cross-training to expand your skills and advance your career.

• Location: This is an in-person position located at our Clarksville, TN contact center at 2971 International Blvd, Clarksville, TN 37040. This is not a remote role. Associates hired for this role are expected to work onsite

• Mandatory Training: Each start date includes four weeks of mandatory paid training (Monday–Friday). Attendance is required and training schedules cannot be modified.

• Production Schedules: After training, you will transition to your selected Production Schedule. These shifts are based on current business needs and vary by start date. Weekends off.

• Full-Time Availability: This is a full-time position only.

• Commitment: Production schedules are static. New hires must keep their selected schedule for 90 days and then are eligible to request changes if desired. All schedule requests are subject to business needs. Our associates participate in semi-annual shift bids.

• Selection Process: Schedules are chosen during the offer process on a first-come, first-served basis. Available shifts are subject to change based on business requirements.

• Kia Care Consumer Affairs Hours of Operation: 08:00 am to 09:00 pm EST. Monday through Friday. Full Time only.

Upcoming Training Classes:

CLASS A: Start Date: Monday, October 26th, 2026 - * * * PLEASE NOTE: THIS START DATE IS FULL AT THIS TIME. * * *

• Training Schedule: 09:00 am to 05:00 pm EST. Monday - Friday for four weeks.

• Production Schedules: Full-Time only. All shift times are listed in Eastern Standard Time (EST). Mids/Afternoons: 12:00 pm - 08:30 pm (Sat/Sun off), 12:30 pm - 09:00 pm (Sat/Sun off)

CLASS B: Start Date: Monday, November 9th, 2026

• Training Schedule: 09:00 am to 05:00 pm EST. Monday - Friday for four weeks.

• Production Schedules: To Be Determined. Actual shift times are still pending and will be posted as soon as they are available. All shifts are full time, between the Kia hours of operation of 08:00 am - 09:00 pm EST, Monday - Friday.

What to Expect After You Apply:

• Immediately after you apply, check your inbox (and Spam folder) for a "Magic Link" from our vendor partner, Harver.

• Complete your Harver Computer Skills Assessment right away. It only takes about 5-10 mins total to do this step.

• Keep an eye on your text messages and email for an update. Qualified candidates will be sent a calendar link to schedule an interview on Zoom with a Recruiter.

Hiring In:

• United States: Clarksville, Tennessee

The anticipated closing date to submit applications for this role is November 11th, 2026 and October 28th, 2026 by 5:00 pm. Join our Greenhouse Candidate Portal to track your application status and receive instant alerts for future openings.

The base salary range presented represents the anticipated low and high end salary range for new hires in this position. Your final base salary will be determined based on factors such as work location, experience, job related skills, and relevant training and education. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package provided by Agero to employees.

National Pay Range

$16.50 per hour USD

Life at Agero:

At Agero, you'll find a workplace where your unique perspective is not just welcomed, it's celebrated. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we're committed to creating an environment where every employee feels a sense of belonging. If you're looking for a company that values your individuality, provides opportunities for growth, and champions open communication, Agero is the place for you. Join our team and help us drive the future of driver assistance, while experiencing a workplace where you can truly thrive.

Benefits Built for Well-being:

Agero’s innovation is driven by a workforce where all associates feel like they can truly thrive. Agero offers a wide range of benefits to promote well-being, encourage personal development, and ensure financial stability. Our benefits include:

• Health and Wellness: Healthcare, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and mental health benefits for associates and their families.

• Financial Security: 401(k) plan with company match and tuition assistance to support your future goals.

• Work-Life Balance: Flexible time off, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually. For Contact Center Roles: Accrual of up to 3 weeks Paid Time Off per year, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually.

• Family Support: Parental planning benefits to assist associates through life’s milestones.

• Bonus/Incentive Programs

Join Agero and experience a workplace that invests in your success both personally and professionally.

*Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full‑time basis. This position is not eligible for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Director, People Experience Operations (HR Connect & Payroll)
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Director, People Experience Operations is a pivotal leadership role within AbbVie's People Experience organization, responsible for delivering seamless, high-quality HR services that support employees and the business globally. This leader oversees two critical operational pillars: HR Connect — AbbVie's global HR contact center responsible for managing and resolving employee inquiries end-to-end — and Payroll — encompassing both in-house and vendor-managed payroll operations across global markets.

This is a role for a rare combination of strategic visionary and operational excellence leader. The Senior Director will drive continuous improvement, modernize service delivery models, and champion the use of AI and emerging technologies to create a more efficient, proactive, and employee-centric People Experience. The ideal candidate brings deep HR operations expertise, a passion for innovation, and the leadership presence to inspire high-performing global teams while influencing cross-functional stakeholders at the most senior levels.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

• Define and execute a forward-looking strategy for HR Connect and Payroll operations that aligns with and advances the broader People Experience vision and AbbVie's enterprise priorities.

• Serve as a thought leader on HR service delivery transformation, benchmarking against industry best practices and identifying opportunities to evolve AbbVie's operating model.

• Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, Finance, IT, and external vendors to ensure integrated, cohesive service delivery.

• Represent the People Experience Operations function in senior leadership forums, influencing strategic decisions and resource investments.

HR Connect — Global HR Contact Center

• Provide executive oversight of AbbVie's global HR contact center, ensuring timely, accurate, and empathetic resolution of employee inquiries across all geographies and channels.

• Set and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and quality standards; drive accountability to continuously improve the employee experience.

• Champion a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge management within HR Connect, ensuring agents are equipped with up-to-date information and tools to resolve inquiries effectively.

• Lead the evolution of HR Connect's service model — including tiered service delivery, self-service expansion, and AI-powered virtual assistance — to increase resolution rates and reduce handle time.

Payroll Operations

• Oversee global payroll operations, including in-house processed payroll and vendor-managed payroll programs across multiple countries and legal entities.

• Ensure payroll accuracy, compliance, and timeliness across all markets, partnering with Finance, Tax, Legal, and regional HR teams to meet regulatory requirements.

• Manage payroll vendor relationships, including contract governance, performance management, and strategic roadmap alignment.

• Lead efforts to standardize, simplify, and automate payroll processes, reducing manual effort and error risk while improving the employee pay experience.

HR Technology Operations

• Oversee global HR Technology operations, including Workday, ServiceNow and other HR platforms that are used internally or with employees

• Develop streamlined capabilities to effectively receive and process stakeholder requests for system improvements, creating criteria for prioritization, and managing capacity to execute

• Coordinate with the HR Technology Strategy lead to ideate and provide practical insights into the HR Technology roadmap, reducing our broader technology footprint while optimizing the use of existing tools and their impact

AI, Innovation & Technology

• Actively identify and champion opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and digital tools to drive operational efficiencies across HR Connect and Payroll functions.

• Partner with HR Technology and IT teams to evaluate, implement, and scale AI-enabled solutions — including intelligent virtual agents, predictive analytics, and automated workflow tools.

• Build an innovation mindset within the team, encouraging experimentation and data-driven decision making to continuously raise the bar on performance and employee experience.

• Stay ahead of emerging HR technology trends and advise senior HR leadership on the implications and opportunities for People Experience operations.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

• Lead, develop, and inspire a diverse, geographically distributed team of HR operations professionals, fostering a high-performance, inclusive culture.

• Set clear expectations, provide meaningful coaching and feedback, and build talent pipelines to ensure organizational resilience and growth.

• Create an environment where team members feel empowered, engaged, and aligned to a shared mission of delivering an exceptional employee experience.

Operational Excellence & Governance

• Establish robust governance frameworks, operational metrics, and reporting cadences to ensure visibility, accountability, and continuous performance improvement across all areas of responsibility.

• Manage operating budgets effectively, identifying efficiencies and ensuring responsible stewardship of resources.

• Develop and maintain business continuity plans for HR Connect and Payroll operations to ensure service resilience in all scenarios.

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 15+ years of progressive HR operations experience, with significant leadership responsibility in HR shared services, contact center operations, or payroll.

• Demonstrated success leading large-scale, global HR operations functions with accountability for service delivery, compliance, and employee experience outcomes.

• Proven ability to design and implement operational improvement programs, including process reengineering and technology-enabled transformation.

• Experience managing in-house and vendor-processed payroll in a multi-country environment.

• Strong understanding of HR technology platforms (e.g., Workday) and HR service delivery models.

• Proven experience leveraging AI and automation tools to drive HR operational efficiencies.

• Executive presence with the ability to communicate, influence, and build relationships at all levels of the organization.

• Demonstrated ability to lead, engage, and develop distributed, diverse teams.

Preferred

• Advanced degree (MBA or Master's in HR or related field).

• Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry.

• Familiarity with global payroll compliance requirements across major markets (US, EU, APAC).

• Prior experience implementing or scaling AI-powered contact center or HR service delivery tools.

Competencies

• Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen

• Operational Excellence & Execution

• Innovation & Change Leadership

• Data-Driven Decision Making

• Executive Communication & Influence

• People Leadership & Talent Development

• Global Mindset & Cultural Agility

The People Experience team is at the heart of how AbbVie attracts, develops, and retains the world-class talent needed to deliver on its mission. jobs.title: Director, Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers. We're just over 2 years old, and more than 7 million teachers from all over the world have joined our platform. Join a top team at a fast growing company that is working towards real social impact. Make an account and try us out at our website https://www.magicschool.ai and connect with our passionate community on our Wall of Love https://love.magicschool.ai/all.



MagicSchool is looking for a Director of Digital Marketing to build and lead our paid and organic acquisition engines. You will own how we reach two audiences: teachers who sign up and use MagicSchool every day, and the schools and districts that partner with us. You will manage a significant budget across paid search, paid social, and display, run our website strategy with a focus on conversion, and shape our lifecycle and email programs.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy, roll up your sleeves to optimize campaigns and channels, and manage a small team and of contractors and  agency partners to deliver results you can measure. You will report to the Chief Marketing Officer and work closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Drive B2C signups and adoption through paid digital channels, balancing volume, quality, and cost efficiency.

 - Generate top-of-funnel leads and pipeline for our B2B sales team across search, paid social, display, and other paid channels.

 - Own the website strategy and roadmap with a focus on conversion rate optimization, including automated A/B testing and publishing in Webflow.

 - Oversee lifecycle and email marketing strategy in partnership with marketing operations to improve activation and retention.

 - Manage and coach our paid digital agency and contractors so that performance is clear, consistent, and strong.

 - Build performance reporting across channels and turn the data into a clear story for leaders and partner teams.

 - Partner with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and the wider marketing team to keep digital marketing aligned with company goals.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS, COMPETENCIES, AND SKILLS

 - Data fluency: You analyze performance data with ease and explain what it means and what to do next in plain language.

 - Ownership: You take full accountability for results and drive work from idea through execution.

 - Collaboration: You work well across marketing, sales, product, and customer success.

 - Coachability: You welcome feedback, apply it quickly, and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: You make sound decisions with incomplete information and adjust as you learn.

 - Mission alignment: You care about improving education through technology.
   
   


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - Director-level experience managing a multi-million dollar marketing budget.

 - Several years of hands-on and managerial experience in search engine marketing (Google Ads and Bing Ads), with a record of ROI-positive campaigns across global markets.

 - Deep experience running paid social campaigns, especially on Meta and LinkedIn.

 - A proven ability to drive both B2C user acquisition and B2B demand generation.

 - Experience managing web developers and overseeing website strategy.

Nice to have: experience with Iterable or a similar lifecycle email platform, Webflow (including automated A/B testing and CMS publishing), reporting tools such as Looker, Metabase, Amplitude, or HockeyStack, a background in edtech or mission-driven SaaS, and experience briefing and managing creative production for paid campaigns.



Why Join Us?

 - Work on cutting-edge AI technology that directly impacts educators and students.

 - Join a mission-driven team passionate about making education more efficient and equitable.

 - Flexibility of working from home, while fostering a unique culture built on relationships, trust, communication, and collaboration with our team - no matter where they live.

For full time employees:

 - Unlimited time off to empower our employees to manage their work-life balance. We work hard for our teachers and users, and encourage our employees to rest and take the time they need.

 - Choice of employer-paid health insurance plans so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Dental and vision are also offered at very low premiums.

 - Every employee is offered generous stock options, vested over 4 years.

 - 401k match & monthly wellness stipend.



Our Values:

 - Educators are Magic:  Educators are the most important ingredient in the educational process - they are the magic, not the AI. Trust them, empower them, and put them at the center of leading change in service of students and families.

 - Joy and Magic: Bring joy and magic into every learning experience - push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

 - Community:  Foster community that supports one another during a time of rapid technological change. Listen to them and serve their needs.

 - Innovation:  The education system is outdated and in need of innovation and change - AI is an opportunity to bring equity, access, and serve the individual needs of students better than we ever have before.

 - Responsibility: Put responsibility and safety at the forefront of the technological change that AI is bringing to education.

 - Diversity: Diversity of thought, perspectives, and backgrounds helps us serve the wide audience of educators and students around the world.

 - Excellence:  Educators and students deserve the best - and we strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Associate Director, Chief of Staff – People Experience (PE) serves as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the PE Leadership Team, driving the execution and acceleration of the People Experience vision. This role is a core member of the PE leadership team, responsible for optimizing the PE organization itself — how it operates, prioritizes, plans, and delivers against its agenda. The Chief of Staff acts as an integrator, communicator, and accelerator, translating PE's vision into tangible outcomes and ensuring the PE team functions at its highest potential.

Note: This role is focused on PE organizational optimization — not broad HR optimization, which is a shared accountability across the entire PE team. The Chief of Staff ensures PE as an organization runs with excellence, coherence, and strategic clarity.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision Acceleration

• Partner with the Head of People Experience and PE leadership to define, refine, and cascade the PE vision and multi-year strategy.

• Identify and resolve strategic gaps, dependencies, and opportunities that affect execution of the PE agenda.

• Serve as a thought partner to senior PE leaders, bringing an enterprise perspective and anticipating organizational needs before they arise.

• Synthesize complex information and distill it into clear, compelling narratives for leadership and stakeholders.

PE Organizational Optimization

• Own the continuous improvement of how the PE organization operates — including how the team is structured to deliver, how decisions get made, and how work gets done.

• Drive clarity on roles, accountabilities, and interdependencies across PE sub-functions to eliminate duplication and increase team effectiveness.

• Identify operational inefficiencies within PE and implement scalable solutions to improve team performance and output quality.

• Partner with PE leaders to assess and evolve the operating model as the team's scope and strategy evolve.

• Note: Broad HR optimization (e.g., improving HR programs and services for the enterprise) is a shared responsibility across the entire PE team. This role is specifically accountable for optimizing the PE organization itself.

Prioritization & Portfolio Management

• Lead and manage the PE Leadership Team's portfolio of strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment to top priorities and business outcomes.

• Drive rigorous prioritization frameworks to focus PE resources on the highest-value work.

• Track progress against strategic goals and OKRs; escalate risks and recommend course corrections as needed.

• Partner with Finance and HR Operations on PE resource planning and investment decisions.

Rhythms of Business & Operating Model

• Design, own, and continuously improve the rhythms of business for the PE organization, including leadership team meetings, planning cycles, business reviews, and all-hands communications.

• Prepare and curate agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up actions for PE Leadership Team meetings to ensure productive, outcome-oriented sessions.

• Coordinate and manage annual and quarterly planning processes, connecting PE plans to broader AbbVie enterprise cycles.

• Build and maintain a PE operating calendar that ensures key milestones, deliverables, and decisions are managed proactively.

• Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

• Strong executive communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to synthesize complexity for senior audiences.

• High learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

Preferred

• Prior Chief of Staff, HR Strategy, or HR Business Partner experience at a large, matrixed organization.

• Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry.

• Familiarity with organizational design, change management, and workforce planning methodologies.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Location: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

Role Scope

Habitat Health is looking for a Product Manager to own strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes across our clinical and business applications portfolio — including EHR, CRM, Call Platform, Risk Suspecting, and ancillary clinical applications.

This role would be accountable for knowing the problem space deeply, deciding what gets built and in what order, and proving that what shipped actually worked. You'll run discovery with clinical, growth, and operational stakeholders, define clear requirements and success metrics, prioritize a backlog against a real prioritization framework, and partner with technical and vendor teams to deliver against it. You'll work closely with Platform, Clinical, Operations, and Growth leaders — not just to gather requirements, but to shape what the roadmap should be, defend trade-offs with data, and drive adoption once features ship.

Primary Areas of Responsibility
●    Own and evolve the product roadmap across the clinical and business applications portfolio, using a structured prioritization framework to balance strategic bets against operational demand
●    Lead product discovery — engaging clinical and business stakeholders and end users directly to surface real workflow pain points, not just intake tickets — and translate findings into clear problem statements
●    Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria; partner with technical and vendor delivery teams (Epic/OCHIN, Salesforce, TalkDesk, and others) to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery
●    Maintain the product backlog end to end, balancing new capabilities, enhancements, and technical debt
●    Work with business stakeholders to define success metrics and KPIs for each initiative, track adoption and outcomes post-launch, and use that data to inform the next iteration of the roadmap
●    Partner with PACE Center Leadership, the Office of the CMO, Population Health, Practice Operations, Finance, Strategy, Growth, and Health Plan Operations to align product direction with business strategy
●    Partner with Operations leadership to drive adoption of new rollouts — closing training gaps through documentation, demos, and change management
●    Coordinate with multiple vendors, escalating to leadership when vendor needs to be held accountable to scope, documentation, and delivery timelines
●    Facilitate stakeholder and steering meetings, and represent the voice of the product to senior leadership
●    Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, exercising sound independent judgment to identify issues, evaluate options, make recommendations, and drive matters to resolution

Qualifications
●    Aligns with our purpose and our values, and is excited about living those out in daily practice
●    3+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in healthcare, health tech, or another complex, highly regulated operational environment
●    Demonstrated ability to run discovery, write clear requirements/user stories, and prioritize a backlog using a defined framework rather than by loudest voice
●    Comfort using success metrics and relevant data to make and defend prioritization calls for review/sign-off
●    Excellent communication skills and ability to facilitate cross-departmental meetings, including senior leadership as well as line-level staff
●    Strong documentation skills, especially product requirement docs, roadmap artifacts, and PowerPoint/board-ready materials
●    Proficiency with MS Office suite, backlog/roadmap tooling, and visualization tools

Nice to Have
●    Experience with Salesforce, TalkDesk, and/or Epic
●    Formal product management training or certification (e.g., CSPO, Pragmatic Institute)
●    Experience with Agile methodology, including working as or with a SCRUM team
●    Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR) or EHR data models
●    PACE experience

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $148,000 – $170,000 for candidates located in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, and $135,000 – $153,000 for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of the base salary and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

Because this is a remote position, employment will be governed by the laws applicable to the employee’s work location, and applicable legal requirements will be followed.

Vaccination Policy, including COVID-19

To help maintain a safe environment for our participants and team members, Habitat Health maintains vaccination and infection control policies applicable to certain roles and work locations. For COVID-19 and influenza, team members who are working in a participant care setting are required to provide either proof of vaccination or a signed declination form and comply with applicable masking requirements while in a care setting to the extent permitted by law in the applicable jurisdiction.

Habitat Health will consider requests for reasonable accommodation based on an applicant's disability, medical condition, or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance in accordance with applicable law.

As a condition of employment, team members are expected to comply with all applicable infection control protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and vaccination requirements associated with their role and work location, and to the extent required by law and as permitted in the applicable jurisdiction.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Habitat Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to the principles of equal opportunity and inclusion. Employment decisions at Habitat Health are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, reproductive health decision-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Habitat Health is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. Consistent with applicable law, we provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to individuals with religious beliefs, practices, or observances that require accommodation.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform the essential functions of a position, or receive other employment benefits and privileges, please contact us at careers@habitathealth.com.

We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

E-Verify Participation Notice

Habitat Health participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with information from your Form I-9 to confirm your authorization to work in the United States.

If E-Verify cannot confirm your authorization to work, Habitat Health will provide you with written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and/or the Social Security Administration (SSA) to resolve the issue before any adverse employment action is taken, including termination of employment.

E-Verify is used only after an applicant has accepted an offer of employment and completed the Form I-9 and to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Habitat Health complies with all federal and state employment eligibility verification requirements.

Beware of Scams and Fraud

Habitat Health is committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment scams. Please ensure that you submit applications only through Habitat Health's official careers website or authorized job boards.

Official communications from Habitat Health recruiters and team members will come from email addresses ending in @habitathealth.com. Habitat Health will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment, or provide sensitive financial information as part of the recruiting or hiring process.

If you receive suspicious communications claiming to represent Habitat Health, we encourage you to exercise caution and independently verify the communication before responding.

If you believe you have been the victim of a recruitment scam or fraudulent job posting, please report the incident to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) through its fraud reporting website at reportfraud.ftc.gov.

jobs.title: Partner Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.




THE ROLE

Baseten has emerging co-sells relationships with multiple strategic marketplaces and clouds, including OpenAI https://www.baseten.co/talk-to-us/openai/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_campaign=acquisition_ICA-OpenAI-Partnership_2026-09-30&utm_term=baseten%20openai&utm_campaign=Search+-+Models&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&utm_id=24316507588&hsa_acc=9990356727&hsa_cam=24316507588&hsa_grp=199416272086&hsa_ad=826599669780&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-2504168645905&hsa_kw=baseten%20openai&hsa_mt=e&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=24316507588&gbraid=0AAAAAqCKh1tZ-ESp-CbtgHnyoj6pkRZGL&gclid=CjwKCAjw56zWBhB0EiwAdPOQOTzW3Bhx_UxkJI6XA8gB1rqClDpNVWFQtTzWlO0RBCV5Xx_yB54yDxoCcd4QAvD_BwE, NVIDIA and other Hyperscalers, Model Labs, and Data Platforms. The task at hand is to enable and activate partner sellers and as ensuring as our internal field teams are well-support to run partner motions.

As Baseten’s Partner Enablement Lead, you'll turn each partnership into a repeatable field motion. You'll work out why a partner account executive should care about Baseten, which of their customers are a fit, and what joint execution looks like. Then you'll co-build what it takes for sellers on both sides to run that play: the value proposition, the account mapping, the talk tracks, the training, and the relationships with partner field leaders.

As always, the work starts with earning partner attention. This is a strategic, hands-on role for an ecosystem GTM operator who peaks in enablement. Your work will include deep cross-functional collaboration, instructional design, content development, and training delivery. You won't own partner-sourced pipeline directly, but you will make those who do much more effective.

Our partnerships span Hyperscalers, Model Labs, Semiconductors, Consulting and Systems Integrators, and Data Platforms. While much of what partner enablement looks will be in your hands to define, it will include getting in front of field sellers, developing co-sell opportunities, and driving adoption of marketplace incentives for customers to buy Baseten against the commitments they already have.

You'll report to the Head of GTM Enablement & Productivity and work closely with our Partnerships, Sales, FDE, Marketing, and RevOps teams.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design the joint go-to-market motion with strategic partners

 - Build a working picture of each partner's field: seller roles, how they're paid and measured, what makes them bring in a third party, and what gets in the way.

 - Define joint value propositions, customer triggers, and target segments in partnership with our alliance leads and sales & revops leadership.

 - Turn those into co-sell plays with clear entry points, owners, and next steps for both sides.

 - Run account mapping with partner teams so the plays land on specific accounts, not just slides.

Activate partner field teams

 - Activate partner sellers and their managers to be aware of Baseten, confident in when to pull us in, and motivated to do so.

 - Build relationships with partner field leaders, partner development managers, and ISV teams so enablement reaches the sellers who matter.

 - Plan and run activations by region and segment: field briefings, account planning sessions, joint office hours, and events alongside our partner marketing team.

 - Teach both sides how marketplace and co-sell mechanics work, so those programs make deals simpler and faster to execute.

Enable Baseten's own sellers on partner motions

 - Make sure our AEs, SAs, and FDEs know how to work a partner-sourced or co-sell deal: how to engage the partner rep, how attribution and credit work, and which plays to run.

 - Build or collate the playbooks, demos, and certifications our team needs, and keep them current as each partnership changes.

 - Bring partner content into our onboarding and GTM Academy so new hires learn the partner motion from day one.

Measure it and keep it running

 - Define how we measure activation: trained and engaged partner sellers, joint account plans, co-sell opportunities registered, and partner-influenced pipeline.

 - Work with RevOps on the operational side of partner programs, including deal registration, marketplace private offers, and POC and MDF requests.

 - Report monthly to GTM leadership on what's working, what isn't, and advise on where to invest next.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in partner or alliance GTM, partner enablement, or field GTM at a cloud, data, AI, or infrastructure company.

 - Hands-on experience activating co-sell with at least one hyperscaler or major platform partner (Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, NVIDIA, or similar).

 - You think in pipeline and seller behavior as well as in curriculum. You can explain a joint motion end to end, from partner incentives to the first customer meeting.

 - Enough technical depth to be credible with SAs and engineers on both sides. You don't need to be an ML engineer, but you should be comfortable learning inference, model serving, and GPU economics quickly.

 - You want to build: the play, the deck, the training, the measurement plan. You don't stop at the framework.

 - Comfortable working across teams you don't control, inside Baseten and inside partner organizations much larger than ours.

Strong candidates may come from a mix of backgrounds such as:

 - Cloud alliances or partner GTM at a data or infrastructure ISV that co-sells with the hyperscalers.

 - ISV, partner development, or marketplace roles inside a hyperscaler or NVIDIA.

 - Partner enablement leadership at a technical company, with a track record tied to pipeline rather than training volume.

 - A partner-facing SA or SE who moved into enablement or GTM strategy.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Microsoft co-sell programs, Azure Marketplace, or NVIDIA's partner and ISV programs.

 - Experience at an AI infrastructure, model provider, or developer platform company.

 - Built a partner function or partner enablement program from scratch at a growth-stage company.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs are now one company. Together we build the data movement and transformation tools that data teams around the world rely on. Our Analytics team runs on those same tools every day, so you'll work on a modern data stack and help set best practices for the industry. As a Senior Product Analyst, you'll help product leaders understand how customers adopt, use, and stay with our core Fivetran data movement and dbt platform products as well as new product releases spanning AI, BI, and compute. You'll be a "full-stack" analyst. You'll build the data models, define the metrics, create the dashboards, run the analysis, and turn it all into recommendations that shape what we build next. AI is part of how we work. We expect analysts to use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate analysis and increase efficiency, while applying their own judgment and validating the results. This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based in Oakland, CA. Our hybrid work model offers remote flexibility and in-person collaboration; there is no fixed number of required office days, and we encourage teams to meet in person regularly.

Why This Role Is Exciting

• Two product portfolios just came together. Many questions about how customers use Fivetran and dbt together have never been asked. You'll be one of the first people to answer them.

• Your work drives leadership decisions. You'll focus on adoption, engagement, and retention, the metrics product leaders use to decide where to invest.

• You own the work end to end, from raw data to the decision it informs.

• You'll analyze products built for people like you. Our customers are data teams.

Technologies You’ll Use

• SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)

• dbt / dbt State

• Looker / LookML / Omni

• Hex / Sigma / Google Sheets

• Claude Code / Codex

What You’ll Do

• Partner with product managers and product line leaders to understand problems and potential solutions with data. Deliver regular analysis and insight on product adoption, engagement, and retention.

• Proactively investigate trends in user behavior and product usage. Find issues and growth opportunities before anyone asks, and use them to shape product and growth strategy.

• Define, measure, and monitor the KPIs that show whether our products are healthy and whether the company is on track.

• Size the potential impact of new product initiatives and recommend how to prioritize them.

• Analyze product launches and experiments, and recommend what to do next.

• Find and reduce friction in the funnels users go through to sign up, activate, and adopt our products.

• Tackle questions where product data meets broader business data, such as revenue, sales, and support.

• Build and maintain the data models, metrics, and dashboards behind your work.

• Help new hires, colleagues, and partners understand our data and use it well, so data-informed decisions become the norm.

Skills We’re Looking For

• 5+ years in analytics, mostly in product analytics, ideally at a high-growth B2B or SaaS company.

• Advanced SQL. You can turn messy, raw data into clean, trustworthy datasets, and write, debug, and explain SQL yourself.

• Comfort using AI tools in analytics workflows to explore data, draft or improve SQL, automate repetitive work, and synthesize findings. You can evaluate and validate AI-generated output.

• Hands-on experience building data models, ideally with dbt, creating dashboards in a BI tool such as Looker, Omni, or Tableau, and performing funnel, cohort, and segmentation analysis.

• A track record of using analysis to drive product or business decisions, not just report on them. You can take an open-ended question with little direction and turn it into a clear analysis and recommendation.

• Strong attention to detail and prioritization. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain findings to executives and technical tradeoffs to engineers.

• Experience influencing cross-functional, distributed teams, both asynchronously and in real time.

Bonus Skills​

• Experience designing and analyzing experiments (A/B/n tests), including test design, sample size, significance, and turning results into launch decisions.

• Deep knowledge of the SaaS customer lifecycle and business metrics, such as ARR (annual recurring revenue), retention, and expansion.

• Experience defining product events and helping teams self-serve in product analytics tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.

• Experience developing and scaling a large dbt project.

• Python or R for analysis.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Identity, Data Security and Trust
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.



We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer across our Identity, Data Security and Trust organization. These teams builds the security backbone of Snowflake — enabling customers to confidently bring their most sensitive data and workloads to the Data Cloud, empowering every Snowflake engineer to deliver the most secure platform at scale, and giving customers the tools to monitor, achieve, and maintain a strong security, governance, privacy, and compliance posture. As the agentic era accelerates, these teams are at the forefront of building AI-native security capabilities that protect the world's data.




AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Design and implement critical AI security capabilities — including controlled, audited agent workflows, MCP server and client security, agent identity frameworks, and admin guardrails — that form the foundation for secure agentic enterprise adoption

 - Build and evolve foundational identity and access management systems, including authentication protocols, SSO integrations, multi-factor authentication, OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and fine-grained RBAC that scales to millions of objects and users

 - Design and develop core security infrastructure spanning secret management, key management, service identity, and end-to-end encryption across a natively multi-cloud environment

 - Build and maintain security tooling to define, monitor, enforce, and detect policy violations across the platform; implement automation and self-service processes that increase developer autonomy and promote secure-by-default engineering

 - Design and implement extensible, plug-and-play platform components that enable first-, second-, and third-party security detectors, responders, and visualizations to be built on top of Snowflake's Trust Center

 - Leverage industry-accredited benchmarks (e.g., CIS) to develop standards-based security posture assessments; contribute to behavioral analytics pipelines and PII attribution capabilities that help detect, prevent, and respond to threats and abuse vectors

 - Partner with engineering teams across the company to understand security pain points and deliver solutions that reduce friction without compromising safety

 - Lead the design and enforcement of secure network architectures to actively defend against ransomware attacks and detect sophisticated data exfiltration attempts.

 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and on-call rotations; hold a high bar for code quality, reliability, and sound technical decisions




OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 5+ years of industry experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems in production cloud environments

 - Strong foundational computer science skills — data structures, algorithms, systems design, and distributed computing

 - Proficiency in one or more of Java, C++, Python, Golang, or Rust, with solid SQL skills for data-driven features

 - Experience shipping and on-calling production services with a focus on availability, reliability, and observability

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach to engineering — comfortable iterating quickly and working across PM, design, and peer engineering teams

 - BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Knowledge of identity and access management concepts and protocols — SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC, Federation, MFA, or RBAC

 - Familiarity with security infrastructure domains such as secret management, key management, service identity, authentication, or authorization

 - Experience with database internals, query engines, or data platform systems

 - Exposure to machine learning or AI systems, particularly applied to anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, or risk classification

 - Contributions to developer platforms, SDKs, or multi-tenant extensibility frameworks

 - Experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes or production cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)




WHY JOIN OUR IDENTITY, DATA SECURITY AND TRUST TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

These teams sit at a rare intersection: the security, identity, infrastructure, and customer trust layers of one of the fastest-growing data platforms in the world. You won't be maintaining someone else's security layer; you'll be defining it. These are teams that value craft, curiosity, and collaboration, and that take pride in making complex security invisible to the developers and customers who depend on it. If you want a role where your technical decisions matter and your growth is tied directly to the scale of the platform you're protecting — and you're energized by the challenge of securing the agentic era before it fully arrives — this is it.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Investigations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

OKX's Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to the company across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth and development by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced group of lawyers who enjoy the cutting-edge nature of our work and the digital assets industry.

Sitting in the Legal department, the Corporate Investigations team investigates fraud, misconduct and abuse committed against OKX. The team includes experienced investigators, among them former federal agents, and partners closely with the Compliance, Risk, Finance, and HR departments, colleagues in the Legal department, and business executives across OKX's global footprint.

About the Opportunity

This is a senior, high-impact role for a former federal prosecutor who wants to build and lead a global investigations function. The Head of Corporate Investigations will be the single accountable owner for investigating wrongdoing against OKX and developing these matters for appropriate recovery and civil or criminal enforcement as warranted.

As OKX's most senior investigations leader, you will set the standard for how the company uncovers and responds to wrongdoing, leading investigations that reflect the highest standards and best practices in the field. This is an opportunity to build a world-class investigations program, one whose rigor, independence and integrity protect OKX's people, assets and reputation

Where an investigation warrants it, you will be responsible for bringing matters to the appropriate authorities in the US, EMEA and APAC, ensuring each case is built to a prosecutorial standard and supported through to any civil or criminal resolution.

We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services. Extensive international travel on short notice expected in this role.

What You'll Be Doing

• Lead the function and the team. Set the strategy, standards and methodology for internal investigations globally. Own intake, triage and prioritization. Manage and develop a team of investigators that includes former agents.

• Run investigations. Direct investigations from allegations through findings, including interview strategy, subject and witness interviews, digital forensics and financial tracing. Personally lead the most complex and sensitive matters.

• Build cases to a prosecutorial standard. Own OKX's framework for deciding which matters warrant escalation to authorities and in which jurisdiction. Build strong cases to the evidentiary and procedural standards of that jurisdiction, and partner with the Litigation team to pursue recovery of losses.

• Manage engagement with authorities. Where matters are brought to the attention of authorities, oversee OKX's engagement through to resolution, including providing evidence, making witnesses available and responding to legal process, as appropriate.

• Own law enforcement relationships. Build and maintain relationships and networks with law enforcement and prosecutors worldwide, including federal, state and local authorities in the US, EMEA and APAC.

• Partner across the company. Work with Compliance, Risk, Finance, HR, colleagues in the Legal department, and business executives to investigate and resolve matters effectively.

• Strengthen controls and report to leadership. Translate investigative findings into control improvements that prevent recurrence. Report significant matters and trends to senior leadership.

What We Look For In You

• Prior service as an Assistant United States Attorney is required. Experience as a trial attorney in the DOJ Criminal Division, such as the Fraud Section, will also be considered.

• A substantial record of investigating, charging and trying federal white-collar and fraud cases, including leading grand jury investigations and working closely with federal agents.

• A deep understanding of what makes a case prosecutable and what prosecutors and police need before they will accept one.

• In-house or law firm experience leading investigations required.

• A JD and membership in a US state bar.

• 15+ years of legal experience.

• Experience leading and developing investigative teams, including former law enforcement professionals.

• Sound, proportionate judgment, with a commitment to fairness and due process for the individuals under investigation.

• Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear findings to senior leadership and credible presentations to law enforcement.

• Discretion, integrity and composure in sensitive, high-stakes matters.

• A self-starter who is comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage, multicultural environment and across global time zones.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and earn the trust of stakeholders at every level.

Nice to Haves

• Experience in financial services or digital assets.

• Exposure to cases involving cryptocurrency or blockchain tracing.

• Experience engaging with foreign law enforcement and prosecutors, or with international cooperation mechanisms such as MLATs, particularly in Asia-Pacific.

• Supervisory experience within a US Attorney's Office, such as a unit chief or deputy chief.

• Global investigations experience.

• Language capabilities: Mandarin

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

• Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer I - Platform Billing Experience
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

Billing powers Elastic's Cloud business. It runs across AWS, GCP, and Azure in over 50 regions. We oversee usage-based metering, consumption billing, and marketplace integrations at global scale.

The Billing Experience team owns the customer-facing layer of our billing systems. We build and maintain the public and internal APIs, as well as the billing and account pages within Elastic Cloud consoles. Our goal is to make it easy for customers and internal teams to understand and manage their billing data.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to drive technical direction within the Billing Experience domain. This is a hands-on role. You will design APIs, shape user-facing systems, and work across teams. You will help our billing services grow in scale, reliability, and developer productivity. You will work closely with Product, Design, SRE, and Cloud Infrastructure teams.

What You Will Be Doing :

• Own complex billing and account management systems, including public APIs, internal APIs, and Cloud console experiences.

• Lead API design and evolution — set standards for contract stability, versioning, and developer experience across internal and external consumers.

• Build and improve full-stack features in Elastic Cloud consoles, from backend services to frontend billing and account UIs.

• Improve observability, incident response, and reliability of billing-facing services using modern DevOps practices.

• Shape system architecture for scale and modularity. Guide service design, API structure, and data modeling.

• Work with SRE and Cloud teams to improve deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Be the go-to technical reviewer for the billing experience stack. Maintain technical consistency and quality standards.

• Mentor engineers and tech leads across the Billing organization. Help raise the bar on design and operational standards.

• Work with Product, Design, and Finance to set roadmap priorities. Make sure plans are feasible and aligned with business goals.

• Take part in on-call rotations. Make sure systems are production-ready through automation, resilience testing, and alerting.

What You Bring :

• 8+ years in backend or full-stack engineering, with solid skills in API design and development.

• Proven experience building and maintaining developer-facing or customer-facing APIs at scale.

• Solid background in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including networking, IAM, monitoring, and deployment.

• Experience with frontend technologies used in console or dashboard products is a plus (React or similar).

• Ability to lead multi-quarter projects across teams — building consensus and delivering results.

• Track record of mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and raising engineering standards.

• Experience with SaaS billing, metering, or financial systems is a real plus.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills. Able to influence across teams and speak to both technical and non-technical partners.

• Comfortable working on your own in a global, distributed, and async environment.

• Able to work across projects, collaborate across functions and teams, and adapt to changing team structures.

• Track record of using AI to accelerate up development, debug complex systems, and improve code quality — while owning the outcomes.

• Eligible to work in Department of Defense (DoD) Impact Level 4 or above cloud service environments.

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

You will design APIs, shape user-facing systems, and work across teams. You will help our billing services grow in scale, reliability, and developer productivity. You will work closely with Product, Design, SRE, and Cloud Infrastructure teams.
