jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer, Dive-LD
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of seabed exploration. Anduril has brought to the market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform, and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "large" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on multi-million-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer to join our new team in Quonset, RI. In this role, you will be responsible for working inside and outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver for AUV integration. You will help drive Anduril's internal quality management system to meet AS9100 customer requirements and scaling into our new facility. You will partner across the product development organization, production organization, and field operations organizations. This role will be dynamic and full of new engagement, challenges, and opportunities. If you are someone who has passion for the quality of their work, is hands-on with engineering, production, and vendors, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

This role focuses on integration for the AUV and all the sub-systems. The right person for this role will have the knowledge of manufacturing, integration, sub-system performance criteria, and metrology that builds confidence with defense customers. If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Partner with the manufacturing engineering, production, and development engineers to support the quality of the integration process for components such as underwater sensors/equipment, PCBAs, cables, wiring harness, actuators, machined parts and structures, etc. Conduct audits and inspections to ensure compliance with quality standards. Partner with development engineers to create, define, develop, and implement inspection systems.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the product build and inspection requirements to meet our customer quality requirements.

• Lead the non-conformance review (NCR) process for vehicle integration: Identify defects and flaws in vehicle and subsystem assembly, identify issues and implement corrective actions, and support the usage of coordinate systems, envelopes, and interfaces for system integration.

• Lead the Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) process for integration, incident management system and Material Review Board (MRB) activities for aircraft programs, while owning containments for prototype builds and production.

• Support the incoming inspection processes and integration process for quality documentation, planning, and metrics for effectiveness.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or similar technical field

• 2+ years of experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality in complex assembly and production processes

• Working knowledge of quality management in defense or other highly regulated environment (AS9100 etc.)

• Experience driving product quality and performance requirements to test and measurement system development and optimization.

• Experience partnering with Manufacturing Engineering, chief engineers, development engineers, and customer facing team members to deliver to customer requirements.

• Working knowledge of product development methodologies such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) elements such as Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

• Working knowledge of mechanical and/or electrical manufacturing processes

• Application of industry standards and best practices

• A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects from start to completion

• Previous experience working with PLM and MES systems

• Analytical skills and experiences for data mining, data quality, metrics generation, issue management systems, and statistical analysis tools (MatLab, JMP, MiniTab, etc)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of experience with developing quality systems for low volume, high complex manufacturing environments and suppliers

• Working knowledge of AS9100/ AS6500 / ISO 9001-based Quality Management System requirements

• Experience with IPC standards and general workmanship standards

• Experience with government contracts and MIL standard requirements commonly applied to quality requirements for aerial vehicles

• Experience with Teamcenter, SolidWorks/NX, Jira, Foundry, and manufacturing execution systems

• Familiarity with Manufacturing Readiness Levels a plus

US Salary Range

$86,000—$112,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Settlement & Notary
jobs.description:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.

We design workflow software and AI-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.

We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.


THE OPPORTUNITY

More than one billion notarizations take place in the United States each year, supporting consequential transactions across real estate, financial services, legal services, automotive, wealth management, and other regulated industries. Yet much of the work required to schedule signings, find qualified notaries, manage documents, communicate with participants, and resolve exceptions still happens through phone calls, email, and disconnected systems.



Snapdocs provides trusted infrastructure for high-stakes transactions—transactions where the parties may not know or trust one another, mistakes carry real consequences, and the resulting records must withstand legal, regulatory, investor, and customer scrutiny. We earned our credibility by modernizing residential mortgage closings at scale, and became the market leader. Now, we’re taking on the broader notarization market, with a vision to make Snapdocs the trusted platform for every high-stakes notarization—across industries, wherever and however it happens.



Customer Success is central to realizing this opportunity. This role will help customers redesign operational workflows, adopt new in-person and remote notarization capabilities, and demonstrate measurable business value. The Customer Success Manager will also translate customer needs and early market learnings into product, operational, and go-to-market decisions as Snapdocs expands into new industries and use cases.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the customer relationship and commercial outcome. Serve as the accountable post-sale owner for a portfolio of Notary Connect and Snapdocs RON customers, with responsibility for customer health, value realization, retention, growth, and relationship continuity.

 - Develop the account strategy. Build a deep understanding of each customer’s business, operating model, notarization workflows, stakeholders, goals, and growth plans. Maintain account success plans in Salesforce that document customer objectives, stakeholder coverage, milestones, adoption gaps, risks, renewal strategy, expansion opportunities, and forecasts.

 - Drive measurable value realization. Establish customer baselines, target outcomes, and success measures such as hard-cost savings, time-to-value, signing volume, utilization, service quality, exception handling, and participant experience. Quantify realized value and build the business case for continued and broader adoption.

 - Build executive alignment and customer champions. Develop durable, multi-threaded relationships with executives, operational leaders, administrators, schedulers, and end users. Build champions and align decision-makers across operations, technology, finance, legal, compliance, and executive leadership.

 - Lead the customer operating cadence. Run operating reviews, executive business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and escalation communications that connect product usage and service performance to realized value, customer priorities, risks, and agreed next steps.

 - Accelerate adoption and utilization. Lead the post-launch customer journey in partnership with Implementation, including pilots, rollout planning, training, change management, release readiness, and ongoing optimization. Design and execute plays that close adoption and utilization gaps, introduce new capabilities, and increase customer value.

 - Provide product and workflow guidance. Demonstrate Notary Connect and Snapdocs RON, answer customer questions, recommend workflow best practices, and bring in the appropriate internal expert when deeper product, technical, operational, legal, or compliance expertise is required.

 - Own renewals and expansion. Lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through close. Identify and qualify opportunities across business units, locations, transaction volume, signing types, mobile and remote workflows, service models, and integrations. Build the value case, develop the commercial offer, negotiate terms and tradeoffs within approved guardrails, align the customer’s buying group, and maintain accurate forecasts. Partner with Sales and Solutions Consulting when additional commercial or technical support is needed.

 - Own service delivery and escalations. Coordinate across Operations, the notary network, Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, and Accounting to keep customer commitments on track. Own escalations through resolution, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and address underlying issues—not only immediate symptoms.

 - Turn customer insight into organizational advantage. Synthesize recurring customer feedback, market patterns, and competitive signals into actionable input for Product, Operations, and go-to-market teams. Build reusable playbooks, customer stories, and operating practices that help Snapdocs scale successfully across new customers, verticals, and use cases.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR




REQUIRED

 - At least five years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic account management, or a related customer-facing role in a software or technology-enabled services business, including experience owning mid-market or enterprise customer relationships.

 - Demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes within an installed customer base, including renewals, expansion, and upsell. You have built value cases, developed commercial offers, navigated negotiations, influenced buying groups, maintained accurate forecasts, and advanced opportunities through close.

 - A track record of driving customer adoption and measurable value in a business where transaction volume, product usage, utilization, or service performance affects the value delivered.

 - Experience using customer, product, service, and financial data to identify risks and opportunities, quantify business value, and recommend actions.

 - Strong executive communication and business acumen. You can understand a customer’s business, define what success looks like, and explain realized and potential value clearly to executive buyers and operational stakeholders.

 - Experience developing relationships across complex customer organizations, including building champions and aligning stakeholders across operations, technology, finance, legal, compliance, and executive leadership.

 - Experience leading customer enablement, workflow change, and adoption programs, including training, rollout planning, and ongoing optimization.

 - Strong project and portfolio management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate cross-functional teams, and own customer commitments and escalations through resolution.

 - The ability to learn a complex product and service model quickly, demonstrate it confidently, and explain it clearly to customers and internal teams.

 - High agency and structured judgment. You take ownership in ambiguous situations, answer questions directly, use relevant evidence, and communicate complex ideas concisely.


STRONGLY PREFERRED

 - Experience across both new-business sales and post-sale account ownership, ideally including experience as an Account Executive followed by a role in Customer Success or Account Management.

 - Experience in fintech, mortgage technology, real estate, legal services, financial services, or another regulated and operationally complex industry.

 - Experience with a marketplace, network, service-linked, transaction-based, consumption-based, or utilization-based business model.

 - Experience helping customers move human-centered or manually coordinated services toward technology-enabled delivery.

 - Experience with Salesforce or a similar customer and revenue platform, including maintaining account plans, customer health information, renewal and expansion opportunities, and forecasts.




AI FLUENCY IS A REQUIREMENT

AI fluency is a standard for every hire at Snapdocs. For this role, that means using approved AI tools in repeatable workflows that improve account research, customer preparation, written communication, and follow-through while protecting customer data. Be ready to walk through a real workflow, what the tool did, what you checked, and where you made the final call.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

We believe in being upfront about pay. 

 - Base Salary: $107,000 - $145,000

This role is also eligible for a 30% variable component, bringing total on-target earnings to:

 - OTE: $139,100 - $188,500

Where you land within the range depends on your experience, skills, and how you'll make an impact in the role. In addition to base salary and variable compensation, this position includes meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Snapdocs

We’re here to transform one of the most critical and complex industries in the world. That requires a team that is curious, driven, thoughtful, and practical. We value:

 - Product discipline and clear reasoning

 - Deep ownership of outcomes (not just tasks)

 - Straightforward, honest communication

 - Empathy for the people who use our software

This is a place for people who want to solve hard, meaningful problems with real economic impact — not just ship features.




JOIN US

We’re expanding our product suite and the network it connects. To do that, we need people who are excited by complexity, energized by scale, and motivated to make a tangible dent in how the mortgage ecosystem works. If you’re hungry to learn, build, and lead — you’ll do the best work of your career here.

To support our team, we offer a comprehensive & thoughtful benefits package for all full-time employees, which includes:

 - Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - 401(k) with up to 4% company match

 - 16 weeks of paid parental leave

 - Flexible Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 Sick Days for exempt roles

 - Generous Accrued Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 sick days for non-exempt roles

 - Summer & Winter Break (~1-week each) + 9 Holidays per year

 - Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

 - HSA Employer Contribution ($75-150 for individuals, $150-$250 for families)

 - $15K Family Building Benefit (lifetime limit)

 - Life and Disability Insurance

 - $1,500 Annual Lifestyle Stipend to support your well-being

Please note: Part-time employees are not eligible for benefits at this time

Snapdocs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

California residents applying for positions at Snapdocs are subject to our candidate privacy policy. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Hardware Applications Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first focus goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.




JOB OVERVIEW 

The  Hardware Applications Engineer will own application-specific testing of Heron's solid state transformer (SST) across its core use cases: powering AI data centers, utility-scale BESS, and PV plants. That means bringing up hardware in the lab and at pilot sites, writing scripts to drive test equipment and power converters, and debugging performance against what each application demands, from MPPT performance and PPC/EMS/BMS communication to AI load smoothing and DC protection coordination. You will work hand in hand with the Systems Integration team: they own the SST platform; you own the applications.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Own end-to-end application testing of a novel high C-rate battery pack (SuperBBU) with Heron's SST, validating ripple mitigation, backup capability, slew rates, and power-loss profiles.

 - Support SST and utility-scale BESS integration testing at pilot sites, covering EMS-to-SST communication, black start and grid-forming coordination, charge/discharge cycling, and round-trip efficiency.

 - Support integration testing of the SST with commercial off-the-shelf DAS, SCADA and EMS systems. 

 - Own Heron's first pilot deployments: review field performance, identify feature gaps, and work with SW/FW teams to turn findings into product improvements.

 - Write and maintain Python-based test automation to command power converters, sequence tests, log data, and turn manual procedures into repeatable automated loops.

 - Safely operate power converters, chillers, contactors, and protection hardware, and set up cabling, instrumentation, and data acquisition for high-power test runs.




WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We have a short list of must-have requirements. We prioritize a strong grip on first principles, hands-on skills, and a sense of initiative. Domain-specific knowledge and experience will help determine the career level for each hire.




MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in power electronics, energy storage, EV, grid, or a comparable hardware-intensive environment.

 - Strong grasp on DC circuit fundamentals: resonances, parasitics, slew rates, and inductive spikes. You can correlate test data with simulation results.

 - Strong scripting and test-automation skills to drive instruments and power converters and to log and analyze data.

 - Working knowledge of power conversion and battery systems: inverters and converters, BMS, DC pre-charge, contactors and protection, and thermal and cooling loops.

 - Comfort with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, DAQ systems) and comms protocols such as CAN and Modbus TCP.

 - Scrappy mindset: you get things done with a hundred hurdles in front of you.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with solid state transformers or grid-forming inverters.

 - Familiarity with utility-scale BESS commissioning, grid-support functions, or EMS integration.

 - Prior experience in systems-level testing of power electronics or energy storage products

 - Hands-on experience with circuit and system simulation tools such as LTspice, Simscape, or PLECS. 

If you are passionate about the energy transition and enjoy working at the frontier of power electronics and grid integration, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The base salary range for this role is from $140,000 to $200,000K.

jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Special Access Program Security team is responsible for ensuring the security of classified information for Anduril’s most sensitive programs and contracts. The team has individuals located across the country and works in a collaborative manner to ensure the security of Anduril and government information, and Anduril’s defense products.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an Assistant Contractor Special Access Program Security Officer/Assistant Contractor Special Security Officer (ACSSO) to join our growing team in Washington, DC. This is a security position requiring a qualified security professional in support of special access program (SAP) and Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) initiatives. As a ACSSO, you will be responsible for assisting the current CSSO on management, direction, administration and development of security programs and procedures for assigned programs that have contractually imposed security requirements beyond 32 CFR Part 117, National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM) Rule requirements to include DoDM 5205.07, Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs 703, 704, 505, and others as applicable), Security Classification Guides (SCGs), and Statements of Work. Key responsibilities include Personnel Security, Physical Security and program OPSEC/P2 planning. The ACSSO will interface with government agencies regarding assigned program security matters and requirements and will be responsible for managing all security-related aspects of assigned programs in close collaboration with other Anduril CSSOs. This will require detailed knowledge of the government policies applicable to SCI and Special Access Program (SAP) security, as well as practical experience implementing this knowledge to a fast-paced, quickly scaling, and complex manufacturing environment. If you are someone who enjoys fast-paced and collaborative work, finding solutions to interesting challenges, and possess a “can do” attitude, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Knowledgeable in interpreting and implementing security guidance based on applicable ICDs, SEADs, 32 CFR Part 117. “NISPOM Rule,” DoDM 5205.07, and other policies, regulations, and processes as applicable.

• Knowledge of all aspects of Customer Personnel Security Program requirements. This includes, guidance and assistance for validation of SCI and SAP access, access requirements, processing SAP and SCI and eligibility and polygraph requests, nomination interviews, submission of investigative requests, and conducting/coordinating SAP and SCI security briefings.

• Ability to perform all aspects of Physical Security by providing day to day support for badging, access control and visitor control. Ensure all SCIF and SAP Facility documentation is current and up to date.

• Support program managers and personnel with classification guidance and other program related requirements, i.e., incoming and outgoing visit certifications, foreign travel reporting and proposal support.

• Knowledge of how SCI and SAP material is properly controlled, transmitted, transported, packaged, safeguarded, and destroyed, as appropriate.

• Assist CSSO to investigate security incidents, prepare required reports and implement customer directed course of action.

• Build and maintain a relationship with government security counterparts.

• Provide security awareness training as required by regulations and as requested by our customers.

• Work with IT and Cyber to ensure equipment being brought into the secure areas is authorized and approved.

• Assist and provide guidance on ICD 705 modifications/upgrades at company site(s).

• Collaborate and assist the ISSO / ISSM on management of information systems.

• Maintain personnel security records for special access programs (SAP) and/or Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI)-related programs to include the use of SIMS, DISS, JADE, and other systems as applicable.

• Assist CSSO to conduct internal self-inspections and manage government Staff Assistance Visits and Customer Security Assessments on behalf of Anduril.

• Assist with maintenance of classified material accountability records to include inventory lists, receipt and transmittal records and final disposition documentation.

• Maintain working knowledge in the preparation and maintenance of prime and subcontract DD254s.

• Assist with the development and maintenance of the program's Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), Program Protection Implementation Plan (PPIP) and Operational Security (OPSEC) plans.

• In collaboration with the physical security team, maintain the program’s access control and alarm systems.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in related discipline or equivalent education and work experience.

• At least 1-2 years’ experience working with special programs in an ACSSO role.

• Ability to work collaboratively and possess knowledge of security principles, including but not limited to identifying and evaluating program risks/vulnerability; implementing mitigating improvement; and disseminating security procedures/processes.

• Strong oral and written communication skills.

• Build and maintain relationships with government security counterparts.

• DoD Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility with current investigation and ability to maintain a DoD Top Secret clearance with Special Program accesses.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Willing to work extended hours in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment in a variety of program areas.

• Willingness to travel on company business (varies but probably less than 15%).

US Salary Range

$112,000—$149,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Vice President, Head of Legal
jobs.description:
About Superluminal Medicines:

Superluminal Medicines is a generative biology and chemistry company revolutionizing the speed and accuracy of how small molecule medicines are created. The Company’s platform aims to create candidate-ready compounds with unprecedented speed using a combination of deep biology, computational and medicinal chemistry, machine learning, and proprietary big data infrastructure. We are expanding the team of talented scientists who seek to build the future of small molecule drug discovery with creativity and innovation.

About Superluminal Medicines

Superluminal Medicines is a generative biology and chemistry company revolutionizing the speed and accuracy of how small molecule medicines are created. We aim to develop candidate-ready compounds with unprecedented speed using a combination of deep biology, computational and medicinal chemistry, machine learning, and proprietary big data infrastructure. We are expanding the team of talented individuals who seek to build the future of small molecule drug discovery with creativity and innovation.

About the Role

We are seeking a VP, Head of Legal to provide strategic and practical legal counsel across Superluminal as the company continues to grow. Reporting to the CFO this individual will partner closely with the executive leadership team and Board of Directors and will provide strategic and practical legal counsel across corporate, intellectual property, employment, governance, compliance and other legal matters. This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role with the opportunity to establish and scale the company’s legal capabilities. The VP, Head of Legal will work closely with internal stakeholders and external counsel to provide thoughtful, business-oriented advice, manage legal risk, and support the company’s strategic priorities. This individual will help determine where legal capabilities should be managed internally versus through external counsel and will build the legal function over time as the company's needs evolve.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical legal expertise, sound business judgment, and excellent communication skills. They will be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, moving between strategic matters and detailed execution, and balancing thoughtful risk management with the need to move quickly including the ability to communicate complex legal matters clearly to both legal and non-legal audiences.

The role is particularly well suited to an experienced in-house life sciences attorney who has supported companies through significant growth, financings, strategic transactions, and evolving corporate governance requirements, and who is excited by the opportunity to help build the legal infrastructure for the next phase of the company.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Governance & Corporate Matters

• Serve as a senior legal advisor to the CEO, executive leadership team, and Board of Directors.

• Lead corporate governance matters, including Board and committee support, corporate records, resolutions, minutes, and governance policies.

• Establish and maintain effective governance practices and processes as the company grows.

• Advise on corporate structure, capitalization, equity matters, securities and other corporate matters in partnership with Finance and external advisors.

• Support significant corporate milestones, financings, strategic initiatives, and other corporate transactions.

• Partner with Finance and executive leadership on legal considerations related to material events, corporate communications and disclosures.

• Monitor developments in applicable laws and regulations and advise leadership on their implications for the company as the business evolves.

Corporate & Commercial Legal

• Advise the business on a broad range of commercial, operational and other legal matters

• Provide legal leadership and support for the negotiation of material commercial agreements, including strategic collaborations, licensing arrangements, research agreements and other significant contracts, in partnership with the Contract Management function and relevant business stakeholders.

• Provide legal guidance on contract terms, risk allocation, negotiation strategy and approval of material agreements.

• Partner with Business Development, Operations, Finance and other functions to provide practical legal guidance that enables the business while appropriately managing risk.

• Develop legal templates, playbooks and guidance that enable the organization to address recurring legal matters efficiently.

• Partner with Contract Management to establish appropriate escalation points and ensure legal review of material or higher-risk agreements.

Intellectual Property & Life Sciences Matters

• Partner closely with scientific, clinical and business development teams on intellectual property and related legal matters.

• Partner with Clinical, Regulatory and other scientific teams on legal matters associated with the transition to clinical development, research activities, vendors, investigators, collaborations and other development activities.

• Work with external IP counsel to protect and manage the company’s intellectual property portfolio.

• Support licensing, collaboration, partnering, and other transactions involving intellectual property and scientific assets.

• Advise on confidentiality, data ownership, publications, research collaborations and related matters.

• Partner with internal teams and external counsel to identify and appropriately manage legal risks related to the company's intellectual property and scientific assets.

Build and Scale the Legal Function

• Establish the company’s legal operating model, including determining which capabilities should be managed internally versus through external counsel.

• Develop a roadmap for expanding the legal function as the company’s needs evolve.

• Establish scalable processes for corporate records, Board materials, legal entity management, legal spend, and outside counsel management.

• Develop legal policies, processes, templates, and approval authorities appropriate for the company's size and complexity.

• Select, manage, and develop external legal partners.

• Establish appropriate legal technology and knowledge-management infrastructure.

• Build an internal legal team over time as business needs warrant.

Employment & People Matters

• Partner with the Head of HR and executive leadership on employment-related legal matters.

• Provide guidance on employment agreements, executive arrangements, employee relations, workforce changes, policies, and other employment matters.

• Partner with external employment counsel as appropriate.

• Help ensure employment practices and policies evolve appropriately as the organization grows.

Legal, Compliance & Risk Management

• Develop and evolve appropriate legal and compliance policies and processes as the company’s business and regulatory activities evolve.

• Partner with internal functions and external advisors, including Clinical, Regulatory and Quality resources, on legal and regulatory risk management.

• Develop and maintain appropriate policies, training and controls as the company scales.

• Advise leadership on securities law, insider trading, materiality, disclosure and other legal considerations relevant to corporate communications and transactions.

• Partner with Finance and other functions on disclosure, document retention and related legal and internal control processes.

• Identify emerging legal and compliance risks and provide practical recommendations to the executive team.

• Support insurance, risk management and other corporate risk matters in partnership with Finance and Operations.

Transactions & Strategic Initiatives

• Lead or support legal work associated with financings, strategic partnerships, licensing transactions, acquisitions, divestitures, and other significant corporate transactions.

• Lead or support legal diligence processes and coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisors.

• Manage relationships with outside counsel and other legal advisors supporting significant transactions and strategic initiatives.

• Provide clear, commercially oriented recommendations to senior leadership on transaction structure, legal risk, and execution.

• Support complex and time-sensitive strategic initiatives, balancing legal and business considerations.

Minimum Qualifications

• Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.

• Active license to practice law and member in good standing of at least one U.S. state bar (or the District of Columbia)

• 10-15+ years of relevant legal experience, with significant experience supporting life sciences, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical companies.

• Experience with In-house legal leadership, ideally within a growth-stage life sciences company.

• Experience across corporate, commercial and general legal matters, with the ability to serve as a strategic legal partner to the business.

• Experience with corporate governance, commercial transactions, securities and other strategic legal matters.

• Experience advising CEOs, CFOs, executive teams and Boards of Directors.

• Experience managing outside counsel and establishing or scaling legal processes and infrastructure.

• Experience supporting significant corporate milestones, financings, strategic transactions and evolving governance requirements.

• Experience navigating complex securities, disclosure, and corporate governance matters in a private or public company environment strongly preferred.

• Experience working with external legal and business advisors on complex corporate transactions and strategic matters.

• Experience with intellectual property, licensing, collaborations and research-related agreements in a life sciences environment.

Pay Range
$315,000 - $357,000

The annual base salary range listed above represents the lowest and highest amounts we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for this position at the time of posting. An individual’s starting base salary within this range will be based on relevant experience, job-related skills, and education relevant to the role. In addition to base salary, this position offers bonus and equity opportunities, as well as benefits.

Benefits:

Superluminal offers a comprehensive benefits package that fully covers employees’ annual deductibles and monthly premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance. The package also includes a 401(k) match program, a Massachusetts transportation subsidy, equity, unlimited paid time off, and both disability and life insurance.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Superluminal Medicines is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; creed; religion; national origin; age; ancestry; nationality; marital, domestic partnership or civil union status; sex, gender, gender identity or expression; affectional or sexual orientation; disability; veteran or military status or liability for military status.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor - Construction Management
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are looking for an experienced Associate Director, Cost Manager and/or Quantity Surveyor to provide leadership across a portfolio of commercial real estate, hospitality, and capital projects. The role is responsible for client relationship management, commercial oversight, team leadership, and the successful delivery of cost management and quantity surveying services. The Associate Director will also support business development initiatives, mentor project teams, and help drive the growth and strategic direction of the regional Cost Management practice.

To be successful in this role, you must have excellent communication skills and be comfortable operating in a client-facing environment. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently as well as part of a team. In this significant position, you will be responsible for providing leadership and direction, embedding, and promoting the purpose, values, and vision of Turner & Townsend.

Responsibilities:

• Strong leadership skills, with experience leading cost management teams and ensuring delivery across all accountabilities on complex construction programs.
• Taking a lead role interfacing with clients, stakeholders, and consultants across all stages of commercial real estate and broader construction projects.
• Maintain excellent communication with clients and project teams throughout all project phases.
• Perform quantity surveying, cost control, and change management activities across the full project lifecycle, including fit-out, refurbishment, and ground-up developments.
• Communicate effectively and professionally with general contractors, owners’ representatives, and external stakeholders, taking responsibility for Turner & Townsend coordination within the overall construction process.
• Coordinate and assist with the strategic and operational delivery of Cost Management and Project Controls services across a variety of project types and sectors.
• Act as the primary point of contact for reporting on the overall commercial status of projects and programs.
• Drive Turner & Townsend best practices at all stages of a project or program.
• Identify opportunities to improve cost management procedures, processes, templates, and tools.
• Undertake staff performance reviews and support career development initiatives.
• Set a clear strategy and ambition for the team aligned with client and business objectives.
• Identify, coach, and mentor talent to realize their potential and celebrate team success.
• Grow and develop high-performing teams across cost management and quantity surveying disciplines.
• Demonstrate excellence in leadership and service delivery in line with client expectations and contractual requirements.
• Manage financial performance by utilizing internal systems to track margins, fee forecasts, and resource planning across commissions.
• Develop priority plans including risk mitigation strategies, performance tracking through KPIs, and alignment with company objectives.
• Implement and maintain internal Business Management Systems and delivery methodologies to ensure consistent best practice application.
• Undertake internal BMS audits and coordinate external audit processes with certification authorities.
• Develop a strong understanding of the market, acting as a brand ambassador and building a pipeline of opportunities.
• Advise clients on contracting and procurement strategies across a range of delivery models, including program-level capital planning and reporting.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and cross-functional team members.
• Participate in leadership meetings and prepare and deliver presentations to senior stakeholders.
• Provide regular updates on project status, initiatives, and staffing, and propose solutions for leadership alignment and approval.
• Identify and pursue cross-selling and business development opportunities.
• Participate in proposal development and RFP responses for new clients and projects.
• Support knowledge management by capturing lessons learned and contributing to internal best practice databases.
• Attend relevant industry and networking events to support market presence and business growth.
• Act as a role model, promoting a collaborative culture that balances outcomes for people, clients, stakeholders, and society.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering, or a related field.
• Graduate degree in quantity surveying, cost management, construction management, or engineering is preferred.
• Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in cost management within the construction industry, including experience on commercial real estate projects.
• Construction consultancy experience is strongly preferred.
• Strong foundation in quantity surveying practices, with RICS certification or working toward accreditation preferred.
• Demonstrated experience supporting projects across multiple sectors is valued.
• Excellent presentation, verbal, written, organizational, and communication skills.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our clients' needs.*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

Turner & Townsend does not accept any speculative or unsolicited CV’s that have been sent to our internal recruitment team or hiring managers from agencies outside of our preferred supplier list or that have not followed due process. Any speculative or unsolicited CV’s will be treated as a direct application.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician Hiring Event (Hiring Event, Greater Boston, November 17th - 10A-3P)
jobs.description:
At Bozzuto, every team member shares a deep commitment to doing good for those around us. We live this each day by designing, building, managing and maintaining one-of-a-kind residences. Whether it’s the talent within our communities or the expertise across our property operations teams, we work together to make extraordinary happen for our clients, residents and fellow team members.

Our people are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to everyone we serve including each other. This shared purpose drives us to excel in every role and fosters a welcoming, inclusive workplace where teamwork thrives. Guided by our core values of concern, creativity, passion and the pursuit of perfection, we are inspired and empowered to reach higher, unlock our full potential and be truly extraordinary.

Now Hiring Maintenance Technicians in Greater Boston!

Join us at our upcoming in-person hiring event! This is your chance to interview directly with our team, learn more about the role and discover what a career with Bozzuto could look like.

To get started, click “Apply” to complete a brief questionnaire to confirm your interest in this event.

A recruiter will follow up to learn more about you, share the event location and schedule your in-person interview. Offers may be extended to qualified candidates within 48 hours of the event.

Event Details:
When: Tuesday, November 17th
Time: 10A-3P EST

Please come with your updated resume and business professional dress. We look forward to speaking with you!

Primary Responsibilities:

As a Maintenance Technician, your primary responsibilities include:

• Showing care and concern for our residents through excellence in service ticket resolution and preventative maintenance

• Resolving maintenance issues in the area of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and appliance repair

• Preparing vacant apartments for move-in through turn-over repairs and improvements

• Preserving the beauty of the building and the safety of the community through general upkeep and cleanliness, snow removal and grounds maintenance

• Providing residents with outstanding customer service

• Working weekends or evenings and being on call for after hour emergencies

What You Bring to Us:

• Experience in building maintenance or an education in the trades

• Beginner to intermediate proficiency in HVAC, plumbing, electrical and appliance repair

• Availability for emergency situations at the property, including an on-call rotation

• The ability to exert 25 to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or 10 to 20 pounds of force constantly

• Personal, reliable transportation to get to work and to respond to on-call emergencies

• Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

• A sharp professional appearance

• Basic computer skills and comfort using various software, apps and computer programs

• A service mentality and a thirst for learning

This position is eligible for additional bonus opportunities.

Salary Range

$52,000—$55,000 USD

Main Street Health is the nation's largest provider of value-based care exclusively serving rural America.  We believe in the old ways of medicine when healthcare was simpler. Navigating the changes to our healthcare system can be intimidating and confusing for doctors and patients alike.  The Health Navigator’s role is to make it easier. You will start by developing trusted relationships with our patients and providers and will assist with various patient-facing, administrative, and logistical tasks so that doctors can focus on delivering high-quality medical care to their patients. Navigators work for Main Street but go to work every day inside one of our partner clinics alongside clinic staff.  They meet with and call patients, enter data into our systems, contact the pharmacy to refill prescriptions, troubleshoot challenges with insurance coverage and more.  Main Street’s management and training teams will equip you with the training and tools you need to perform these duties.   You will:

• Help patients access various community resources

The Legal team at Signifyd plays a critical role in enabling and protecting the business as it scales. Our team is responsible for drafting and negotiating sales and vendor contracts, reviewing privacy and data protection matters, and supporting product development. We work closely with the Sales, Partnerships, Product, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and Finance teams to help drive business objectives forward. By shaping processes that accelerate deal cycles, we help keep the commercial flywheel turning. jobs.title: Sales Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT STUUT

Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.


Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.


Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai http://stuut.ai. 




THE ROLE 

Stuut is seeking its first Sales Enablement hire to build the function for our Account Executive and BDR teams. Our sales org is growing quickly and selling a product that rapidly evolves to finance buyers. This role owns how sellers ramp, how they tell the Stuut’s story, and how they get better every quarter.

This is an individual contributor role reporting into Revenue Operations. It is hands-on: you will set the strategy and also write the onboarding curriculum, record the demo, build the battlecard, and run call reviews. You will partner closely with Sales leadership, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Onboarding and ramp

 - Design and run a repeatable onboarding program for new BDRs, andAEs, with a defined bar for what "ramped" means at each role and clear ramp-time targets

 - Own the first 30/60/90 for every new seller, including product certification, pitch and demo certification, tooling proficiency, and territory readiness

 - Build in feedback loops so every cohort improves the next one

Messaging, pitch, and demo

 - Codify the Stuut pitch into a single, current, opinionated narrative that every seller can deliver the same way

 - Build and maintain the standard demo flow for each product surface and keep it current as the product ships

 - Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use cases, buyer personas, and vertical narratives

Ongoing enablement and coaching

 - Run a regular enablement cadence (weekly rep-facing sessions, monthly deep dives, quarterly kickoffs) driven by what the field actually needs

 - Build a live call-review and coaching program with Sales leadership, using recorded calls to reinforce what good looks like and surface where reps are getting stuck

 - Own the enablement content library — playbooks, talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handles, competitive battlecards, ROI framing — and keep it usable, current, and findable

Product-to-field translation

 - Sit close to Product to translate each release into "what this means for the field": what to say, who to say it to, when to bring it up, and what proof to lean on

 - Build a launch process that turns product updates into field readiness quickly and consistently

Sales methodology and skill development

 - Partner with Sales leadership to select and operationalize the qualification and deal-management framework that fits Stuut's motion — training, reinforcement, coaching, and inspection

 - Build role-specific skill programs (discovery, multi-threading, negotiation, executive presence, technical selling to CFOs)

Measurement and iteration

 - Define what enablement is accountable for: ramp time to first deal, pitch and demo certification pass rates, win rate on contested deals, content adoption, and manager coaching consistency

 - Report against those metrics and kill programs that do not move them




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years in sales enablement, sales training, sales operations, or a quota-carrying / sales-adjacent role at a B2B software company, with clear ownership of a program you built end to end

 - A track record of building or scaling enablement from zero or near-zero — you have been the first or second enablement hire before, or you have owned a function that ran like one

 - Strong instincts for sales messaging and translating a complex, fast-moving technical product into a story that sellers can tell and buyers can act on

 - Fluency running coaching and call reviews with sellers and Sales leadership — you can spot what a rep needs from listening to five minutes of a call

 - Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales leadership, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

 - Willingness to be in the San Francisco or New York office four days per week




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a Series A–D company selling a fast-changing product to a mix of technical and business buyers

 - Background enabling direct sales with an enterprise motion

 - Experience selling or enabling into AI, finance, or accountanting

 - Familiarity with modern enablement and revenue tooling (CRM, LMS, conversation intelligence, content management)

 - Previous time as an AE, SDR, or SC before moving into enablement

US Compensation

• Assist with organizing and reviewing program documents, policies, guidance, and cost-estimating inputs

• Help identify and improve processes for program tracking, data management, cost analysis, and team efficiency

Required Qualifications:

• Active Secret Clearance

• 2–5 years of experience in program analysis, program support, project coordination, cost analysis, financial analysis, or a related role

• Experience working with program, financial, or cost data in a government or defense environment

• Experience developing, organizing, analyzing, or validating data using Microsoft Excel

• Familiarity with cost estimating, Life Cycle Cost Estimates (LCCEs), or related program cost-analysis activities

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to analyze information, identify discrepancies, and communicate findings clearly

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced government environment

• Clear written and verbal communication skills

• Experience preparing briefings, reports, spreadsheets, and other analytical products using PowerPoint, Word, and Excel

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

• Leaving the scene of an accident.

• Vehicular homicide or assault

jobs.title: Scientific Computer Engineer, Staff Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Staff Cloud Infrastructure / Scientific Computer Engineer to help build, operate, and improve the infrastructure foundations that support computational science, data engineering, analytics, and enterprise business operations across RevMed. This role will emphasize site reliability engineering, Kubernetes operations, observability, Databricks infrastructure, and cloud financial management (FinOps).

This role will partner with scientific, G&A, data, security, and IT stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, scalable compute and platform services. The ideal candidate brings deep infrastructure experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to translate scientific and business computing needs into practical, reusable platform patterns. They will balance reliability, performance, security, and cost, using operational data to guide improvements.

• Design, operate, and improve secure cloud infrastructure for R&D and scientific computing workloads.

• Build reusable infrastructure patterns for compute, storage, networking, identity, secrets management, and observability.

• Use Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform, to standardize provisioning and change management.

• Apply SRE practices to critical platform services, including service-level indicators and objectives, actionable alerting, incident response, post-incident reviews, and automation that reduces operational toil.

• Operate and improve Kubernetes environments, including cluster upgrades, workload deployment, resource allocation, autoscaling, networking, access controls, and troubleshooting.

• Develop observability across cloud, Kubernetes, and data platforms using metrics, logs, and traces to identify failures, diagnose performance issues, and understand capacity needs.

• Support high-throughput and scientific compute environments, including HPC and scheduler-based workloads.

• Enable reproducible compute patterns using Linux, containers, registries, and automated deployment workflows.

• Partner with data and ML teams on infrastructure for dataset staging, training workflows, batch inference, and platform reliability.

• Own the operational foundations of Databricks environments, including workspace provisioning, compute policies, networking, identity, secrets, governance integrations, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

• Partner with data teams to improve Databricks workload reliability, compute utilization, performance, and cost through appropriate compute sizing, autoscaling, workload isolation, and lifecycle controls.

• Support data platform infrastructure for scientific, analytics, and G&A use cases, including secure access patterns, governance integrations, and scalable storage.

• Drive FinOps practices across cloud and Databricks services, including cost allocation and tagging, usage visibility, budgets, forecasting, anomaly detection, and optimization recommendations.

• Identify and implement cost improvements through rightsizing, idle-resource cleanup, storage lifecycle management, and appropriate purchasing commitments, while preserving workload reliability and performance.

• Improve operational practices such as monitoring, incident response, runbooks, capacity planning, recovery readiness, and service ownership.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with scientists, data engineers, security, and IT to deliver practical platform solutions.

• Mentor others and contribute to standards, documentation, and reusable patterns for cloud operations, reliability engineering, and scientific infrastructure.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems engineering, DevOps/SRE, scientific computing, or related technical roles.

• Strong experience operating production infrastructure in AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform.

• Strong experience with Terraform or comparable Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Practical experience with Linux, networking fundamentals, system troubleshooting, and operational support.

• Experience with CI/CD, version control, peer review, testing, and change management practices.

• Experience supporting containerized workloads using Docker or similar technologies, including hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production.

• Experience implementing observability and reliability practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident management, and systematic troubleshooting of distributed services.

• Experience operating Databricks or comparable managed data platforms, with an understanding of compute, networking, identity, governance, and operational support.

• Experience analyzing cloud usage and expenditure and implementing cost optimization measures with measurable results.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex technical problems and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar agents for cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, systems configuration, operational tooling, AI-native application development, and agentic engineering.

• Experience with managed Kubernetes services such as Amazon EKS or Azure AKS, and deployment approaches using Helm or GitOps.

• Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or comparable cloud-native or commercial tools.

• Experience with Databricks infrastructure automation, Unity Catalog integrations, compute policies, and workload usage and cost reporting.

• Experience with FinOps processes and tooling, including cost attribution, showback, forecasting, commitment planning, and collaboration with Finance and workload owners.

• Experience supporting HPC or high-throughput compute environments, including Slurm or similar schedulers.

• Experience supporting scientific computing, computational chemistry, computational biology, or data-intensive R&D workflows.

• Experience with cloud security, identity, least privilege access, auditability, and regulated environments.

• Familiarity with workflow tools such as Nextflow, Snakemake, Airflow, or cloud batch services.

• Experience building reusable platform patterns, documentation, and self-service infrastructure capabilities.
