Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

EXPOSURE TO

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Additional Job Details Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. Maintian all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

The Senior Commercial Counsel will serve as strategic legal counsel supporting Relativity’s buy-side commercial transactions and disputes. • In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.
• Fumes from food odors.
• Exposure to cornmeal dust.
• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.
• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
• Depth perception.
• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

• Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

• For short distances for short durations.
• Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

• Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

• Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

• Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
• Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

• Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

All drivers (applicant or employee) must meet these requirements in order to be eligible to drive:

• Must be 18 years or older
• Have a minimum of the last 2 years licensed driving history in the United StatesMust provide documentation of at least 2 years of licensed driving history in the U.S.
• Must have an unsuspended or uninterrupted driving history of at least 1.5 years during the last 2 years. The suspension cannot be at the start of the 2 year period
• No more than 1 violation and 1 at-fault accident associated within the last 2 years
• No more than 2 violations and 1 at-fault accident associated within the last 3 years
• No more than 3 violations in the last 3 years
• No more than 1 at-fault accident in the last 3 years
• Moving citations (i.e. speeding, vehicle safety, etc.) count as violationsSeatbelt citations do not count as violations; andInoperable brake light citations do not count as violations.
• No distracted driving/inattentive driving violations within the last 3 years
• No serious violations allowed in the past 5 years. Some examples include:Drugs/AlcoholLeaving the sceneFailing to report an accidentReckless/careless drivingVehicular homicideHit and runSpeed contestEluding policeMaking a false police reportDriving while suspended/not licensedSpeeding 30 MPH or faster over the posted speed limit

Periodic Delivery Vehicle Inspection

Motor vehicles used for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries, must have the following items inspected under the supervision of franchisees and the managers of stores at the start of employment and thereafter on a periodic basis:

• Headlights
• Turn signals
• Tires
• Rear-view mirror
• Taillights/Break lights
• Brake pressure
• Windshield wipers
• Doors
• Backup lights
• Exhaust system
• Horn
• Safety belt

Any motor vehicle that does not pass the inspection must not be used to operate a motor vehicle for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries. These inspections are not intended to replace extensive mechanical inspections by a professional and the vehicle operator is responsible for the safe operating condition of his/her vehicle

We are looking for a driven Recruiting Specialist to join our team in Irvine, CA and support hiring across our growing multifamily portfolio, with a primary focus on recruiting for financial sales roles.

We’re seeking a Recruiting Specialist to join our Talent Acquisition team and help us attract top talent across all levels from entry-level to executive positions. Position Summary:

The GCP Quality Assurance candidate will manage activities related to the development, maintenance and oversight of GCP activities related to the Clinical Trial activities sponsored by company. The primary responsibilities will be to ensure both quality and compliance of company sponsored clinical trials with respect to Standard Operating Procedures, applicable regulatory requirements (US FDA, ICH, and country specific), along with current industry standards and practices.

Key Responsibilities:

• Write and/or review SOPs to assess consistency and compliance with regulatory requirements/internal standards and determine/ensure effective implementation across the organization.

• Provide guidance to Clinical Operations staff and other GCP-related departments, as applicable, based on interpretation of current regulations to ensure best practices including risk based management.

• Provide guidance with the identification and management of risks in clinical trial activities and monitor/evaluate risk management activities.

• Work closely with Clinical Operations and other GCP-related departments, as applicable, to ensure/coordinate appropriate and complete resolution of findings/non-compliant issues in a timely manner, including approval of corrective action/preventative action (CAPA) plans, as necessary.

• Participate in the review of drug safety practices for clinical trial compliance.

• Conduct and/or assist in internal audits (systems, processes, vendors, computer system validation).

• Identify need for, conduct and/or assist in external audits (includes, but is not limited to, investigator sites, central IRBs, CROs and clinical labs).

• Oversee the audit response process for the Investigator Site and Contract Research Organization (CRO) audits/inspections and ensure acceptability of actions to address findings through the CAPA process.

• Provide functional review of clinical protocols, Informed Consent Forms, Clinical Study Reports and other clinical trial related documents.

• Assist and advise with training QA and clinical staff as necessary for GCP.

• Collaborate with applicable departmental heads to identify clinical trial and regulatory training needs of Clinical Operations (and other Clinical trial members) based on regulatory changes, process/system changes, audit findings, trends, , and assist in coordinating the training to meet the needs.

• Identify potential systemic gaps and coordinate with the appropriate stakeholder to ensure timely remediation. As appropriate, escalate issues of critical non-compliance and/or lack of urgency in remediation to senior management.

• Perform program specific root cause analysis of compliance issues and provide the appropriate metrics for tracking and trending for the overall QA reporting requirements to functional and senior management.

• Provide guidance with the development and management of key vendor oversight activities for clinical trials and monitor/evaluate the oversight activities.

• Assist senior staff during regulatory inspections.

• Ability to travel domestic and international.

• Other duties, as required.

Qualifications:

• BS in a life science required

• At least 10 years of direct GCP pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience

• Solid understanding and application of GCP, GLP and ICH requirements, especially ICH E6

• Excellent written and oral communications skills A well organized, self-motivated and independent work style with the ability to initiate and follow through on assignments

• Excellent interpersonal skills with knowledge of basic negotiation, influencing and conflict management to assure effective interactions within and across departments

• The ability to simultaneously handle multiple project issues while dealing with time demands, incomplete information, or unexpected events

• Understanding of the drug and biologic development and clinical research processes

• General understanding of non-clinical research and manufacturing processes including terminology

• Ideal candidate will have broad experience in product development, clinical operations, regulatory compliance and GCP auditing

Salary Range

$230,000 - $281,000 USD

jobs.title: Associate Director, Business Process Management & Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!

Vaxcyte is a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance.

WHAT we do is every bit as important as HOW we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:

*RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.

*AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.

*LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.

*MODEL EXCELLENCE:  The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.

Summary:

This role within Technical Operations’ Capabilities & Business Operations function is critical for strengthening how Technical Operations translates strategy into executable work and builds repeatable, scalable ways of working as the organization advances toward commercialization and future growth.

This role partners closely with Technical Operations leaders and cross-functional teams across Vaxcyte to shape strategic priorities into well-defined initiatives, strengthen end-to-end business processes and operating practices, and improve execution readiness through continuous improvement. The Principal also leads select high-priority cross-functional initiatives where additional coordination, specialized expertise, or execution capacity creates the greatest business value.

The successful candidate brings a combination of business process management, operational excellence, strategy realization, and strong cross-functional execution capability. A core expectation of the role is that every initiative strengthens both business outcomes and organizational capability - building better processes, clearer governance, stronger ways of working, and reusable learning through the work itself.

Essential Functions:

Strategy Realization & Execution Readiness:

• Partner with leaders to translate Technical Operations strategy and priorities into executable initiatives, with clear roadmaps, milestones, ownership, governance, decision rights, and measures of success.

• Establish and apply project-shaping and execution-readiness practices so high-priority work is well defined, resourced, governed, and ready before execution begins.

• Support demand intake and prioritization by helping leaders assess business value, readiness, dependencies, risk, resource implications, and sequencing.

• Connect strategy, priorities, and execution by identifying gaps, interdependencies, and decisions needed to move work forward.

Business Process Management & Operational Excellence:

• Design, map, optimize, and sustain end-to-end business processes and cross-functional workflows that improve execution, scalability, and clarity across Technical Operations.

• Establish practical process ownership, governance, operating rhythms, roles, decision rights, and performance measures where they create value.

• Identify operational friction, duplication, bottlenecks, and handoff gaps, and simplify work across functional boundaries.

• Lead continuous-improvement efforts using fit-for-purpose problem-solving and process-improvement methods, applying Lean/Six Sigma tools where useful without limiting the role to a single methodology.

• Capture lessons learned, codify best practices, and build repeatable processes and playbooks that reduce dependence on individual effort or expertise.

Cross-Functional Initiative Leadership:

• Lead select high-priority cross-functional initiatives that call for neutral leadership, organizational coordination, specialized expertise, or added execution capacity.

• Facilitate complex cross-functional decisions, working sessions, and problem-solving efforts that build alignment and accelerate action.

• Strengthen the interfaces between Technical Operations and other functions so interdependent work stays integrated while functional ownership remains clear.

• Build trusted relationships with leaders and technical experts, bringing an objective, business-minded perspective to execution challenges and tradeoffs.

Organizational Capability:

• Ensure major initiatives build organizational capability alongside near-term outcomes.

• Help leaders establish sustainable ways of working that strengthen accountability, decision-making, coordination, and operational performance.

• Partner with the Principal, Business Operations & Digital Enablement so business processes, portfolio visibility, data, systems, and digital solutions reinforce one another.

• 10+ years of progressive experience in business process management, operational excellence, strategy execution, transformation, business operations, program leadership, or related disciplines.

• Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical manufacturing, Technical Operations, or another complex regulated environment strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience designing and improving end-to-end business processes, including process architecture, process ownership, process mapping/redesign, governance, and performance management.

• Demonstrated ability to translate broad strategy into executable plans and lead complex cross-functional initiatives from ambiguity through execution.

• Strong understanding of operating models, governance, decision rights, continuous improvement, and organizational change and adoption.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
About IEX

IEX is an exchange operator and technology company dedicated to innovating for performance in capital markets. Founded in 2012, IEX launched a new kind of securities exchange in 2016 that combines a transparent business model and unique architecture designed to protect investors. Today, IEX applies its proprietary technology and experience to drive performance across asset classes, serve investors, and advocate for transparent and competitive markets.

About the Role

IEX is looking for a self-motivated Compliance Officer to join our team and report to the Chief Compliance Officer. You'll help develop the policies and procedures that guide how we operate and conduct the monitoring and testing that confirm we follow them.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across several areas of a compliance program. You'll collaborate with experts in Regulation, Risk, Legal, InfoSec, and Technology, learning from colleagues across the company as you tackle complex projects and develop practical solutions.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York office.

What You'll Do

• Draft, manage, and advise on firm policies and procedures, including those for options.

• Build, run, and enhance compliance monitoring and testing, including drafting the controls we test against.

• Spot potential issues early and propose practical solutions.

• Work with Regulation, Risk, Legal, InfoSec, and Technology to implement and maintain effective policies and internal controls.

• Provide guidance on IEX policies, federal securities laws, and industry rules and regulations.

• Assist with regulatory exams, audits, and books and records obligations.

• Manage compliance projects from start to finish.

• Help build out the Compliance program as IEX enters the options market.

• Find ways to make compliance processes more efficient, including with AI tools.

Your Background

• 5+ years in compliance at an exchange, broker-dealer, or trading firm.

• Experience with policies and procedures and with compliance monitoring and testing.

• Working knowledge of securities laws, FINRA, SEC and SRO rules, and AML.

• Strong issue-spotting skills and a habit of providing solutions.

• Ability to juggle multiple complex projects and own them to completion.

• Excellent communication and a collaborative, team-first style.

• Attention to detail, good judgment, and a "no task too big or small" attitude.

• Curiosity about market structure and technology, and a commitment to fair, transparent markets.

Nice to Have

• Experience drafting (not just maintaining) policies and controls, or building a testing or monitoring program.

• Experience working with Technology teams.

• Equities and options experience.

• JD and bar admission.

• Series 7 and 24, 14 or willingness to obtain them.

• Experience with AI tools and compliance management software.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting annual base pay is between $125,000-$175,000 for this NY-based position. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Model Lifecycle and Signals
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on the Model Lifecycle and Signals team at SpaceXAI, you'll own the bridge between frontier models and every user facingCursor product, used at a scale few teams ever see. You'll decide when we use which model, spot where models go off track and build the guardrails to keep them on it, and shape what the next generation of models should learn.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, data, and product. You'll bring models from preview to production, dig into real-world data to find out what's actually working, and partner with research, inference, product, and data science teams to turn that evidence into better products and better models.

Every improvement you make compounds across our products and every model we ship.


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Get new frontier models into users' hands the day they're ready, and retire old ones without anyone noticing.

 - Evaluate internal and external preview models before launch and give meaningful feedback to the teams building them.

 - Build Cursor Router https://cursor.com/docs/cursor-router: decide which model handles each request, balancing quality, speed, and cost at massive scale.

 - Build the eyes and ears of the product, and the experimentation platform that puts them to work: signals that show where each model shines, where it goes off track, and what 'better' actually means.


YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You're an exceptional engineer with a track record of shipping production systems people rely on. You own problems end to end, and you'd rather automate a painful process than repeat it.

 - You've built and operated evaluation, measurement, or model serving systems, such as AI evals, experimentation, ranking/relevance, or routers. You can turn ambiguous "quality" questions into concrete metrics, pipelines, and decisions.

 - You're fluent with data and can collaborate effectively with data scientists and researchers.

 - You have strong taste and real curiosity about model and agent behavior. You try new models the day they come out and have opinions about where each one shines.


APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious Electrical-optical Silicon photonics IC engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation PIC/EIC for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has not previously been available, affordable or reliable. Join us to help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.

• Design, simulate and model electro-optical building blocks for a silicon photonics solution

• Design, simulate and model RF/analog/mixed signal circuits and systems

• Derive specifications for the Photonics IC/Electrical IC subsystems and circuits

• Develop Analog/Mixed-Signal/RF/Microwave circuits in SiGe or CMOS processes

• Work with system architects, DSP and electro-optics, and ASIC engineers to partition functions between hardware and software domains

• Perform IC floor planning and layout

• Model package and external parasitic components

• Evaluate, characterize and measure electrical and optical building blocks of a high-speed optical link solution

• Assist in the development of automated test lab equipment for lab measurements

• Work with manufacturing engineers on production testing and qualification of the EIC/PIC components and systems

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or computer science

• Familiarity with high speed SerDes architecture, modulation schemes such as NRZ and PAM4 and link protocols

• Familiarity with optical and radio related test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector signal analyzers, vector signal generators, high speed oscilloscopes and BERTs

 - Own Lambda's global tax strategy, risk profile, operating model and multi year roadmap, aligned with the company's growth, capital structure and infrastructure deployment plans.

 - Advise the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Accounting Officer and other executives on material tax exposures, alternatives and recommended actions in concise business terms.

 - Establish practical governance for when Tax must be involved in contracts, financings, entity formation, site selection, acquisitions, compensation decisions and other significant events.

 - Maintain a current view of the company's highest tax risks, open decisions, cash tax opportunities, deadlines and resource constraints.

Tax reporting compliance and controversy

 - Own ASC 740, including quarterly and annual provision processes, forecasts, effective tax rate analysis, deferred tax accounting, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, disclosures and management review controls.

 - Direct outsourced federal, state and international income tax compliance and ensure that filing positions, provision conclusions and legal entity data remain consistent.

 - Lead tax audits and controversy, including the current IRS examination, information document requests, position development, settlement authority and coordination with Legal and advisers.

 - Oversee ownership change analyses under IRC Section 382 for significant equity financings and ensure that any resulting limitations are incorporated into tax attributes, compliance and financial reporting.

Transactions infrastructure and growth

 - Lead tax analysis for project financings, special purpose entities, debt and equity structures, intercompany arrangements, major customer and vendor contracts and data center development projects.

 - Provide timely technical guidance on unusual arrangements, including long term and escalating leases under IRC Section 467, asset acquisitions and purchase price allocations under IRC Section 1060, executive compensation and other material one time matters.

 - Integrate tax into land acquisitions, leased data centers, construction, power arrangements, equipment procurement and deployment decisions before commercial terms or purchase commitments are locked.

 - Partner with the indirect tax leader on sales and use tax, property tax, VAT, exemptions, incentives, audits and the operational controls needed to preserve benefits after approval.

International tax and legal entity expansion

 - Lead the tax workstream for new foreign data centers and market launches, covering legal entity structure, permanent establishment, transfer pricing, withholding, VAT or GST, customs, financing, repatriation and local compliance.

 - Establish scalable intercompany policies, agreements, invoicing and data flows in partnership with Accounting and the Head of Consolidations.

 - Own international matters directly during the initial transition, then assess the timing, scope and level of an international tax deputy as the portfolio and team stabilize.

Systems controls advisers and team

Define tax requirements for finance transformation initiatives, including Coupa, fixed asset systems, ERP reporting, billing, tax engines and legal entity reporting.

 - Build documented controls, data ownership and review evidence suitable for a fast growing company preparing for public company expectations. Prior IPO experience is helpful but not required.

 - Set clear scopes, budgets, service levels and accountability for external advisers. Use specialists heavily where efficient while retaining management ownership of facts, judgments and decisions.

 - Lead, coach and develop a lean team. Clarify roles across provision and income tax, indirect tax, international tax and operations; identify interim support and hiring needs before capacity becomes a control risk.

What hands on leadership means in this role

 - Personally lead the highest risk or most ambiguous matters until the issue, workplan and ownership model are stable.

 - Review and challenge calculations, workpapers, contracts, models, returns, memoranda and adviser conclusions at the level needed to make an informed management decision.

 - Translate technical tax questions into clear business choices for the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Accounting Officer, Legal, Treasury, Infrastructure and other executives.

 - Step into execution gaps during close cycles, audits, transactions, system implementations and international launches, while building repeatable processes that reduce reliance on heroics.

 - Delegate work with clear decision rights, remain accountable for the result and develop the team rather than operating as either a pure reviewer or a permanent individual contributor.

You

 - Approximately 12 or more years of progressively responsible corporate tax experience, including meaningful in house leadership experience in a complex, rapidly changing business.

 - Deep command of ASC 740 and demonstrated ability to own a provision process, assess uncertain positions and communicate judgments to senior finance leadership and auditors.

 - Strong federal corporate tax and international tax foundations with practical experience across transactions, tax attributes, controversy and multi state matters.

 - Experience directing external advisers and outsourced compliance while maintaining internal control, documentation and decision ownership.

 - Ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution, including reviewing detailed work, drafting or shaping technical positions and driving cross functional projects to completion.

 - Executive presence without unnecessary formality. Able to explain complex issues clearly, make a recommendation and identify what requires escalation.

 - Track record of building teams, prioritizing limited resources and creating durable processes in an environment where facts and timelines change quickly.

 - Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, taxation or a related field. CPA, JD, MST or comparable advanced qualification is strongly preferred.

Nice to Have

 - Technology, cloud infrastructure, data centers, energy intensive operations, equipment leasing or another capital intensive and internationally expanding business.

 - International structuring, transfer pricing, withholding, VAT or GST, customs and foreign legal entity implementation.

 - Project finance, special purpose entities, debt structures and large fixed asset investments.

 - State and local tax incentives, property tax and sales and use tax issues associated with construction and equipment deployment.

 - Pre IPO readiness, public company controls or SEC reporting environments. Direct IPO experience is not required.

 - Tax technology, ERP reporting, procure to pay, billing or fixed asset system implementation.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.




About Lambda

 - Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

 - Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

 - We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

 - Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SCHOOLHOUSE

Founded by Sal Khan, Schoolhouse http://schoolhouse.world/ is a peer-to-peer learning platform that delivers human connection and develops durable skills through online learning to best prepare students to thrive in the age of AI. So far, we’ve reached 200k+ learners from 180+ countries and we plan to grow to millions.


ABOUT THE VISION

Our vision is to provide an education safety net to ensure that no talent goes undiscovered and that every student feels empowered in our changing world. We do this by bringing high school students together around learning to create an environment where they can develop and showcase academic mastery and durable skills.

At Schoolhouse, learning is academic, civic, and global. Students join tutoring sessions where peers help them reach academic goals through personalized support. They participate in Dialogues to discuss challenging issues and empathize across divides. Above all, students belong to a global community centered around human connection.

We believe this vision is ambitious, so we need a team that can move quickly in the face of ambiguity. We value sincerity and empathy and believe deeply in the power of human connection. We step in to help each other out, we think big but start small, we uplift each other, and we’re all learners at heart.

Learn more about our vision and our values here:

 - Teen Helps 52-Year-Old Man Earn His High School Diploma https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdIPGLgT8pk

 - The Power of Peer Tutoring https://schoolhouse.world/blog/the-power-of-peer-tutoring/

 - Schoolhouse’s Public Roadmap https://schoolhouse.world/roadmap

 - What are Schoolhouse's community values? https://schoolhouse.world/faq/en/article/what-are-schoolhouses-community-values-1b7nl3c/


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers who want to build stuff that’ll have an impact. You’ll join our 5-person engineering team and own full-stack features that hundreds of thousands of learners and tutors use worldwide.

Engineers at Schoolhouse have lots of ownership — you’ll work directly with our designer and other stakeholders to build out new experiments and streamline existing operations. We think the best way for engineers to build a quality product is to be involved early, drive progress, and stay close to our end users.

Scaling free quality interactions between students around the world comes with challenges that live at the intersection of UX, people ops, and technology. We need to both meet learner / tutor needs while ensuring that these interactions stay high quality and safe.

Some examples of what we’ve worked on include:

 - Building an AI simulation & coach to help tutors practice for their first tutoring session

 - Experimenting with new ways to connect tutors to learners wanting immediate homework help

 - Creating a moderation system to automatically recognize and act on safety issues so humans can focus their time on the most important issues

Responsibilities

 - Work with users and teammates to define problems, contribute product ideas, and lead work from prototypes / experiments through deployment.

 - Break ambiguous work into manageable steps, coordinating contributions when needed

 - Write simple, readable code and create / improve patterns that make future work easier.

 - Help teammates grow through code reviews and pairing sessions


ABOUT YOU

If this sounds like you, we’d love for you to apply!

 - [Senior] You’ve been a full-stack software engineer 3+ years and have a track record of leading full-stack projects from ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.

 - [Senior] You can anticipate risks and make decisions that balance tradeoffs between speed, quality, and user experience.

 - You have experience with Typescript, Node.js, React, Next.js, and Postgres (or can ramp up quickly).

 - You build for users & have a nose for understanding what would help them the most.

 - You move quickly while maintaining code quality. Perfect is the enemy of good.

 - You fill in the gaps — you ask for help, but still work independently to figure things out. If necessary you can put on another hat if it’ll help users the most.

 - You’re available to work in a US timezone.

Bonus points

 - You have deep technical experience with our stack Typescript, Node.js, React, Next.js, Postgres, AWS, and GCP.

 - You have experience building mobile apps.

 - You have experience working in education or on an ed-tech product.


LIFE AT SCHOOLHOUSE

 - Work with an amazing team. We’ve got folks with backgrounds in education, consulting, astrophysics, startups, and more.

 - Fully remote with flexible working hours. Meetings are in US Pacific Time mornings.

 - Take real time off. We have unlimited PTO & use it. Folks regularly take time off throughout the year.

 - Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. Work-from-home stipend. Professional development budget. Health, dental, vision (for US employees).

 - Semesterly retreats and monthly regional meetups

 - Make an impact you can see. Check out our community stories page https://schoolhouse.world/stories. Watch students help each other learn. See tutors grow into leaders. Your code will help real people learn and grow.


ABOUT THE APPLICATION PROCESS

 - We might make some adjustments, but our expected interview process:

 - A 30-minute intro screen to learn more about you and understand whether this role is a mutual fit

 - A 45-minute screen where you'll read some code and brainstorm / prioritize product ideas

 - A 1-hour programming interview where you’ll fix bugs and implement features on a toy repo

 - A 1-hour systems design problem where you'll design a data model / api and handle challenges at scale

 - A 45-minute culture fit call with non-technical team members

 - Reference calls

 

We’re building an inclusive and equitable platform for learners across the world, and it’s important our core team reflects these principles too. Research shows people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we strongly encourage to you apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.

jobs.title: Finance Manager - Corporate FP&A
jobs.description:
About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Finance Manager - Corporate FP&A to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. This role can be hybrid in Palo Alto, CA (preferred), or remote within the United States.

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, you will be a foundational pillar of the Finance organization—owning company-wide consolidation and executive reporting while leading financial data governance, and cash flow forecasting. The ideal candidate brings a rare blend of systems thinking, startup agility, and executive storytelling. You are just as comfortable architecting clean data hierarchies and automated workflows as you are zooming out to synthesize clear, strategic narratives for leadership. Beyond reporting the numbers, you will build the scalable processes and modern financial infrastructure that power decision-making as Wing grows.

What You’ll Do:

• Own end-to-end financial consolidation, managing the process, deliverables, and narrative synthesis for monthly financial reporting and the Annual Budget.

• Establish and govern the enterprise financial data taxonomy—across cost centers, chart of accounts, project codes, and location tags—to unlock scalable, granular reporting.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to design, automate, and implement the financial systems architecture that will power Wing’s growth.

• Design, chair, and operationalize Wing’s Spend Governance framework, including approval thresholds, contract review gates, and vendor commitment tracking.

• Build and refine Wing’s indirect cash flow and runway models in partnership with Accounting, Treasury, and Supply Chain Finance to forecast working capital and monthly cash burn.

What You’ll Need:

• 8+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance.

• Demonstrated experience owning full-company P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow consolidation.

• Proven track record scaling financial processes, data governance, and multi-dimensional reporting in a high-growth environment.

• Hands-on experience implementing modern planning, ERP, and BI systems and leveraging AI to automate financial workflows.

• Deep familiarity with GAAP accounting, three-statement modeling, and working capital and cash flow drivers.

• Exceptional storytelling skills, with a knack for translating complex datasets into clear, visually clean memos for senior leadership.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

• MBA, CPA, or CFA.

• Experience operating in hardware, aviation, logistics, supply chain, or multi-site physical operations environments.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is the salary range below + bonus + equity + benefits. Wing’s salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

Salary Range

$174,000—$181,000 USD

Wing is an equal opportunity employer and it is Wing's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. Employment at Wing is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Wing does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Regional Events UCANZ
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

As the Senior Manager, Regional Events UCANZ, you will be the regional leader responsible for the strategy, programming, production, and execution of Crunchyroll’s sponsored, partnered, and owned events across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. You will own the delivery of exceptional experiences for fans, licensors, partners, and internal stakeholders.

You will be accountable for the full event lifecycle—from vision, strategy, and inception through planning, approvals, production, execution, and post-event measurement. Success requires strong strategic judgment, creative ambition, operational discipline, and a deep understanding of anime, pop culture, streaming, and regional fan behavior.

You will partner closely with Franchise & Title Marketing, Creative Services, Operations, our Global Events Center of Excellence and Global Brand Center of Excellence teams, Japanese partners, licensors, and external agencies. You will serve as a reliable regional partner while advancing the principle of being “globally aligned, regionally relevant.”

Core Areas of Responsibility

UCANZ EVENTS STRATEGY & PORTFOLIO

• Lead the exploration and development of the UCANZ events strategy in close partnership with the Director of SVOD Marketing, UCANZ.

• Define the role of co-productions, sponsorships, third-party events, owned experiences, and adjacent opportunities within the regional portfolio.

• Build annual event plans that balance fan impact, business priorities, licensor needs, regional relevance, and operational feasibility.

• Research and recommend opportunities for event expansion, new partnerships, and future additions to the regional strategy.

• Establish a cohesive portfolio approach rather than treating individual events as standalone activations.

EVENT PROGRAMMING & EXPERIENCE INNOVATION

• Lead the innovation, planning, and execution of Crunchyroll’s presence at priority events, including Anime Expo, Anime NYC, New York Comic Con, Fan Expo Canada, and PAX Australia.

• Develop event programming and experiences that deepen fandom, strengthen Crunchyroll’s brand, and support content, membership, theatrical, and broader business priorities.

• Partner with the Brand Experience team and Director of SVOD Marketing, UCANZ, to create globally coherent, locally resonant experiences that support franchise growth and fan engagement.

• Foster the sharing of ideas, resources, and best practices across regions in support of the “globally aligned, regionally relevant” principle.

• Recommend event locations, timing, and programming in alignment with marketing priorities, content calendars, and Japanese partner needs.

EVENT PRODUCTION & EXECUTION

• Own end-to-end production for UCANZ tentpole events and key event executions, from briefing and planning through on-site delivery and closeout.

• Lead production agency briefing, alignment, and project execution, ensuring scope, timelines, quality standards, and deliverables are clearly managed.

• Work with direct reports and cross-functional partners to ensure content, creative, operational, and request needs are met.

• Review and recommend event plans, production approaches, and resource requirements.

• Take direct ownership and accountability for the quality, effectiveness, and results of regional event executions.

PREMIERES, SCREENINGS & THEATRICAL ACTIVATIONS

• Lead and oversee UCANZ premiere events for AAA theatrical releases as needed.

• Develop and deliver fan screenings and premiere experiences for lower-tier theatrical titles.

• Create scalable, valuable screening and “No-Con-Left-Behind” programs that can be used across regions.

• Connect screenings and premieres to broader title, franchise, membership, and fan engagement strategies.

PARTNER & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

• Manage relationships with Japanese partners, licensors, internal teams, agencies, and external stakeholders across key events.

• Lead executive tours and on-site stakeholder experiences that showcase Crunchyroll’s event strategy, innovation, and regional execution.

• Serve as a trusted partner to the Global Communications, Community, Brand Experience, and Events teams.

• Maintain strong alignment with the regional UCANZ Marketing team and ensure stakeholders are informed, engaged, and supported throughout the event lifecycle.

BUDGET, MEASUREMENT & OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

• Review and recommend event budget allocations in partnership with the Senior Director of Brand and Community, UCANZ, and event producers.

• Establish clear objectives, success measures, and reporting expectations for UCANZ events.

• Direct the event reporting process to evaluate performance and return on investment against expectations.

• Identify opportunities to streamline event processes, improve efficiency, and strengthen consistency across the portfolio.

• Produce and maintain shared event resources, including an asset catalog for key IPs and reusable giveaway designs, in collaboration with Marketing Operations and global teams.

HEALTH & SAFETY

• Lead the implementation and ongoing improvement of health and safety protocols and standards across UCANZ events.

• Ensure production plans, agencies, venues, and on-site teams operate in accordance with applicable requirements and Crunchyroll standards.

• Promote a culture of proactive risk management, preparedness, and accountability across the event portfolio.

TEAM LEADERSHIP & DEVELOPMENT

• Lead, support, and develop a high-performing regional event production team

• Set clear expectations, priorities, and accountability for direct reports and cross-functional event partners.

• Contribute to the growth and development of team members through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, and exposure to regional and global event work.

• Encourage shared learning, innovation, and resourcefulness across the events organization.

In the role of Senior Manager, Regional Events UCANZ, you will report to the Senior Director of Brand & Community, UCANZ.

We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

• 8+ years of relevant B2C event programming and production experience.

• 3+ years of people management experience.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-visibility events from strategy through execution.

• Strong knowledge of anime, pop culture, streaming, and current regional audience trends.

• Experience working in a global organization and/or delivering international events.

• Experience partnering with major events in the United States and Canada.

• Experience with, or a working understanding of, events in Australia and New Zealand.

• Having established relationships with event venues and vendor partners is a plus.

• Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate strategy, influence senior stakeholders, and represent Crunchyroll with confidence in high-visibility settings.

• Experience in identifying and managing creative event agencies.

• Experience managing and keeping track of budgets.

• Strong project management and keeping track of event milestones.

• Knowledge of health and safety protocols and standards across UCANZ events.

• Demonstrated ability to balance creative ambition with operational rigor and accountability for results.

• Experience working with Japanese partners and licensors is a plus.

• Japanese language proficiency is highly preferred.

About the Team

The UCANZ Events & Experiences team creates high-impact, fan-first experiences that bring Crunchyroll’s brands, titles, and communities to life across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Working closely with regional and global partners, the team delivers a connected portfolio of owned, sponsored, and partnered events—from major conventions to premieres and screenings—balancing creative ambition with operational excellence. Its success is measured by meaningful fan engagement, strong partner experiences, and measurable impact on franchise, membership, theatrical, and broader business priorities.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

• Employer paid commuter benefit

• Support program for new parents

• Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

#LifeAtCrunchyroll  #LI-Hybrid

The Pay Range for this position is listed. Actual pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Crunchyroll’s Total Rewards offerings for employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks.

$141,200—$176,440 USD

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

• Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

• Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

• Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

• Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
