Activities include: Building relationships with local businesses (e.g., mechanic shops, dental offices, furniture stores) and speaking with local business owners and their employees about how Oportun’s services can help their customers. Conducting outreach efforts at local flea markets, community events, and at our Lending As A Service (LAAS) partner locations to increase awareness, capture leads, and assist with starting applications; Actively engaging with people at and around Oportun’s retail locations, encouraging store visits, and assisting with applications. The right fit looks like this

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

• Must love to help members, including prospective members through outreach and educational activities.

Required

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager - West

Senior Account Manager, Customer Success (West)

Full-Time, Remote / Salary, Exempt / Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno is growing! We're looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our Customer Success team, the people who make sure every law firm we partner with feels like they're in the best possible hands. You'll be the go-to person for your AmLaw firms, the one they trust to get it right, and the glue between our clients, Account Executives, and the teams behind every deposition. We're a diverse team from all over the country (and beyond) and we're crazy about redefining the boundaries of an outdated industry.

Who are you?

You're the person clients are relieved to hear from. You remember that one firm wants the exhibits sent a certain way and that another always needs things yesterday, and you handle both without breaking a sweat. You're detail-obsessed, calm when a deposition is on the line, and happiest when you've spotted a problem before anyone else knew it existed. You like owning things through to the finish, you love building real relationships, and you know how to balance a busy inbox with the bigger picture. In this role, you'll be both a trusted relationship owner and an operational partner, working side by side with Account Executives, Scheduling, Operations, Production, and Billing. This role reports to the Customer Success leadership team.

If you're looking for a company that offers support, guidance, an abundance of killer giphys, and unlimited potential to grow into your best self, you can bet we'd love to have you too.

On a regular basis you will

• Be the primary day-to-day contact for your assigned AmLaw firms, delivering white-glove, personalized service shaped around each firm's preferences and workflows
• Partner with Account Executives to stay aligned on account priorities, client concerns, and opportunities to grow and improve the relationship
• Review and coordinate deposition orders through daily quality checks, making sure jobs are entered accurately and tied to the right firm and location
• Triage scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellation requests, routing them to the right teams and following through until they're done
• Spot urgent and expedited requests, communicate the urgency clearly, and rally internal teams to meet client deadlines
• Own first-line issue resolution, managing tickets with clear documentation, prioritization, and follow-up, and escalating high-impact issues to the right people
• De-escalate tough conversations with empathy and professionalism, then confirm the fix landed and the client is happy
• Keep clients informed with proactive updates and get ahead of questions before they become concerns
• Share what you're seeing, from recurring errors and ticket trends to shifts in client sentiment, with AEs and leadership, and help fix root causes
• Educate clients on Steno's products, services, and best practices, and flag opportunities for firms to get even more from our technology
• Pitch in on scheduling inboxes and ticket queues during high-volume periods, and join our after-hours coverage rotation for urgent, last-minute deposition needs

jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure Lease Accounting
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Director, Infrastructure Lease Accounting to lead technical accounting for our most complex infrastructure and energy arrangements — the data center leases and related structures underpinning our recently significant investment in American computing infrastructure. As we continue our rapid growth, you will ensure the financial statement accuracy of the most technically complex contracts we enter into.

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic accounts for the highest-stakes arrangements underpinning our compute and energy portfolio.

You will serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for arrangements spanning data center leases (ASC 842), and counterparty or joint-venture structures (ASC 810 VIE analysis). You'll work closely with Real Estate, Legal, Finance, and external auditors to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for Anthropic's most complex infrastructure arrangements, leading classification, measurement, and subsequent accounting judgments

• Apply ASC 842 to complex lease arrangements, including lease identification, modifications, reassessments, and embedded leases within compute, colocation, and data center contracts

• Apply ASC 810 to counterparty and joint-venture structures, including variable interest entity (VIE) analysis for special purpose entities

• Apply ASC 815 to energy and infrastructure arrangements, including consideration of embedded derivatives

• Lead technical accounting analysis and memo preparation for new arrangements, ensuring positions are well-reasoned, supported, and auditor-ready

• Partner with Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams during contract negotiation and execution to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made

• Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders — explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on

• Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors on technical accounting matters within your portfolio

• Mentor accounting professionals across the Infrastructure Accounting team on technical accounting matters

• Drive process improvements and automation, including leveraging AI tooling, to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of technical accounting work

Minimum qualifications

• Have 12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, with meaningful time in a technical accounting role

• Hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA required

• Possess strong technical accounting knowledge of ASC 842 (leases), ASC 810 (consolidation, including VIE analysis), and ASC 815 (derivatives and hedging), applied to real arrangements

• Have a track record of authoring and defending technical accounting memos on complex, judgment-intensive arrangements

• Demonstrate strong analytical abilities and comfort working with large, complex contracts and datasets

• Have a track record of improving scalable technical accounting processes in fast-moving environments

• Are adept at translating technical accounting concepts into financial implications for non-finance stakeholders

• Communicate clearly and influence effectively across cross-functional partners — Real Estate, Legal, Finance, and Procurement

• Have experience partnering with engineering, infrastructure, or operations teams to improve financial reporting and cost transparency

Preferred qualifications

• Background in a Big 4 technical accounting practice (SEC reporting / technical consultation) combined with industry experience

• Experience at hyperscalers, utilities, or energy companies with meaningful PPA, REC, or commodity-arrangement exposure

• Experience with renewable energy contracts, carbon markets, or related clean-energy accounting frameworks

• Exposure to data center and compute-related infrastructure arrangements (including colocation, dark fiber IRUs, and equipment leases)

• Experience with lease accounting software and derivative / hedge accounting systems at scale

• SQL proficiency for querying and analyzing large contract and accounting datasets

• Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure and associated cost structures

• Experience applying AI tooling (including Claude) to technical accounting research, memo drafting, or close automation

• Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results in rapidly changing environments

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Program Executive, Early Phase
jobs.description:
Location:  This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is seeking an experienced Program Executive to lead one of our high-priority development programs in earlier-stage clinical development. This leader will own the cross-functional strategy, execution, and governance required to advance a potentially best- or first-in-class therapy through proof-of-concept and key value-inflection milestones, while building a clear path toward later-stage development.

Working across Research, Development, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Translational Sciences, Medical, and other functions, you will align teams around the most important questions, translate emerging data into decisive action, and drive high-quality execution. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, challenges assumptions, and knows when to accelerate, adapt, or stop.

Primary Responsibilities

• Lead the integrated program strategy and development plan through early clinical development, proof-of-concept, and preparation for later-stage development.

• Drive cross-functional execution, governance, and decision-making against program objectives, timelines, and key scientific, clinical, and business milestones.

• Own program strategy, budget, resource planning, and investment recommendations, including acceleration, adaptation, and go/no-go decisions.

• Partner across Clinical Development, Research, Translational Sciences, Regulatory, Technical Operations, Medical, Biometrics, Finance, and other functions to build an integrated evidence-generation strategy.

• Evaluate emerging clinical, translational, regulatory, competitive, and operational data to identify risks, opportunities, and alternative development paths.

• Lead preparation for key health authority interactions and ensure alignment across clinical, regulatory, CMC, and evidence-generation strategies.

• Represent the program with executive leadership, governance committees, partners, and external stakeholders while fostering accountability, transparency, and high performance.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

• Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading therapeutic programs through early clinical development and meaningful value-inflection points, including first-in-human, dose optimization, proof-of-mechanism, proof-of-concept, or transition to later-stage development.

• Proven cross-functional leadership with accountability for integrated program strategy and execution in Phase 1 and/or Phase 2 development.

• Direct ownership of program strategy, budgets, resource planning, governance, and investment recommendations for complex development programs.

• Experience integrating clinical, translational, biomarker, preclinical, regulatory, and competitive evidence to make sound decisions with incomplete or evolving data.

• Experience leading or preparing significant interactions with FDA and/or other global health authorities.

• Demonstrated ability to lead matrixed teams, resolve competing perspectives, and influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end drug development and the ability to connect near-term decisions to long-term product and patient impact.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing therapies in CNS

• Experience with rare disease development, biomarker-driven development, patient stratification, or innovative proof-of-concept strategies.

• Alliance or partnership management experience.

• Success operating in lean, fast-paced biotechnology organizations where leaders move fluidly between strategy and execution.

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

Annualized Base Salary

$300,000—$350,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Attention: Job Scam Alert
Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to careers@praxismedicines.com.

jobs.title: Scientist I, Medicinal Chemistry
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is seeking a scientifically talented individual to join our world-class Discovery Research organization as a Scientist I, Medicinal Chemistry.  This individual contributor role will work as a key member of an integrated, multidisciplinary drug discovery team making significant contributions toward the discovery of important new drug candidates.

Responsibilities:

• Design and synthesis of biologically active compounds to support SAR: Analysis of biological data. SBDD based design of analogs. Planning and execution of the synthetic routes, synthesis purification of final targets.

• Recommend alternative synthetic routes, research new methods and techniques, and proactively seek out others to identify solutions to challenges.

• Present research findings to the Medicinal Chemistry team and management.

• Partner in the scientific activities of other outstanding medical chemists and cross functional team members and create an environment where all ideas are shared.

• Collaboration with external teams, CROs (contract research organizations).

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• D. with a background in synthetic organic chemistry and 0-3 years of postdoctoral or relevant pharma/biotech industry experience.

• Strong understanding of synthetic organic and medicinal chemistry.

• Experience with NMR, HPLC, and Mass Spectrometry techniques.

• Familiar with modern synthetic, organic chemistry techniques and instrumentation.

• Well versed in synthetic methodologies and can independently design and execute synthetic procedures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills to work with interdepartmental teams.

• Ability to multi-task, be efficient and well-organized, and work collaboratively as a team player with high energy in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills:

• Demonstrated experience in the total synthesis of complex molecules, including multistep route design, synthetic problem-solving, and stereochemical control.

• Experience in beyond Rule-of-Five (bRo5) small-molecule drug discovery.

• Experience in oncology drug discovery research.

jobs.title: Integrated Demand Generation Specialist III
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Integrated Demand Generation Specialist to support Meta's Developer Marketing team within Business Growth Marketing.

This role is responsible for executing integrated marketing initiatives across web, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and creative channels to increase conversion, product adoption, engagement, retention, and monetization.

Working alongside specialized channel strategists, you will translate marketing strategies into coordinated campaigns, drive conversion rate optimization and experimentation initiatives, develop lifecycle and cross sell programs, and leverage AI and automation to improve marketing efficiency.

The ideal candidate is a hands on marketing professional who combines strong campaign execution, analytical capabilities, and cross functional coordination with a demonstrated ability to turn marketing strategies into measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

Integrated Demand Generation and Campaign Execution

• Plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing campaigns across web, lifecycle, email, paid media, and creative channels.

• Manage campaign calendars, milestones, dependencies, approvals, and launch timelines.

• Translate channel strategies into actionable execution plans with clearly defined deliverables and success metrics.

• Partner with marketing strategists, creative teams, analytics partners, and external agencies to ensure successful campaign delivery.

• Identify and resolve execution challenges while maintaining campaign quality and deadlines.

Conversion Rate Optimization and Experimentation

• Establish hypotheses, testing methodologies, and performance metrics to evaluate campaign effectiveness.

• Analyze experiment outcomes and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

• Build dashboards, funnel reports, and performance scorecards to identify optimization opportunities.

Lifecycle Marketing and Monetization

• Develop and execute lifecycle marketing initiatives that increase product adoption, engagement, retention, monetization, and cross sell opportunities.

• Create audience segments, personalized journeys, automated triggers, and targeted messaging strategies.

• Partner with lifecycle strategists to identify customer engagement opportunities throughout the customer journey.

• Analyze lifecycle campaign performance and implement improvements that increase conversion and customer value.

AI and Marketing Automation

• Utilize generative AI, automation, and agentic workflows to improve campaign planning, execution, analysis, and reporting.

• Develop reusable AI prompts, templates, workflows, and lightweight agents that streamline marketing operations.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing processes and improve execution efficiency.

• Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and implement scalable solutions that improve marketing performance.

Creative Agency and Stakeholder Management

• Manage creative agency workflows from initial campaign brief through final asset delivery.

• Coordinate creative production across web, lifecycle, and paid media channels.

• Ensure marketing assets meet channel specifications, campaign objectives, and launch timelines.

• Track deliverables, identify risks, and resolve production dependencies.

• Maintain strong communication and alignment across internal stakeholders and external creative partners.

Required Qualifications

• 4 to 6 years of experience in demand generation, growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, conversion optimization, or integrated digital marketing.

• Proven experience executing integrated marketing campaigns across web, lifecycle or email, paid media, and creative channels.

• Hands on experience developing lifecycle marketing programs tied to product adoption, engagement, retention, monetization, or cross sell.

• Demonstrated experience designing, executing, and measuring A/B testing and CRO initiatives.

• Experience coordinating creative agencies, marketing stakeholders, and campaign deliverables.

• Strong analytical skills with experience developing marketing dashboards, funnel reports, and performance scorecards.

• Practical experience utilizing generative AI, marketing automation, or agentic workflows to improve marketing execution.

• Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and independently drive initiatives to completion.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with marketing automation, experimentation, analytics, content management, and paid media platforms.

• Experience with audience segmentation, triggered lifecycle journeys, next best action programs, and full funnel measurement.

• Experience developing reusable AI powered marketing workflows or lightweight agents.

• Experience marketing to developer or technical audiences.

• Background in B2B technology, SaaS, or product led growth environments.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to integrated marketing initiatives at Meta, combining demand generation, lifecycle growth, experimentation, performance measurement, and AI enabled marketing operations.

You will collaborate with specialized marketing strategists and cross functional teams to develop scalable programs that improve conversion, customer engagement, and monetization.

Success will be measured through experimentation velocity, improved conversion rates, lifecycle engagement, product adoption, campaign execution, actionable reporting, and operational efficiency.

Join a team focused on building innovative, data driven marketing programs at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The mission of Plaid's Product Security Team is “Improve our customer’s trust by assuring secure development and delivery of products and services,  minimizing risk to the ecosystem, and preventing security incidents.

Plaid's Product Security team helps engineering teams build secure products and continuously identify and reduce security risks. Our work spans security architecture and design, application security, vulnerability management, supply chain security, and security automation.

We work directly with product and engineering teams to identify risks early, influence secure architecture, and define security requirements. We build and leverage automated security capabilities to expand testing coverage, validate fixes, and reduce recurring vulnerabilities. As AI accelerates software development, our goal is to help Plaid maintain strong security without relying on manual reviews for every change.

This role is perfect for you if:

 - You enjoy understanding complex products and systems and finding security risks that are not immediately obvious.

 - You have strong application security fundamentals and are comfortable working directly with code and architecture.

 - You enjoy working closely with engineers and product teams to solve security problems early in development.

 - You can evaluate technical and business tradeoffs and influence architectural decisions.

 - You are excited about how AI is changing software development and how we approach product security.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 - Lead security architecture and design reviews for high-priority Plaid products, working directly with engineering and product teams from early development through launch.

 - Conduct threat modeling and technical security assessments of complex applications, APIs, distributed systems, and product workflows to identify material security risks.

 - Evaluate authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, sensitive data flows, and business logic to identify potential vulnerabilities and abuse cases.

 - Review application code, investigate security weaknesses, and validate that proposed fixes address the underlying risks.

 - Assess security implications of new technologies and product capabilities, including AI-powered applications and agentic workflows.

 - Partner with engineering leadership to prioritize material security risks, agree on mitigations, and track them through remediation or approved risk acceptance.

 - Identify recurring security weaknesses, define reusable security requirements and secure design patterns, and partner with engineering teams to implement preventive controls.

 - Leverage AI-assisted security analysis and testing to continuously improve security assessments and validate important security assumptions.


MUST HAVES:

 - 5+ years of experience in product or application security, with strong expertise in secure architecture, application security fundamentals, and technical risk assessment.

 - Experience leading security design reviews and threat modeling for complex applications, APIs, or distributed systems.

 - Deep understanding of authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, sensitive data protection, and common application security vulnerabilities.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to read application code, analyze vulnerability paths, and evaluate security fixes.

 - Experience assessing security risks in cloud-native applications and understanding the security implications of system architecture and implementation decisions.

 - Ability to communicate complex security risks, recommend practical mitigations, and influence engineering and product leadership.

 - Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and collaborate effectively across teams.

Nice to have:

 - Experience securing AI-powered applications or agentic systems.

 - Experience with penetration testing, vulnerability research, or security testing of complex business logic.

 - Experience securing financial technology products or systems handling sensitive or regulated data.





Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!



Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.



Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here https://plaid.com/legal/#candidate-privacy-notice.


Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. jobs.title: Case Manager - Tenancy Plus
jobs.description:
Why join Launch Housing

Launch Housing is an independent Melbourne based community organisation passionately committed to ending homelessness. From providing high quality housing and an innovative range of support, education and employment services, we bring solutions to homelessness under one roof for thousands at risk of, or experiencing the crisis and trauma of homelessness.  With over 400 staff working across 16 locations in metropolitan Melbourne, we combine direct action with advocacy, research and innovation to drive widespread change.
 
Our people are the backbone of our organisation and supporting their wellbeing and professional development is critical to our ability to help our clients and the community. We value lived experience and diversity in our staff, and provide high-quality training & supervision, wellbeing days, access to an Employee Assistance Program and much much more to ensure your career with us is fulfilling.
 
Don’t just walk past homelessness.  Join the solution.  

Our permanent and fixed-term employee benefits include:
• Contributing to useful and rewarding work and giving something back to the community
• Wellbeing days, ceremonial leave, carers leave and study leave 
• Flexible working arrangements 
• Purchased leave 
• 17.5% leave loading 
• 8 weeks’ gender neutral paid parental leave after 12 months of service for both the primary and secondary carer
• Training and career growth opportunities across Launch Housing
• A portion of your income can be tax-free by salary packaging your personal expenses
• Additional tax-free salary packaging on dining and accommodation expenses
• Positive, supportive and progressive work environment

About the opportunity: 
Launch Housing is funded to deliver the Department of Families, Fairness and Housing’s (DFFH) Tenancy Plus – tenancy support program in the north catchment of the DFFH North & West Region and in the inner/middle catchments of the DFFH Southern region.  

Tenancy Plus provides case management support to public housing tenants and residents and some community housing tenants to achieve positive client outcomes and prevent homelessness. Tenancy Plus operates with a strong focus on sustaining tenancies in consideration of a vulnerable and disadvantaged client group and works to address needs and risk factors that make tenancies vulnerable. 

The role of Tenancy Plus is to ensure that clients maintain safe, appropriate and sustainable accommodation by providing support to achieve goals and address issues that are impacting negatively on a tenancy. Case Managers  work within an outreach based support model of service delivery and provide a case management model approach  that includes assessment, case planning, case co-ordination and liaison. The Tenancy Plus program sits within the Foundational Support area of Launch Housing.


Maximum-term, part-time role (60.8 hours per fortnight) based at Collingwood, ending 30 June 2027.

jobs.description:

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
 
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.


Requisition #: 1943
Job Title: Senior Contract Vehicles Manager
Location: Hybrid preferred, open to remote for the right candidate
Travel: up to 10% per month
Position Summary
The Senior Contract Vehicles Manager is responsible for the administration, oversight, compliance, and maintenance of the company’s portfolio of GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, and MACs, as well as contracts corporate accounts and portals. The role ensures accurate data, compliant reporting, accessible systems, and smooth coordination with internal and external stakeholders. This role partners closely with Delivery, Project Control (PC), Accounting, Information Security, Personnel Security, Pricing, Procurement, contracts team members and other functional teams to ensure compliant, efficient, and effective contract vehicle execution and maintenance. The Senior Contracts Vehicle Manager serves as a trusted advisor to leadership, customers, Contracting Officers, and prime teaming partners, while leading initiatives to improve contract vehicle management processes, mitigate risk, and support company growth.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership & People Management
Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on contract vehicles within the Contracts function, providing guidance, mentoring, training, and consultation to contracts team members and cross-functional partners.
May directly supervise and manage contracts team member(s), including performance management, coaching, professional development, and career growth.
Support hiring activities, including resume review, interviewing, selection, and onboarding activities for new contracts personnel.
Lead contracts team operations as designated by the Vice President of Contracts, including but not limited to facilitating weekly team meetings, managing data calls, and designing and delivering internal contracts-related training programs.
Contracts Management & Negotiation
Lead and support the negotiation of contract vehicle artifacts, including but not limited to Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA), Teaming Agreements (TA), Prime Contracts and Subcontracts, license agreements, and other contractual instruments as applicable.
Serve as the primary interface with Contracting Officers, prime contractors, and prime teaming partners on GWACs, MACs, IDIQs, and BPAs, building strong working relationships and ensuring clear, effective communication,
Support delivery and growth teams in understanding and communicating contracting vehicle options and pathways to current and potential customers and Contracting Officers.
Advise internal stakeholders on vehicle related contractual terms and conditions, required flow-downs, risks, opportunities, and impacts to program execution.
Partner with procurement to ensure timely and accurate vehicle flow downs, including terms and conditions, LCAT requirements, ceiling rates, reporting, and other vehicle related requirements.
Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Spearhead process improvements for Agile Defense that increase overall efficiency, productivity, and effectiveness in relation to contract vehicle management.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with Delivery, Project Control (PC), Accounting, Information Security, Personnel Security, Procurement, Pricing, and other teams to align contract processes with business objectives.
Document and track vehicle compliance, ensuring all requirements are communicated and monitored for timely and accurate completion, including bid/no-bid selections, proposals submissions, sales traction, and other requirements.
Serve as an internal partner and escalation point to resolve complex, cross-functional contract vehicle related issues.
Identify and implement new ideas to streamline contract vehicle-related workflows and improve coordination across functions.
Compliance, Risk Management & Governance
Spearhead preparation for and lead participation in all assessment and audit activities related to contract vehicles, including GSA MAS annual assessments, ensuring compliance through thorough preparedness and risk mitigation.
Interpret and apply FAR/DFARS and other regulatory requirements, ensuring compliance across all contract vehicle phases.
Serve as a resource for compliance-related questions and escalation issues across the company
Documentation & Record Keeping
Document and maintain accurate contract vehicle records, key contract data, briefs, and supporting materials in accordance with company policies and audit requirements. Ensure all vehicles are properly documented in CAB artifacts and other reference documentation.
Participate in cross-functional workflows to support contract briefs, reporting, audits, and internal and external requests for information. 
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated experience company initiatives resulting in process improvements, efficiencies, and positive business outcomes.
Proven experience managing contract vehicles and related compliance activities.
Experience in reviewing, editing, and compliant execution of contract vehicle agreements.
Extensive experience managing the full lifecycle of contract vehicles, including pre-award, award, execution, and closeout.
Strong working knowledge of FAR/DFARS and government contracting requirements.
Experience advising program teams on contractual risks, opportunities, and flow-down requirements.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong attention to detail.
Ability to identify and implement new ideas to streamline and improve business processes across contracts and other functions.
Ability to effectively prioritize, multi-task, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environments
Demonstrated ability to build strong internal and external relationships. 
Preferred Skills & Competencies
Ability to manage competing priorities and heavy workloads using effective time management techniques. 
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and demonstrate flexibility.
Demonstrated initiative, drive, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Strong negotiation skills with an ability to balance business objectives, risk, and compliance.

jobs.title: Cluster Medical Head, CHAT-CEE
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

The Cluster Medical Head, CHAT-CEE leads an organization responsible for supporting better health outcomes for patients through understanding the current and future needs of patients and medical care. The incumbent will be a forward-looking, objective, matrixed leader, establishes both the strategy and culture to drive the organization towards delivering differential value to our key thought leaders and patients.

The Medical organization provides a critical bridge between the science and medical practice and is core to the collaboration between science/development and commercial/ market facing functions as well as BMS and the external collaborators/stakeholders. The successful candidate will work closely with peers and colleagues in the development and commercial organizations worldwide to support the delivery of the company's product and portfolio strategies. He/ she will bring a strong external focus and patient-centric approach. Most critically, the successful candidate will be a highly pragmatic, results-oriented, execution-minded leader.

Accountable for providing vision and delivery of a first in class medical model for a biopharma company with a robust pipeline, supporting multiple launches in the cluster. Effectively drive the review process and execution of the medical book of work including but not limited to investigators sponsored, phase IV research and real-world data generation, while ensuring the safe and appropriate use of BMS medicines. Building and applying core medical capabilities to support the medical delivery model. Develop, maintain and monitor processes/policies and ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements for global medical activities undertaken for launches and approved products. Ensure effective partnerships with the company's Commercial, Access, Regulatory and Development teams, and external stakeholders to develop post-marketing strategies that address key data gaps that are aligned with unmet medical needs.

Position Responsibilities

• Ability to lead and develop a cross-country organization with strength in medical, clinical practice and scientific expertise.

• Ability to motivate and engage an organization and lead through transformation (i.e., launch, integration, divestiture, new partnerships).

• Strong external customer focus and the ability to rapidly build a comprehensive and efficient network of external relationships.

• Ability to lead and influence at the company level, cooperating with global matrix functions, commercial, Clinical Operations and R&D teams.

• Excellent communication skills, and ability to represent BMS and complex scientific evidence at medical meetings and congresses.

• Depth of knowledge in therapeutic areas.

• Driving leadership and strategy in gaining access across all countries.

• Ability to lead Alliance partnerships across markets.

• Ensuring compliance in a dynamic business environment.

• Talent & Culture management. Embedding the BMS People Strategy and ensuring employee engagement, attraction, development and retention of talent.

Education & Experience Requirements

• Advanced degree required; MD preferred, with 10-15 + years of pharmaceutical leadership experience

• Demonstrated track record of leadership in a complex, matrix environment. Experience delivering successful results in a variety of business situations.

• Experience building and delivering Medical capabilities in a complex global organization

• Successful track record of leading through influence and working across complex, global organizational matrices

Leadership Capabilities

• Enterprise Mindset: Makes decisions, set priorities and creates strategies based on what will beneﬁt the whole. They build and maintain networks within and outside of the organization to both strengthen their understanding of the big picture, the market dynamics and business value drivers and leverage diverse perspectives, experiences and expertise to maximize performance.

• Authentic Leadership: Builds legitimacy through cultivating honest relationships. They generate trust by demonstrating the highest level of consistency between their words and their actions, especially under pressure. They are role models and promote an environment of openness.

• Change Agility: Is constantly thinking ahead and scanning the environment for opportunities. They are able to navigate ambiguity for themselves by demonstrating smart risk taking and personal resilience. They lead others through change by focusing individuals and teams on the highest priorities and simplifying work, continuously creating the context and engaging individuals. Talent Development Maintains a current and strategic view of talent management aligned with the organization’s priorities. This includes an understanding of the needs and diversity of the organization’s current and future talent. In addition, they proactively develop talent across the organization and engage external talent.

This role is a HQ based position with up to  40%+ international/domestic travel requirement.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

How We Work

Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways-of-working.

Supporting People with Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Wells Fargo is seeking a Teller to join our National Branch Network. In this front line, customer focused role, you will support customers’ everyday banking needs through in-branch interactions, completing transactions accurately while delivering a welcoming and reliable experience. As a primary point of contact for customers, you represent the branch through strong service, attention to detail, and genuine care.

As a Teller, you will build foundational banking skills while learning about customers’ needs and introducing them to helpful products, services, and digital tools. You will identify opportunities to support customers and connect them to the right banker for more detailed product conversations. You will work closely with branch teammates to keep daily operations running smoothly and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Ingénieur en Transformation Digitale :  Projet Qualité International » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en janvier ou Février 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de plusieurs personnes au sein du département  « Qualité transverse pour les sites internationaux  »  en charge de relayer les directives qualités Groupe d'Airbus Atlantic vers ses sites internationaux.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Pilotage de la performance Qualité : Administrer et analyser les Indicateurs Clés de Performance reconnus conjointement par les fournisseurs et les clients sur l'ensemble du flux de production.
• Modélisation de la maturité des sites : Concevoir et mettre à jour des diagrammes en radar standardisés pour chaque site international, sur la base de critères définis avec les experts métier d'Airbus Atlantic.
• Harmonisation et synergie inter-sites : Collaborer avec l'Expert Qualité pour démontrer statistiquement l'alignement progressif des standards et agir comme véritable facilitateur de la transversalisation entre les entités.
• Accompagnement de la transformation IA : Participer au déploiement et à la transversalisation des cas d'usage IA (notamment via l'écosystème Google Gemini / Gems) au sein des processus métiers opérationnels de la Qualité.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation

• Management de projet & Conduite du changement : Structuration d'une feuille de route d'harmonisation de standards complexes, accompagnement des utilisateurs dans l'adoption de nouveaux outils IA (Google Gemini) et pilotage des jalons d'avancement.
• Ingénierie de la Performance & Data Analytics : Modélisation et suivi de tableaux de bord Qualité, analyse statistique de la convergence des données inter-sites et cartographie de maturité via des représentations graphiques avancées (spider graphs).
• Communication multiculturelle & Management transversal : Animation d'ateliers de travail et de réunions d'alignement en anglais avec des équipes internationales, rédaction de synthèses décisionnelles pour la direction et posture d'influence sans lien hiérarchique.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de Numérique et Informatique ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Maîtrise des concepts de la gestion de projet et de la gouvernance des données / IA.
• Connaissance globale des méthodologies d'amélioration continue et de gestion de la qualité.
• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication,Capacité d'adaptation
• Anglais: avancé
• Français : courant
• Portugais, marocain ou tunisien serait un plus : intermédiaire

Vous pourrez être amené(e) à vous déplacer avec votre tuteur.

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

In order to support dynamics parts availability for H135 and H135 programs, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Dynamics parts Supply - H135 & H145 Responsible (d/f/m)

You will be part of the Customer Support organization, responsible for managing stock, backorders, and supplier performance, as well as ensuring the accuracy and availability of estimated delivery dates for elementary parts. This function directly supports dynamic spares and MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) activities for the H135 and H145 programs—an essential role in supporting the overhaul and repair of dynamic assemblies.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for the Dynamic Spares Supply team in Donauwörth and join the Rotor and Transmission Center of Excellence (CoE) community.

In this role, you will provide MRO workshops and Front Office teams with clear visibility into parts availability, enabling them to effectively plan their activities and optimize stock levels.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Our Benefits for You

• Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
• Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
• Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
• Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
• Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• Oversee spare parts performance for Dynamics elementary components across the H135 and H145 programs.
• Act as the primary point of contact between Donauwörth, Airbus Helicopters Technik , Airbus Helicopters Inc. (AHI), Kawasaki, and external suppliers.
• Improve forecast accuracy and worldwide parts management to give suppliers clear visibility on S&OP capacity horizons and potential shortages.
• Provide MRO workshops and Front Office teams with clear visibility on parts availability to effectively plan their activities and optimize stock levels.

An opportunity for an Aircraft Static Loads Engineer within Flight Physics has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

2) Aerodynamics, Structures.
3) Maths, Programming.

• Loads models building for flight and ground loads.

• Continuous software development and maintenance of methods and tools for loads calculation.
• Writing certification documents and presentation to Airworthiness Authorities.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Digitalisation d'un atelier de maintenance mécanique (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en mars 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 24 personnes au sein du département Manufacturing Engineering en charge des activités de maintenance mécanique du site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Support à la migration ERP : Accompagner la transition vers notre système SAP.
• Digitalisation des activités de maintenance : Faciliter le travail sur le terrain (recherche de pièces, traçabilité, gestion des ordres de travail...).
• Pilotage de la performance : Construire ou reconstruire des indicateurs de performance (KPIs) pertinents pour le département.

• Systèmes d’Information et ERP : Compréhension approfondie de l'architecture et du fonctionnement des outils de gestion.
• Analyse de données et Data Visualisation : Création de tableaux de bord impactants qui aident à la décision.
• Digitalisation et Gestion de projet : Déploiement de solutions et accompagnement au changement auprès des équipes.
• Expertise de l'industrie et de la maintenance : Compréhension des flux logistiques ou de maintenance (ordres de travail, gestion des stocks de pièces détachées) et maîtrise pratique des outils de GMAO (Gestion de Maintenance Assistée par Ordinateur).

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans les domaines de Génie Industriel, Systèmes d'Information (SI) ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Vous avez une forte appétence pour les systèmes d'information et la digitalisation des processus. Une première connaissance du fonctionnement d'un ERP (idéalement SAP) ou des outils de GMAO est un réel atout.
• Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, en particulier Excel (fonctions avancées, TCD), et êtes à l'aise avec la manipulation et l'analyse de données. La connaissance d'un outil de Data Visualisation (Power BI, Tableau...) serait un plus très apprécié.
• Vos atouts (Savoir être): Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation

Langues:

Anglais  :  intermédiaire

Français : courant

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.
